/Battlepass/LongSetName.oracleText: Magic: The Gathering® | Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

AbilityHanger/AbilityType/Fight_Body.oracleText: When two creatures fight each deals noncombat damage equal to its power to the other.
AbilityHanger/AbilityType/Fight_Body.translation: 两个生物各向对方造成等同于本身力量的伤害。

AbilityHanger/AbilityType/Goad_Body.oracleText: Until your next turn, a goaded creature attacks each combat if able. In games with more than two players, it attacks a player other than you if able.
AbilityHanger/AbilityType/Goad_Body.translation: 直到你的下一个回合，被煽惑的生物每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击，且若能攻击使其被煽惑之永久物、咒语或异能的操控者以外的牌手，则必须如此作。

AbilityHanger/AbilityType/WinsTheFight_B.oracleText: If two creatures fight, each deals noncombat damage equal to its power to the other. A creature wins the fight if it is the only one that survives this damage.
AbilityHanger/AbilityType/WinsTheFight_B.translation: 如果两个生物互斗，它们各向对方造成等同于本身力量的非战斗伤害。如果仅有一个生物存活，该生物赢得互斗。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Adamant.oracleText: This spell has an additional effect if cast with three mana of the indicated color.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Adamant.translation: 如果施放此咒语时支付过至少三点提及的法术力，则此咒语获得额外效应。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Addendum.oracleText: This spell has an additional effect if you cast it during your main phase.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Addendum.translation: 如果你是在你的行动阶段施放此咒语，则它具有额外效应。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Annihilator_1_.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, defending player sacrifices a permanent.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Annihilator_1_.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，防御牌手牺牲一个永久物。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Annihilator_N_.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, defending player sacrifices {numeral} permanents.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Annihilator_N_.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，防御牌手牺牲{numeral}个永久物。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Annihilator_X_.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, defending player sacrifices X permanents.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Annihilator_X_.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，防御牌手牺牲X个永久物。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Ascend.oracleText: If you control ten or more permanents, you get the city's blessing for the rest of the game.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Ascend.translation: 如果你操控十个或更多永久物，则于这盘游戏接下来的时段中，你得到黄金城祝福。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/BeholdAHero_Bo.oracleText: To behold a Hero, choose a Hero you control or reveal a Hero card from your hand.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/BeholdAHero_Bo.translation: 请援英雄的流程是选择一个由你操控的英雄或从手上展示一张英雄牌。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Body.oracleText: Choose a creature you control with the chosen type or reveal a creature card with the chosen type from your hand.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Body.translation: 选择一个由你操控且为所选类别生物，或从你手上展示一张为所选类别的生物牌。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Dragon_.oracleText: To behold a Dragon, choose a Dragon you control or reveal a Dragon card from your hand.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Dragon_.translation: 请援龙的流程是选择一个由你操控的龙或从手上展示一张龙牌。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Element.oracleText: To behold an Elemental, choose an Elemental you control or reveal an Elemental card from your hand.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Element.translation: 请援元素的流程是选择一个由你操控的元素或从手上展示一张元素牌。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Elf_Bod.oracleText: To behold an Elf, choose an Elf you control or reveal an Elf card from your hand.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Elf_Bod.translation: 请援妖精的流程是选择一个由你操控的妖精或从手上展示一张妖精牌。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Gamma_C.oracleText: To behold a Gamma Creature, choose a Gamma Creature you control or reveal a Gamma Creature card from your hand.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Gamma_C.translation: 请援伽马人生物的流程是选择一个由你操控的伽马人生物或从手上展示一张伽马人生物牌。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Goblin_.oracleText: To behold a Goblin, choose a Goblin you control or reveal a Goblin card from your hand.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Goblin_.translation: 请援鬼怪的流程是选择一个由你操控的鬼怪或从手上展示一张鬼怪牌。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Kithkin.oracleText: To behold a Kithkin, choose a Kithkin you control or reveal a Kithkin card from your hand.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Kithkin.translation: 请援洁英的流程是选择一个由你操控的洁英或从手上展示一张洁英牌。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Merfolk.oracleText: To behold a Merfolk, choose a Merfolk you control or reveal a Merfolk card from your hand.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Behold_Merfolk.translation: 请援人鱼的流程是选择一个由你操控的人鱼或从手上展示一张人鱼牌。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/ChooseABackgro.oracleText: You can have a Background as a second Commander. At this time, Backgrounds are not on Arena.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/ChooseABackgro.translation: 你能用一个身世当作第二指挥官。目前身世并未在MTG竞技场中推出。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Cipher_Body.oracleText: After casting you may imprint this card on a creature you control. If you do, whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player you may cast a copy of this spell without paying its mana cost.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Cipher_Body.translation: 在施放后你可以放逐此牌，并赋码于一个由你操控的生物上。若你如此作，每当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，你可以复制此牌，同时可以施放此复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/CollectEvidenc.oracleText: To collect evidence {numeral}, exile cards with total mana value {numeral} or greater from your graveyard.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/CollectEvidenc.translation: 要搜证{numeral}，从你坟墓场中放逐任意数量的牌，这些牌的法术力值加总须达到{numeral}更多。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/CollectEvidenc.oracleText: To collect evidence X, exile cards with total mana value X or greater from your graveyard.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/CollectEvidenc.translation: 要搜证X，从你坟墓场中放逐任意数量的牌，这些牌的法术力值加总须达到X更多。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Constellation.oracleText: This ability triggers when an enchantment enters the battlefield under your control.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Constellation.translation: 当一个结界在你的操控下进战场时，触发此异能。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/EarthBend_N_Bo.oracleText: Target land you control becomes a 0/0 land creature with haste. Put {numeral} +1/+1 counters on it. When it dies or is put into exile, return it to the battlefield tapped.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/EarthBend_N_Bo.translation: 目标由你操控的地成为0/0，具敏捷异能的生物，且仍然是地。在其上放置{numeral}个+1/+1指示物。当它死去或被放逐时，将它横置移回战场。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/EarthBend_X_Bo.oracleText: Target land you control becomes a 0/0 land creature with haste. Put X +1/+1 counters on it. When it dies or is put into exile, return it to the battlefield tapped.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/EarthBend_X_Bo.translation: 目标由你操控的地成为0/0，具敏捷异能的生物，且仍然是地。在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物。当它死去或被放逐时，将它横置移回战场。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Enrage.oracleText: This ability triggers whenever this creature takes damage.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Enrage.translation: 每当此生物受到伤害时，便会触发此异能。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Firebending_N_.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, add {mana}. This mana lasts until end of combat.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Firebending_N_.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，加{mana}。这份法术力能留至战斗结束。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Firebending_X_.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, add X {oR}. This mana lasts until end of combat.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Firebending_X_.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，加X点{oR}。这份法术力能留至战斗结束。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/ForMirrodin_Bo.oracleText: When this Equipment enters the battlefield, create a 2/2 red Rebel creature token, then attach this to it.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/ForMirrodin_Bo.translation: 当此武具进战场时，派出一个2/2红色反抗军衍生生物，然后将它贴附于其上。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Fuse_Body.oracleText: You may cast one or both halves of this card out of your hand.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Fuse_Body.translation: 你可以选择从你手牌中一同施放该连体牌的两边，而非选择其中一边。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Gift_Card_Body.oracleText: You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they draw a card before its other effects.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Gift_Card_Body.translation: 你施放此咒语时可以应诺礼赠一位对手。如果你如此作，则该牌手在此咒语其他效应之前先抓一张牌。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Gift_Fish_Body.oracleText: You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they create a tapped Fish token before its other effects.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Gift_Fish_Body.translation: 你施放此咒语时可以应诺礼赠一位对手。如果你如此作，则该牌手在此咒语其他效应之前先派出一个已横置的鱼衍生生物。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Gift_Food_Body.oracleText: You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they create a Food token before its other effects.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Gift_Food_Body.translation: 你施放此咒语时可以应诺礼赠一位对手。如果你如此作，则该牌手在此咒语其他效应之前先派出一个食品衍生物。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Gift_Rhystic_S.oracleText: You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they conjure a card named Rhystic Study onto the battlefield before its other effects.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Gift_Rhystic_S.translation: 你施放此咒语时可以应诺礼赠一位对手。如果你如此作，则该牌手在此咒语其他效应之前将一张名称为琉晶研究的牌幻变进战场。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Gift_Treasure_.oracleText: You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they create a Treasure token before its other effects.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Gift_Treasure_.translation: 你施放此咒语时可以应诺礼赠一位对手。如果你如此作，则该牌手在此咒语其他效应之前先派出一个珍宝衍生物。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Impending_Body.oracleText: If you cast this spell for its impending cost, it enters with {numeral} time counters and isn't a creature until the last is removed. At the beginning of your end step, remove a time counter from it.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Impending_Body.translation: 如果你支付此咒语的隐现费用来施放之，则它进场时上面有{numeral}个计时指示物，且直到移去最后一个为止都不是生物。在你的结束步骤开始时，从其上移去一个计时指示物。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/InstantSorcery.translation: 当前是第{spellsCast}张瞬间／法术牌。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Intimidate_Bod.oracleText: A creature with Intimidate can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or creatures that share a color with it.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Intimidate_Bod.translation: 具威吓异能的生物只能被神器生物和／或与它有共通颜色的生物阻挡。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Landfall.oracleText: This ability triggers when a land enters the battlefield under your control.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Landfall.translation: 当一个地在你的操控下进战场时，触发此异能。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/LifeGainedThis.oracleText: You have gained {lifeGained} life this turn.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/LifeGainedThis.translation: 本回合中你已获得{lifeGained}点生命。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/LifeGainedThis.oracleText: Your opponent has gained {lifeGained} life this turn.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/LifeGainedThis.translation: 本回合中你对手已获得{lifeGained}点生命。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Magecraft_Body.oracleText: This ability triggers when you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Magecraft_Body.translation: 每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，触发此异能。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Melee_Body.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each opponent you attacked this combat.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Melee_Body.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，本次战斗中每有一位受你攻击的对手，此生物便得+1/+1直到回合结束。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Offspring_Body.oracleText: You may pay an additional {abilityCost} as you cast this spell. If you do, when this creature enters, create a 1/1 copy of it.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Offspring_Body.translation: 你施放此咒语时可以额外支付{abilityCost}。如果你如此作，则当此生物进场时，派出一个为其复制品的1/1衍生物。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Offspring_Refe.oracleText: You may pay an additional cost as you cast a creature with Offspring. If you do, when that creature enters, create a 1/1 copy of it.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Offspring_Refe.translation: 你施放具有繁生异能的生物时可以支付额外费用。如果你如此作，则当该生物进场时，派出一个为其复制品的1/1衍生物。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/OtherInstantSo.translation: 当前是第{spellsCast}张其他瞬间／法术牌。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/PowerUp_Body.oracleText: Activate each power-up ability only once. Reduce the cost by its mana cost if it entered this turn.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/PowerUp_Body.translation: 每个超能异能只能起动一次。如果其为本回合进场，则此费用会减去其法术力费用。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Raid.oracleText: This ability triggers if a creature you control attacked this turn.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Raid.translation: 如果本回合中由你操控的生物曾进行攻击，便会触发此异能。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Renown_1_Body.oracleText: When this creature deals combat damage to a player, if it isn't renowned, put a +1/+1 counter on it, and it becomes renowned.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Renown_1_Body.translation: 当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，若它未铭勇，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物且它已铭勇。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Renown_N_Body.oracleText: When this creature deals combat damage to a player, if it isn't renowned, put {numeral} +1/+1 counters on it, and it becomes renowned.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Renown_N_Body.translation: 当此生物对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，若它未铭勇，则在其上放置{numeral}个+1/+1指示物且它已铭勇。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Revolt.oracleText: This ability triggers if another permanent you control left the battlefield this turn.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Revolt.translation: 如果本回合中曾有其他由你操控的永久物离开战场，便会触发此异能。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/SpellsCastThis.oracleText: You have cast {spellsCast} spells this turn.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/SpellsCastThis.translation: 本回合中你已施放了{spellsCast}个咒语。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/SpellsCastThis.oracleText: Your opponent has cast {spellsCast} spells this turn.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/SpellsCastThis.translation: 本回合中你对手已施放了{spellsCast}个咒语。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/StartYourEngin.oracleText: If you have no speed, it starts at 1. It increases once on each of your turns when an opponent loses life. Max speed is 4.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/StartYourEngin.translation: 如果你没有速度，则从1开始。于你的每个回合中，当有对手失去生命时，此数值便会增加，但每回合限一次。速度极限为4。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Surge_Body.oracleText: You may cast this spell for its surge cost if you or a teammate has cast another spell this turn.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Surge_Body.translation: 如果你或你的队友本回合中施放过其他咒语，则你于施放此咒语时可以支付其潮涌费用，而不支付此咒语的法术力费用。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Suspect_Body.oracleText: A suspected creature has menace and can't block.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Suspect_Body.translation: 已遭疑的生物具有威慑异能且不能进行阻挡。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Suspected_Body.oracleText: This is a suspect! It has menace and can't block.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Suspected_Body.translation: 它是嫌犯！它具有威慑且不能进行阻挡。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Suspend_Body.oracleText: Rather than cast this card from your hand, you may pay {abilityCost} and exile it with {numeral} time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, you may cast it without paying its mana cost
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Suspend_Body.translation: 除了从你手上施放此牌，你可以支付{abilityCost}并将它放逐，且上面有{numeral}个计时指示物。在你的维持开始时，从其上移去一个计时指示物。当移去最后一个时，你可以施放它且不需支付其法术力费用。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Suspend_Refere.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, you may play it without paying its mana cost. If it's a creature, it has haste.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Suspend_Refere.translation: 在你的维持开始时，移去一个计时指示物。当移去最后一个时，你可以使用它且不需支付其法术力费用。如果它是生物，则它具有敏捷。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Teamwork_Body.oracleText: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may tap any number of creatures you control with total power {numeral} or more.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Teamwork_Body.translation: 你可以横置任意数量由你操控且力量总和等于或大于{numeral}的生物，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Toxic_Body.oracleText: A player dealt combat damage by a creature with toxic also gets poison counters equal to that creature's total toxic value.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Toxic_Body.translation: 受此生物战斗伤害的牌手还会得到等同于其总下毒值的中毒指示物。

AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Undergrowth.oracleText: This ability checks the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
AbilityHanger/AbilityWord/Undergrowth.translation: 此异能会检查你坟墓场中的生物牌数量。

AbilityHanger/CantSpecialize/Cant_Specia.oracleText: This permanent does not have specialized faces and can't specialize.
AbilityHanger/CantSpecialize/Cant_Specia.translation: 此永久物不具有精进牌面，无法精进。

AbilityHanger/CantTransform/Cant_Transfo.oracleText: This is not a double-faced card and it can't transform.
AbilityHanger/CantTransform/Cant_Transfo.translation: 它本身不是双面牌，不会转化。

AbilityHanger/CantTransform/Cant_Transfo.oracleText: This permanent is not double-faced and can't transform.
AbilityHanger/CantTransform/Cant_Transfo.translation: 它本身不是双面牌，不会转化。

AbilityHanger/CostChange/CostModified_Bo.oracleText: This spell's mana cost modified to {newCost}
AbilityHanger/CostChange/CostModified_Bo.translation: 此咒语的施放费用改为{newCost}

AbilityHanger/Counters/PoisonCounter_Bod.oracleText: A player with ten or more poison counters loses the game.
AbilityHanger/Counters/PoisonCounter_Bod.translation: 如果一位牌手有十个或更多的中毒指示物，则其输掉游戏。

AbilityHanger/Counters/ShieldCounterRefe.oracleText: If a permanent with a shield counter on it would be dealt damage or destroyed, remove a shield counter from it instead.
AbilityHanger/Counters/ShieldCounterRefe.translation: 如果其上有后盾指示物的永久物将受到伤害或将被消灭，则改为从其上移去一个后盾指示物。

AbilityHanger/Counters/ShieldCounter_Bod.oracleText: If this would be dealt damage or destroyed, remove a shield counter from it instead.
AbilityHanger/Counters/ShieldCounter_Bod.translation: 如果它将受到伤害或将被消灭，则改为从其上移去一个后盾指示物。

AbilityHanger/Counters/StunCounterRefere.oracleText: If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.
AbilityHanger/Counters/StunCounterRefere.translation: 如果某个其上有晕眩指示物的已横置永久物将成为未横置，则改为从其上移去一个晕眩指示物。

AbilityHanger/Counters/StunCounter_Body.oracleText: If this would become untapped, remove a stun counter from it instead.
AbilityHanger/Counters/StunCounter_Body.translation: 如果它将成为未横置，则改为从其上移去一个晕眩指示物。

AbilityHanger/DeckBuilder/CompanionViola.oracleText: This card invalidates your declared Companion. See the Companion's rules text for details.
AbilityHanger/DeckBuilder/CompanionViola.translation: 此牌会使你当前行侣无效，查看行侣文本了解规则详情。

AbilityHanger/Designation/ChosenCompanio.oracleText: This card is your chosen companion. Once per game you may pay {o3} any time you could cast a sorcery to put it into your hand.
AbilityHanger/Designation/ChosenCompanio.translation: 此牌是你选择的行侣。每盘游戏限一次于你可以施放法术的任意时机，你可以支付{o3}来将它放入手牌。

AbilityHanger/Designation/Commander_Body.oracleText: This commander will cost {cost} more the next time it is cast from the command zone.
AbilityHanger/Designation/Commander_Body.translation: 此指挥官下一次从统帅区中施放时，费用将增加{cost}。

AbilityHanger/Designation/Companion_Body.oracleText: If your starting deck meets the companion's restriction you may choose it to be your companion. Once per game you may pay {o3} any time you could cast a sorcery to put your chosen companion into your hand.
AbilityHanger/Designation/Companion_Body.translation: 如果你的起始套牌满足行侣条件，你可以将它选为你的行侣。每盘游戏限一次，于法术时机，你可以支付{o3}来将它置于你手上。

AbilityHanger/Designation/Earthbent_Body.oracleText: When this dies or is exiled, return it to the battlefield tapped under {playerName}'s control.
AbilityHanger/Designation/Earthbent_Body.translation: 当其死去或被放逐时，将它在{playerName}的操控下横置移回战场。

AbilityHanger/Designation/Goaded_Body.translation: 每次战斗若能攻击，则必须攻击。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Discover3_Body.translation: 从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张法术力值等于或小于3的非地牌为止。如果施放该牌所成之咒语的法术力值等于或小于3，你便可以施放之，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果你未施放，则将该牌置于你手上。将其余所放逐的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Discover4_Body.oracleText: Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value 4 or less. You may cast it without paying its mana cost or put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Discover4_Body.translation: 从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张法术力值等于或小于4的非地牌为止。如果施放该牌所成之咒语的法术力值等于或小于4，你便可以施放之，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果你未施放，则将该牌置于你手上。将其余所放逐的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Discover5_Body.oracleText: Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value 5 or less. You may cast it without paying its mana cost or put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Discover5_Body.translation: 从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张法术力值等于或小于5的非地牌为止。如果施放该牌所成之咒语的法术力值等于或小于5，你便可以施放之，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果你未施放，则将该牌置于你手上。将其余所放逐的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/DiscoverX_Body.oracleText: Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value X or less. You may cast it without paying its mana cost or put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/DiscoverX_Body.translation: 从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张法术力值等于或小于X的非地牌为止。如果施放该牌所成之咒语的法术力值等于或小于X，你便可以施放之，且不需支付其法术力费用。如果你未施放，则将该牌置于你手上。将其余所放逐的牌以任意顺序置于你牌库底。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Disguise_Body.oracleText: You may cast this card face down for o3 as a 2/2 creature with ward o2. Turn it face up any time for its disguise cost.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Disguise_Body.translation: 你可以牌面朝下地施放此牌并支付o3，将其当成 2/2、具守护2的生物。可随时支付其伪装费用使其翻回正面。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Disturb.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard transformed for its disturb cost.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Disturb.translation: 你可以从你坟墓场中施放已转化的此牌，且支付其惊扰费用。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/DoubleStrike.oracleText: This creature deals both first-strike and regular combat damage. (Does not apply when creatures "fight")
AbilityHanger/Keyword/DoubleStrike.translation: 具连击异能的生物能造成先攻与普通战斗伤害。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/DoubleTeam_Body.oracleText: When a creature with double team attacks, if it's not a token, conjure a duplicate into your hand, then both of them perpetually lose double team.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/DoubleTeam_Body.translation: 当一个具双打异能的生物攻击时，若它不是衍生物，则将一个副本幻变进你手上，然后这两者均永久性失去双打异能。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/DraftFromSpellbook.oracleText: Choose and conjure one of three random cards from this card's spellbook into your hand.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/DraftFromSpellbook.translation: 从此牌的法术书内随机的三张牌中选择一张幻变进你的手牌。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Dredge_Body.oracleText: If you would draw a card you may instead mill {numeral} cards and return a card with dredge {numeral} from your graveyard to your hand.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Dredge_Body.translation: 若你将要抓一张牌，你可以改为磨{numeral}张牌，且将一张具有发掘{numeral}的牌从你的坟墓场移回你手上。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Echo_Body.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if this came under your control since the beginning of your last upkeep, sacrifice it unless you pay its echo cost.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Echo_Body.translation: 在你的维持开始时，若你在你最近的维持开始后才开始操控该永久物，则除非你支付其返响费用，否则牺牲之。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Embalm.oracleText: You may pay the Embalm cost and exile this card from your graveyard to create a token that's a copy of this card, except it's white, it has no mana cost, and it's a Zombie in addition to its other types. Activate this ability only any time you could cast a sorcery.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Embalm.translation: 你可以支付遗存费用并从你的坟墓场放逐此牌来派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为此牌的复制品，但它是白色，没有法术力费用，且额外具有灵俑此类别。只能于法术时机起动。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Embalm_Reference_B.oracleText: Exile a card with embalm and pay its embalm cost: Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a white Zombie in addition to its other types and has no mana cost. Embalm only as a sorcery.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Embalm_Reference_B.translation: 放逐一张具有遗存的牌并支付其遗存费用：派出一个为其复制品的衍生物，但它是白色灵俑，额外具有原本类别且没有法术力费用。只能于法术时机遗存。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Emerge.oracleText: You may cast this spell by sacrificing a creature and paying the emerge cost reduced by that creature's mana value.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Emerge.translation: 你可以牺牲一个生物并支付化生费用用来施放此咒语，此时总费用会扣除该生物之法术力值。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/EmergeFromArtifact.oracleText: You may cast this spell by sacrificing an artifact and paying the emerge cost reduced by that artifact's mana value.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/EmergeFromArtifact.translation: 你可以牺牲一个神器并支付化生费用来施放此咒语，此时总费用会扣除该神器之法术力值。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Endure1_Body.oracleText: Put 1 +1/+1 counter on this creature or create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Endure1_Body.translation: 在此生物上放置1个+1/+1指示物或派出一个1/1白色精怪衍生生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/EndureN_Body.oracleText: Put {numeral} +1/+1 counters on this creature or create a {numeral}/{numeral} white Spirit creature token.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/EndureN_Body.translation: 在此生物上放置{numeral}个+1/+1指示物或派出一个{numeral}/{numeral}白色精怪衍生生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Enlist_Body.oracleText: As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. When you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Enlist_Body.translation: 于此生物攻击时，你可以横置一个由你操控、不具召唤失调且未进行攻击的生物。当你如此作时，将所横置生物的力量加至此生物直到回合结束。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Enweb_Body.oracleText: You may cast this spell for {abilityCost} if you also return a tapped creature you control to its owner's hand.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Enweb_Body.translation: 如果你额外将一个由你操控且已横置的生物移回其拥有者手上，则可以支付{abilityCost}来施放此咒语。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Enweb_Reference_Bo.oracleText: You may cast a spell for its enweb cost if you also return a tapped creature you control to its owner's hand.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Enweb_Reference_Bo.translation: 如果你额外将一个由你操控且已横置的生物移回其拥有者手上，则可以支付咒语的缠网费用来施放此咒语。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Equip.oracleText: You may pay the Equip cost to attach this permanent to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Equip.translation: 你可以支付佩带费用将此永久物装备在目标由你操控的生物上。佩带的时机视同法术。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Escalate.oracleText: Pay the escalate cost for each mode chosen beyond the first
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Escalate.translation: 第一个模式之外每多选一个模式，便须支付一次此费用。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Escape.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard for its escape cost.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Escape.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场施放此牌，并支付其逸脱费用。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Eternalize.oracleText: You may pay the Eternalize cost to exile this card from your graveyard and create a token that's a copy of this card, except it's black, it's 4/4, it has no mana cost, and it's a Zombie in addition to its other types. Activate this ability only any time you could cast a sorcery.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Eternalize.translation: 你可以支付永生费用并从你的坟墓场放逐此牌来派出一个衍生物，此衍生物为此牌的复制品，但它为黑色，是4/4，没有法术力费用，且额外具有灵俑此类别。只能于法术时机起动。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Evoke.oracleText: You may cast this spell for its evoke cost. If you do it's sacrificed when it enters the battlefield.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Evoke.translation: 你可以支付此咒语的呼魂费用来施放它。若你如此作，当它进战场时便牺牲之。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Evoke_Reference.oracleText: If you cast a spell for its evoke cost, sacrifice it when it enters the battlefield.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Evoke_Reference.translation: 若你支付咒语的呼魂费用来施放它，则当它进入战场时，将其牺牲。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Evolve.oracleText: Whenever a creature enters the battlefield under your control, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Evolve.translation: 每当一个生物在你的操控下进战场时，若该生物的力量或防御力大于此生物，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Exalted.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each instance of exalted among permanents you control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Exalted.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物单独攻击时，由你操控的永久物的每个颂威异能使该生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Exalted_Body.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each instance of exalted among permanents you control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Exalted_Body.translation: 每当一个由你操控的生物单独攻击时，由你操控的永久物的每个颂威异能使该生物得+1/+1直到回合结束。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Exert.oracleText: An exerted creature won't untap during your next untap step.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Exert.translation: 已耗竭的生物于你的下一个重置步骤中不能重置。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Exhaust_Body.oracleText: Activate each exhaust ability only once.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Exhaust_Body.translation: 每个竭绝异能只能起动一次。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Expend_Four_Body.oracleText: You expend 4 as you spend your fourth total mana to cast spells during a turn.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Expend_Four_Body.translation: 你在一回合中用到第四点法术力来施放咒语时，就算达到花销4。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Exploit_Body.oracleText: When this creature enters the battlefield, you may sacrifice a creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Exploit_Body.translation: 当此生物进战场时，你可以牺牲一个生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Explore.oracleText: Reveal the top card of your library. Put that card into your hand if it's a land. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, then put the card back or put it into your graveyard.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Explore.translation: 展示你的牌库顶牌。如果该牌是地，则置于你手上。若否，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物，然后将所展示的牌放回原位或置入你的坟墓场。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Extort.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay <sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xWB">. If you do, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain that much life.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Extort.translation: 每当你施放一个咒语时，你可以支付<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xWB">。如果你如此作，则每位对手各失去1点生命，且你获得等同于以此法失去的生命总和的生命。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Fabricate1.oracleText: When this creature enters the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on it or create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Fabricate1.translation: 当此生物进战场时，在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物或派出一个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Fabricate2.oracleText: When this creature enters the battlefield, put two +1/+1 counters on it or create two 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature tokens.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Fabricate2.translation: 当此生物进战场时，在其上放置两个+1/+1指示物或派出两个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Fabricate3.oracleText: When this creature enters the battlefield, put three +1/+1 counters on it or create three 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature tokens.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Fabricate3.translation: 当此生物进战场时，在其上放置三个+1/+1指示物或派出三个1/1无色自动机衍生神器生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Fading5.oracleText: This enters with 5 fade counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a fade counter from it. If you can't, sacrifice it.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Fading5.translation: 其进场时上面有5个消退指示物。在你的维持开始时，从其上移去一个消退指示物。若你无法如此作，则将它牺牲。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Fear_Body.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or black creatures.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Fear_Body.translation: 此生物只能被神器生物和／或黑色生物阻挡。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/FinalityCounter.oracleText: If a permanent with a finality counter on it would go to a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it instead.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/FinalityCounter.translation: 如果其上有终命指示物的永久物将从战场进入坟墓场，则改为放逐之。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/FirstStrike.oracleText: This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike. (Does not apply when creatures "fight")
AbilityHanger/Keyword/FirstStrike.translation: 具先攻异能的生物会比不具此异能的生物提前造成战斗伤害。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Flash.oracleText: You may cast a spell with flash any time you could cast an instant.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Flash.translation: 你可以于能够施放瞬间的时机下施放具有闪现异能的咒语。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Flashback.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Flashback.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场施放此牌，并支付其返照费用，然后将它放逐。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Flashback_Referenc.oracleText: You may cast a card with flashback from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Flashback_Referenc.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场施放一张具有返照异能的牌，并支付其返照费用，然后将它放逐。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Flying.oracleText: A creature with flying can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Flying.translation: 具飞行异能的生物只能被具飞行或延势异能的生物阻挡。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Forage_Body.oracleText: To forage, exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Forage_Body.translation: 觅粮的流程，是从你的坟墓场放逐三张牌或牺牲一个食品。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Forestcycling_Body.oracleText: {abilityCost}, Discard this card: Search your library for a Forest card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Forestcycling_Body.translation: {abilityCost}，弃掉此牌：从你的牌库中搜寻一张树林牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Forestwalk.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Forest.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Forestwalk.translation: 只要防御牌手操控树林，此生物就不能被阻挡。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Foretell.oracleText: During your turn, you may pay <sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="x2"> and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Foretell.translation: 于你的回合中，你可以支付<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="x2"> 并将此牌从手上牌面朝下地放逐，在之后的回合你可以施放它并须改为支付其预示费用。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Foretold_Body.oracleText: Your opponent may cast this spell on their turn for its foretell cost.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Foretold_Body.translation: 对手可以在其回合中支付此咒语的预示费用来施放它。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Graft2_Body.oracleText: This creature enters the battlefield with 2 +1/+1 counters on it. Whenever another creature enters the battlefield, you may move a +1/+1 counter from this creature onto it.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Graft2_Body.translation: 此生物进场时上面有2个+1/+1指示物。每当另一个生物进场时，你可以将此生物上的一个+1/+1指示物移到前者上。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/HarmonizeN_Body.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard for {abilityCost}. You may tap a creature you control to reduce that cost by oX, where X is that creature's power. Then exile this spell.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/HarmonizeN_Body.translation: 你可以从你坟墓场中施放此牌，并支付{abilityCost}。你可以横置一个由你操控的生物来将该费用减少oX，X为该生物的力量。然后放逐此咒语。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/HarmonizeReference.oracleText: You may cast a card with Harmonize from your graveyard for its Harmonize cost. You may tap a creature you control to reduce that cost by {oX}, where X is that creature's power. Then exile that spell.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/HarmonizeReference.translation: 你可以从你坟墓场中施放具有谐颂异能的牌，并支付其谐颂费用。你可以横置一个由你操控的生物来将该费用减少{oX}，X为该生物的力量。然后放逐该咒语。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Harness_Body.oracleText: Once harnessed, this permanent's Origin ability is active.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Harness_Body.translation: 一旦受掌控后，此永久物的起源异能便会生效。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Harness_UB_Body.oracleText: Once harnessed, this permanent's ∞ ability is active.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Harness_UB_Body.translation: 一旦受掌控后，此永久物的∞异能便会生效。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/HasFinalityCounter.oracleText: If this would go to a graveyard from the battlefield, exile this instead.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/HasFinalityCounter.translation: 如果它将从战场进入坟墓场，则改为放逐之。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Haste.oracleText: A creature with haste can attack and {oT} as soon as it comes under your control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Haste.translation: 具敏捷异能的生物受你操控时便能攻击与{oT}。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Heist_Body.oracleText: Look at three random nonland cards from target opponent's library. Exile one of them face down. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any type to cast that spell.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Heist_Body.translation: 检视目标对手牌库中的随机三张非地牌。将其中一张牌面朝下地放逐。于其持续放逐的时段内，你可以施放该牌，且你可以将法术力视同任意种类的法术力来施放。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof.oracleText: A player or permanent with Hexproof can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof.translation: 具辟邪异能的牌手或永久物不能成为由对手操控之咒语或异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof from Blac.oracleText: This permanent can't be the target of black spells or abilities your opponents control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof from Blac.translation: 此生物不能成为由对手操控之黑色咒语或异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof from Blue.oracleText: This permanent can't be the target of blue spells or abilities your opponents control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof from Blue.translation: 此生物不能成为由对手操控之蓝色咒语或异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof from Whit.oracleText: This permanent can't be the target of white spells or abilities your opponents control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof from Whit.translation: 此生物不能成为由对手操控之白色咒语或异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromAColor.oracleText: A player or permanent with hexproof from a color can't be target of spells or abilities your opponents control of that color.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromAColor.translation: 具有反某色辟邪的牌手或永久物不能成为由对手所操控之该色咒语或异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromEachCo.oracleText: A permanent with hexproof from each color can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control that are one or more colors.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromEachCo.translation: 具有反五色辟邪的永久物不能成为由对手所操控之单色或多色咒语或异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromEachOf.oracleText: A permanent with hexproof from each of its colors can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control that share a color with it.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromEachOf.translation: 具有反自身各色辟邪异能的永久物不能成为由对手操控之与它有共通颜色的咒语或异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromEachOf.oracleText: Hexproof from each of its Colors

AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromGreen_.oracleText: This permanent can't be the target of green spells or abilities your opponents control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromGreen_.translation: 此永久物不能成为由对手所操控之绿色咒语或异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromInstan.oracleText: This permanent can't be the target of instant spells your opponents control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromInstan.translation: 此永久物不能成为由对手操控之瞬间咒语的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromMultic.oracleText: A permanent with hexproof from multicolored can't be the target of multicolored spells or abilities your opponents control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromMultic.translation: 具有反多色辟邪的永久物不能成为由对手所操控之多色咒语或异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromRed_Bo.oracleText: This permanent can't be the target of red spells or abilities your opponents control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/HexproofFromRed_Bo.translation: 此永久物不能成为由对手所操控之红色咒语或异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof_from_Abil.oracleText: A permanent with hexproof from activated and triggered abilities can't be the target of abilities your opponents control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof_from_Abil.translation: 具有反起动式和触发式异能辟邪的永久物不能成为由对手所操控之异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof_from_Arti.oracleText: A permanent with hexproof from artifacts and enchantments can't be the target of abilities from artifacts or enchantments your opponents control, or Auras your opponents cast.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof_from_Arti.translation: 具有反神器和结界辟邪的永久物不能成为由对手所操控之神器或结界的异能目标，也不能成为由对手操控之灵气的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof_from_Mono.oracleText: This permanent can't be the target of monocolored spells or abilities your opponents control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof_from_Mono.translation: 此生物不能成为由对手操控之单色咒语或异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof_from_Plan.oracleText: This permanent can't be the target of planeswalker abilities your opponents control.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hexproof_from_Plan.translation: 该永久物不能成为由对手所操控之鹏洛客异能的目标。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hideaway4_Body.oracleText: When this permanent enters the battlefield, look at the top four cards of your library, exile one face down, then put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hideaway4_Body.translation: 当此永久物进战场时，检视你牌库顶的四张牌，将其中一张牌面朝下地放逐，然后将其余的牌以随机顺序置于牌库底。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hideaway5_Body.oracleText: When this permanent enters the battlefield, look at the top five cards of your library, exile one face down, then put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Hideaway5_Body.translation: 当此永久物进战场时，检视你牌库顶的五张牌，将其中一张牌面朝下地放逐，然后将其余的牌以随机顺序置于牌库底。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Improvise.oracleText: Your artifacts can help you cast this spell. Each artifact you tap pays for {o1}.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Improvise.translation: 你的神器能协助你施放此咒语。你起动完法术力异能之后每横置一个神器，就能为此咒语支付{o1}。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incorporate_Body.oracleText: A card incorporated this way costs {abilityCost} more to cast and is {color} in addition to its other colors.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incorporate_Body.translation: 以此法添补的牌张增加{abilityCost}来施放，为{color}，且仍具有原本颜色。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incorporate_Body_D.oracleText: A card incorporated this way costs {abilityCost} more to cast and is {color1} and {color2} in addition to its other colors.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incorporate_Body_D.translation: 以此法添补的牌张增加{abilityCost}来施放，为{color1}和{color2}，且仍具有原本颜色。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Increment_Body.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if the amount of mana you spent is greater than this creature's power or toughness, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Increment_Body.translation: 每当你施放咒语时，若你支付的法术力数量大于此生物的力量或防御力，则在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incubate1_Body.oracleText: Create an Incubator token with a +1/+1 counter on it and "{o2}: Transform this artifact." It transforms into a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incubate1_Body.translation: 派出一个上面有一个+1/+1指示物的抚育器衍生物，且具有「{o2}：转化此神器。」 它转化为0/0非瑞人神器衍生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incubate2_Body.oracleText: Create an Incubator token with 2 +1/+1 counters on it and "{o2}: Transform this artifact." It transforms into a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incubate2_Body.translation: 派出一个上面有2个+1/+1指示物的抚育器衍生物，且具有「{o2}：转化此神器。」 它转化为0/0非瑞人神器衍生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incubate3_Body.oracleText: Create an Incubator token with 3 +1/+1 counters on it and "{o2}: Transform this artifact." It transforms into a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incubate3_Body.translation: 派出一个上面有3个+1/+1指示物的抚育器衍生物，且具有「{o2}：转化此神器。」 它转化为0/0非瑞人神器衍生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incubate4_Body.oracleText: Create an Incubator token with 4 +1/+1 counters on it and "{o2}: Transform this artifact." It transforms into a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incubate4_Body.translation: 派出一个上面有4个+1/+1指示物的抚育器衍生物，且具有「{o2}：转化此神器。」 它转化为0/0非瑞人神器衍生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incubate5_Body.oracleText: Create an Incubator token with 5 +1/+1 counters on it and "{o2}: Transform this artifact." It transforms into a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Incubate5_Body.translation: 派出一个上面有5个+1/+1指示物的抚育器衍生物，且具有「{o2}：转化此神器。」 它转化为0/0非瑞人神器衍生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/IncubateX_Body.oracleText: Create an Incubator token with X +1/+1 counters on it and "{o2}: Transform this artifact." It transforms into a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/IncubateX_Body.translation: 派出一个上面有X个+1/+1指示物的抚育器衍生物，且具有「{o2}：转化此神器。」 它转化为0/0非瑞人神器衍生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Indestructible.oracleText: Effects that say "destroy" don't destroy a permanent with indestructible, and if it's a creature, it can't be destroyed by damage.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Indestructible.translation: 注明「消灭」的效应不会消灭具不灭异能的永久物，且如果其是生物，则不会因伤害而消灭。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Infect_Body.oracleText: A creature with infect deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters and to players in the form of poison counters.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Infect_Body.translation: 具有侵染生物以-1/-1指示物的形式对生物造成伤害，并以中毒指示物的形式对牌手造成伤害。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/IntensityCount_Bod.oracleText: Current intensity {intensityCount}. This perpetually increases by 1 when it intensifies.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/IntensityCount_Bod.translation: 当前强度{intensityCount}。当其强化时，其强度永久增加1。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Intensity_Body.oracleText: Cards start with 0 intensity, unless they have a starting intensity ability. Their intensity perpetually increases by 1 when they intensify.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Intensity_Body.translation: 卡牌起始强度为0，除非其具有一个起始强度异能。当其强化时，其强度永久增加1。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Investigate.oracleText: Create a colorless Clue artifact token with "{o2}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card."
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Investigate.translation: 派出一个无色线索衍生神器，且其具有「{o2}，牺牲此神器：抓一张牌。」

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Is_Cloaked_Body.oracleText: It's controller may turn it face up at any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Is_Cloaked_Body.translation: 如果该牌是生物牌，则其操控者可随时支付其法术力费用使其翻回正面。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Is_Cloaked_Title.translation: 此永久物处于匿伏状态

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Islandcycling_Body.oracleText: {abilityCost}, Discard this card: Search your library for a Island card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Islandcycling_Body.translation: {abilityCost}，弃掉此牌：从你的牌库中搜寻一张海岛牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Islandwalk_Body.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls an Island.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Islandwalk_Body.translation: 只要防御牌手操控海岛，此生物便不能被阻挡。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Job_Select_Body.oracleText: When this Equipment enters, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token, then attach this to it.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Job_Select_Body.translation: 当此武具进场时，派出一个1/1无色英雄衍生生物，然后将它贴附于其上。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Jump-start.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs. Then exile this card.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Jump-start.translation: 你可以从你的坟墓场施放此牌，但必须支付其所需费用并额外弃一张牌。然后放逐此牌。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Kicker.oracleText: You may pay an additional cost as you cast this spell.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Kicker.translation: 你施放此咒语时可以支付额外费用。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Learn.oracleText: You may reveal a Lesson card you own from outside the game and put it into your hand, or discard a card to draw a card.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Learn.translation: 你可以弃一张牌。若你如此作，则抓一张牌。如果你未弃牌，则你可以从游戏外展示一张由你拥有的课程牌，并将它置于你手上。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Lifelink.oracleText: Damage dealt by a creature, planeswalker or spell with lifelink also causes its controller to gain that much life.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Lifelink.translation: 具系命异能之生物、鹏洛客或咒语造成的伤害，会让其操控者获得等量的生命。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/LivingWeapon_Body.oracleText: When this Equipment enters the battlefield, create a 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ creature token, then attach this to it.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/LivingWeapon_Body.translation: 当此武具进战场时，派出一个0/0黑色非瑞人/病菌衍生生物，然后将它贴附此武具。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/LongListEnts_Body.oracleText: When you cast your next creature spell of that type this turn, that creature enters the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. {linkedInfoItems}
AbilityHanger/Keyword/LongListEnts_Body.translation: 当你施放你的下一个具有该类别的生物咒语，该生物进战场时上面额外有一个+1/+1指示物。 {linkedInfoItems}

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Madness.oracleText: If you discard this card, discard it into exile. When you do, cast it for its madness cost or put it into your graveyard.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Madness.translation: 若你将弃掉此牌，则改为将其弃到放逐区，若你如此作，可以通过支付其疯魔费用来施放之，若你未以此法施放则将此牌置入坟墓场。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Madness_Reference.oracleText: If you discard a card with madness, discard it into exile. When you do, cast it for its madness cost or put it into your graveyard.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Madness_Reference.translation: 如果你弃掉一张具有疯魔异能的牌，将之弃到放逐区。当你如此作时，支付其疯魔费用施放之，否则便将其置入你的坟墓场。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/ManifestDread_Body.oracleText: To Manifest Dread, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/ManifestDread_Body.translation: 显化惧象的流程是：检视你牌库顶的两张牌。将其中一张牌面朝下地放进战场，当成2/2生物，另一张则置入你的坟墓场。如果该牌是生物牌，则可随时支付其法术力费用使其翻回正面。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Manifest_Body.oracleText: To manifest a card, put it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Manifest_Body.translation: 显化某张牌的流程，是将该牌面朝下地放进战场，当成 2/2 生物。如果该牌是生物牌，则可随时支付其法术力费用使其翻回正面。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Manifested_Body.oracleText: It's controller may turn it face up at any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Manifested_Body.translation: 如果该牌是生物牌，则其操控者可随时支付其法术力费用使其翻回正面。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Manifested_Title.translation: 此永久物处于已显化状态

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mayhem_Body_Land.oracleText: You may play this card from your graveyard if you discarded it this turn. Timing rules still apply.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mayhem_Body_Land.translation: 如果你弃掉此牌，在同一回合中你可以从你坟墓场使用它，但仍须遵守使用时机规则。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mayhem_Body_Nonlan.oracleText: You may cast this card from your graveyard for {abilityCost} if you discarded it this turn. Timing rules still apply.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mayhem_Body_Nonlan.translation: 如果你弃掉此牌，在同一回合中你可以支付{abilityCost}来从你坟墓场施放它，但仍须遵守施放时机规则。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mayhem_Body_Refere.oracleText: You may cast a card from your graveyard for its mayhem cost if you discarded it this turn. Timing rules still apply.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mayhem_Body_Refere.translation: 如果你弃掉某牌，在同一回合中你可以支付该牌的疯乱费用来从你坟墓场施放它，但仍须遵守施放时机规则。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Menace.oracleText: A creature with menace can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Menace.translation: 具威慑异能的生物只能被两个或更多生物阻挡。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mentor.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature with lesser power.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mentor.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，在目标进行攻击且力量小于它的生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mill.oracleText: To mill a card a player puts the top card of their library into their graveyard.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mill.translation: 牌手磨一张牌指该牌手将牌库顶牌置于其坟墓场。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Miracle_Body.oracleText: You may reveal a card with miracle as it's drawn, if it's the first card you drew this turn. When you do, you may cast it for its miracle cost.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Miracle_Body.translation: 如果你本回合抓到的第一张牌为具有奇迹异能的牌，你可以展示之。当你如此作，你可以支付其奇迹费用来施放它。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mobilize_1_Body.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create a tapped and attacking 1/1 red Warrior creature token. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mobilize_1_Body.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，派出一个已横置且正进行攻击的1/1红色战士衍生生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时，将它牺牲。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mobilize_Body.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, create {numeral} tapped and attacking 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mobilize_Body.translation: 每当此生物攻击时，派出{numeral}个已横置且正进行攻击的1/1红色战士衍生生物。在下一个结束步骤开始时将它们牺牲。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Modified.oracleText: Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Modified.translation: 由你操控的武具，灵气，以及指示物是饰装。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Modular1.oracleText: This enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. When it dies, you may put its +1/+1 counters on target artifact creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Modular1.translation: 此永久物进战场时上面有一个+1/+1指示物。当它死去时，你可以将它的+1/+1指示物置于目标神器生物上。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Modular2.oracleText: This enters the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it. When it dies, you may put its +1/+1 counters on target artifact creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Modular2.translation: 此永久物进战场时上面有两个+1/+1指示物。当它死去时，你可以将它的+1/+1指示物置于目标神器生物上。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Modular3_Body.oracleText: This enters the battlefield with three +1/+1 counters on it. When it dies, you may put its +1/+1 counters on target artifact creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Modular3_Body.translation: 此永久物进战场时上面有三个+1/+1指示物。当它死去时，你可以将它的+1/+1指示物置于目标神器生物上。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Modular4.oracleText: This enters the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it. When it dies, you may put its +1/+1 counters on target artifact creature.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Modular4.translation: 此永久物进战场时上面有四个+1/+1指示物。当它死去时，你可以将它的+1/+1指示物置于目标神器生物上。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Monstrosity1_Body.oracleText: If this creature isn't monstrous, put a +1/+1 counter on it and it becomes monstrous.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Monstrosity1_Body.translation: 如果此永久物未蛮化，则在其上放置一个+1/+1指示物且它成为已蛮化。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/MonstrosityX_Body.oracleText: If this creature isn't monstrous, put X +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/MonstrosityX_Body.translation: 如果此永久物未蛮化，则在其上放置X个+1/+1指示物且它成为已蛮化。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Monstrosity_Body.oracleText: If this creature isn't monstrous, put {numeral} +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Monstrosity_Body.translation: 如果此永久物未蛮化，则在其上放置{numeral}个+1/+1指示物且它成为已蛮化。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Morph_Body.oracleText: You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for <sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="x3">. Turn it face up any time for its morph cost.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Morph_Body.translation: 你可牌面朝下地施放此牌并支付<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="x3">，将其当成2/2生物。可随时支付其变身费用使其翻回正面。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mountaincycling_Bo.oracleText: {abilityCost}, Discard this card: Search your library for a Mountain card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mountaincycling_Bo.translation: {abilityCost}，弃掉此牌：从你的牌库中搜寻一张山脉牌，展示该牌，将它置于你手上，然后洗牌。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mutate_Body.oracleText: If you cast this spell for its mutate cost, put it under or over target non-Human creature you own. They mutate into the creature on top plus all abilities from under it.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Mutate_Body.translation: 如果你支付合变费用施放之，则改为将其放置在目标你拥有的非人类生物的顶上或底下，他们合变做顶上的生物，并拥有底下生物的所有异能。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Myriad_Body.oracleText: When a creature you control with Myriad attacks, for each opponent other than the defending player, you may create a token copy that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control. Exile the tokens at end of combat. No tokens are created in a two player game.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Myriad_Body.translation: 每当一个由你操控且具繁影异能的生物攻击时，对防御牌手之外的每位对手而言，你可以派出一个衍生复制品，其为横置且正向该牌手或某个由他操控的鹏洛客进行攻击。在战斗结束时，放逐这些衍生物。在双人游戏中，不会派出衍生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Ninjutsu_Body.oracleText: {abilityCost}, Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Ninjutsu_Body.translation: {abilityCost}，将一个由你操控且未受阻挡的攻击生物移回其拥有者手上：将此牌从你手上横置放进战场，且正进行攻击。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Outlast_Body.oracleText: {abilityCost}, <sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xT" color="#FFFFFF">: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Outlast only as a sorcery.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Outlast_Body.translation: {abilityCost}，<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xT" color="#FFFFFF">：在此生物上放置一个+1/+1指示物。延生的时机视同法术。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Overload.oracleText: You may cast this spell for its overload cost. If you do, change its text by replacing all instances of "target" with "each."
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Overload.translation: 你可以支付此咒语的超载费用来施放它。如果你如此作，将其中的“目标”字样全部更改为“每个”。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Paradigm_Body.oracleText: Exile this spell as it resolves. After you first resolve a spell with this name, you may cast a copy of it from exile without paying its mana cost at the beginning of each of your first main phases.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Paradigm_Body.translation: 当此咒语结算时将之放逐。自你首度结算具此名称的咒语起，在你之后的每个第一个行动阶段开始时，你都可以从放逐区施放一个其复制品，且不需支付其法术力费用。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Parameterized/Scav.oracleText: {abilityCost}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to this card's power on target creature. Scavenge only as a sorcery.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Parameterized/Scav.translation: {abilityCost}，从你的坟墓场放逐此牌：在目标生物上放置若干+1/+1指示物，其数量等同于此牌的力量。只能于法术时机食腐。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/PartnerCharacterSe.oracleText: You can have two commanders if both have character select.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/PartnerCharacterSe.translation: 你可将两个具有拍档～角色选择异能的生物共同用作指挥官。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Shadow_Body.oracleText: This creature can block or be blocked by only creatures with shadow.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Shadow_Body.translation: 此生物只能阻挡具次元幽影异能的生物，亦只能被具此异能的生物阻挡。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Shroud_Body.oracleText: A player or permanent with shroud can't be the target of spells or abilities.

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Siege_Body.oracleText: A battle is a permanent type that enters with defense counters. As a Siege battle enters, your opponent will be chosen to protect it, while you can attack it. Damage removes its defense counters, when the last counter is removed, exile it, then cast it transformed.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Siege_Body.translation: 战役是一种带有布防指示物的永久物类别。于围攻进战场时，选择一位对手来防卫之。你可以攻击它。 伤害会使其失去等量的布防指示物，当移去战役上最后一个布防指示物时，围攻的操控者将之放逐，且可以施放已转化的此牌。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Skulk.oracleText: A creature with skulk can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Skulk.translation: 具潜匿的生物不能被力量比它大的生物阻挡。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Sneak_Body.oracleText: You may cast this spell for {abilityCost} if you also return an unblocked attacker you control to hand during the declare blockers step. It enters tapped and attacking.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Sneak_Body.translation: 你可以于宣告阻挡者步骤中支付{abilityCost}来施放此咒语，但须额外将一个由你操控且未受阻挡的攻击生物回手。它以已横置且正进行攻击之状态进场。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Sneak_Body_NonCrea.oracleText: You may cast this spell for {abilityCost} if you also return an unblocked attacker you control to hand during the declare blockers step.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Sneak_Body_NonCrea.translation: 你可以于宣告阻挡者步骤中支付{abilityCost}来施放此咒语，但须额外将一个由你操控且未受阻挡的攻击生物回手。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/SorcererRole_Body.oracleText: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has "Whenever this creature attacks, scry 1."

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Specialize_Body.oracleText: {abilityCost}, Choose a color, discard a card of that color or associated basic land type: This creature perpetually specializes into that color. Activate only as a sorcery.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Specialize_Body.translation: {abilityCost}，选择一种颜色，弃掉一张该色或与该色关联之基本地类别的牌：此生物永久精进为该颜色。只能于法术时机起动。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Spectacle.oracleText: You may cast this spell for its spectacle cost rather than its mana cost if an opponent lost life this turn.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Spectacle.translation: 如果本回合有对手曾失去生命，则你可以支付此咒语的揭幕费用而非法术力费用来施放它。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/SplitSecond.translation: 只要具有转瞬异能的咒语在堆叠上，牌手便不能施放咒语或起动不是法术力异能的异能。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Station_Body.oracleText: Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters on this Spacecraft equal to its power. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at {chargeRequirement}+
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Station_Body.translation: 横置另一个由你操控的生物：依其力量在此太空船上放置等量的充电指示物。蓄势的时机视同法术。达到{chargeRequirement}+后它便是神器生物。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Station_EternityEl.oracleText: Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters on this Spacecraft equal to its power. Station only as a sorcery.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Station_EternityEl.translation: 横置另一个由你操控的生物：依其力量在此太空船上放置等量的充电指示物。蓄势的时机视同法术。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Station_Planet_Bod.translation: 横置另一个由你操控的生物：依其力量在此行星上放置等量的充电指示物。蓄势的时机视同法术。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Storm.oracleText: When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Swampwalk.oracleText: This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Swamp.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Swampwalk.translation: 只要防御牌手操控沼泽，此生物就不能被阻挡。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/TheRingTemptsYou_B.oracleText: As the Ring tempts you, you get an emblem named The Ring if you don't have one. Then your emblem gains its next ability and you choose a creature you control to become or remain your Ring-bearer.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/TheRingTemptsYou_B.translation: 于魔戒引诱你时，如果你没有名称为魔戒的徽记，则你获得一个该徽记。然后你的徽记获得其下一个异能，且你可以选择一个由你操控的生物来担任持戒人。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Tiered_Body.oracleText: Choose one mode and pay its additional cost.

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Trample.oracleText: A creature with trample can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
AbilityHanger/Keyword/Trample.translation: 具践踏异能的生物造成之过量战斗伤害能对所攻击的牌手或鹏洛客造成之。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Unearth_Body.oracleText: {abilityCost}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step or if it would leave the battlefield. Unearth only as a sorcery.

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Unearth_Body_Gener.translation: 你可以在法术时机支付破坟费用将该牌移回战场。若你如此作，它获得敏捷异能，且在下一个结束步骤开始时或若它将离开战场，将它放逐。

AbilityHanger/Keyword/Vanishing1_Body.oracleText: This permanent enters the battlefield with 1 time counter on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter from it. When the last is removed, sacrifice it.

AbilityHanger/Keyword/WarpReference_Body.oracleText: You may cast a card with Warp from your hand for its warp cost. Exile that creature at the beginning of the next end step, then you may cast it from exile on a later turn.

Reprints from other sets are valid so long as they were also printed in Dominaria. Cards in sideboards are not counted.

其他系列的重印卡牌只要曾在多明纳里亚印刷过即为有效。备牌中的卡牌不计入统计。

与火花精灵的对局和直接对战均不计入成就。

The following changes to the MTG Arena banned list have taken effect:

Format
* {cardName} is banned
* {cardName} is unbanned

BanAnnouncement/Upcoming_Ban_Announcemen.oracleText:
Effective on {Date}, the following changes to the MTG Arena banned list will take effect:

Format
* {cardName} is banned
* {cardName} is unbanned
Cards banned in Standard will not appear in store or prize boosters, but will still appear in Draft and Sealed events.

BanAnnouncement/Upcoming_Ban_Announcemen.translation: 牌手收藏中每有一张禁用牌，便会获得一张同等稀有度的万用牌。

Card/Textbox/RingBearer_Body_1.oracleText: As your Ring-bearer this is legendary and can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.

Card/Textbox/RingBearer_Body_2.oracleText: Whenever this attacks, draw a card, then discard a card.

Card/Textbox/RingBearer_Body_3.oracleText: Whenever this becomes blocked by a creature, that creature's controller sacrifices it at end of combat.

Codex/2023/StarterDeck_BG_Description.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Fill up your graveyard with goodies to use, reuse, and abuse its contents against your terrified opponents!
Codex/2023/StarterDeck_BG_Description.translation: <color #CCCCCC>用好东西填满你的坟墓场，使用、重复使用和滥用它的内容来对付你惊恐的对手!

Codex/2023/StarterDeck_BR_Description.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Control the battlefield and your opponents with potent artifacts, then smelt them into something entirely new!
Codex/2023/StarterDeck_BR_Description.translation: <color #CCCCCC>用强大的神器控制战场和你的对手，然后将它们熔炼成全新的东西！

Codex/2023/StarterDeck_GU_Description.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Create vast amounts of mana to set loose giant creatures far quicker than your opponents could ever expect!
Codex/2023/StarterDeck_GU_Description.translation: <color #CCCCCC>创造大量的法术力，以比你的对手想象的更快的速度释放巨型生物！

Codex/2023/StarterDeck_GW_Description.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Flood the battlefield with creatures of all shapes and sizes and get ready to party!
Codex/2023/StarterDeck_GW_Description.translation: <color #CCCCCC>用各种形状和大小的生物充斥战场，准备参加派对！

Codex/2023/StarterDeck_RG_Description.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Unleash your ferocious werewolves at night to stalk your unsuspecting prey. Awooo!
Codex/2023/StarterDeck_RG_Description.translation: <color #CCCCCC>晚上释放你凶猛的狼人来跟踪你毫无戒心的猎物。哇哦！

Codex/2023/StarterDeck_RW_Description.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Study the blade and harness the power of your samurai to unleash an avalanche of swords against all who would defy you!
Codex/2023/StarterDeck_RW_Description.translation: <color #CCCCCC>研究刀刃并驾驭武士的力量，向所有敢于挑战你的人施展如雪崩般的刀剑！

Codex/2023/StarterDeck_UB_Description.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Use your sneaky ninjas to strike your opponents when and where they least expect. Believe it!
Codex/2023/StarterDeck_UB_Description.translation: <color #CCCCCC>使用你的鬼鬼祟祟的忍者在他们最不期望的时间和地点打击你的对手。相信它！

Codex/2023/StarterDeck_UR_Description.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Combine instants and sorceries together to create something truly wonderous and claim victory!
Codex/2023/StarterDeck_UR_Description.translation: <color #CCCCCC>将瞬间和法术结合在一起，创造出真正奇妙的东西并取得胜利！

Codex/2023/StarterDeck_WB_Description.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Maintain the balance between artifact and enchantment spells, and all your opponents will fall!
Codex/2023/StarterDeck_WB_Description.translation: <color #CCCCCC>保持神器和结界咒语之间的平衡，所有对手都会倒下！

Codex/2023/StarterDeck_WU_Description.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Smite foes with your glorious angels as they fly over your opponent's creatures to count up the wins!
Codex/2023/StarterDeck_WU_Description.translation: <color #CCCCCC>用你光荣的天使粉碎敌人，当他们飞过你的对手的生物时，就可以计算出胜利的数量了！

Codex/2025/Precon_EPPFDN_RW.oracleText: <sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW"> Might of the Legion
