Codex/Decks_BasicLands.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>If you have a specific basic land in your collection, you'll be able to use as many copies of it as you'd like. Many basic lands from each set are already in your collection, but you can also find more in the Store from time to time!
Codex/Decks_BasicLands.translation: <color #CCCCCC>如果你的收藏里有某个基本地，那么你可以使用任意数量的该基本地。每个系列的普通基本地都已经在你的收藏中，你还可以在商店中找到更多好看的！

Codex/Decks_Collection.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Additionally, this is where you can view all the cards in your <color #E9E9F6><b>Collection.
Codex/Decks_Collection.translation: <color #CCCCCC>另外，在这里你还可以查看你拥有的所有卡<color #E9E9F6><b>收藏。

Codex/Decks_EarnCards.oracleText: <color #ED5922>You can earn cards in a variety of ways:
Codex/Decks_EarnCards.translation: <color #ED5922>你可以通过多种方式获得卡牌：

Codex/Decks_EarnCards_List.oracleText:
• Open in a booster pack from your collection (purchasable in the Store)
• Choose in a draft or Open in a sealed event that is not phantom (Cards in phantom events are not added to your collection, and most events are not phantom)
• Earn as a reward
• Craft using a wildcard of the same rarity
• Level Up your Set Mastery or Mastery Pass
• Purchase in the Store usually in a bundle.
Codex/Decks_EarnCards_List.translation:
•打开你收藏中的补充包而得（可从商店中购买补充包）
•从轮抽赛事中抽选牌张或在非幻影的现开赛事（幻影赛事的牌张不会添加到你的收藏中，且大多数现开赛事均为非幻影赛事）中开到而得
•赢取奖励而得
•利用相同稀有度的万用牌合成而得
•升级你的精研通行证等级而得
•在商店中购买而得（单卡通常只会出现在套装中）。

Codex/Decks_FourCopies.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>If you receive a card you already have four exact copies of, then you'll earn gems instead, since you cannot play more than 4 copies of any card in a constructed event.
Codex/Decks_FourCopies.translation: <color #CCCCCC>由于在构筑赛事中同名牌不得超过四张，如果某张牌你已拥有四张，而你又将获得同样的牌的话，则你会改为获得宝石。

Codex/Decks_Import.oracleText: You can also Import decks from outside of MTG Arena, and if you already have the cards, then you can jump right in! If you don't, then you'll be shown exactly how many Wildcards are required to finish that particular deck before playing with it. Wildcards can be gained from a variety of sources, including opening packs. Wildcards share the same rarity of Magic cards, allowing you to craft cards of that same rarity to use in as many different decks as you like!
Codex/Decks_Import.translation: 你还可以从万智牌：竞技场之外导入套牌；如果你已备妥牌张的话，就可以立刻用新套牌来进行对战！如果你牌张不齐的话，也会提示你还需要多少张万用牌才能完成相应套牌以用之对战。万用牌的来源多种多样，包括开启补充包，你可以将万用牌合成为与之稀有度相同的任何卡牌并用于套牌之中。

Codex/Decks_Intro.oracleText: The Decks scene is where you can Create and Edit decks before playing with them in constructed events and queues. Many players find that brewing new decks and modifying existing ones is one of the best parts of the game!
Codex/Decks_Intro.translation: 套牌界面是你创建并编辑套牌的地方。对于构筑赛事和匹配而言，你都需要先备好套牌才能加入对战。有许多牌手认为，不断酝酿新套牌创意，或是根据自己的理解调整现有套牌，才是本游戏的精华所在。

Codex/Decks_Reassurance.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>There are many cards in the game so while it's easy to get overwhelmed, if you stick with it, you'll be an amazing deck builder in no time!
Codex/Decks_Reassurance.translation: <color #CCCCCC>由于本游戏牌张众多，起初可能会面对各色选择不知所措，但如果你能够坚持下去的话，相信你很快就能成为出色的套牌构筑大师！

Codex/Decks_StarterDecks.oracleText: A good place to start is with opening one of the Starter Decks and adapting it to your playstyle. Or by adding in that new exciting card you just got (and probably removing an existing card to do so).
Codex/Decks_StarterDecks.translation: 一个比较好的上手方法，是打开一副新手套牌并按照自己的游戏风格调整其中内容，比如说加入你刚获得的强力牌张（这时可能要先移去一张现有牌才行）。

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Attacking_A.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Once you have cast a spell it resolves. If it's a creature, its two main functions are attacking and blocking!
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Attacking_A.translation: <color #CCCCCC>你施放完咒语之后，它就会结算。如果它是生物，则它的主要作用就有两个：攻击和阻挡！

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Attacking_B.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>To attack, you'll be prompted to declare your attackers, and can select the creatures to attack with. They will automatically tap, and head into the red zone. Creatures can't attack the turn you cast them because they have something informally called "summoning sickness" by default.
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Attacking_B.translation: <color #CCCCCC>当你要攻击时，游戏会提示你宣告攻击者，这时你就可以选择要派出攻击的生物。这些生物会自动横置并冲入战区。生物在你刚施放它的当回合中不能攻击，因为在通常情况下，它会受到俗称「召唤失调」之状态的影响。

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Attacking_C.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Once you've attacked, the other player can choose to block. Each creature can only block one creature, although the opponent may choose for all of those creatures to block the same creature. Unlike attacking, creatures that are cast on the previous turn are allowed to block - so be ready! After blockers are assigned, the attacking player then chooses how their attacking creatures assign damage if multiple creatures are blocking the same attacker, and then damage is dealt to both attacking and defending creatures accordingly.
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Attacking_C.translation: <color #CCCCCC>你宣告完攻击后，对方牌手便可选择如何阻挡。每个生物只能阻挡一个生物，但对手可以让他的数个生物一起阻挡同一个攻击生物。与攻击不同，在前一个回合施放的生物也可以进行阻挡——所以要做好准备！在分配完阻挡者后，若有多个生物阻挡同一个攻击生物，则由攻击牌手决定如何分配伤害，然后攻击生物和防御生物会相应地造成和承受伤害。

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Attacking_D.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Creatures attacking and blocking is one of the core elements to playing Magic, and this "combat math" can get complex, but there's a battlefield tactician in you just waiting to come out!
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Attacking_D.translation: <color #CCCCCC>生物之间的攻防互动是万智牌此游戏的核心元素之一，此处需要顾及的「战斗计算」可能会变得非常复杂，但或许你内里那颗战术专家的内心早已蠢蠢欲动！

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/BeginAndEnd_A.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>In most ways to play Magic, each player begins with a starting life total of 20 and draws seven cards to start. Players can then "mulligan" to draw a new set of cards until they find one they like. Each time you mulligan, you have to put a card from that opening hand on the bottom of your library, so decide carefully!
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/BeginAndEnd_A.translation: <color #CCCCCC>在大多数万智牌的玩法中，双方牌手都以20点总生命来开始游戏，并抓七张起手牌。牌手之后可以「再调度」来重抓起手牌，直到自己满意为止。但你每再调度一次，就需要将一张牌从最后决定的起手牌中置于牌库底，因此请务必谨慎抉择！

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/BeginAndEnd_B.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>And then throughout that game, each player will summon creatures that can attack players, and cast powerful spells that can affect the battlefield, or even call upon Planeswalker allies to help them claim victory!
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/BeginAndEnd_B.translation: <color #CCCCCC>在整盘游戏过程中，双方牌手都会试图召唤生物来攻击对手，或是施放能够影响战局的强力咒语，甚至召唤鹏洛客伙伴来帮自己赢下对战！

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/BeginAndEnd_C.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>A player can lose the game in a few ways. Usually, it's when that player's life total is reduced to 0. Another way is when a player can't draw a card because their library (face down deck) has zero cards in it. Or here on MTG Arena, if a player hasn't taken an action in a while, they will automatically concede. There are plenty more ways to win (or lose) a game of Magic, so keep an eye out!
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/BeginAndEnd_C.translation: <color #CCCCCC>这游戏有好几个落败条件。最常见的情况，便是牌手因为总生命降到0而输掉游戏。此外，如果牌手的牌库（牌面朝下部分的套牌）中已没有牌，而其又要去抓牌的话，这样也会输掉游戏。此外，在MTGA当中，如果某牌手在一段时间内未进行操作，其便会自动认输。万智牌游戏的输赢方式多种多样，还请务必留心战局！

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/BeginAndEnd_D.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>In between the beginning and ending of a game, is where all the good stuff happens! So whether you're playing a game of Brawl with a friend or a game of Sealed in an Arena Open for monetary rewards, there's plenty of games to begin and end!
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/BeginAndEnd_D.translation: <color #CCCCCC>游戏始终之间的过程才是精彩所在！无论你是在跟朋友对战争锋，还是于竞技场公开赛中为夺奖金用现开套牌一较高下，各式玩法都等着你来探索其间精彩。

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/BeginAndEnd_I.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>One of the best ways to learn Magic is to jump in a game! But if you want to know a little more before playing, you've come to the right place!
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/BeginAndEnd_I.translation: <color #CCCCCC>学习万智牌的最好方法之一就是加入一局游戏。但如果你想在游戏开始前了解更多有关信息，那你就来对地方了！

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Casting_A.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>While you can play one land a turn, you'll need to tap those lands to pay for spells! Every card that isn't a land is a spell.
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Casting_A.translation: <color #CCCCCC>虽然你每回合都可以使用（打出）一张地牌，但别忘了你还需要横置地才能支付费用来施放咒语！每张牌要不是地的话，就是咒语。

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Casting_B.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>To attack, you will be prompted to declare your attackers, and can select the creatures to attack with. They will automatically tap, and head into the red zone. Creatures can't attack the turn you cast them because they have something informally called "summoning sickness" by default.
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Casting_B.translation: <color #CCCCCC>当你要攻击时，游戏会提示你宣告攻击者，这时你就可以选择要派出攻击的生物。这些生物会自动横置并冲入战区。通常生物在你刚施放它的当回合中不能攻击，此规则俗称「召唤失调」。

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Casting_C.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>You will need to pay 1 mana for each symbol in a card's mana cost that matches that color. For example, swamps add <sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"> You'll also need to pay generic mana equal to the number there too.
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Casting_C.translation: <color #CCCCCC>牌张的法术力费用中每有一个符号，你就需要支付1点与之颜色相符的法术力。举例来说，沼泽能加<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"> 。此外，你还需要支付与一般法术力符号中所示数字等量的一般法术力。

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Casting_D.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>So if a card costs <sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="x2"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR">, you will need to add 4 total mana, with at least one blue mana, and one red mana. On Arena, if you can cast a spell, not only will it be highlighted, but the lands Arena chooses to automatically tap to cast it will be highlighted as well.
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Casting_D.translation: <color #CCCCCC>因此，如果某张牌的费用为<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="x2"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR">的话，则你需要总共加4点法术力，其中必须包含一点蓝色法术力和一点红色法术力，才能支付其费用。在MTGA中，如果你能够施放某咒语，游戏不仅会高亮显示该牌，提示你可以施放之，同时也会高亮将会自动横置的地。

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Casting_E.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Some cards even let you cast spells without paying their mana cost, or just put them onto the battlefield. Such value!
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Casting_E.translation: <color #CCCCCC>有些牌会让你以「不需支付其法术力费用」的方式来施放咒语，甚至是直接将牌放进战场。真可谓物超所值！

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/GameActions_I.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>There are many actions you take during a game of Magic, and here are some of the most important ones!
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/GameActions_I.translation: <color #CCCCCC>你在万智牌游戏的过程中能够进行许多操作，以下便是最重要的几项！

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/GoldenRule_Te.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>While you're playing Magic, remember: Whenever a card's text directly contradicts a rule, the card takes precedence in that specific situation. The only exception is that a player can concede the game at any time. You can always jump right back into another game!
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/GoldenRule_Te.translation: <color #CCCCCC>在你玩万智牌的时候，请记住：每当某张牌的规则叙述直接抵触这些规则时，以牌上的叙述为优先。这张牌只能在此特殊状况下取代其所抵触的规则。唯一的例外是：牌手随时都可以认输一盘游戏。

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Tapping_A.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Cards are turned sideways to show they have been used for the turn. You'll untap all permanents (cards on the battlefield) you control at the beginning of your turn.
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Tapping_A.translation: <color #CCCCCC>你在用过某牌张之后，便需将之横置以示其在当回合中不能再利用。在你的回合开始时，你会重置所有由你操控的永久物（战场上的牌）。

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Tapping_B.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>You tap your lands to cast spells and tap your creatures to attack. Some creatures and artifacts can also tap to activate abilities. Some cards even untap others so you're not limited to activating that ability only once a turn!
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Tapping_B.translation: <color #CCCCCC>你会横置地来施放咒语，还会横置生物来攻击。有些生物和神器还能横置来起动异能。还有些牌甚至还能重置其他牌，因此有时能够再同一回合中多次利用需横置的异能！

Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Tapping_C.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Some players play decks that don't even cast spells on their own turn! While most cards are only played during your turn, instants and cards with flash can be played almost anytime. If your opponent has two islands untapped, keep your guard up!
Codex/HowToPlay/QuickStart/Tapping_C.translation: <color #CCCCCC>有些牌手所用的套牌甚至不需要在自己的回合中施放咒语！虽然大多数种类的牌都只能在你自己的回合中施放，但瞬间和具有闪现异能的牌几乎随时都能打出。如果你对手留着两张海岛的费用的话，请务必提高警惕！

Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_BG_desc.oracleText: Unleash the power of life and death, consigning all creatures to the graveyard. But yours won't stay there for long!
Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_BG_desc.translation: 释放死生之力，将所有生物送进坟场。但你的生物不久便能复活！

Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_BW_desc.oracleText: Command the relentless power of Phyrexia and swarm over your enemies with your unstoppable army of biomechanical zealots!
Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_BW_desc.translation: 统御非瑞克西亚残酷之力，用势不可挡的生物机械狂热者大军吞没你的敌人！

Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_RB_desc.oracleText: Conjure implements of malice and be willing to sacrifice your own creatures and artifice in pursuit of power.
Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_RB_desc.translation: 变出恶意的工具，并愿意牺牲自己的生物和神器来追求力量。

Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_RG_desc.oracleText: Unleash the might of dragons and dinosaurs to blast through your opponent's defenses.
Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_RG_desc.translation: 释放巨龙和恐龙的强大力量来冲破对手的防御。

Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_RW_desc.oracleText: Suit up your rebellious forces with potent equipment and fight valiantly in the name of Mirrodin!
Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_RW_desc.translation: 为你的反抗军装备强大的武具，以秘罗地之名英勇作战！

Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_UB_desc.oracleText: Uncover the secrets of the past and remove all who would stand in your way with esoteric spells.
Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_UB_desc.translation: 使用深奥咒语揭开往日的秘密，扫清挡路的敌人。

Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_UG_desc.oracleText: Join forces with elves and foresee your glorious victory with memory and might.
Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_UG_desc.translation: 与精灵联手，用记忆和力量预见你的辉煌胜利。

Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_UR_desc.oracleText: Master arcane wizardry to weave together knowledge and fire in a dizzying flurry of spellcraft!
Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_UR_desc.translation: 掌握奥术魔法，将知识和火焰编织成令人眼花缭乱的法术！

Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_UW_desc.oracleText: Soar above your opponents with your skyborne soldiers and ride the winds of victory!
Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_UW_desc.translation: 与你的天空战士一起乘着胜利之风翱翔在你的对手之上！

Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_WG_desc.oracleText: Cultivate your spirits, elementals, and elephants into an indomitable power that will triumph over all others!
Codex/Precon/Precon_EPP2024_WG_desc.translation: 培养你的精怪、元素和大象，使其成为一种不屈不挠的力量，战胜一切！

Codex/Profile_Constructed.oracleText: Constructed formats are where you bring your own deck such as Standard, Alchemy, Pioneer, and Historic. You can only use cards legal in that format, but the "rules" for the game are the same in all of these constructed formats. Your results in these formats only affect your rank if you play in the ranked queue. Most events and the play queue let you battle with no pressure!
Codex/Profile_Constructed.translation: 构筑赛制需要你事先组好套牌，诸如标准、炼金、先驱和史迹这些都属于构筑赛制。虽然各个赛制允用牌张的范围不同会限制你构组套牌时的选择，但所有赛制核心的「游戏规则」并无差异。在各构筑赛制中，只有你选择在排位队列中对战的情况下，才会影响你的段位。大多数活动和「对战」队列都让你能轻松战斗，毫无压力！

Codex/Profile_Intro.oracleText: The Profile scene shows you all the information about, well, you! You can also customize your default Emotes, Companions, Sleeves, and Avatar! Any changes you make to specific decks will take priority over your defaults set here.
Codex/Profile_Intro.translation: 个人档案界面则会显示与「你」本人相关的所有信息！你可以自定义你的默认表情、宠物、牌套、和头像！不过你为特定套牌中指定的相应项目，会盖过你整体的默认设置。

Codex/Profile_Limited.oracleText: Limited formats are where you build your deck during the event, such as Draft or Sealed. Premier Draft, Quick Draft, and Sealed affect your limited rating, while Traditional Draft does not.
Codex/Profile_Limited.translation: 限制赛制则需要你在活动当中现场组出套牌参赛，诸如轮抽和现开都属于限制赛制。竞技轮抽、快速轮抽和现开会影响你的限制段位，不过三盘轮抽则不会影响你的段位。

Codex/Profile_Ranking.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>If your ranking is displayed before the name of a queue or event, then your results there will affect your ranking. Is it time to prove that your new brew has what it takes, or that it's correct to play that 41st card?
Codex/Profile_Ranking.translation: <color #CCCCCC>如果队列或赛事的名称前面显示了你的段位，则说明该项游戏模式的结果会影响你的段位。是要证明你的最新心血已微调完毕，还是验证自己加入第41张牌的决定是否正确？

Codex/Profile_Season.oracleText: You can compete to improve your ranking in each Season and they reset at the end of each month. And the best part is you can earn rewards based on how you finish! Rewards will be given for both ranks, and you can select your rank to find out exactly how much you are able to earn.
Codex/Profile_Season.translation: 你可以不断进行排位对局来在每个赛季中增进自己的段位。赛季的成绩在每个月的月末都会重置。至于每个月辛苦奋战，最大的收获莫过于每月末你都能根据最终段位赢取奖励！奖励会按照两个段位的结果来分别发放，你也能选择段位来了解自己月末到底能获得什么东西。

Codex/Profile_SeasonalRank.oracleText: Here is also where you see your Seasonal Rank. You have two ranks: Constructed and Limited. All ranked Constructed events will impact your singular Constructed rank, and likewise, the same is true for Limited. If you're just starting off on your journey, you might just have one rank here: Spark Rank! There is much for you to explore and learn as you rank up...
Codex/Profile_SeasonalRank.translation: 你也可以在这里查看你的赛季段位。 你会有两个段位：构筑和限制。所有排位构筑赛事都只会影响你的构筑段位，同样，所有排位限制赛事都只会影响你的限制段位。如果你只是刚刚开始游戏旅途，那你这里可能就只会显示一个段位：火花段位！随着你段位提升，就会有越来越多的内容待你来发现...

Codex/RotationRenewal_1.oracleText: Renewal is an event that happens once a year here on MTG Arena. It is a time of change and new beginnings as we rotate cards out of Standard and Alchemy, and roll in celebratory gifts for all players in the form of the yearly Renewal Egg!
Codex/RotationRenewal_1.translation: 焕新是MTG竞技场一年一度举行的活动。每逢此时，我们会将牌张轮替出标准与炼金，改变环境，迎接全新开始。同时我们还为所有牌手准备了年度焕新蛋这一庆祝礼物，邀请大家与我们共通庆贺。

Codex/RotationRenewal_11b.oracleText: Renewal is also our time to update various play modes such as Jump In! and Quick Draft with cards from the newest sets. So be sure to come celebrate with us here on MTG Arena as we rotate out the old, ring in the new, and explore even more corners of the Multiverse!
Codex/RotationRenewal_11b.translation: 焕新也是更新各种游戏模式的时刻，比如速学！和快速轮抽（包含最新系列牌张）。因此，请务必来万智牌：竞技场与我们一起庆祝，我们将辞旧迎新，探索多元宇宙的更多角落！

Codex/RotationRenewal_1b.oracleText: Renewal is an event that happens once a year here on MTG Arena. It is a time of change and new beginnings as we rotate cards out of Standard and Alchemy, and roll in celebratory gifts for all players in the form of the yearly Renewal Egg!
Codex/RotationRenewal_1b.translation: 焕新是MTG竞技场一年一度举行的活动。每逢此时，我们会将牌张轮替出标准与炼金，改变环境，迎接全新开始。同时我们还为所有牌手准备了年度焕新蛋这一庆祝礼物，邀请大家与我们共通庆贺。

Codex/RotationRenewal_2.oracleText: During Renewal Season, both MTG Arena and tabletop Magic: The Gathering will rotate. Upon the release of the renewal set, around four or so of the "oldest" sets in Standard and Alchemy will "rotate" out, which means they will no longer be legal in those formats. However they will remain legal in MTG Arena's non-rotating game modes like Historic, Pioneer, and Historic Brawl.
Codex/RotationRenewal_2.translation: 在焕新季期间，MTG竞技场与桌面版万智牌游戏都会发生轮替。待焕新系列发售时，在标准和炼金赛制中约四个「最古老」的系列会被「轮替」出去，意味着这些系列中的牌张不再允用于对应赛制，但仍能在MTG竞技场中的非轮替游戏模式（诸如史迹、先驱和史迹争锋等）中使用。

Codex/RotationRenewal_2b.oracleText: During Renewal Season, both MTG Arena and tabletop Magic: The Gathering will rotate. Upon the release of the renewal set, around four or so of the "oldest" sets in Standard and Alchemy will "rotate" out, which means they will no longer be legal in those formats. However, they will remain legal in MTG Arena's non-rotating game modes like Pioneer, Historic, Brawl and Timeless.
Codex/RotationRenewal_2b.translation: 在焕新季期间，MTG竞技场与桌面版万智牌游戏都会发生轮替。待焕新系列发售时，在标准和炼金赛制中约四个「最古老」的系列会被「轮替」出去，意味着这些系列中的牌张不再允用于对应赛制，但仍能在MTG竞技场中的非轮替游戏模式（诸如先驱、史迹、争锋和永恒等）中使用。

Codex/RotationRenewal_3.oracleText: More importantly, you will see the Renewal Egg on your Profile! This is both a reminder that rotation is coming up and it holds a package containing some special rewards that will help kick off the new year! Hovering over the Egg will show how much time is left until rotation when the Egg will open.
Codex/RotationRenewal_3.translation: 更重要的时，你会在个人档案界面中看到焕新蛋！它不仅提示系列轮替即将到来，其中还有特殊奖励，帮助你迎接下一年的到来！将鼠标悬停在焕新蛋上便能看到距离系列轮替、焕新蛋打开还剩多久。

Codex/RotationRenewal_3b.oracleText: For the duration of the Renewal Season, you will see the Renewal Egg and Rotation details within your Inbox! These serve both as a reminder that rotation is coming up and, in regard to the Egg, informs the player of the special rewards they'll receive to kick off the new year!
Codex/RotationRenewal_3b.translation: 在焕新赛季期间，您将在收件箱中看到焕新蛋和轮替详情！这些信息不仅提醒您轮替即将到来，而且就焕新蛋而言，还告知玩家他们将获得的特殊奖励，为新的一年拉开序幕！

Codex/RotationRenewal_4.oracleText: Note: In 2023, Standard will not rotate. Cards will rotate out of Alchemy like normal, which will maintain Alchemy's two years worth of cards, while expanding Standard to three years!
Codex/RotationRenewal_4.translation: 注意：2023年标准赛制不会轮替。炼金赛制则会如常轮替牌张，让炼金赛制的牌池保持两年间的系列不变，同时将标准赛制的牌池扩充到三年间的系列！

Codex/RotationRenewal_5.oracleText: This means that when Rotation occurs in 2023 with the release of Wilds of Eldraine in September, these five sets will no longer be legal in Alchemy, but will remain legal in Standard until Rotation occurs again in 2024!
Codex/RotationRenewal_5.translation: 也就是说，随着9月艾卓仙踪系列发售进行2023年轮替时，以下五个系列将不再允用于炼金赛制，但仍能在标准赛制中使用，直到2024年轮替之时！

Codex/RotationRenewal_5b.oracleText: In 2025, with the release of Edge of Eternities in July, these 5 sets will no longer be legal in Standard:
Codex/RotationRenewal_5b.translation: 2025年7月，随着虚空边域系列的发布，以下5个系列将不再允用于标准赛制：

Codex/RotationRenewal_7.oracleText: Renewal also is our time to update various play modes such as Jump In!, Quick Draft, and the 10 two-color Starter Decks with cards from the newest sets. So be sure to come celebrate with us here on MTG Arena as we rotate out the old, ring in the new, and explore even more corners of the Multiverse!
Codex/RotationRenewal_7.translation: 焕新也是更新各种游戏模式的时刻，比如速学！、快速轮抽和十套双色新手套牌（包括最新系列牌张）。因此，请务必来MTGA与我们一起庆祝，我们将辞旧迎新，探索多元宇宙的更多角落！

Codex/RotationRenewal_8b.translation: 2025年7月，随着虚空边域系列的发布，以下8个系列将不再允用于炼金赛制：

Codex/ThePlayBlade_Events.oracleText: Events will show you every event that is currently available for you to join. There are filters on the right for you to narrow down all the choices, with newer events like the Color Challenge and Jump In! alongside events you've already joined near the top of the list.
Codex/ThePlayBlade_Events.translation: 赛事会显示当前可供加入的赛事。你可以利用右侧的筛选器来挑选自己感兴趣者，减少左侧显示的赛事数量。其中较新的、「颜色挑战」、「速学！」和你已加入的活动会显示在靠近顶部的位置。

Codex/ThePlayBlade_FindMatch.oracleText:
Find Match lets you join constructed queues: Ranked, Play, and Brawl!

• Ranked puts your skills to the test in four constructed formats: Standard, Alchemy, Historic, and Pioneer. Matches in this queue will affect your seasonal ranking. You can toggle to choose to play in Best of One, where you play a single game, or Best of Three, where games include sideboarding, and the first player to win two games wins the match.

• Play lets you play the same four formats, but these do not impact your constructed rank. You can still choose Best of One or Best of Three, and you can even play against Sparky in a Bot Match!

• Brawl is where you play the casual singleton formats (where only one copy of each card is allowed in your deck) of Brawl and Standard Brawl! Choose your Commander to build around and battle!
Codex/ThePlayBlade_FindMatch.translation:
寻找对局则让你可以投身构筑赛制对战，有天梯、对战和争锋三种模式可供选择！

• 天梯中提供了四种构筑赛制，你可以任选其一来挑战技艺：标准、炼金、史迹和先驱。你在此队列中的对局结果将会影响你的赛季段位。你可以在单盘制（只进行一盘对局）或三盘制（包含备牌，先夺取两盘对战胜利的牌手便赢下整局对战）。

• 对战同样提供了这四种赛制的对战队列，但对局结果不会影响你的构筑段位。你也可以在此选择单盘制或三盘制，甚至还能在人机对战中跟辉辉切磋！

• 争锋则是进行休闲无双对战（每种只能加入一张）的好去处，有争锋和标准争锋供你选择！因此快快来选择一位指挥官，然后投身对战！

Codex/ThePlayBlade_PlayButton.oracleText:
The Play Blade can be opened with the large orange button that says "Play" on the bottom right of the first screen you see, the Home Scene. It's the best way to get into a game of Magic!

You'll be met with 3 different ways to find just the game you're looking for:

• Events
• Find Match
• Recently Played
Codex/ThePlayBlade_PlayButton.translation:
对战选择界面可通过点击主界面（即你进入游戏后首个看到的界面）右下角的「开始游戏」橙色按钮打开。这是你投身万智牌对局的最佳方式！

之后你将在界面上看到三种寻找对战模式的方式：

• 赛事
• 寻找对局
• 最近对战

Codex/ThePlayBlade_RecentlyPlayed.oracleText:
Recently Played will simply display the most recent events and queues you played. So get back in there and show 'em the updates you just made to your new favorite deck!

While the Play Blade isn't the only way to jump into a game, it's certainly one of the easiest and quickest ways. So what are you waiting for?
Codex/ThePlayBlade_RecentlyPlayed.translation:
最近对战中将列出你最近参加的赛事和对战队列。你可以快速返回先前游玩的赛制，向大家展示你刚对最爱套牌进行的酷炫改动！

虽然「对战选择界面」并非开始游戏的唯一 方式，但绝对能帮你轻松快速加入战局。所以你还在等什么呢？

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Add.oracleText: <color #ED5922>While those are the 5 main constructed formats, on Arena, that's not all:
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Add.translation: <color #ED5922>竞技场中除了5种主要的构筑赛制之外，还有以下丰富玩法：

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Alc.oracleText: Alchemy is a rotating format similar to Standard except for one key difference: players can also play with digital cards not present in paper! This could be cards from Standard that have been "rebalanced" to allow for new strategies, or even entirely new cards released in each set's Alchemy drop. These cards do things on MTG Arena that aren't possible in paper and might have you approaching this format differently. That combined with our ability to balance cards that aren't seeing a lot of play (or too much play), make Alchemy an ever-changing format! But a great place to start would be 10 Starter Decks and adding in digital-first cards!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Alc.translation: 炼金 也跟标准一样属于轮替赛制，不过它最大的区别在于：此赛制中，牌手还能使用不存在实体版本的电子版牌张！这些可能是实体标准赛中被「再平衡」的牌张，好让牌手尝试新的战术，甚至可能是每个系列之炼金内容中的全新牌张。这些牌张会利用MTG竞技场这一电子媒介，来实现根本无法在实体版游戏中体现的机制，令你能以全新的角度来思考此赛制。加上我们还会对不常用（或是太常用）的牌张作平衡调整，因此炼金赛制常打常新！要想上手这一赛制，最好的方式莫过于在10副新手套牌中加入电子版专用牌张！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_B.oracleText: These formats, like limited, can be played as Best of One where players play only a single game, or a Traditional Best of Three variant where the winner of the match is the player who wins two games.
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_B.translation: 这些赛制跟限制赛一样，牌手既能进行一盘定胜负的一盘制对战，也可以在，传统的三盘制对战中一决高下，以先赢两盘游戏者为最终胜家。

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Bot.oracleText: And finally, we have the Arena for you to battle our wonderful mascot: Sparky! While this is technically not a format, since you can bring any deck legal in any format, it's still a place where you can test out a new deck without playing against other humans. Just don't let her catch you going easy on her!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Bot.translation: 最后，你还可以在竞技场中与我们可爱的吉祥物火花精灵辉辉进行对战！虽然这严格来说并不算一个赛制，因为只要是任一赛制中合法的套牌，你都可以在这模式中使用，但其仍不失为在跟其他人类牌手对战前的一个练兵之处。不过千万别让她发现你故意手下留情就行！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Bra.oracleText: Brawl, and its cousin, Historic Brawl, are constructed formats
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Bra.translation: 争锋（及衍生之史迹争锋）也都是构筑赛制

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_C.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Each deck also can employ an optional "sideboard", or cards that are "outside the game". Usually, they are used in games after the first when playing Best of Three, but sometimes even in Best of One, you might find some cards that let you use these sideboard cards. The maximum number of cards you may include in a sideboard is 7 in Best of One, and 15 in Best of Three.
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_C.translation: <color #CCCCCC>每副套牌都可以准备一副可选「备牌」，或是一些「游戏外的牌」。通常备牌只有在三盘制对局中双方进行完第一盘游戏之后才会用到，但有时甚至在一盘制的对局中，你都会遇到会让你用到这些备牌的牌张。你备牌中的牌张数量上限，在一盘制对局中为7张，在三盘制对局中为15张。

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Com.oracleText: Their closest analogue is the tabletop format, Commander, but with a few key differences. While you still select a Legendary card to be the commander of your singleton constructed deck, in Brawl you can choose any Planeswalker as well! Standard Brawl only uses cards legal in Standard. Meanwhile, Brawl has a minimum deck size of 100, and can use cards legal in Historic: which is almost every card on MTG Arena!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Com.translation: 在实体版游戏中与之最相近的赛制可能要算是指挥官，不过两者之间不少差别。虽然两者都要求构组的套牌符合无双规则，同时要你选择一个传奇生物当作指挥官，但在争锋中任何鹏洛客也可以充当指挥官！同时标准争锋只能使用标准赛的允用牌张。另一方面，争锋的套牌张数下限为100张牌，且可以使用在史迹中允用的牌张～这基本上就是MTGA中的所有牌！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Exp.oracleText: Pioneer, like Standard, is a true-to-paper format. However, unlike Standard, it's non-rotating, which means cards are legal in it eternally! If a card is present on Arena, and was legal in Standard since around 2012 (Return to Ravnica), it is legal. Again, MTG Arena makes understanding card legality easy, and deckbuilding filters can help you find just the card you need!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Exp.translation: 先驱与标准类似，是个忠于实体版牌张的赛制。不过与标准不同的是，这是个非轮替的赛制，也就是说其中的牌都一直可用！本赛制中包括所有曾在标准中允用的牌张（从在MTGA上推出过的系列算起）。如果某张牌曾在MTGA中登场，且在2013年时期在标准可用，则它就能在本赛制中使用。在此再次提醒各位，如果你想知道某张牌的赛制可用性，MTGA能让你一目了然。同时其的套牌构组工具筛选器能让你轻松找到你需要的牌！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_For.oracleText: <color #ED5922>There five main MTG Arena formats to consider when creating (or importing) a new deck:
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_For.translation: <color #ED5922>当创建（或导入）一副新套牌时，需要考虑万智牌竞技场上五种主要赛制。

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_His.oracleText: Historic is similar to Pioneer in that cards never rotate out. The biggest difference is that the vast majority of cards on MTG Arena are at your disposal, including digital-first cards and paper cards predating 2013. In fact, if a card hasn't been banned or suspended, then it's most likely legal here! If you're looking for a broad but curated Magic: The Gathering experience, then Historic might be the format for you!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_His.translation: 史迹与先驱赛制相似的地方，大概就是本赛制的牌张也不会轮替。但其最大的区别在于，本赛制中绝大多数MTG竞技场中的牌都能为你所用，包括电子版专用牌张，以及2013年之前的实体版卡牌。基本上，如果某张牌未遭禁用或停用，则其就能在本赛制中使用！如果你期望涉猎覆盖范围最广、强度得到精心调整的万智牌体验，史迹可能就是最适合你的赛制！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Int.oracleText: Constructed events are where you build a deck from cards in your collection before you join the event and bring it to battle other players! Decks have a minimum of 60 cards, and usually play 22-25 lands. There are many constructed formats for Magic: The Gathering, but in MTG Arena, they are defined by their status of "rotating" or not, and if they use digital only cards not available in tabletop Magic: The Gathering.
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Int.translation: 构筑赛事要求你在加入前须事先利用收藏牌张构组套牌，并用该套牌与其他玩家对战！本赛制的套牌张数下限为60张牌，其中通常会用到22-25张地牌。万智牌此游戏有许多构筑赛制，但在MTGA中，则主要按是否「轮替」或能否使用万智牌实体版中不存在的「纯电子版牌张」来分类。

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Int.oracleText: These formats, like limited, can be played as Best of One where players play only a single game, or a Traditional Best of Three variant where the winner of the match is the player who wins two games.
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Int.translation: 这些赛制跟限制赛一样，牌手既能进行一盘定胜负的一盘制对战，也可以在，传统的三盘制对战中一决高下，以先赢两盘游戏者为最终胜家。

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Int.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Each deck also can employ an optional "sideboard", or cards that are "outside the game". Usually, they are used in games after the first when playing Best of Three, but sometimes even in Best of One, you might find some cards that let you use these sideboard cards. The maximum number of cards you may include in a sideboard is 7 in Best of One, and 15 in Best of Three.
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Int.translation: <color #CCCCCC>每副套牌都可以准备一副可选「备牌」，或是一些「游戏外的牌」。通常备牌只有在三盘制对局中双方进行完第一盘游戏之后才会用到，但有时甚至在一盘制的对局中，你都会遇到会让你用到这些备牌的牌张。你备牌中的牌张数量上限，在一盘制对局中为7张，在三盘制对局中为15张。

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Sta.oracleText: Standard is Magic: The Gathering's flagship format and is the most widely sanctioned format at all levels of organized play. It's comprised of cards from most sets released in the last three years and is the same format whether you play it on MTG Arena, or on tabletop with paper cards. Rotation is an event usually every year where older cards "rotate" out and are no longer legal, while newer cards can still be played! That way the format is always "fresh" and new strategies and discoveries are always happening. On MTG Arena, we call it "Renewal" and celebrate this process with gifts and updates that come with the yearly Renewal Egg!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Sta.translation: 标准 是万智牌主推的赛制，也是各级组织化赛事中参与牌手最广泛的认证赛事。本赛制包括在最近三年间发行的绝大部分系列中的所有牌张，无论是在MTGA的电子游戏端还是桌面的实体纸牌端都具有相同的赛事规则。轮替则是指较老系列的牌张「轮替」出去，不能再在标准赛中使用，但此时较新系列的牌张仍能使用！通常每年会轮替一次，这样能确保标准赛制总能保持「新鲜感」，且鼓励牌手不断尝试并发现新的策略。在MTGA中，我们则称之为「焕新」，并在每年焕新季节送出焕新蛋，伴以各式礼物和更新来庆贺这一时刻！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Tim.oracleText: Timeless is most similar to Historic in that nearly every card on MTG Arena is legal here and that cards never rotate out. The key difference is that Timeless has few-to-no banned cards, though some of the most powerful are restricted to a maximum of one copy per deck. With a larger card pool than any of the aforementioned formats, Timeless is Magic: The Gathering at its highest level of power – be ready for anything and everything!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Constructed_Tim.translation: 永恒与史迹赛制相似的地方，大概就是可以使用MTGA中的所有牌张，且从不轮替。但关键的区别在于，永恒赛制几乎没有禁用牌，只是会将其中一些威力最强的卡牌限用至每套牌一张而已。永续赛制的牌池比前述所有赛制都要广阔，万智牌强劲威力尽显其间～备好一切武器，应对各式挑战！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/JumpIn/JumpIn_A.oracleText:
Jump In! is an easy to play format that's perfect for newly sparked Planeswalkers to...well...Jump into! In fact, you only need to make two choices before you get right into playing: selecting two different half-decks from a variety of cool themes. Combine them, and you'll have decks with names like "High-Tech Knights" or "Oily Vampires" ready to go!

You might have earned some "Jump-In Tokens" during your journey and here's where you can cash them in! MTG Arena takes care of what lands to play, and while you'll even earn a prize for winning a game, you can play with your deck as many times as you'd like.

This format uses cards legal in Historic, and is a good first step toward playing other formats like Draft and Sealed. What are those? Keep playing and you're sure to find out!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/JumpIn/JumpIn_A.translation:
速学！本赛制上手简单，非常适合刚点燃火花的新晋鹏洛客们来...投身加入！你实际上只需要做两个选择就可以开始游戏：在一系列酷炫主题的套牌中选择两套半副套牌。将他们混合一起，你就会得到一副名称像是「尖端科技+骑士列阵」或 「烁油缠身+吸血魔鬼」这样的完整套牌，可以用来进行对战！

你在之前的游戏历程中可能也已经获得了一些「速学门票」 ，这里便是兑换它们的地方！MTGA会帮你配好套牌中需要用到的地牌，你每赢一盘还能得到奖品，而且利用同一副套牌进行对战的次数并无限制。

本赛制利用在史迹赛制中允用之牌张，你也可以藉此当作练习其他赛制（如轮抽和现开）良好起点。这些又是什么赛制？别心急，继续投身游戏，亲身经历后就会知道！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_A.oracleText: Limited events are where you open up packs during the event itself and build a deck out of what you find! You're able to use as many basic lands as you'd like, and the minimum number of cards for these decks is 40, with players playing around 17 lands, but MTG Arena will take care of this for you.
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_A.translation: 限制赛制需要你的活动过程中现场打开补充包，并利用你得到的牌张构组套牌！你可以使用任意数量的基本地，且限制赛制的套牌张数下限为40张，虽然大多数玩家会放过入大约17张地牌，不过MTGA会自动为你搭配地牌数量。

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_B.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>What you'll need to do on your own is to decide what nonland cards to play! Most limited decks are 2 colors, with some being 3, often "splashing" a card or two (playing only one or two cards of a third color).
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_B.translation: <color #CCCCCC>而你需要自行决定的，便是要选择要用哪些非地牌！大多数限制套牌都是两色，虽然有的会是三色，但通常只是为了「混入」一两张其他颜色的牌而已（也就是第三色只用一两张牌）。

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_C.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Generally you want a fair number of creatures (around 13-15) as that's how you plan to win the game! The rest should be removal spells (cards that remove your opponent's creatures from the battlefield), and maybe one or two combat tricks (cards you can cast during combat to surprise your opponent). Having a couple cards that allow you to draw even more cards is usually not a bad idea! Oh, and you don't want too many cards that cost one mana, or that cost more than five mana. Limited is challenging!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_C.translation: <color #CCCCCC>通常你会希望套牌中有足够数量的生物（一般是13-15个），因为这是最常见赢得游戏的方式！剩余部分应加入一些去除咒语（能够将对手生物从战场上除掉），以及一到两个战斗诡计（可以在战斗中施放，令对手难于防范的牌）。加入一些让你能够额外抓牌的牌张也不失为好主意！对了，一般情况下也会避免一费或者五费以上咒语偏多的情况。限制赛挑战重重！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_D.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>But great news, cards you draft will be added to your collection! So maybe you spot a card that would go great in one of your constructed decks, or you see something that inspires you to create a deck all your own built around this one card!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_D.translation: <color #CCCCCC>不过好消息是，你抓取的牌张会加入到你的收藏当中！因此你可能会这过程中碰到能在你构筑套牌中大放异彩的强牌，或是能给你带来全新套牌构筑思路的关键张也说不定！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_Express.oracleText: <color #ED5922>There are a few different expressions of limited:
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_Express.translation: <color #ED5922>限制赛还有几种不同的分类：

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_JumpIn_.oracleText: Jump In! bridges the gap between Draft and Sealed and is a great introduction to Limited. Instead of making over 40 choices for a draft, you only make two! You get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes. Combine them, and you'll then have a deck ready to go! This is the best place to get your feet wet by Jumping In to Limited on Arena!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_JumpIn_.translation: 「速学！」填补了轮抽与现开之间的空白，适合新牌手通过此玩法来熟悉限制赛制。在此玩法中，你不需抽选40多次才能组出套牌，而只用选两次就好！你能从多种主题的半副套牌中选择两幅，将它们混合一起，便组成了一副完整套牌来与他人对战！这是你在竞技场中「速学！」限制赛事的最佳方式！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_Premier.oracleText: Draft is the most common form of Limited, and Premier Draft is the gold standard here on MTG Arena. In this event you will Draft 3 packs of Magic: The Gathering cards, with each pack containing around 14 or 15 cards, depending on the set. You'll pick one card out of a pack, then pass it to the player on your "left" You'll then receive the pack to the player on your "right" and repeat the process until every card is chosen.
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_Premier.translation: 轮抽 是最常见的限制赛制，而竞技轮抽则是MTGA中的黄金标准。在此活动中，你需要从3包万智牌补充包中抓取牌张，每包根据系列不同包括14到15张牌。你需要从补充包中挑选一张牌，然后将剩余的牌传给你「左边」的牌手，并收到从你「右边」的牌手传来的补充包。重复此流程，直到你选完一包中的所有牌为止。

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_Premier.oracleText: <indent=5%><color #CCCCCC>Then you'll open the second pack, and repeat this process, except you'll pass it to the "right". Then with the third pack, you'll pass it back to your "left". Don't worry, MTG Arena will take care of much of this for you, but at the end of the draft you'll have just over 40 cards to make a deck with! MTG Arena will automatically add 17 lands to your deck, but you'll need to "cut" some cards to trim your deck size down to the recommended 40. They'll be in your "sideboard" and not involved in any of your games.
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_Premier.translation: <indent=5%><color #CCCCCC>接着你打开第二包补充包，并重复上述流程，只是这一包需要你向「右边」传。然后到第三包的时候，就需要再往「左边」传。别担心，MTGA会帮你处理传牌的流程，不过在轮抽结束后，你就只有40多张牌来构筑套牌！MTGA会自动在你套牌中添加17张地牌，但你还需要「剔除」一些牌张，好将套牌张数尽量接近推荐的40张。被剔除的牌张就是你的「备牌」，在你之后的游戏中不会用到。

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_QuickDr.oracleText: This style of Draft is again, similar to Premier Draft but with one twist: You draft with bots! In Quick Draft, there are no pick timers, and no waiting in between picks! So while you'll still play against other human opponents, you'll be drafted with 7 other AI opponents. Do you think you have what it takes to out draft a bot? At any rate, you still get to keep the cards you draft!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_QuickDr.translation: 这种轮抽也跟竞技轮抽类似，只是你是跟电脑一起轮抽！快速轮抽没有计时，且两次抓取之间也不需等待！尽管之后你仍会和其他人类对手对战，但你是跟7个其他AI对手进行轮抽。你有本事在轮抽中胜过其他电脑吗？不过不管怎么说，你都能留下你轮抽中抓取的牌！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_Sealed_.oracleText: Sealed events are unique in that you still only get to build a deck with cards you collect from the event, but there's no drafting! Each player opens a "pool" of 6 packs of Magic, and then attempt to make the best deck they can out of their pool. Each pool is random, but many players try to play as many Rares and Mythic Rares as they can, while still sticking to two or three colors.
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_Sealed_.translation: 现开赛事的特点在于，虽然你仍是只能用你在活动中得到的牌张来构筑套牌，但完全不用跟其他人来轮抽！每位牌手都打开6包万智牌补充包，所得的牌便是其「牌池」，然后便尝试从自己的牌池中组出最强的套牌来战胜其他牌手。每个牌池的内容都是随机的，但许多牌手都会尽量用上自己开到的稀有 和秘稀 牌，同时尽量保持套牌在两色到三色之间。

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_Traditi.oracleText: This type of Draft is similar to Premier Draft, but with one big difference: Instead of each match going to the player who wins the game, instead you'll play a Best of Three match! Your goal is to win 2 games, and you may sideboard in every game except the first! In sideboarding you can add additional cards you initially cut to your deck you think might be good in that game! You should also probably cut cards that you don't think match up well against your opponent, but that's for you to decide!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Limited_Traditi.translation: 这种轮抽与竞技轮抽类似，只是你们不再是一盘决胜负，而是要进行三盘制的对局！你的目标是赢下2盘游戏，且在第一盘之后还能更换备牌！在更换备牌时，你可加入原本从套牌中剔除出去、但可能在眼下对局中派上用场的牌张！同时你应该换出不适合当前对手的牌张，不过一切都由你自己来决定！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Precons_A.oracleText: Preconstructed Decks (Precons) are a mix of Constructed and Limited. You don't need to build a deck beforehand, but you don't select individual cards in the event either: You choose an entire deck!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Precons_A.translation: 预组套牌对战 （预组战） 将构筑赛 和限制赛的特点融合一体。你虽然不需要事先构组套牌，但参赛的时候也不是抽选单张牌张：而是选择整副套牌！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Precons_B.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>Many events featured on MTG Arena let you choose a deck from a selection, often themed around the newest set release. Oftentimes in the Brawl format, but every Constructed format can be offered as a Preconstructed play mode!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Precons_B.translation: <color #CCCCCC>MTGA上有许多活动会让你从许多套牌中选择一副来参加～而这些套牌通常也是围绕新系列的主题来构筑。最常进行预组套牌对战活动的赛制是争锋，但所有构筑赛制都可以进行预组套牌对战。

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Precons_ColorCh.oracleText: There's already an event that uses preconstructed decks you might already be aware of: The Color Challenge! Choose your color and win 5 matches to complete the challenge and progress further throughout your MTG Arena journey!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Precons_ColorCh.translation: 实际上你可能已经参加过预组套牌对战玩法的活动：颜色挑战！选择颜色，赢得5盘对局即可完成挑战，进一步推进你的MTGA旅程！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Precons_ColorCh.oracleText: <color #CCCCCC>The Color Challenge is a great way to get more familiar with some of the rules of Magic, so let's jump right in!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Precons_ColorCh.translation: <color #CCCCCC>颜色挑战是熟悉万智牌规则的最佳方式，现在就开始吧！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Precons_SparkRa.oracleText: Spark Rank is the introduction to MTG Arena's Ranking system. While this Ranked play mode is technically Constructed (you can bring the exact deck you want to play with), it is highly suggested to start with one of these 10 two color Starter Decks. You can easily adjust the deck to exactly how you want to play it, just remember to try remove and add card types in similar amounts! And while it might be enticing to cut boring 'ol lands for exciting new spells, try not to. You need those lands to cast your spells!
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Precons_SparkRa.translation: 火花段位是你参加MTGA天梯赛的入门。虽然这一天梯赛 实际上采用的是构筑赛模式 （即你可以使用任何已经组好的套牌来参加），但在此建议先从10副双色新手套牌入门。之后你可以按照自己的游戏风格来调整套牌内容，只是要记住增减牌张的时候确保数字一致！另外，虽然用新获得的咒语来替换地牌是个诱人选项，请千万不要这么做。毕竟你得有地牌才能施放咒语！

Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Precons_Starter.oracleText: This Unranked event uses all 10 two color Starter Decks to do battle! Each player can only choose between these 10 decks based around themes accentuated by the ten color pairs of Magic:
Codex/WaysToPlay/Formats/Precons_Starter.translation: 这一非天梯 赛事让牌手利用全部10副双色新手套牌 互相对战！这10副套牌均以万智牌中10种双色组合特色为主题，牌手能从其中选择一副来参加赛事。

Decks/Precon/Alchemy_OTJ_Sultai.translation: 瓦丝卡与杰斯，不再孤单

Decks/Precon/CC_ANB_B_Desc.oracleText: As a black mage, every advantage comes at a cost. Sacrifice whatever is necessary to control the forces of death and darkness.
Decks/Precon/CC_ANB_B_Desc.translation: 身为黑色法师，你深知不付出代价就没有回报，为能掌控死亡与黑暗之力，甘愿作出任何牺牲。

Decks/Precon/CC_ANB_G_Desc.oracleText: As a green mage, the natural world is at your command. The power of life itself fuels your magic.
Decks/Precon/CC_ANB_G_Desc.translation: 身为绿色法师，你能够掌控整个自然世界，生命的力量本身就会为你提供充沛法力。

Decks/Precon/CC_ANB_R_Desc.oracleText: As a red mage, you revel in the chaos of battle. Fire is your weapon and your inspiration.
Decks/Precon/CC_ANB_R_Desc.translation: 身为红色法师，你陶醉于战斗的混乱，火焰既是你的武器，又能给你启迪。

Decks/Precon/CC_ANB_U_Desc.oracleText: As a blue mage, you control the battlefield through illusion. Always think three steps ahead of your foe.
Decks/Precon/CC_ANB_U_Desc.translation: 身为蓝色法师，你通过虚影来掌控战场，总是能够料敌先机。

Decks/Precon/CC_ANB_W_Desc.oracleText: As a white mage, you command disciplined armies. Enforce order to overwhelm your enemies.
Decks/Precon/CC_ANB_W_Desc.translation: 身为白色法师，你手下部队纪律严明，强化秩序以征服对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_Dreamhack2023_Desc.oracleText: An army of Soldiers is at your command on MTG Arena. Now, march into battle and onward to victory!
Decks/Precon/Precon_Dreamhack2023_Desc.translation: MTGA上已准备好一支士兵大军供你调遣。现在你只需踏上战场，赢回胜利！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_BG_Desc.oracleText: Death is only the first step. What comes next - or comes back - is worth waiting for.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_BG_Desc.translation: 死亡只是第一步。接下来会发生什么 - 或回来 - 值得等待。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_BR_Desc.oracleText: Victory requires taking chances. Lead your army into battle, no matter the risks.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_BR_Desc.translation: 胜利需要把握机会。带领你的军队投入战斗，无论风险如何。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_GU_Desc.oracleText: These creatures are large and in charge, and you'd better believe they mean business.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_GU_Desc.translation: 这些生物体型庞大，掌管着一切，你最好相信它们是认真的。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_GW_Desc.oracleText: The tales of this deck's Adventures have been told far and wide. Now you can become part of them!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_GW_Desc.translation: 该套牌的历险故事已广为流传。现在你可以成为它们的一部分！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_RG_Desc.oracleText: Ferocity and might are the keys to victory when these big brawlers come to the table.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_RG_Desc.translation: 当这些大斗士出现时，凶猛和威力是胜利的关键。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_RW_Desc.oracleText: Expect plenty of derring-do and heroics when these gallant knights take the field.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_RW_Desc.translation: 当这些英勇的骑士上场时，预计会有大量的惊险动作和英雄主义。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_UB_Desc.oracleText: The creatures of Ikoria can exhibit many very strange, very useful mutations.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_UB_Desc.translation: 依克黎的生物可以表现出许多非常奇怪、非常有用的变异。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_UR_Desc.oracleText: Each spark, each mote of magic will fuel your power. Keep casting and seize victory.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_UR_Desc.translation: 每一个火花，每一粒魔法都会激发你的力量。继续铸造，夺取胜利。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_WB_Desc.oracleText: Put your life total to work for you, and your opponents will struggle to keep up.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_WB_Desc.translation: 让你的生命总量为你工作，你的对手将难以跟上。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_WU_Desc.oracleText: From the starfield of Nyx, use these enchantments and artifacts to outwit your opponent.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2021_WU_Desc.translation: 在尼兹的星空中，使用这些结界和神器智取你的对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_BG_Desc.oracleText: Even the humblest creature can grow to be a real terror - and this deck is far from humble!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_BG_Desc.translation: 即使是最卑微的生物也可以成长为真正的恐怖——而这套牌远非卑微！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_BR_Desc.oracleText: It's time to collect the price on your opponent's head. Just don't spend it all in one place!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_BR_Desc.translation: 是时候猎取对手头上的悬赏了。只是不要把所有的钱都花在一个地方！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_GU_Desc.oracleText: Get ready to ramp! When this snowstorm hits, it'll be all downhill for anyone in your way.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_GU_Desc.translation: 准备好斜坡（双关：ramp）！当这场暴风雪来袭时，任何挡路的人都会走下坡路。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_GW_Desc.oracleText: Live long and beat down! Build up your army and your life total, then bring down the house.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_GW_Desc.translation: 活着并胜利！构建你的军队和你的总生命，然后把房子拆掉。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_RG_Desc.oracleText: It's a jungle out there! Every new land you discover will help power your creatures to victory.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_RG_Desc.translation: 外面是丛林！你发现的每一个新地都将帮助你的生物获得胜利。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_RW_Desc.oracleText: Eyes open, there's danger afoot! Use your equipment to get a leg up, then kick your opponents to the curb.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_RW_Desc.translation: 睁眼，危险就在眼前！用你的装备站起来，然后把你的对手踢到路边。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_UB_Desc.oracleText: Keep the battlefield clear until the late game. Then you'll be taking control while they're wondering where it all went wrong.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_UB_Desc.translation: 保持战场清空，直到游戏后期。然后，当他们想知道哪里出了问题时，你将获得控制权。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_UR_Desc.oracleText: It's showtime! Show off some flashy moves with these crafty wizards and their powerful spells.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_UR_Desc.translation: 好戏开场了！用这些狡猾的巫师和他们强大的咒语炫耀一些华丽的动作。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_WB_Desc.oracleText: Adventurers, assemble! Get your party together, then head into the dungeon. The only danger is to your enemies.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_WB_Desc.translation: 冒险家们，集合! 召集你的队伍，然后进入地牢。唯一的危险是对你的敌人而言。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_WU_Desc.oracleText: The sky is the limit! Plan your moves carefully, and your air game will reign supreme.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2022_WU_Desc.translation: 天空才是极限！仔细计划你的动作，你的空中游戏将至高无上。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_BG_Desc.oracleText: Fill up your graveyard with goodies to use, reuse, and abuse its contents against your terrified opponents!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_BG_Desc.translation: 用好东西填满你的坟墓场，使用、重复使用和滥用它的内容来对付你惊恐的对手!

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_BR_Desc.oracleText: Control the battlefield and your opponents with potent artifacts, then smelt them into something entirely new!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_BR_Desc.translation: 用强大的神器控制战场和你的对手，然后将它们熔炼成全新的东西！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_GU_Desc.oracleText: Create vast amounts of mana to set loose giant creatures far quicker than your opponents could ever expect!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_GU_Desc.translation: 创造大量的法术力，以比你的对手想象的更快的速度释放巨型生物！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_GW_Desc.oracleText: Flood the battlefield with creatures of all shapes and sizes and get ready to party!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_GW_Desc.translation: 用各种形状和大小的生物充斥战场，准备参加派对！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_RG_Desc.oracleText: Unleash your ferocious werewolves at night to stalk your unsuspecting prey. Awooo!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_RG_Desc.translation: 晚上释放你凶猛的狼人来跟踪你毫无戒心的猎物。哇哦！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_RW_Desc.oracleText: Study the blade and harness the power of your samurai to unleash an avalanche of swords against all who would defy you!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_RW_Desc.translation: 研究刀刃并驾驭武士的力量，向所有敢于挑战你的人施展如雪崩般的刀剑！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_UB_Desc.oracleText: Use your sneaky ninjas to strike your opponents when and where they least expect. Believe it!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_UB_Desc.translation: 使用你的鬼鬼祟祟的忍者在他们最不期望的时间和地点打击你的对手。相信它！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_UR_Desc.oracleText: Combine instants and sorceries together to create something truly wonderous and claim victory!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_UR_Desc.translation: 将瞬间和法术结合在一起，创造出真正奇妙的东西并取得胜利！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_WB_Desc.oracleText: Maintain the balance between artifact and enchantment spells, and all your opponents will fall!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_WB_Desc.translation: 保持神器和结界咒语之间的平衡，所有对手都会倒下！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_WU_Desc.oracleText: Smite foes with your glorious angels as they fly over your opponent's creatures to count up the wins!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2023_WU_Desc.translation: 用你光荣的天使粉碎敌人，当他们飞过你的对手的生物时，就可以计算出胜利的数量了！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_BG_desc.oracleText: The sugary monstrosities of Sweettooth village hunger for victory. Create food tokens to generate value, then take a bite out the competition!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_BG_desc.translation: 甘饴村的糖怪们渴望胜利。创造食品衍生物来产生价值，然后在竞争中大获全胜！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_BW_desc.oracleText: Slip through your opponent's defenses with a squad of unassuming – but deadly – creatures.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_BW_desc.translation: 与一队不起眼但却致命的生物一起穿过对手的防线。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_RB_desc.oracleText: The most ruthless outlaws in the multiverse are on your side... for now. Use every underhanded trick at your disposal and you'll soon find out why crime pays!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_RB_desc.translation: 多重宇宙中最冷酷无情的不法分子都站在你这边......暂时如此。使用你所掌握的一切阴险伎俩，你很快就会发现为什么犯罪是有代价的！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_RG_desc.oracleText: Awaken the awesome power of dinosaurs and trample your enemies underfoot!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_RG_desc.translation: 唤醒恐龙的强大力量，将敌人踩在脚下！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_RW_desc.oracleText: Plumb the depths of your deck for trinkets, treasures, and terrors! Who knows what you might discover?
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_RW_desc.translation: 在套牌深处寻找饰品、珍宝和恐怖！谁知道你会发现什么呢？

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_UB_desc.oracleText: Take to the skies with mischievous faeries, then outmaneuver the opposition with instant-speed disruption!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_UB_desc.translation: 与调皮的小精灵一起飞上天空，然后用瞬间速度干扰对手！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_UG_desc.oracleText: Scour the desert for extra land cards, then use your excess mana to cast haymaker after haymaker!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_UG_desc.translation: 在沙漠中搜寻额外的地牌，然后利用多余的法术力施放一个又一个“铡草者”！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_UR_desc.oracleText: What's the point of winning if you can't do it in style? Sling two spells in a turn for double the value and double the flair!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_UR_desc.translation: 如果不能有型有款，赢了又有什么意义？在一个回合内施放两个咒语，价值加倍，效果加倍！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_UW_desc.oracleText: Assemble a team of Detectives, then use clues and cunning to stay one step ahead of your enemies!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_UW_desc.translation: 组建一支侦探队伍，然后利用线索和狡猾的手段领先敌人一步！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_WG_desc.oracleText: Charge into battle on your trusty mount creatures backed by spells to power them up!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP2025_WG_desc.translation: 骑着你值得信赖的坐骑生物冲锋陷阵，并用咒语加强它们！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_BG_desc.oracleText: Who says death needs to be a bad thing? Destroy opposing creatures and strategically sacrifice your own to benefit from Morbid abilities and grind out your enemies!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_BG_desc.translation: 谁说死亡一定是坏事？消灭对手的生物，并策略性地牺牲自己的生物，以利用丧心异能来消耗敌人！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_BW_desc.oracleText: A legion of vampires is at your command! Drain your opponent's life total while bolstering your own!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_BW_desc.translation: 一支吸血鬼军团由你统帅！在削弱对手生命的同时提升自己的生命！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_RB_desc.oracleText: Press the attack with this aggressive, creature-focused deck! Clear the way of blockers and reap the rewards of triggering Raid abilities turn after turn!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_RB_desc.translation: 用这个以生物为核心的进攻套牌发起攻击！清除路上的阻挡者，并在每个回合触发突击异能以获取回报！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_RG_desc.oracleText: Slam one mighty creature after another, then use effects that multiply their power! Trample over blockers for double-digit damage!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_RG_desc.translation: 接连召唤强大的生物，然后使用效果倍增它们的力量！践踏阻挡者，造成两位数的伤害！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_RW_desc.oracleText: Overwhelm the opposition with an army of creatures and effects that bolster your entire team!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_RW_desc.translation: 用一支生物大军和能增强整个队伍的异能压倒对手！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UB_desc.oracleText: Zombies arise! Dredge fill your graveyard with zombie creatures, then use recursive effects to bring them back again and again!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UB_desc.translation: 灵俑崛起！利用发掘效果将灵俑生物填满你的坟墓场，然后递归异能让它们一次又一次地复生！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UB_desc_updat.oracleText: Bide your time with removal spells and card filtering, then extract huge value from your well-stocked graveyard!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UB_desc_updat.translation: 用除去咒语和滤牌手段来拖延时间，然后从你储备丰富的坟墓场中获取巨大价值！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UG_desc.oracleText: Accelerate your mana with effects that let you put extra lands into play. Power out huge threats to go over the top of anything else!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UG_desc.translation: 通过能让你额外放置地牌的异能来加速你的法术力。施放巨大的威胁，超越其他一切！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UR_desc.oracleText: Bide your time with tricky spells before devastating opponents with an onslaught of ferocious dragons!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UR_desc.translation: 在用一些巧妙的咒语拖延时间后，用一群威猛巨龙来摧毁你的对手！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UR_desc_updat.oracleText: Throw caution to the wind by flinging spells at the opponent and overwhelming them with your wizarding ways!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UR_desc_updat.translation: 抛开顾虑，向对手倾泻咒语，用你的法术师之道将其压倒！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UW_desc.oracleText: Draw extra cards to out-value your opponents, then close out the game with hard-to-stop fliers!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_UW_desc.translation: 通过额外抓牌在价值上压制对手，然后用难以阻挡的飞行生物结束比赛！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_WG_desc.oracleText: Go wide with a pride of ferocious felines that power each other up!
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPPFDN_WG_desc.translation: 与一群威猛的猫科动物一起扩展战场，它们会相互增强力量！

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_BG_Desc.oracleText: Unlock your inner trash-monster when you get down and dirty with the Golgari guild.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_BG_Desc.translation: 与葛加理公会一同深耕地底，释放内心腐朽猛兽。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_BR_Desc.oracleText: Have a blast clowning around with the manic antics of the Rakdos guild.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_BR_Desc.translation: 与拉铎司公会一道装痴扮狂，引爆激情震撼全场。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_Black_Desc.oracleText: As a black mage, every advantage comes at a cost. Sacrifice whatever is necessary to control the forces of death and darkness.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_Black_Desc.translation: 身为黑色法师，你深知不付出代价就没有回报，为能掌控死亡与黑暗之力，甘愿作出任何牺牲。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_Blue_Desc.oracleText: As a blue mage, you control the battlefield through illusion. Always think three steps ahead of your foe.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_Blue_Desc.translation: 身为蓝色法师，你通过虚影来掌控战场，总是能够料敌先机。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_GU_Desc.oracleText: Grab your favorite octopus-crab-shark and get weird with the mutants of the Simic.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_GU_Desc.translation: 与析米克公会一道感受变异，把章鱼螃蟹鲨鱼拼合一体。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_GW_Desc.oracleText: Join the family to live in peace and harmony among the Selesnya guild.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_GW_Desc.translation: 融入瑟雷尼亚公会大家庭，与兄弟姐妹同享安宁祥和。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_Green_Desc.oracleText: As a green mage, the natural world is at your command. The power of life itself fuels your magic.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_Green_Desc.translation: 身为绿色法师，你能够掌控整个自然世界，生命的力量本身就会为你提供充沛法力。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_RG_Desc.oracleText: Take a walk on the wild side with the raucous misfits of the Gruul guild.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_RG_Desc.translation: 与古鲁公会一起感受野性，战吼震天破坏彻地。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_RW_Desc.oracleText: Take power alongside the Boros guild by marching on to the battlefield with a never-ending parade of creatures.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_RW_Desc.translation: 与波洛斯公一齐并肩作战，军队连绵称霸战场。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_Red_Desc.oracleText: As a red mage, you revel in the chaos of battle. Fire is your weapon and your inspiration.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_Red_Desc.translation: 身为红色法师，你陶醉于战斗的混乱，火焰既是你的武器，又能给你启迪。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_UB_Desc.oracleText: Little is known about the secretive Dimir guild and we're not talking.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_UB_Desc.translation: 底密尔公会行踪成谜，外界所知甚少。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_UR_Desc.oracleText: Spark your curiosity then explode onto the scene with the experimental Izzet guild.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_UR_Desc.translation: 与伊捷公会一块深入探究，轰鸣实验放飞想象。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_WB_Desc.oracleText: Appreciate the finer things in life and death when you rub elbows with the ghostly Orzhov guild.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_WB_Desc.translation: 与欧佐夫公会一起遁入幽魅，算尽财富超脱生死。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_WU_Desc.oracleText: Get serious by laying down the law with the Azorius guild.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_WU_Desc.translation: 与俄佐立公会一同严肃议事，循规蹈矩制定法律。

Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_White_Desc.oracleText: As a white mage, you command disciplined armies. Enforce order to overwhelm your enemies.
Decks/Precon/Precon_EPP_White_Desc.translation: 身为白色法师，你手下部队纪律严明，强化秩序以征服对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_B.oracleText: As a black mage, every advantage comes at a cost. Sacrifice whatever is necessary to control the forces of death and darkness.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_B.translation: 身为黑色法师，你深知不付出代价就没有回报，为能掌控死亡与黑暗之力，甘愿作出任何牺牲。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_BG.oracleText: Utilize creatures that explore through the deck to get an advantage on your opponent.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_BG.translation: 利用勘察生物探索套牌，找寻克敌先机。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_BR.oracleText: Plunder and pillage your enemies with the cunning maneuvers of pirates! Make them walk the plank.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_BR.translation: 善用航海士巧谋妙计掠夺四海，让敌人走投无路！

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_GU.oracleText: Sneak past your foe's defenses and manipulate the battlefield to your benefit with the slick Merfolk of Ixalan.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_GU.translation: 运用依夏兰人鱼之灵动优势，巧妙绕过敌人防线，暗中操弄战局让己方得占先机。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_GW.oracleText: Build up a powerful army and overrun the battlefield. Find glory and strength in numbers.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_GW.translation: 组建强大生物军团主宰战场，众人齐力共探无上荣光。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_RG.oracleText: Useful early on, even stronger later. Utilize the flexibility of kicker spells to get more might for your mana.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_RG.translation: 增幅咒语不仅能在早期用来救急，更能在后期扭转战局。灵活运用这类咒语，充分发挥法术力威力。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_RW.oracleText: Combine powerful weapons and enchantments with your creatures to overpower your foes.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_RW.translation: 利用强力武具与灵气，全副武装你的生物，一举击溃拦路之敌。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_UB.oracleText: Seize control of the battlefield and once it's yours, summon powerful creatures to finish off your enemies.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_UB.translation: 强势控制战场。等到了一切尽在掌握之时，再召唤强力生物终结对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_UR.oracleText: Cast powerful spells to manipulate the game. Utilize your wizards to improve your magic even further.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_UR.translation: 施放强力咒语改变战局。利用法术师让自己的咒语更上一层楼。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_WB.oracleText: Outlive your opponent by using your opponent's lifeforce to heal your wounds. Your life means their death.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_WB.translation: 汲取对手生命精萃滋补自身活力，最终拖垮对手。你之所生，彼之灭亡。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_WU.oracleText: Unlock the hidden power of artifacts using White and Blue magic. Craft awesome combos to take down the opposition.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_Desc_WU.translation: 解锁隐藏在白蓝魔法之后的神器之力。亲手搭配强力组合，一举拿下对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_G.oracleText: As a green mage, the natural world is at your command. The power of life itself fuels your magic.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_G.translation: 身为绿色法师，你能够掌控整个自然世界，生命的力量本身就会为你提供充沛法力。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_R.oracleText: As a red mage, you revel in the chaos of battle. Fire is your weapon and your inspiration.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_R.translation: 身为红色法师，你陶醉于战斗的混乱，火焰既是你的武器，又能给你启迪。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_U.oracleText: As a blue mage, you control the battlefield through illusion. Always think three steps ahead of your foe.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_U.translation: 身为蓝色法师，你通过虚影来掌控战场，总是能够料敌先机。

Decks/Precon/Precon_July_W.oracleText: As a white mage, you command disciplined armies. Enforce order to overwhelm your enemies.
Decks/Precon/Precon_July_W.translation: 身为白色法师，你手下部队纪律严明，强化秩序以征服对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_BG_Desc.oracleText: Overrun anyone in your way with a Swarm of Saprolings.
Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_BG_Desc.translation: 召唤腐生物大军，横扫一切挡路之敌。

Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_BR_Desc.oracleText: Death is not the end. Strike terror from beyond with powerful graveyard combos.
Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_BR_Desc.translation: 死亡并非终局。借助强力坟墓场组合技，召使死者之力震撼出击。

Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_GW_Desc.oracleText: Enchant your creatures to new levels of power and use binding spells to restrain your foes.
Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_GW_Desc.translation: 用灵气武装你的生物，增强己方战力，同时运用束缚咒语制约对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_RG_Desc.oracleText: Create additional mana to summon massive monsters to crush your enemies.
Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_RG_Desc.translation: 运用额外法术力召唤庞巨怪兽击垮对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_RW_Desc.oracleText: Overwhelm your opponent with a massive army. Strike with powerful combat spells to turn the tides in your favor.
Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_RW_Desc.translation: 集结大军压倒对手。以强大的战斗咒语扭转战局。

Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_UB_Desc.oracleText: Manipulate the battlefield to your advantage with these crafty spells.
Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_UB_Desc.translation: 利用诡诈咒语抢占战场先机。

Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_UG_Desc.oracleText: Sneak past your foe's defenses and manipulate the battlefield to your benefit with the slick Merfolk of Ixalan.
Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_UG_Desc.translation: 运用依夏兰人鱼之灵动优势，巧妙绕过敌人防线，暗中操弄战局让己方得占先机。

Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_UR_Desc.oracleText: Cast powerful spells to wreak havoc on your enemies.
Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_UR_Desc.translation: 施放强力咒语，将敌人玩弄于股掌之间。

Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_WB_Desc.oracleText: Outlive your opponent by using their lifeforce to heal your wounds. Your life means their death.
Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_WB_Desc.translation: 汲取对手生命精萃滋补自身活力，最终拖垮对手。你之所生，彼之灭亡。

Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_WU_Desc.oracleText: Leverage your affinity for artifacts to pummel your foes.
Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_WU_Desc.translation: 运用大量神器击倒对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_WU_Desc_2.oracleText: Soar over your opponent's defense while protecting your front-line with tactical spells.
Decks/Precon/Precon_NPE_GRN_WU_Desc_2.translation: 利用战斗咒语保护接敌生物，派出空中部队洞穿对手防线。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_ELD_Oko_Desc.oracleText: Oko is a shapeshifting iconoclast, uncommonly clever even for a faerie, who prefers trickery and manipulation to all-out battle. Deploy evasive creatures and augment them at crucial moments to build an unstoppable force.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_ELD_Oko_Desc.translation: 幻法仙灵瓯柯是一个变形叛逆者，即使对一个仙灵来说也是不寻常的聪明，他更喜欢诡计和操纵，而不是全面的战斗。部署易闪躲生物并在关键时刻附体它们，以建立一支不可阻挡的力量。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_ELD_Rowan_Desc.oracleText: As the daughter of a king, Rowan has trained extensively in both swordsmanship and etiquette — but she greatly prefers to solve her problems with a blade. Marshal an army of noble knights and assault your opponent with military precision.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_ELD_Rowan_Desc.translation: 作为国王之女，萝婉在剑术和礼仪方面都接受了广泛的训练--但她更喜欢用刀剑来解决问题。召集一支贵族骑士军队，以精准军事化风格突击你的对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_GRN_BG-Desc.oracleText: Fill your graveyard with creatures, then draw on the power of death to crush your foe.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_GRN_BG-Desc.translation: 牺牲生物填满自己的坟墓场，然后利用死亡的力量击溃对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_GRN_UR_Desc.oracleText: Disrupt your opponent's plans and pummel them with a flurry of spells on your way to victory.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_GRN_UR_Desc.translation: 利用连串咒语打乱对手计划、令其无暇应对，便可一路迈向胜利。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M20_Ajani_Desc.oracleText: Aid your allies as you lead them to victory.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M20_Ajani_Desc.translation: 助力己方伙伴，引导他们迈向胜利。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M20_Chandra_Desc.oracleText: Overwhelm your foe with fire and fury.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M20_Chandra_Desc.translation: 利用无尽烈焰和滔天怒火征服对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M20_Mu_Desc.oracleText: Lock down your opponent and soar over their defenses.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M20_Mu_Desc.translation: 先设法让对手动弹不得，而后利用空中大军穿越防线。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M20_Sorin_Desc.oracleText: Draw strength from death and destruction.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M20_Sorin_Desc.translation: 从死亡与毁灭当中汲取力量，壮大自己。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M20_Vivien_Desc.oracleText: Crush your opponent with nature's might.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M20_Vivien_Desc.translation: 召使自然之力压服对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M21_Basri_Desc.oracleText: The entire multiverse has opened before Basri Ket, ready to test his unshakable ideals. Spread the hurt by permanently powering up an army of creatures that submit to no one.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M21_Basri_Desc.translation: 整个多重宇宙已经在巴席利面前展开，准备测试他不可动摇的理想。通过永久强化一群不服从任何人的生物来传播伤害。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M21_Chandra_Desc.oracleText: Passionate, powerful, possessing a short fuse, Chandra is always ready to bring the heat. Launch a burning barrage directly at your opponent's life total until  nothing but ash remains.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M21_Chandra_Desc.translation: 激情，强大，暴脾气，茜卓总是准备好带来热浪。直接向你的对手倾泻燃烧弹幕，直到只剩下灰烬。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M21_Garruk_Desc.oracleText: Cursed no longer, Garruk is free to stalk the multiverse for the prey of his choosing. Overrun your opponent  with a ceaseless stampede of really, really big creatures.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M21_Garruk_Desc.translation: 不再被诅咒的贾路可以自由地在多重宇宙中寻找他选择的猎物。用非常非常大的生物不断地踩踏你的对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M21_Liliana_Desc.oracleText: Freed from her previous burdens, Liliana is prepared to take what is rightfully hers. In this case, it's your complete and utter victory fueled by a highly  disposable army of undead.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M21_Liliana_Desc.translation: 摆脱了之前的负担，莉莲娜准备好接受属于她自己的命运。在如此境遇，以一支高度可支配的亡灵大军，获得完全彻底的胜利。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M21_Teferi_Desc.oracleText: A master of time magic, Teferi wields the lessons of the past to forge a better future. Clean your opponent's clock with an overwhelming number of resources.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_M21_Teferi_Desc.translation: 作为时间魔法大师，泰菲力运用过去的教训来营造更美好的未来。泰菲力用大量资源打断对手的节奏获取胜利。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_RNA_1_Desc.oracleText: Summon a horde of feral creatures and goad them into a frenzy as you stampede to victory!
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_RNA_1_Desc.translation: 持续召唤凶猛兽群，激发它们破坏天性，踏平一切阻碍赢取胜利！

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_RNA_2_Desc.oracleText: Optimize spells by casting them at the perfect moments to clear the way for your flying creatures.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_RNA_2_Desc.translation: 看准时机施放咒语，发挥其最大效用，借此为飞行生物扫清障碍。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_THB_Ashiok_Desc.oracleText: Fill your graveyard along with your opponent's for massive value as you slowly drive them insane.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_THB_Ashiok_Desc.translation: 将你的坟墓场和对手的坟墓场一起填满，获取巨大的优势，当然也慢慢把你对手逼疯。

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_THB_Elspeth_Desc.oracleText: Build up a battalion of devoted soldiers and fearlessly lead them to a glorious victory.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_THB_Elspeth_Desc.translation: 忠诚卫士结为军阵，无畏荣光引导胜利

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_WAR_UG_Desc.oracleText: Take control of the situation! Manipulate your opponent's battlefield and power up your army with Proliferate!
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_WAR_UG_Desc.translation: 将局面掌控在自己手中！扰乱对手战场，同时利用增殖强化己方实力！

Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_WAR_WB_Desc.oracleText: Build up your forces by gaining life. Overwhelm your foes with pure power and use crafty tactics to sneak past their defenses.
Decks/Precon/Precon_PW_WAR_WB_Desc.translation: 获得生命即可壮大军势。而后依靠纯粹战力击溃对手，并利用巧妙策略绕开防线。

Decks/Precon/Precon_Posty_Firesong.oracleText: A Song of Sun and Fire

Decks/Precon/Precon_SSR_M20_R_Desc.oracleText: Use spells and creatures to overwhelm your foe.
Decks/Precon/Precon_SSR_M20_R_Desc.translation: 抛洒咒语，派出生物，一举压服对手。

Decks/Precon/Precon_SSR_M20_W_Desc.oracleText: Use your flying creatures to directly attack their life.
Decks/Precon/Precon_SSR_M20_W_Desc.translation: 部署飞行生物统治天空，而后直击对手获取胜利。

Decks/Precon/Precon_StarterAmazon_M21_B_.oracleText: Weaken your foes with deadly spells and finish them off with your dark minions.
Decks/Precon/Precon_StarterAmazon_M21_B_.translation: 致死魔咒削弱敌军，暗黑爪牙终结生命

Decks/Precon/Precon_StarterAmazon_M21_G_.oracleText: Command giant beasts to crush your opponents and decimate their armies.
Decks/Precon/Precon_StarterAmazon_M21_G_.translation: 号令群兽，粉碎敌手，歼灭敌军

Decks/Precon/Precon_Starter_M21_B_Desc.oracleText: Weaken your foes with deadly spells and finish them off with your dark minions.
Decks/Precon/Precon_Starter_M21_B_Desc.translation: 致死魔咒削弱敌军，暗黑爪牙终结生命

Decks/Precon/Precon_Starter_M21_G_Desc.oracleText: Command giant beasts to crush your opponents and decimate their armies.
Decks/Precon/Precon_Starter_M21_G_Desc.translation: 号令群兽，粉碎敌手，歼灭敌军

Decks/Precon/Precon_StreamLabs_desc.oracleText: Recruit your army and mentor your foot soldiers into battle-hardened veterans. Build a force to be reckoned with!

Duelscene/SettingsMenu/PrivacyPolicy/Opt.oracleText:
• You can reset your mobile ad ID (IDFA or AAID) at any time through your device settings, which will allow you to limit the use of information collected about you. You may also visit http://www.aboutads.info/appchoices.
• The location data collected through an app depends on your device settings and app permissions.  You can disable location permissions on the app or device level and Bluetooth and WiFi scanning.
• If you have linked your Wizards account with certain social media or third party gaming platforms, such as Facebook or Steam, you may unlink your accounts at any time by visiting your Wizards account settings.
Duelscene/SettingsMenu/PrivacyPolicy/Opt.translation:
"-您随时可以通过您所使用的设备来重置您的移动广告标识符（IDFA或AAID），这样便能够限制相关方面使用您设备提供之可供收集的个人信息。您也可以访问http://www.aboutads.info/appchoices了解其他选择。
-您可以通过您设备的设置与应用权限设定来控制应用所收集的位置信息：应用或设备层级的定位许可及蓝牙与WiFi扫描。"

Duelscene/SettingsMenu/PrivacyPolicy/Spe.oracleText:
• California residents have special rights, including the rights to known certain information and to require specific pieces of information; the right to delete certain information; the right to opt-out of the "sale" of their personal information to third parties; and the right not to be discriminating against for exercising their rights.
• To the extent Wizards sells your personal information as the term "sell" is defined under the California Consumer Privacy Act, you have the right to opt-out of the sale of your personal information by us to third parties at any time. You may submit a request to opt-out by going to https://company.wizards.com/legal/wizards-coasts-privacy-policy#donotsell, calling our toll-free number at (800) 324-6496 or emailing us at privacy@wizards.com.
• We do not sell personal information of consumers who we have actual knowledge are under 16 years old.
Duelscene/SettingsMenu/PrivacyPolicy/Spe.translation:
•加利福尼亚州居民享有以下特殊权利，包括：获知指定信息及索取指定信息的权利；删除指定信息的权利；拒绝将其个人信息「出售」予第三方的权利；以及不受歧视地行使自身权利之权利。
•在《加利福尼亚州消费者隐私法（California Consumer Privacy Act）》规定之「出售」涵义范围内，针对威世智将您的个人信息「出售」给第三方此行为，你有权随时主动注销。您可以通过以下方式提出此意愿：访问https://company.wizards.com/legal/wizards-coasts-privacy-policy#donotsell；拨打我们的免费电话（800）324-6496；或向privacy@wizards.com发送电子邮件。
•我们不会出售已实际掌握之不满16周岁消费者的个人信息。

Duelscene/SettingsMenu/PrivacyPolicy/Spe.oracleText: Special Notice Regarding European, UK and Swiss Users
Duelscene/SettingsMenu/PrivacyPolicy/Spe.translation: 关于欧盟用户的特别说明

Duelscene/SettingsMenu/PrivacyPolicy/Spe.oracleText:
• Users located in European Union, United Kingdom and Switzerland have special rights, including to access, rectify and erase personal data; the right to data portability; the right to be forgotten; the right to withdraw consent; and the right to restrict or object to processing of personal data.
• Personal data will be transferred out of the EU, Switzerland and the UK to the United States. We utilize appropriate safeguards for transfers of personal data, such as Standard Contractual Clauses.

-个人数据将从欧盟境内转出存至美国。"

Duelscene/SettingsMenu/PrivacyPolicy/Spe.oracleText: • If you engage in organized play, your information (e.g., name, DCI number, city, state, nationality, username and email) may be accessible by authorized tournament organizers, retail locations that are part of the Wizards Play Network, members of the Wizards' community that are adjudicating organized play events, and prize fulfillment service providers. These parties are independent of Wizards, but they are contractually prohibited from using your information for any other purpose than that for which it was provided to them, and they agree to maintain the confidentiality, security and integrity of information they receive from us.  Your information may also be disclosed to members of the Wizards' community who are engaged in investigating violations of tournament rules and the Code of Conduct. Additionally, your name, city and country may appear in online leaderboards and organized play event results.
Duelscene/SettingsMenu/PrivacyPolicy/Spe.translation:
"- 如果您参加组织化赛事，则经授权的比赛主办人、Wizards play Network销售网络成员销售点、威世智社群中担任组织化赛事裁判之成员，及发放奖金之服务提供商均有权访问您的信息。
虽然上述各方均为独立于威世智的第三方，但威世智与其均立有合约，规定其不得将您的个人信息用于原本规定之外的其他用途，且上述各方均同意严守从我处获得之所有信息的私密、安全及完整。
您的信息也会披露给调查违反比赛规则和行为准则的威世智社群成员。
此外，您的信息可能显示于在线排行榜和组织化赛事的结果中。"
