Events/Event_Desc_Festival_KHM_Precon.oracleText: Listen now to the Festival of Tales! Hear stories from across the World Tree, the bridge between the realms! From the halls of Starnheim to the mists of Littjara, it is the World Tree that links Kaldheim together. Those who know it can travel across the realms - as long as the god Esika sees fit to let them! She was born of the Tree, and she keeps it well. She shares the Tree with the clever Cosmos beast Toski, her messenger and spy, who hears all and brings new secrets to her. If you ever find yourself between the realms, give your thanks to Esika, and prepare yourself to become a part of the next tale we tell! Select from among the event's preconstructed decks and play as much as you like. Change decks whenever you choose.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_KHM_Precon.translation: 立即收听传说节庆！聆听源自通连诸境之世界树彼端的故事！ 从斯达海姆正殿到利雅拉迷雾，凯德海姆各境域经由世界树连接在一起。知道其间奥秘的人都能够经此跨越境域～只要世界树神埃西卡允许！埃西卡由世界树孕育成长，如今由她来保佑世界树平安。她与聪慧的寰宇野兽托斯奇一通住在树间，并让后者作为自己的信使和间谍，在各境域之间聆听消息，回报秘密。 如果你有幸能够穿行境域，别忘了向埃西卡表示谢意，也许我们下次的故事里你就是主角！ 从本赛事的预组套牌中选择一副来参加，之后便可尽情对局。你可以在本活动中随时更换所用套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_LCI_HistoricB.oracleText:
Collect some of your Favorite Card Style in this Historic Brawl Festival!

Take these Historic Brawl preconstructed decks for a spin, and see if you find a new favorite! Change decks as often as you like.

ADD MORE DESCRIPTION WHEN DECKS ARE COMPETE
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_LCI_HistoricB.translation:
在这个史迹争锋节上收集一些你最喜欢的卡牌样式！

试试这些史迹争锋预组套牌，看看你是否能找到新的最爱！可以随意更换套牌。

“当套牌完成时，添加更多描述”

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_LCI_ImmortalS.oracleText:
Collect some of your Favorite Card Style in this Historic Festival!

The Immortal Sun provides vast magical power to its wielder and is currently lost in the multiverse. How will you wield its ancient power?

Bring a 60-card deck from among any cards available on MTG Arena. Put old favorites and new contenders toe-to-toe with the powers of the Immortal Sun:

At the beginning of your draw step, draw an additional card.

Spells you cast cost {o1} less to cast.

Creatures you control get +1/+1.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_LCI_ImmortalS.translation:
在这个史迹节里收集一些你最喜欢的卡牌样式！

永生圣阳为它的使用者提供了巨大的魔力，目前它已经迷失在多重宇宙中。你将如何运用它的古老力量？

从万智牌竞技场上可用的任何卡牌中选择60张卡牌。让旧爱和新兴竞争者与永生圣阳的力量面对面：

在你的抓牌步骤开始时，额外抓一张牌。

你施放的咒语减少{o1}来施放。

由你操控的生物得+1/+1。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_LCI_Storydeck.oracleText:
Collect some of your Favorite Card Style in this Block Festival!

Play out the story with 60-card decks containing only Lost Caverns of Ixalan cards usable in Standard. Change decks as often as you like.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_LCI_Storydeck.translation:
在这个街区节日中收集一些你最喜欢的卡牌样式！

用仅包含可用于标准模式的《依夏兰迷窟》60张卡牌作为套牌来演绎故事。随意更换套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_LTR_Brawl.oracleText: Your favorite legendary creature from The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth is ready to command your deck into battle! Bring a 60-card Alchemy-legal Brawl deck with a twist: Legendary creatures and planeswalkers are banned except those from The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth. Play and change decks as much as you want until the event ends! "To Isengard!" the Ents cried in many voices. "To Isengard!" To Isengard Though Isengard be ringed and barred with doors of stone; Though Isengard be strong and hard, as cold as stone and bare as bone, We go, we go, we go to war, to hew the stone and break the door; For bole and bough are burning now, the furnace roars – we go to war! To land of gloom with tramp of doom, with roll of drum, we come, we come; To Isengard with doom we come! With doom we come, with doom we come! So they sang as they marched southwards -- The Ends, Book 2, pg 485
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_LTR_Brawl.translation: 你最钟爱的魔戒：中洲传说传奇生物已经准备好指挥你的套牌投入战斗！ 使用事先组好的60张炼金争锋套牌参赛，但这次有些不一样：你只能利用出自魔戒：中洲传说的传奇生物和鹏洛客，其他传奇生物和鹏洛客都被禁用。你可以随心所欲地更换套牌，并尽情对局直到活动结束！ 「去艾森加德！」恩特们异口同声呐喊道。「去艾森加德！」目标艾森加德！ 哪怕高墙环绕石门阻隔； 哪怕艾森加德固若金汤，冷若岩石，荒若白骨， 我们前进、前进，挺进战场，劈山裂石，摧毁门户； 林木受焚烧，熔炉狂咆哮，我们往战场前进！ 踩着判决的步伐，往那阴森土地进发；伴着隆隆鼓声，我们前进、前进； 目标艾森加德，我们带来最后的结局！ 我们带来最后的结局！最后的结局！ 他们边如此高唱，边向南行去。 ～恩特（第二部，第99页）

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_M21_HistoricS.oracleText: For this week's Festival of Time event, you'll need to weave together more cards than ever, calling in aid from many times and places. Can you bring the past into the present? The future may depend upon it. Your deck must be at least 100 cards from all of MTG Arena, but you can only use a single copy of any card that isn't a basic land, and you cannot use a sideboard or companion. The following cards are not allowed: Nexus of Fate Oko, Thief of Crowns
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_M21_HistoricS.translation: 欢迎来到本周的时光活动节，你需要聚集的卡牌远超从前，从各个多重宇宙呼唤援助。你能否将过去带至当下？未来或许取决于此。 你的牌组必须有至少100张牌，你可以使用MTGA中的所有卡牌，但除基本地外每张牌都只能使用一张，你不能使用备牌区和行侣。 以下卡牌被禁止使用： 龙命连结点 窃冠瓯柯

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_M21_HistoricS.oracleText: For this week's Festival of Time event, you'll need to weave together more cards than ever, calling in aid from many times and places. Can you bring the past into the present? The future may depend upon it. In the community-inspired Gladiator format, your deck must be at least 100 cards, and you can use (almost) any card on Arena. However, you can only use a single copy of any card that isn't a basic land. The following cards are not allowed: Nexus of Fate Oko, Thief of Crowns
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_M21_HistoricS.translation: 在本周的时间节庆活动中，你需要借助不同时空与地域的援助，寻觅更多牌张来构组套牌。你能否将过往带回现在？未来如何发展就端看于此。 本次活动采用社群热门的角斗赛制：你的套牌可由来自《MTG竞技场》的（几乎）所有牌张构成，但必须有至少100张。不过，基本地以外的同名牌只能有一张。 不得使用以下牌张： 龙命连结点 窃冠瓯柯

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_M21_NewPlayer.oracleText: Welcome to the Festival of Time! This week, we are turning the clock forward for a glimpse of what is to come. Change is on the horizon, and even savvy veterans will have to learn new ways to achieve glory. These decks have already adapted to the coming changes. They use only cards from the past year, and they will be useful to planeswalkers young and old for a long while yet. Fight it out, and determine who will rule the future!
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_M21_NewPlayer.translation: 欢迎来到时间节庆！在本周的活动中，我们将调快时钟，一瞥将来发展。面对即将到来的改变，就连最精明的老手也要潜心研究才能赢回昔日荣光。 这些套牌在构组时已考虑到系列轮替带来的变动。套牌中只利用到过去一年之间发行的牌张，希望会对新来乍到或稍微离开的鹏洛客们带来帮助。亲自来体验这些套牌吧，看看哪些能够在未来发光发热！

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_MID_Emblem.oracleText: The Harvest Festival is winding down, but there's still time for one more party! This season of plenty means there's plenty to go around, so come right in! Dig into a delicious dish, tickle your brain with a clever puzzle, or just enjoy the shine of a pretty bauble. Actually, how about all three? At the Harvest Bash, everyone gets a few treats to celebrate the season: you'll get a Clue token, a Treasure token, and a Food token. Bring a 60-card Singleton deck and win Equinox card styles for your collection! Play as much as you want until the event ends. For more details on this event, including a list of banned cards, click here.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_MID_Emblem.translation: 收成节庆即将结束，但我们仍有时间再聚一次！正逢丰收季节，集会硕果累累，还请加入享乐！畅享美味佳肴，挑战巧智谜题，或只是醉心耀眼饰品。然而，三全齐美岂不更好？ 在收成狂欢中，每个人都会得到一些礼物来欢庆佳节：你将得到一个线索衍生物、一个珍宝衍生物和一个食品衍生物。使用事先组好的60张无双套牌参赛，赢取昼分卡牌样式为收藏增添色彩！尽情对局，直到活动结束。 关于此活动的更多信息以及禁牌清单请点击此处。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_MID_Precon.oracleText: Welcome to the Harvest Festival! Do you hear that music? Smell those funnel cakes? The season is well and truly in swing, so step into the fair and have a look around. Whether you like haunted houses or hay rides, there's fun for all ages! And don't pay any mind to reports of menacing clawed figures looming in the shadows outside the grounds. We're quite sure there's nothing to be worried about... Enjoy the attractions of the Festival with these preconstructed decks, and win Equinox card styles for your collection! You can change decks as often as you like and play as much as you want until the event ends. For more details on this event, including a list of banned cards, click here.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_MID_Precon.translation: 欢迎来到收成节庆！你可有听到这美妙音乐？你可曾闻到这蛋糕香气？丰收节庆正当盛时，还请光临会场亲身体验。无论你是想进鬼屋探险，还是享受篷车狂欢，总有一处适合你！ 如果你听到有人报告在会场外阴影处见到恐怖锐爪行迹，请不要挂在心上。我们保证世道太平，无心担心...。 利用预组套牌享受节庆时光，赢取昼分卡牌样式为收藏增添色彩！你可以随心所欲地更换套牌，并尽情对局直到活动结束。 关于此活动的更多信息以及禁牌清单请点击此处。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_MKM_Storydeck.oracleText: Collect some of your Favorite Card Style in this Block Festival! Play out the story with 60-card decks containing only Murders at Karlov Manor cards usable in Standard. Change decks as often as you like.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_MKM_Storydeck.translation: 在本街区活动节中收集一些你最爱的卡牌样式！ 用一副60张的套牌演绎故事，套牌中仅能包含卡洛夫庄园谋杀案中标准合法的卡牌。你可以随时更换套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_MOM_HistoricA.oracleText: Collect your Favorite Team-Up Card Style in this Historic Artisan Festival! Bring a 60-card deck using only commons, uncommons, and basic lands from any set in MTG Arena. Without rares, the common folk can truly be heard!
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_MOM_HistoricA.translation: 在此史迹巧匠节庆中，收集你最喜爱的携手英雄卡牌样式！ 使用事先组好的60张套牌参赛，其中可包含《MTG竞技场》中所有系列的牌，但仅能以「普通」、「非普通」稀有度牌张以及基本地组成。套牌无稀有，普通做先锋！

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_MOM_HistoricB.oracleText:
Collect your Favorite Team-Up Card Style in this Historic Brawl Festival!

Bring a 100-card Brawl deck using any cards in MTG Arena, led by your favorite legendary creature or planeswalker!
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_MOM_HistoricB.translation:
在此史迹争锋节庆中，收集你最喜爱的携手英雄卡牌样式！

使用事先组好的100张争锋套牌参赛，其中可包含所有能在MTG竞技场中使用的牌，并由你最喜爱的传奇生物或鹏洛客统帅！

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ONE_Basilica.oracleText: Behold the Fair Basilica! Its crimson sinews and porcelain metal are styled after its ruler, Elesh Norn, the dominant praetor of New Phyrexia. Her control over old Mirrodin's mycosynth reserves has ensured her rule continues unchallenged...so far. This 60-card Singleton event arrives at the Fair Basilica, the white-dominated sphere of New Phyrexia. The glory of Elesh Norn cannot be denied in this place, and abilities that trigger from creatures entering the battlefield will be doubled in exultation of her generosity and wisdom. Embrace this true perfection, and you'll earn white Ichor Showcase card styles from Phyrexia: All Will Be One. For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ONE_Basilica.translation: 敬请感受苍皓宗堂的无尽荣光！其间生灵的绯红肌腱及钢瓷外壳均承自此间主宰、亦是当今新非瑞克西亚的当家魔判官～艾蕾侬。她将古秘罗地的构生菌来源全数划归己有，得以确保统治连续不断...直到现在。 如今60张牌无双赛活动带领我们来到苍皓宗堂，这片受白色统领的新非瑞克西亚狱界。艾蕾侬的荣光遍布此界，因生物进战场而触发的异能则会受其慷慨与睿智加成而有双倍功效。接纳这等真实完化入怀，便能赢得来自非瑞克西亚：万界归一系列的的白色脓水特色卡牌样式。 关于此活动的更多信息，以及可收集的卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ONE_Compleatl.oracleText: Our target is New Phyrexia, formerly known as Mirrodin. An entire plane rebuilt from the inside out, filled with predators, hazards, and traps. Everything there will kill you, compleat you, or both given half a chance. This should be a walk in the park, right? If you attack New Phyrexia, you'd better do your homework lest you find yourself Compleatly Outmatched. Learn where the real power lies with these Brawl decks, each helmed by a dangerous foe who can be found defending (or also attempting to conquer) New Phyrexia. As you win, you'll earn Manga card styles for planeswalkers from Phyrexia: All Will Be One. There are 10 different styles to collect! For more details on this event, including a full list of card styles you can earn, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ONE_Compleatl.translation: 我们的目标是新非瑞克西亚。这里原来叫作秘罗地，但如今整片时空已被由内而外重新构造，遍地皆是魔判官、危险与陷阱。其间万物不是会杀了你，就是会完化你，或两者兼而有之。对你来说都是小菜一碟，对吧？ 如果你下定决心要攻击新非瑞克西亚，你最好先做足准备，以免自己被完化压制。仔细研究这些争锋套牌，发掘其间的真正力量～每副套牌都由一位防卫（或试图征服）新非瑞克西亚的危险敌人领军。随着你获胜场次的增加，你将获得来在非瑞克西亚：万界归一系列的日漫风鹏洛客卡牌样式。共有10种不同的样式可供收集！ 关于此活动的更多信息，以及可收集的卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ONE_Furnace.oracleText: The Autonomous Furnace was the first sphere established by Phyrexia in their assault on what was once Mirrodin. The Mirran resistance now uses it as a refuge and staging ground, ignored by Urabrask while the praetor furthers his own plots. This 60-card Singleton event takes us to the Autonomous Furnace, the red-dominated sphere of New Phyrexia. Nothing is wasted in this massive forge complex: when you discard a card here, you'll still be able to cast it this turn. Use your resources wisely, and you'll earn red Ichor Showcase card styles from Phyrexia: All Will Be One. For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ONE_Furnace.translation: 自治熔炉本是非瑞克西亚人袭击旧秘罗地后第一个夺下的狱界，如今秘罗志士却用此地当作避难所及集结地，全因此间魔判官洼巴司一心推进自身志业，任由反抗势力发展壮大。 本如今60张牌无双赛活动带领我们一探自治熔炉，这片受红色统领的新非瑞克西亚狱界。此界是一个巨大的锻造复合体，所有一切都可重复利用：当你在此处弃一张牌时，你仍能在当回合中施放它。善用你的资源，为自己赢得来自非瑞克西亚：万界归一系列的红色脓水特色卡牌样式。 关于此活动的更多信息，以及可收集的卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ONE_Maze.oracleText: The Hunter Maze is a labyrinthine wilderness of copper trees draped in vines and green fog. The praetor Vorinclex and his ally, the compleated former Mirran hero Glissa, rule over this endless battlefield where only the strong survive. This 60-card Singleton event brings us to the Hunter Maze, the green-dominated sphere of New Phyrexia. This impenetrable jungle rewards the strongest combatants: when a creature with 4 or more power joins your side, it will bring a new card along with it. Overpower the competition, and you'll earn green Ichor Showcase card styles from Phyrexia: All Will Be One. For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ONE_Maze.translation: 猎者迷林正如其名，此地满是无尽铜树、藤蔓与绿雾，漫步其间很容易就会迷失方向。魔判官弗霖凯及副手格莉莎统领此处，后者虽原为秘罗英雄，如今已遭完化效忠新非瑞克西亚。此界乃是无尽战场，唯有强者才能继续生存。 如今60张牌无双赛带领我们踏入猎者迷林，这片受绿色统领的新非瑞克西亚狱界。唯有最强大的战力才能从这片密不透风的丛林中得到奖赏：当你有力量等于或大于4的生物加入时，它会同时给你带来一张新牌。脱颖而出，便能为自己赢得来自非瑞克西亚：万界归一系列的绿色脓水特色卡牌样式。 关于此活动的更多信息，以及可收集的卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ONE_Pits.oracleText: The praetor Sheoldred reigns over the Dross Pits after claiming them by trickery from one of her upstart rivals. The acidic necrogen and toxic gases that flow throughout the sphere make an unforgiving setting for their ongoing war games. This 60-card Singleton event descends into the Dross Pits, the black-dominated sphere of New Phyrexia. It is a foul place dominated by death: your abilities that trigger from creatures dying will be doubled here. Capture this power, and you'll earn black Ichor Showcase card styles from Phyrexia: All Will Be One. For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ONE_Pits.translation: 魔判官希欧蕊坐镇蔓菲深沼，而她还是利用妙计才从自命不凡的对手手中夺下此处。此界遍布腐蚀性的化尸瘴和有毒性气体，为持续不断的战事推演提供了绝佳的残酷环境。 如今60张牌无双赛带领我们深入蔓菲深沼，这片受黑色统领的新非瑞克西亚狱界。此处恶邪不堪，受死亡统治：因生物进死去而触发的异能会有双倍功效。掌控这一力量，为自己赢得来自非瑞克西亚：万界归一系列的黑色脓水特色卡牌样式。 关于此活动的更多信息，以及可收集的卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_OTJ_AlchemyPr.oracleText:
Collect some of your Favorite Card Style in this Alchemy Festival!

The vault is open and it's time for The Big Score to take center stage! Play with BIG cards in these Alchemy preconstructed decks. Change decks as often as you like.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_OTJ_AlchemyPr.translation:
在这个炼金节中收集一些你最喜欢的卡牌样式！

金库已经敞开大门，是时候《满载而归》了！在这些炼金预组套牌中体验BIG系列的卡牌。随意更换套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_OTJ_BonnyPall.oracleText:
Collect some of your Favorite Card Style in this Standard Festival!

Bring a 60-card Standard deck. Break out the latest and greatest from the lab, or maybe find a new favorite!

In this event, each player gets some help from Banny Pall, Clearcutter:

Whenever you attack, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand or graveyard onto the battlefield.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_OTJ_BonnyPall.translation:
在这个标准节上收集一些您最喜欢的卡牌样式！

带上一副 60 张标准套牌。揭开实验室的最新、最精彩的成果，或者找到新的最爱！

在这个活动中，每位牌手都能得到利落樵女伯妮帕的帮助：

每当你攻击时，抓一张牌，然后你可以将一张地牌从你手上或坟墓场放进战场。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_One_Bay.oracleText: Tread carefully in the Surgical Bay; its entire surface is covered in a swirling sea of quicksilver and oil. The sky is lit by ominous, eye-like lights that report every move to Jin-Gitaxias in his spire-top laboratory. This 60-card Singleton event explores the Surgical Bay, the blue-dominated sphere of New Phyrexia. Here, cruel and disturbing experiments abound: when you proliferate, it is especially prolific, giving you two instances of extra counters. Your findings will earn you blue Ichor Showcase card styles from Phyrexia: All Will Be One. For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_One_Bay.translation: 在外展海湾行事请务必小心；此间水银及烁油交汇而成的海洋波涛汹涌，席卷全界。天空则遍布不详的眼状亮光，将内里的任何风吹草动都上报给高在尖塔顶端实验室内的金吉塔厦。 如今60张牌无双赛活动带领我们一览外展海湾，这片受蓝色统领的新非瑞克西亚狱界。此界满目皆是残刃骇人的实验：当你增殖时，增加的效应会特别明显，能让你多加两个指示物。实验发现能为你换取来自非瑞克西亚：万界归一系列的的蓝色脓水特色卡牌样式。 关于此活动的更多信息，以及可收集的卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_SNC_Brokers.oracleText: We all know the Brokers of today: a law firm with demonic ties who secretly follow a doomsday prophecy. But how did they go from nomadic paladins to legalistic opportunists? In this 60-card Singleton event, even the slightest advantage can be leveraged, so get ready to turn your counters into cards! As you do, you'll earn Golden Age Showcase card styles from Streets of New Capenna, each featuring spells from the Brokers family. For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_SNC_Brokers.translation: 今日的扶济社广为大家熟知：有恶魔联系的律所、私下信奉末日预言。但他们又是怎样从居无定所的神圣武士转变为善用法律的投机分子的？ 在此60张牌的无双活动中，即使是最微弱的优势也可以发挥关键作用，所以准备好将你的指示物转化为卡牌优势吧！当你这样做时，将获得来自新卡佩纳：喧嚣黑街中扶济社家族咒语的黄金时代特色卡牌样式。 关于此赛制的更多信息，以及卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_SNC_Cabaretti.oracleText: We all know the Cabaretti of today: fun-loving druids who expect loyalty from their followers (or else). But how did they go from keepers of an ancient faith to a nefarious cult? In this 60-card Singleton event, there's strength in numbers, so build your alliance from the ground up! As you do, you'll earn Golden Age Showcase card styles from Streets of New Capenna, each featuring spells from the Cabaretti family! For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_SNC_Cabaretti.translation: 今日的乐舞会广为大家熟知：贪图玩乐的德鲁伊、希冀追随者（跟其他人）忠诚投入。但他们又是怎样从古老信仰的虔诚信徒转变为恶贯满盈的邪恶组织的？ 在此60张牌的无双活动中，人多就是力量，因此从头开始联手携力！当你这样做时，将获得来自新卡佩纳：喧嚣黑街中乐舞会家族咒语的黄金时代特色卡牌样式。 关于此赛制的更多信息，以及卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_SNC_Maestros.oracleText: We all know the Maestros of today: elite vampire assassins with a passion for fine art. But how did they go from generous patrons to a murderous crime family? In this 60-card Singleton event, harness the ruthless ambition of the Maestros as you sacrifice creatures to recast instants and sorceries from your graveyard. As you do, you'll earn Golden Age Showcase card styles from Streets of New Capenna, each featuring spells from the Maestros family! For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_SNC_Maestros.translation: 今日的绝艺盟广为大家熟知：讲究精雕细作、满怀创作热情的精英吸血鬼刺客。但他们又是怎样从慷慨大方的幕后贵人转变为取命为乐的犯罪家族的？ 在此60张牌的无双活动中，牺牲生物来从你坟墓场中重新施放瞬间与法术，亲自掌控绝艺盟的无情野心。当你这样做时，将获得来自新卡佩纳：喧嚣黑街中绝艺盟家族咒语的黄金时代特色卡牌样式。 关于此赛制的更多信息，以及卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_SNC_Obscura.oracleText: We all know the Obscura of today: powerful wizards and mystics who use their power to con and blackmail. But how did they go from enlightened counselors to angels to manipulative grifters? In this 60-card Singleton event, every attack is a covert operation, so get ready to connive your way to victory! As you do, you'll earn Golden Age Showcase card styles from Streets of New Capenna, each featuring spells from the Obscura family. For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_SNC_Obscura.translation: 今日的秘闻帮广为大家熟知：利用强大法力恣意诈骗勒索的法术师和秘教徒。但他们又是怎么样从蒙恩受启的天使参谋转变为手法老练的狡诈骗徒的？ 在此60张牌的无双活动中，每次攻击都是秘密行动，因此务必筹谋周全，直取胜利！当你这样做时，将获得来自新卡佩纳：喧嚣黑街中秘闻帮家族咒语的黄金时代特色卡牌样式。 关于此赛制的更多信息，以及卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_SNC_Riveteers.oracleText: We all know the Riveteers of today: tough-as-nails artisans who can break buildings as easily as kneecaps. But how did they go from skilled tradespeople to dominating the lower levels of New Capenna? In this 60-card Singleton event, no sacrifice is in vain with the right preparation–craft your decks and turns to make your own silver linings. As you do, you'll earn Golden Age Showcase card styles from Streets of New Capenna, each featuring spells from the Riveteers family! For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_SNC_Riveteers.translation: 今日的勤工联广为大家熟知：坚如铁钉的能工巧匠，摧毁建筑就像打碎膝盖一样轻而易举。但他们是如何从技艺纯熟的行商小贩转变为统领新卡佩纳底层人民的一方实力的？ 在此60张牌的无双活动中，只要你准备得当，任何牺牲都不会白费～仔细调整套牌、认真盘算每回合行动，就能为自己创造机会。当你这样做时，将获得来自新卡佩纳：喧嚣黑街中勤工联家族咒语的黄金时代特色卡牌样式。 关于此赛制的更多信息，以及卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_SNC_Turf_Braw.oracleText: The streets grow restless in New Capenna. Tensions between the families are reaching a fever pitch, and the alleys whisper of coming violence. No one's quite sure what started all–do the Obscura have something on the Brokers? Did the Riveteers steal from Maestros? Goodness knows the Cabaretti are ready... whatever the cause, one thing is clear: this means brawl. In Turf Brawls, defend your territory–or expand your influence–using one of the provided decks, each of which features a family representative as the commander! As you win, you'll earn the Skyscraper card styles from Streets of New Capenna. There are 10 different styles to collect! For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles you can earn, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_SNC_Turf_Braw.translation: 新卡佩纳街道躁动不安。五大家族之间的紧张局势已趋白热，街头巷尾都流传暴力对抗一触即发。然而没人知晓导火索为何～是秘闻帮掌握了扶济社的秘密？是勤工联偷了绝艺盟的东西？还有天晓得乐舞会是否已做好准备...无论原因为何，结果都很明显：争锋已至。 在地盘争锋中，有五副由家族代表担任指挥官的套牌供你选用。利用其中之一来保卫你的领土～或扩大你的影响力！获胜后，你将获得新卡佩纳：喧嚣黑街的摩天楼卡片样式。共有10种不同的样式可供收集！ 关于此赛制的更多信息，以及可收集的卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_STX_Knowledge.oracleText: The Strixhaven University College Cup is upon us! At this annual competition, mage-students from Strixhaven's five colleges compete to earn prestige for their college. The first competition is the Test of Knowledge! One of Strixhaven's most respected faculty members is here to oversee the test and provide guidance to the students. Get ready to show your stuff! In this event, the spells will be flying fast and furious! Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery, you'll draw a new card. Bring a 60-card Singleton deck to take advantage and claim victory! For your first win in this event each day, your Strixhaven college-themed sleeve, avatar, and pet will earn points for that College. After three events, the highest-scoring College will earn a special card sleeve for everyone on Arena! For more details on this event and the current scores, click here.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_STX_Knowledge.translation: 斯翠海文大学学院杯已经到来！在此年度赛事中，来自斯翠海文五所学院的修习法师们拼搏竞赛，试图为自己的学院争得荣誉。第一场竞赛是知识测试！本次测试将由斯翠海文校内一位广受学生尊敬的教师主持并提供指导。准备好展现自己的真正实力！ 在此活动中，充满速度与激情的咒语将扑面而来！每当你施放或复制瞬间或法术咒语时，你都能抓一张新牌。请事先构组一副60张的无双套牌参加测验，务请善加利用规则，最终赢得胜利！ 当你每天在此活动中首次赢得胜利时，你使用之斯翠海文学院主题牌套、头像和宠物都将为该学院贡献分数。三场活动之后，积分最高的学院将为每位竞技场内的牌手提供一副特殊牌套！关于本活动的更多信息以及当前各学院积分，请点击此处。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_STX_Leadershi.oracleText: And now, the thrilling conclusion to the Strixhaven University College Cup! At this annual competition, mage-students from Strixhaven's five colleges compete to earn prestige for their college. The third and final competition is the Test of Leadership! Strixhaven has cultivated many fine leaders, and now you must choose one to stand by your side. Rally your friends and followers and seize victory! In this event, bring a 60-card Brawl deck led by a legendary creature or planeswalker from Strixhaven: School of Mages! For your first win in this event each day, your Strixhaven college-themed sleeve, avatar, and pet will earn points for that College. After three events, the highest-scoring College will earn a special card sleeve for everyone on Arena! (Your choice of Commander does not affect these scores. Play whatever you like!) For more details on this event and the current scores, click here.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_STX_Leadershi.translation: 现在，斯翠海文大学学院杯迎来了激动人心的总决赛！在此年度赛事中，来自斯翠海文五所学院的修习法师们拼搏竞赛，试图为自己的学院争得荣誉。第三场，亦即最后一场竞赛是领袖测试！许多优异领袖正是出身斯翠海文，如今你必须选择一位与你并肩作战。召集伙伴与追随者勇夺桂冠！ 在此活动中，你需要准备一副60张争锋套牌，且其指挥官须为出自斯翠海文：魔法学校系列的传奇生物或鹏洛客！ 当你每天在此活动中首次赢得胜利时，你使用之斯翠海文学院主题牌套、头像和宠物都将为该学院贡献分数。三场活动之后，积分最高的学院将为每位竞技场内的牌手提供一副特殊牌套！（你挑选的指挥官不会影响分数。可以自由选用！）关于本活动的更多信息以及当前各学院积分，请点击此处。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_STX_Wit.oracleText: The Strixhaven University College Cup continues! At this annual competition, mage-students from Strixhaven's five colleges compete to earn prestige for their college. The second competition is the Test of Wit! With great power at your fingertips, what will you create? Show off your most impressive and imposing ideas to win both your match and the hearts of the crowd. In this event, you get a Treasure token each upkeep. Bring a 100-card Standard deck to maximize your extra mana! For your first win in this event each day, your Strixhaven college-themed sleeve, avatar, and pet will earn points for that College. After three events, the highest-scoring College will earn a special card sleeve for everyone on Arena! For more details on this event and the current scores, click here.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_STX_Wit.translation: 斯翠海文大学学院杯比拼继续！在此年度赛事中，来自斯翠海文五所学院的修习法师们拼搏竞赛，试图为自己的学院争得荣誉。第二场竞赛是才智测试！当有强大力量涌动指尖时，你会借此创造出何等精妙作品？纵情发挥创意，形成最惊艳、最壮观的作品展现出来，藉此赢下比赛和观众的心。 在此活动中，你每个维持都会得到一个珍宝衍生物。准备一副100张的标准套牌，最大限度地利用这份额外的法术力！ 当你每天在此活动中首次赢得胜利时，你使用之斯翠海文学院主题牌套、头像和宠物都将为该学院贡献分数。三场活动之后，积分最高的学院将为每位竞技场内的牌手提供一副特殊牌套！关于本活动的更多信息以及当前各学院积分，请点击此处。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_Turf_Brawls.oracleText: The streets grow restless in New Capenna. Tensions between the families are reaching a fever pitch, and the alleys whisper of coming violence. No one's quite sure what started all–do the Obscura have something on the Brokers? Did the Riveteers steal from Maestros? Goodness knows the Cabaretti are ready... whatever the cause, one thing is clear: this means brawl. In Turf Brawls, defend your territory–or expand your influence–using one of the provided decks, each of which features a family representative as the commander! As you win, you'll earn the Skyscraper card styles from Streets of New Capenna. There are 10 different styles to collect! For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles you can earn, click here
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_Turf_Brawls.translation: 新卡佩纳街道躁动不安。五大家族之间的紧张局势已趋白热，街头巷尾都流传暴力对抗一触即发。然而没人知晓导火索为何～是秘闻帮掌握了扶济社的秘密？是勤工联偷了绝艺盟的东西？还有天晓得乐舞会是否已做好准备...无论原因为何，结果都很明显：争锋已至。 在地盘争锋中，有五副由家族代表担任指挥官的套牌供你选用。利用其中之一来保卫你的领土～或扩大你的影响力！获胜后，你将获得新卡佩纳：喧嚣黑街的摩天楼卡片样式。共有10种不同的样式可供收集！ 关于此赛制的更多信息，以及可收集的卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处>

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_WOE_DarkTutel.oracleText: Collect some of your Favorite Card Style in this Alchemy Festival! Once upon a time, a dark curse provided knowledge at a harsh price. Bring a 60-card Alchemy deck. Break out the latest and greatest from the lab, or maybe find a new favorite! In this event, each player gets an extra card each turn, but loses life equal to its mana value.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_WOE_DarkTutel.translation: 在这个炼金节上收集一些您最喜欢的卡牌样式！ 很久以前，黑暗诅咒以残酷的代价提供了知识。 带上一副 60 张炼金套牌。 揭开实验室的最新、最精彩的成果，或者找到新的最爱！ 在这个活动中，每个玩家每回合都会额外抽一张牌，但会失去等于其法力值的生命。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_WOE_GiftBagHi.oracleText: Collect some of your Favorite Card Style in this Historic Festival! Once upon a time, a trail of crumbs, clues, and coins led deep into the woods. Which will you find first? Bring a 60-card deck from among any cards available on MTG Arena. Put old favorites and new contenders toe-to-toe! In this event, players get one free treasure, clue, and food token on their first three turns, in whatever order they want!
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_WOE_GiftBagHi.translation: 在这个史迹节中收集一些您最喜欢的卡牌样式！ 很久以前，一条由面包屑、线索和硬币组成的小道通向树林深处。 你会先找到哪个？ 从 MTG Arena 上提供的任意卡牌中挑选一套 60 张卡牌。 让旧的最爱和新的竞争者面对面！ 在此活动中，玩家在前三回合可以按选择的顺序分别获得一个珍宝、线索或食品衍生物！

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_WOE_SeasonofG.oracleText: Collect some of your Favorite Card Styles in this Standard Festival! Once upon a time, enormous stalks rose up from the ground. In their shade, life flourshed. Bring a 60-card Standard deck, battle against the competition, and claim victory in the premier constructed format! In this event, players scry 1 whenever they play a creature, and draw a card whenever they target their own creatures.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_WOE_SeasonofG.translation: 在这个标准节中收集一些您最喜欢的卡牌样式！ 从前，巨大的树干从地里升起。 在他们的树荫下，生命蓬勃发展。 带上 60 张标准牌组，与竞争对手一较高下，并在顶级构筑赛制中获得胜利！ 在此活动中，玩家每次释放生物咒语时都会占卜 1，使用咒语指自己的生物为目标时抓一张牌。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ZNR_3Sets.oracleText: We've simply loved showing you around Zendikar during this Festival of Adventure! But as our journey comes to a close, it's time to put all we've seen into practice with a hands-on survival test. When you're out exploring, you won't always have everything you think you need. What happens when your pack is empty and your favorite rope snaps in two? You'll have to make the best use of what you've got, putting your gear to work in ways you might not have otherwise. Can you survive with limited tools and resources? That is the mark of a true adventurer! Bring a 60-card deck using only cards from the past three Standard sets: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths, Core Set 2021, and Zendikar Rising. Change your deck at any time. The following cards are not allowed: Omnath, Locus of Creation
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ZNR_3Sets.translation: 很高兴能在冒险节庆期间带你遍历赞迪卡！随着旅程临近尾声，是时候考验考验大家所学，让大家将一路上的见闻付诸实践，看看自己能否在这片险恶大地上幸存。 外出探险时，并非随时都有趁手工具在侧。当你的背包空空如也，最爱绳索也断成两截时，你该怎么办？你必须充分利用现有资源，转动脑筋以非常规方式发挥装备作用。你能否在工具资源双双受限的情况下求得生存？通过这一考验，你才能证明自己是真正的冒险家！ 使用事先组好的60张套牌进行游戏，但套牌仅限利用出自最近三个标准赛系列的牌张组成：依克黎：巨兽时空、2021核心系列和赞迪卡再起。你可以随时更换所用套牌。 不得使用以下牌张： 生机核欧那斯

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ZNR_Mastermin.oracleText: We've seen a great deal during the Festival of Adventure. We hope you've been paying attention along the way, because now it's time to put all that information to work. Think you know all there is to know? Then show it off at Trivia Night! Think fast: What's the most important piece of gear for venturing into an Ondu ruin? Do you need a Cleric or a Wizard to decipher these glyphs? Which of these opposing party members is the most dangerous, and why? If you know your stuff, you could win it all! The deck for this event is full of Clerics, Rogues, Warriors, and Wizards, but it contains no lands. Each turn, you may discard a card in exchange for a land token that will make any color of mana.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ZNR_Mastermin.translation: 赞迪卡各地的美丽景色，我们已在冒险节庆期间一饱眼福。我们希望你在游览过程中有留意路上见闻，因为现在正是将旅行收获付诸实践的时候。觉得自己已经无所不晓？那就在问答之夜上证明自己！ 开动脑筋，快速回答：探索昂度遗迹最重要的装备是什么？解密符文奥秘是要靠僧侣还是法术师？对手冒险团中哪个成员最危险，原因为何？如果上述问题你都了然于胸，也许你就能成为最后赢家！ 本活动的套牌全由僧侣、浪客、战士和法术师构成，但其中没有地。每个回合，你都可以弃掉一张牌，来交换能够产生任意颜色法术力的衍生地。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ZNR_Precon.oracleText: Welcome to the Festival of Adventure! During the next few weeks, we will be visiting and learning about the plane of adventure, Zendikar! From the lush canopies of Turntimber to the shadowed passages of Agadeem, this plane has sights and stories that few can match. This week, enjoy any of our fascinating programs, then make your own itinerary! You can choose whether to visit beautiful landmarks or to learn about useful, locally sourced spells. Each path offers a rich experience that you will not soon forget! Select from among the event's preconstructed decks and play as much as you like. Change decks whenever you choose.
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ZNR_Precon.translation: 欢迎参加冒险节庆！在接下来的几周中，我们将四处参观冒险时空赞迪卡，并希望各位在旅途当中学有所得！从旋林的葱郁树冠，到艾格丁的阴暗小径，此时空壮丽之处几无他处可及。 本周，请先享受我们的精彩行程，而后便可自由活动！无论是参观绝景地标，还是学习有用的当地咒语，相信每条路线都能让你收获难以忘怀的体验！ 从本活动的预组套牌中选择一副来参加，之后便可尽情对局。你可以随时更换所用套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ZNR_Singleton.oracleText: In this week's Festival of Adventure, we'll explore one of Zendikar's most unique features: the Roil. Zendikar's mana is so powerful that the ground can't even stay grounded! Bring a 60-card Standard deck with only one copy of any card except basic lands, and change it at any time. Your first spell each turn lets you cast a spell of lower cost out of your deck! The following cards are not allowed: Archon of Emeria Deafening Silence Drannith Magistrate Mangara, the Diplomat Ghostly Pilferer Cauldron Familiar Fires of Invention Flaxen Intruder Once Upon a Time Lutri, the Spellchaser Oko, Thief of Crowns Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath Escape to the Wilds Omnath, Locus of Creation Lucky Clover
Events/Event_Desc_Festival_ZNR_Singleton.translation: 在本周的冒险节庆中，我们将探索赞迪卡最具特色的景观：狂搅。赞迪卡的法术力是如此充沛，就连大地也不会岿然不动。 使用事先组好的60张标准套牌进行游戏，但套牌中每种牌仅限一张（基本地除外），且可以随时更换套牌。你每回合中施放的第一个咒语，都能让你再从牌库中施放另一个费用较低者！不得使用以下牌张： 伊美黎统领 震撼寂静 卓尼斯官员 使节曼格拉 魂魅小偷 鼎镬佣兽 创新烈焰 金发入侵者 很久以前 逐咒獭灵拉翠 窃冠瓯柯 天怒泰坦乌洛 逃往幻野 生机核欧那斯 幸运苜蓿

Events/Event_Desc_Flash_Event.oracleText:
Get a Dominaria pack just for entering this event! Bring your constructed deck, and battle opponents and earn bonus rewards with enough wins. 

Keep playing with that deck until you reach three wins or two losses.
Events/Event_Desc_Flash_Event.translation:
参加赛事即可获得多明纳里亚补充包！使用事先组好的套牌与对手进行对局，获得足够的胜场数量便可赢得额外奖励。

使用同一副套牌持续游戏，直到累积三胜或二败为止。

Events/Event_Desc_Flashback_Premier_Draf.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players This set is not legal in Standard.
Events/Event_Desc_Flashback_Premier_Draf.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 真人轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制 此系列在标准赛制中不可用。

Events/Event_Desc_FullBoxSealed_EOE.oracleText: You will open an entire 30 pack booster box of Edge of Eternities packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Second Spell Cast your second spell in a turn and earn additional bonuses to overwhelm your opponent. Artifact Control Assemble an artifact-based deck to grind out your opponent's resources turn by turn. Void Use the void mechanic at the cost of creatures and artifacts—then trigger devastating events! Landers & Landfall Use Lander tokens and landfall to create mana advantage. Landers can help to trigger landfall more easily! +1/+1 Counters Boost your entire army with +1/+1 counters—stack ‘em up and watch the enemies fall. Go Wide Assemble the largest battlefield in the system and conquer your opponents with sheer numbers. Artifact Aggro Play cheap artifacts you've uncovered on your travels to quickly overpower the field with supreme synergies. Graveyard Salvage long-forgotten ships and fallen warriors with a graveyard strategy that keeps you coming back. Space Stations Station your Spacecrafts by tapping creatures, then reap the rewards of your dedicated crew. Ramp Explore Sothera's furthest regions and worlds by controlling the largest monsters and ships in the system.
Events/Event_Desc_FullBoxSealed_EOE.translation: 你将打开整盒30包的虚空边域补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 二重咒语 在一回合中施放第二个咒语可获得额外加成，彻底压制对手。 神器控制 组建以神器为核心的套牌，逐步消耗对手的资源。 空洞 以牺牲生物和神器为代价发动空洞机制——进而触发毁灭性效果！ 探地器与地落 利用探地器衍生物和地落效应创造法术力优势。探地器能让你更轻松触发地落！ +1/+1指示物 用+1/+1指示物强化整支军队——不断叠加，见证敌军溃败。 横向展开 在星系中构建最庞大的战场，以绝对数量征服对手。 神器快攻 使用旅途中发掘的低费神器，通过极致配合迅速掌控战局。 坟墓场 通过坟场策略打捞被遗忘的飞船与阵亡战士，实现持续返场。 太空船蓄势 通过横置生物来蓄势太空船，随后收获忠诚船员带来的回报。 加速 掌控星系中体型最庞大的怪物与飞船，探索索瑟拉最遥远的疆域与世界。

Events/Event_Desc_Future_Artisan.oracleText: Bring your Artisan deck into the new year! Build your deck from only common and uncommon cards from the sets remaining in Standard after renewal season: Throne of Eldraine, Theros Beyond Death, Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths, and Core Set 2021. The following cards are banned: Cauldron Familiar Zenith Flare
Events/Event_Desc_Future_Artisan.translation: 利用巧匠套牌喜迎标准新年度！使用「普通」和「非普通」稀有度的牌张来构组套牌，但仅限来自焕新赛季后还留在标准赛环境中的系列：艾卓王权、塞洛斯：冥途求生、依克黎：巨兽时空以及2021核心系列。 以下牌张禁用： 鼎镬佣兽 晶顶闪光

Events/Event_Desc_Future_Ranked.oracleText: Get a head start on the upcoming Standard format and earn extra Set Mastery XP! Play Ranked Standard 2020 by using cards from: Guilds of Ravnica, Ravnica Allegiance, War of the Spark, Core Set 2020, and Throne of Eldraine! You can play this event as many times as you want!
Events/Event_Desc_Future_Ranked.translation: 在即将更新的标准赛环境中占得头筹，赢取额外的精研通行证奖励！使用来自烽会拉尼卡、效忠拉尼卡、火花之战、2020核心系列、以及艾卓王权的卡牌，参加2020标准排名赛！ 本赛事没有参赛次数限制！

Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Cascade_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating 15-card draft packs, but with a twist: The first spell you cast each turn will first have you reveal cards from the top of your library until you find a card with a lower converted mana cost. You can cast that card without paying its mana cost. Two spells for the price of one! You'll keep all cards drafted, then play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win.
Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Cascade_Draft.translation: 15张牌的轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。但这次有些不一样：你每回合施放的第一个咒语会先从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张法术力值比它低的牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。付一得二！你所有抽到的牌都归你所有，不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Comp_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating 15-card draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win!
Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Comp_Draft.translation: 15张牌的轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。你所选择的牌张会加入你的收藏，且你会用你抽到的这些牌加上基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌参赛。不断进行三盘两胜的对局，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！

Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Draft_Exploration.oracleText: In Exploration, Magic's rules are changed: You can play two lands per turn, your starting hand size is nine, and you have no maximum hand size! Draft cards using 15-card draft packs and build a 40-card deck to battle others. You'll receive rewards based on how many wins you earn and you get to keep all the cards you choose!
Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Draft_Exploration.translation: 「探险」玩法的万智牌规则略有不同：你每回合可以使用两个地，你的起始手牌数量为九张，且没有手牌上限。用15张牌的补充包进行轮抽，精心挑选牌张，构筑一副40张的套牌与其他牌手对战。最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励，而且所抽选的牌都归你所有！

Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Omniscience_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating 15-card draft packs, but with a twist: Spells don't cost any mana! Keep the lands out of your deck, you don't need them. Your starting hand size is 3.  You'll keep all cards drafted, then play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! (Note that activated abilities and other mana payments function normally.)
Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Omniscience_Draft.translation: 15张牌的轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。但这次有些不一样：咒语无需费用即可施放！套牌中不必加入地，你已不需要它们。你的起始手牌数量为3。  你所有抽到的牌都归你所有，不断进行对局，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！（请注意：起动式异能和其他需要支付法术力才能办到的事情仍会正常作用。）

Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players
Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Premier_Draft.translation: 每次从传过来的轮抽卡包中选一张牌，这些牌会加入你的收藏，你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑40张的套牌开始游戏。你将得到的奖励取决于你的胜场! 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽

Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Quick_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win!
Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Quick_Draft.translation: 轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！

Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Treasure_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating 15-card draft packs, but with a twist: At the beginning of each of your turns, you'll get a Treasure token which you can sacrifice for a mana of any color. Accelerate by one mana each turn, or save them up to cast an expensive spell in half the time! You'll keep all cards drafted, then play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win.
Events/Event_Desc_GRN_Treasure_Draft.translation: 15张牌的轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。但这次有些不一样：在你的每个回合开始时，你会获得一个珍宝衍生物，牺牲它可以产生一点任意颜色的法术力。你可以每回合都用它来加速一点法术力，也可以把它们都留起来提前施放大型咒语！你所有抽到的牌都归你所有，不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Game_Awards_2019.oracleText: Now that we've celebrated at The Game Awards, it's time to shuffle up and pick sides! Join Ashiok and Elspeth in a fight deep in the Theros underworld. They're both armed with some of Magic's most iconic and powerful cards, as well as preview cards from Theros Beyond Death. You'll earn Theros Beyond Death packs that you can open when the set releases in January. Note: Event decks will not be added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_Game_Awards_2019.translation: 我们曾共贺「The Game Awards」盛典，如今奖项落定，是时候挑选阵营一决高下了！加入安梭苛与艾紫培在塞洛斯冥界深处的激烈对抗，双方不仅有来自万智牌历史上最具代表性的强力牌张助阵，更有部分塞洛斯：冥途求生的预览牌张将要登场亮相。 你能在本活动中获得塞洛斯：冥途求生的补充包，待该系列于一月上市之后便可打开。 注意：活动套牌不会加入你的收藏。

Events/Event_Desc_Gathering2021.oracleText: The multiverse is a big place, and everyone in it is unique. That's what makes it so special when you have the right people around you. No matter on what plane you find yourself, it can still feel like home if you're with family - whether you were born into them or discovered them along the way. The right combination of pieces can make for a perfect deck or a perfect holiday. This weekend, you can find your own blend in this All-Access Singleton event. Build any 60-card Standard deck, whether you have the cards in your collection or not, and play as much as you want until the event ends. Have fun!
Events/Event_Desc_Gathering2021.translation: 多重宇宙浩瀚无垠，其中每一个体都是独特存在。也正因为此，你与亲朋好友齐聚一堂时才会有特殊的连结感受。无论你身处哪个时空，只要你与家人相伴，那里便是你的家～无论你的家人是血肉亲情，还是萍水相逢。 只要正确搭配，你就能得到一副完美的套牌～或是完美的假期。在本周末的牌张任用无双赛中，你便可以尽情尝试你的个性调配。无论你收藏中是否拥有，你都可以任用牌张来构组一副60张的标准套牌，之后便可尽情对局直到活动结束。祝你玩得开心！

Events/Event_Desc_Gathering2022.oracleText: The multiverse is a big place, and finding the right people to adventure with is a big job. Building a community with others who share your interests means that you'll always have friends, or even rivals, to make things more interesting! Putting together the right combination of cards can make for a perfect deck, and finding the right community of players can make for a perfect holiday! This weekend, you can find both in Gladiator, a fan format using 100-card singleton Historic decks! This event is All-Access, meaning you can even use cards outside of your collection. To learn more about Gladiator and its community, click here.
Events/Event_Desc_Gathering2022.translation: 多重宇宙浩瀚无垠，找到冒险同伴更是大海捞针。因此与同好共建社群，意味着你始终会有朋友享受游戏，或是有对手共同成长，令游戏体验更加有趣！ 正如牌张正确搭配方能组成最强套牌，找到最佳社群才能让你假期增色添彩！而本周末的角斗玩法中，你甚至能两者兼得～用最强套牌度过完美假期！角斗玩法利用100张史迹无双套牌进行对战，而本次活动可牌张任用，就算不在你收藏中的牌张，也可以任意使用。 要了解有关角斗及其社群的更多信息，请单击此处。

Events/Event_Desc_Giant_Monsters.oracleText: In Giant Monsters, whenever you cast a creature spell with mana value of four or greater, draw a card! Narset, Parter of Veils and Nexus of Fate are banned in this format.
Events/Event_Desc_Giant_Monsters.translation: 在「威凛巨兽」规则下，每当你施放法术力值等于或大于四的生物时，你便抓一张牌！揭帷娜尔施和龙命连结点在此赛制中禁用。

Events/Event_Desc_GladiatorSpotlight.oracleText:
Welcome to Gladiator, one of the most popular fan formats for MTG Arena!

Gladiator uses 100-card singleton Historic decks with a minimal banned list. You then face off in best-of-three matches, giving you the chance to see a wide range of possibilities from both players' decks. There are no sideboards, so what you bring is what you've got!

To learn more about Gladiator and and its community, click <u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/en/articles/archive/magic-digital/community-spotlight-gladiator-august-2022>here</link></u>.
Events/Event_Desc_GladiatorSpotlight.translation:
欢迎来到角斗，这是MTGA最受欢迎的粉丝赛制之一！

角斗使用100张无双史迹套牌和最低限度的禁牌表。然后，你将在三盘两胜制的比赛中对峙，让你有机会从双方玩家的套牌中看到广泛的可能性。没有备牌，所以你带来的就是你所拥有的！

要了解有关角斗及其社区的更多信息，请单击<u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/en/articles/archive/magic-digital/community-spotlight-gladiator-august-2022>此处</link></u>。

Events/Event_Desc_Greedy_Draft.oracleText: In Greedy Draft, draft three packs and keep the cards you draft, but with a twist: Everyone can play two lands per turn, starts with 9 cards in their hand, and has no maximum hand size!
Events/Event_Desc_Greedy_Draft.translation: 在「贪婪轮抽」中，依然是利用三包补充包进行轮抽，且你所抽到的牌张都会加入你的收藏，不过有些不一样：所有人每回合都能使用两个地，以9张手牌起手，没有手牌上限。

Events/Event_Desc_HBG_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Flicker your creatures in and out of play to produce as many triggers as possible! Control the battlefield and sneak in creatures to deal damage to your opponent. The real treasure will be the treasure you make along the way. DRAGONS! The best offense is a good defense? Gain life so you can lower theirs! Earn bonuses every time your creatures leave the battlefield. MORE DRAGONS! What's dead may never die... but may live again? Prepare for trouble! Use the new Double Team mechanic to cast creatures with the same name. EVEN MORE DRAGONS!
Events/Event_Desc_HBG_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励！ 牌手轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制。 闪动自己的生物反复进场，由此产生大量触发令自己获益！ 牢牢掌控战场形势，利用隐匿生物向对手造成伤害。 一路上创造的珍宝才是你的真正财富。 龙！ 严防死守才是最强攻势？得之我幸，失之敌命！ 你的生物每次离开战场都能让你更有所得。 更多的龙！ 逝者不死...还能再起？ 准备好应对之策！利用全新的双打机制，反复施放同名生物。 更多更多的龙！

Events/Event_Desc_HBG_Trad_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Flicker your creatures in and out of play to produce as many triggers as possible! Control the battlefield and sneak in creatures to deal damage to your opponent. The real treasure will be the treasure you make along the way. DRAGONS! The best offense is a good defense? Gain life so you can lower theirs! Earn bonuses every time your creatures leave the battlefield. MORE DRAGONS! What's dead may never die... but may live again? Prepare for trouble! Use the new Double Team mechanic to cast creatures with the same name. EVEN MORE DRAGONS!
Events/Event_Desc_HBG_Trad_Draft.translation: 每次从传过来的轮抽卡包中选一张牌，这些牌会加入你的收藏，你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑40张的套牌进行bo3对战。 你将得到的奖励取决于你的胜场! 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽 在游戏中闪动你的生物，以产生尽可能多的触发器 控制战场，偷袭生物，对你的对手造成伤害。 真正的宝藏将是你沿途创造的财富。 龙！龙！龙！ 最好的进攻就是防守？获得生命，这样你就可以降低他们的生命！ 每次你的生物离开战场时，都能获得奖励。 更多的龙！更多的龙！更多的龙！ 死去的东西可能永远不会死去……但可能会再次复活？ 准备好迎接麻烦! 使用新的双团队机制来施放同名的生物。 甚至更多的龙！甚至更多的龙！甚至更多的龙！

Events/Event_Desc_HOU_Quick_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win!
Events/Event_Desc_HOU_Quick_Draft.translation: 轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！

Events/Event_Desc_HistoricBrawl.oracleText: Bring a Brawl deck using any cards on MTG Arena - not just Standard! Change it at any time during the event. For more details on this format, including a list of banned cards, click <u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/mtga-historic-brawl>here</link></u>.
Events/Event_Desc_HistoricBrawl.translation: 使用MTGA中的任何卡牌构建争锋套牌 - 不仅仅是标准！赛事期间可随时更改。有关此赛制的更多详细信息，包括禁牌表，请单击<u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/mtga-historic-brawl>此处</link></u>。

Events/Event_Desc_HistoricBrawlFest.oracleText: Students at Strixhaven University learn about magic from across the Multiverse, and each college offers its own perspective. Lorehold, for example, searches for critical spells from throughout history, while Quandrix calculates the mathematically correct artifact to perfectly balance out their arsenal. But the most important piece of the puzzle is yours to decide. So, what's your major? It's time to cram for finals! This time, you'll need to bring a 100-card Brawl deck using any cards on MTG Arena - not just Standard! Change it at any time during the event. For more details on this format, including a list of banned cards, click here.
Events/Event_Desc_HistoricBrawlFest.translation: 斯翠海文大学的学生研习来自多重宇宙的魔法，每个学院所长各不相同。比如说衡鉴学院就从历史中搜寻致命咒语，量析学院则计算遵循数学公理的神器，确保其武器库达致完美均衡。但这学校最大的谜题，还是得有你来亲自解开。 你要选读哪个专业？ 是时候为期末考试念书了！这次，你需要准备一副100张的争锋套牌，其中可包含所有能在《MTG竞技场》中使用的牌～并非仅限标准环境！你可以在本活动中随时更换所用套牌。关于此赛制的更多信息以及禁牌清单请点击此处。

Events/Event_Desc_HistoricShakeup_Week1.oracleText:
We're shaking Historic up with an additional banned list for this event! For the full details on this format, including a list of banned cards, click <u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/mtga-khm-hist-shakeup>here</link></u>.

Play your favorites while you can, because next week, we will be back to give things another big shake. Even more cards will get kicked out for the next round! Who will rise to the top?
Events/Event_Desc_HistoricShakeup_Week1.translation:
我们将在本次史迹革新赛事中为史迹增加一份额外禁牌表！关于这一赛制的全部细节，包括禁牌表，请点击<u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/mtga-khm-hist-shakeup>这里</link></u>。

多多玩你的最爱，因为下周，我们将会给带来另一个大变动。甚至更多的牌将被踢出下一轮! 谁将升至顶峰？

Events/Event_Desc_HistoricShakeup_Week2.oracleText:
After one week of Shakeup, Historic is getting re-shaken with even more additional bans for this event! For the full details on this format, including a list of banned cards, click <u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/mtga-khm-hist-shakeup>here</link></u>.

It's anyone's game, but don't get too comfortable. After this week, we'll be making one more round of bans. Your games will help decide who makes the grade and who is left standing at the end!
Events/Event_Desc_HistoricShakeup_Week2.translation:
经过一周的革新后，史迹正在重新调整，并为此赛事增加了更多的禁令！有关此格赛制的完整详细信息，包括禁牌表，请单击<u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/mtga-khm-hist-shakeup>此处</link></u>。

这是任何人的游戏，但不要太舒服。本周之后，我们将再进行一轮禁令。你的游戏将有助于决定谁能取得好成绩，谁能在最后站稳脚跟!

Events/Event_Desc_HistoricShakeup_Week3.oracleText: It's the final week of Historic Shakeup! After three sets of additional bans, can you find the remaining diamonds in the rough?  For the full details on this format, including a list of banned cards, click <u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/mtga-khm-hist-shakeup>here</link></u>.

Events/Event_Desc_Historic_Launch.oracleText:
Celebrate the release of 20 new cards to MTG Arena in this best-of-one Historic event.

You can purchase the complete Historic Anthology 1 in the Store which contains playsets of every new card, or use Wildcards to craft each card individually. Historic allows you to use all sets currently available in MTG Arena.

Banned Cards:
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"> Nexus of Fate

您可以在商店中购买完整的史迹合集1--包含所有新卡片的套装，或者使用万用牌单独制作每张卡片。史迹允许你使用当前在MTGA中可用的所有系列牌。

Events/Event_Desc_Holiday_2018.oracleText: Happy Holidays from the MTG Arena team! Bring your deck of only commons and enjoy the winter scenery as you play!
Events/Event_Desc_Holiday_2018.translation: 万智牌竞技场全体同仁恭祝佳节愉快！利用事先组好之的套牌（仅含普通牌）进行对战，尽情欣赏全新假日对战桌面！

Events/Event_Desc_IKO_Comp_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Your draft pod will contain other players. To celebrate the launch of Player Draft, all players may play in one Premier Draft Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths without paying entry!
Events/Event_Desc_IKO_Comp_Draft.translation: 轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！ 你的轮抽组中包含其他玩家。为庆祝真人轮抽的推出，所有玩家都可以参加竞技轮抽依克黎：巨兽时空，无需付费！

Events/Event_Desc_IKO_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players
Events/Event_Desc_IKO_Premier_Draft.translation: 每次从传过来的轮抽卡包中选一张牌，这些牌会加入你的收藏，你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑40张的套牌开始游戏。你将得到的奖励取决于你的胜场! 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽

Events/Event_Desc_IKO_Quick_Draft.oracleText:
Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win!

Bot Draft - Draft against AI with no waiting & no pick timers
Events/Event_Desc_IKO_Quick_Draft.translation:
每次从传过来的轮抽卡包中选一张牌，这些牌会加入你的收藏，你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑40张的套牌开始游戏。你将得到的奖励取决于你的胜场!

人机轮抽～与AI进行轮抽，无需等待，也不限制选牌时间

Events/Event_Desc_IKO_Trad_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players
Events/Event_Desc_IKO_Trad_Draft.translation: 每次从传过来的轮抽卡包中选一张牌，这些牌会加入你的收藏，你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑40张的套牌进行bo3对战。你将得到的奖励取决于你的胜场！ 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽

Events/Event_Desc_Invitational_Celebrati.oracleText: Tune into the MTG Arena Mythic Invitational this weekend (March 28 - 31), where 64 players compete for $1 million in prizes. Follow all the action at http://twitch.tv/magic and play while you watch! You can win Chemister's Insight and Skewer the Critics card styles.
Events/Event_Desc_Invitational_Celebrati.translation: 本周末（3月28日至31日）收看MGTA秘稀邀请赛，64名玩家将争夺100万美元的奖金。关注 http://twitch.tv/magic 上的所有动态，边看边玩！你可以赢得*化学师的洞察*和*遏止倒彩*的卡牌样式。

Events/Event_Desc_Jump_In.oracleText: Welcome to the world of MTG Arena! Here you can explore popular cards and strategies, and maybe even find a new favorite. It's time to Jump In! When you join this event, you will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes in Alchemy. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go. Play as much as you want here, or use the cards to build new decks for other modes - they're yours to keep! Resign at any time if you wish to rejoin and pick new packets. You will have to pay the entry again, but you will keep all cards from the decks you choose.
Events/Event_Desc_Jump_In.translation: 欢迎来到《万智牌：竞技场》的世界！你能在这里探索热门牌张与流行策略，甚至还有可能发现心头所好。快来加入速学！ 加入此活动后，你需要先从各类反映炼金赛不同主题的半副套牌中选择两种。将它们组合一起之后，你就有了一副能够对战的完整套牌。你可以利用此套牌在本活动中尽情对战，也可以利用它们来构组适合其他模式的套牌～其中牌张都归你所有！ 如果你希望重新参加并另选主题包，也可以随时退出。虽然需要再次支付参加费用，但你能留下你选中套牌中的所有牌张。

Events/Event_Desc_Jump_In_FIN.oracleText: Ready to start playing Magic: The Gathering—FINAL FANTASY on MTG Arena? You can explore different strategies while playing and collecting cards from this new set. When you join this event, you will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go. Play as much as you want here, or use the cards to build new decks for other modes - they're yours to keep!   Resign at any time if you wish to rejoin and pick new packets. You will have to pay the entry again, but you will keep all cards from the decks you choose.
Events/Event_Desc_Jump_In_FIN.translation: 准备好在MTG竞技场中体验万智牌～最终幻想了吗？你可以通过对局和收集新系列的卡牌来探索不同策略。 参加此赛事时，你需要从多种主题中选择两套不同的半副套牌。将它们组合起来，就能获得一副完整的对战套牌。你可以尽情游玩，或者用这些卡牌构建其他模式的套牌——它们都将加入你的收藏！ 如果想选择新的主题包，可随时退出活动。虽然需要重新支付入场费，但你将保留所选套牌中的所有卡牌。

Events/Event_Desc_Jump_In_LTR.oracleText: Ready to start playing The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth on MTG Arena? You can explore different strategies while playing and collecting cards from this new set. When you join this event, you will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes. They'll be combined and you will have a deck ready to go. Play as much as you want here, or use the cards to build new decks for other modes - they're yours to keep! Resign at any time if you wish to rejoin and pick new packets. You will have to pay the entry again, but you will keep all cards from the decks you choose. "The world is indeed full of peril, and in it there are many dark places; but still there is much that is fair, and though in all lands love is now mingled with grief, it grows perhaps the greater." – Haldir (Book 1, pg 349)
Events/Event_Desc_Jump_In_LTR.translation: 准备好在MTG竞技场中体验魔戒：中洲传说的对局了吗？你可以通过对局和收集来自这个全新系列的牌张，探索各种不同的策略。 加入此活动后，你需要先从多种不同主题的半副套牌中选择两种。将它们组合一起之后，你就有了一副能够对战的完整套牌。套牌中的所有牌张都归你所有，并且你可以尽情地进行对局，或者将它们用于构建其他游戏模式下的新套牌！ 如果你希望重新加入并选择新的卡包，你随时可以退出当前活动。你需要再次支付门票，但你将保留你所选择套牌中的所有牌张。 「这世界的确充满了危险，其中也有不少黑暗之处。但是，也仍有许多美丽的事物，尽管如今在所有的地方，爱都交织着悲伤，但或许还是爱占了上风。」～哈尔迪尔（第一部，第435页）

Events/Event_Desc_Jump_In_MSH.oracleText: Ready to start playing Marvel Super Heroes on MTG Arena? You can explore different strategies while playing and collecting cards from this new set. When you join this event, you will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go. Play a few matches to get a feel for the newest set. Use the cards to build new decks for other modes - they're yours to keep! Resign at any time if you wish to rejoin and pick new packets. You will have to pay the entry again, but you will keep all cards from the decks you choose.
Events/Event_Desc_Jump_In_MSH.translation: 准备好在MTG竞技场中体验漫威超级英雄了吗？你可以通过对局和收集新系列的卡牌来探索不同策略。 参加此赛事时，你需要从多种主题中选择两套不同的半副套牌。将它们组合起来，就能获得一副完整的对战套牌。进行几场对局来感受这个最新系列吧。 用这些卡牌构建其他模式的套牌——它们都将加入你的收藏！ 如果想选择新的主题包，可随时退出活动。虽然需要重新支付入场费，但你将保留所选套牌中的所有卡牌。

Events/Event_Desc_Jump_In_TLA.oracleText: Ready to start playing Magic: The Gathering | Avatar: The Last Airbender™ on MTG Arena? You can explore different strategies while playing and collecting cards from this new set. When you join this event, you will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go. Play as much as you want here, or use the cards to build new decks for other modes - they're yours to keep! Resign at any time if you wish to rejoin and pick new packets. You will have to pay the entry again, but you will keep all cards from the decks you choose.
Events/Event_Desc_Jump_In_TLA.translation: 准备好在MTG竞技场中体验万智牌丨降世神通：最后的气宗了吗？你可以通过对局和收集新系列的卡牌来探索不同策略。 参加此赛事时，你需要从多种主题中选择两套不同的半副套牌。将它们组合起来，就能获得一副完整的对战套牌。你可以尽情游玩，或者用这些卡牌构建其他模式的套牌——它们都将加入你的收藏！ 如果想选择新的主题包，可随时退出活动。虽然需要重新支付入场费，但你将保留所选套牌中的所有卡牌。

Events/Event_Desc_Jumpstart2025.oracleText: Welcome to Foundations JumpStart! When you join this event, you will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes in Magic: The Gathering Foundations. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go. Play as much as you want here, or use the cards to build new decks for other modes - they're yours to keep!   Note: Not all Cards from Foundations Jumpstart are Standard Legal. Resign at any time if you wish to rejoin and pick new packets. You will have to pay the entry again, but you will keep all cards from the decks you choose.
Events/Event_Desc_Jumpstart2025.translation: 欢迎来到基石构筑速战！ 加入此活动后，你需要先从万智牌：基石构筑中多种不同主题的半副套牌中选择两种。将它们组合一起之后，你就有了一副能够对战的完整套牌！你可以在此尽情对局，或者使用这些牌来构筑其他赛制的新套牌——这些牌都归你所有！ 注意：并非所有基石构筑速战中的牌都可以在标准赛制中使用。 如果你希望重新参加并另选主题包，也可以随时退出。虽然需要再次支付参加费用，但你仍可保留所选套牌中的所有卡牌。

Events/Event_Desc_Jumpstart_J21.oracleText: Welcome to Jumpstart: Historic Horizons! When you join this event, you will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes inspired by Magic's history and the Modern Horizons sets. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go! You'll keep all the cards from your deck, and you can play with it as much as you want. Resign at any time if you wish to rejoin and pick new packets. You will have to pay the entry again, but you can also earn all rewards again as well.
Events/Event_Desc_Jumpstart_J21.translation: 欢迎来到速战：史迹新篇！ 当你加入此赛事时，你可以从发源于万智牌历史的各种主题，以及摩登新篇主题中选择两个不同的「半套牌」补充包，将它们混合起来，你就有一副可以立刻开玩的套牌了！这些牌会全数加入你的收藏，并且你想玩几局都可以！ 如果你想重选新的主题包，你可以随时退出赛事。你需要重新支付入场费，但你也可以再次获得各种奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Jumpstart_M21.oracleText: Welcome to Jumpstart, where dinosaurs roam above the clouds and spellcasting dogs run free! When you join this event, you will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go! You'll keep all the cards from your deck, including the special basic land styles for each theme. Resign at any time if you wish to rejoin and pick new packets. You will have to pay the entry again, but you can also earn all rewards again as well.
Events/Event_Desc_Jumpstart_M21.translation: 欢迎来到速战 当你加入此赛事时，你可以从发源于万智牌历史的各种主题中选择两个不同的「半套牌」补充包，将它们混合起来，你就有一副可以立刻开玩的套牌了！你将保留你套牌中的所有牌，包括每个主题的特殊基本地样式。 如果你想重选新的主题包，你可以随时退出赛事。你需要重新支付入场费，但你也可以再次获得各种奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_KHM_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players This set is not legal in Standard.
Events/Event_Desc_KHM_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 真人轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制。 注意：此系列不能在标准赛中使用。

Events/Event_Desc_KHM_Quick_Draft.oracleText:

Events/Event_Desc_LCI_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Oltec Ingenuity Buy time with blockers, removal, and lifegain while you assemble an array of wondrous artifacts to take over the late game. Echoes of the Dead Set up to block while you fill your graveyard, then drag your opponent into the deep end with high-cost creatures, card draw, and recursive threats. Going Down! Keep your creatures growing by attacking viciously to make your opponent block or throwing permanents into the graveyard yourself. Then keep them down with creature removal. Dinosaurs of the Sun Empire Summon gigantic dinosaurs to crush the opposition, supporting them with ways to make more mana or break through blockers. Malamet Tactics Keep the pressure on with low-cost creatures. When your opponent tries to set up a defense, it's time to pounce by powering up your forces. Dusk Legion Pilgrimage Sacrifice little creatures and artifacts for the glory of Aclazotz (and additional resources). Once you smell blood, seal their fate with a few larger creatures. Pirates' Plunder Set sail with a rowdy crew and their haul of Equipment and Treasure. When those landlubbers try to stop you, fly over the top or throw their blockers overboard. Fungal Festering Muck up the battlefield with sticky creatures while you fill your graveyard. Once you've descended enough to power your side up, start grinding your way through the opposing blockers. Thousand-Moon Legion Launch your military campaign with lots of small creatures and artifacts, then tactically tap those resources to activate your forces and rout the invaders. River Herald Expedition Go exploring to stock your side with lands and powerful creatures, then sink your extra mana into activated abilities and card draw to drown the opposition in value.
Events/Event_Desc_LCI_Premier_Draft.translation: 从传递中的轮抽补充包中一次选一张牌。这些牌会加入你的收藏。你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一套40张的套牌。进行游戏并基于你的胜场获得奖励！ 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽 欧尔特克智谋 通过阻挡者、去除和生命回复拖延时间，借机集结神器大军在游戏后期出奇制胜。 亡者回响 设防阻挡并借机填坟，再通过高费生物、抽牌手段和无尽威胁将对手拖入深渊。 给我倒下！ 通过猛烈地进攻迫使对手阻挡或自己将永久物扔入坟场让你的生物逐步膨胀，再不断使用去除击倒对手的生物。 烈阳帝国恐龙大军 召唤巨型恐龙压垮对手并通过产出更多法术力或突破阻挡者的手段支援它们。 豹族计策 通过低费生物持续制造压力。对手试图构筑防线之时即是你膨胀军队猛扑之际。 暮影军团朝圣 牺牲小生物和神器来重现阿洛佐兹的荣光（并获取额外资源）。一旦你闻到敌人的鲜血，用更强大的生物了结他们的性命。 海盗劫掠 带领一批残暴的船员和他们抢来的武器和财宝扬帆启航。当那些航海菜鸟试图挡你去路时，飞过他们头顶或直接把他们的阻挡者扔下海。 真菌溃烂 将黏糊糊的生物铺满战场并借机填坟。一旦你已落坟足够多次以强大你的阵线，那就开始逐步蚕食突破对手的阻挡者吧。 千月军团 通过大量小生物和神器开展你的军事行动，然后策略性地横置那些资源以激活你的军队并击溃入侵者。 川流使探险队 进行勘察为你的阵线积累土地和强大生物，然后将你额外的法术力投入起动式异能和抓牌来赚取价值淹没对手。

In its light, you feel an immense surge of power. Chimil, the Inner Sun emblem: "At the beginning of your end step, discover 5."
Events/Event_Desc_LCI_Quick_Draft_Emblem.translation: 轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！ 人机轮抽～与AI进行轮抽，无需等待，也不限制选牌时间 内阳奇密理是依夏兰世界核心中的强大力量源也是欧尔特克人的信仰。在它的光芒中，你会感受到无穷无尽的力量 内阳奇密理徽记：「在你的结束步骤开始时，倾探5。」

Events/Event_Desc_LCI_Trad_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Oltec Ingenuity Buy time with blockers, removal, and lifegain while you assemble an array of wondrous artifacts to take over the late game. Echoes of the Dead Set up to block while you fill your graveyard, then drag your opponent into the deep end with high-cost creatures, card draw, and recursive threats. Going Down! Keep your creatures growing by attacking viciously to make your opponent block or throwing permanents into the graveyard yourself. Then keep them down with creature removal. Dinosaurs of the Sun Empire Summon gigantic dinosaurs to crush the opposition, supporting them with ways to make more mana or break through blockers.   Malamet Tactics Keep the pressure on with low-cost creatures. When your opponent tries to set up a defense, it's time to pounce by powering up your forces. Dusk Legion Pilgrimage Sacrifice little creatures and artifacts for the glory of Aclazotz (and additional resources). Once you smell blood, seal their fate with a few larger creatures. Pirates' Plunder Set sail with a rowdy crew and their haul of Equipment and Treasure. When those landlubbers try to stop you, fly over the top or throw their blockers overboard. Fungal Festering Muck up the battlefield with sticky creatures while you fill your graveyard. Once you've descended enough to power your side up, start grinding your way through the opposing blockers. Thousand-Moon Legion Launch your military campaign with lots of small creatures and artifacts, then tactically tap those resources to activate your forces and rout the invaders. River Herald Expedition Go exploring to stock your side with lands and powerful creatures, then sink your extra mana into activated abilities and card draw to drown the opposition in value.
Events/Event_Desc_LCI_Trad_Draft.translation: 从传递中的轮抽补充包中一次选一张牌。这些牌会加入你的收藏。你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一套40张的套牌。进行bo3对局并基于你的胜场获得奖励！ 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽 欧尔特克智谋 通过阻挡者、去除和生命回复拖延时间，借机集结神器大军在游戏后期出奇制胜。 亡者回响 设防阻挡并借机填坟，再通过高费生物、抽牌手段和无尽威胁将对手拖入深渊。 给我倒下！ 通过猛烈地进攻迫使对手阻挡或自己将永久物扔入坟场让你的生物逐步膨胀，再不断使用去除击倒对手的生物。 烈阳帝国恐龙大军 召唤巨型恐龙压垮对手并通过产出更多法术力或突破阻挡者的手段支援它们。 豹族计策 通过低费生物持续制造压力。对手试图构筑防线之时即是你膨胀军队猛扑之际。 暮影军团朝圣 牺牲小生物和神器来重现阿洛佐兹的荣光（并获取额外资源）。一旦你闻到敌人的鲜血，用更强大的生物了结他们的性命。 海盗劫掠 带领一批残暴的船员和他们抢来的武器和财宝扬帆启航。当那些航海菜鸟试图挡你去路时，飞过他们头顶或直接把他们的阻挡者扔下海。 真菌溃烂 将黏糊糊的生物铺满战场并借机填坟。一旦你已落坟足够多次以强大你的阵线，那就开始逐步蚕食突破对手的阻挡者吧。 千月军团 通过大量小生物和神器开展你的军事行动，然后策略性地横置那些资源以激活你的军队并击溃入侵者。 川流使探险队 进行勘察为你的阵线积累土地和强大生物，然后将你额外的法术力投入起动式异能和抓牌来赚取价值淹没对手。

Events/Event_Desc_LTR_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players "Draw Two" Humans Defend the citadel ! Drawing two cards every turn will ensure you never run out of reinforcements. Amass Control Grow a massive Orc Army , then wield Saruman's mighty suite of spells to turn the tide of battle in your favor. Amass Aggro The forces of Mordor will rush out of your hands and through the enemy's defenses with this aggressive strategy, sacrificing themselves for the glory of Sauron. Power Matters The wilds of Middle-earth™ are home to many of its strongest denizens, such as Ents, Trolls, and the noble Rangers. Use them to overwhelm your opponent with great numbers. Food Never underestimate a Hobbit! This low-to-the-ground aggressive deck uses Food tokens for a lot more than the occasional second-refreshment. Tokens From earthen Treasures to soaring Spirits and everything in-between, this strategy revolves around going wide and eventually overwhelming the opponent. Spells Draw on the knowledge and magic of Middle-earth's most powerful Wizards to cast a stream of increasingly impressive instants and sorceries. Sacrifice Repurpose and recycle your creatures to summon a frightening assortment of terrors, including the Nazgûl and their Fell Beasts. Go-Wide Humans Answer the call and charge into battle! These Humans combine to create a force capable of slicing through any foe. Scry Elvish magic offers you a glimpse at many possible futures. Choose wisely and you'll find victory waiting at the top of your deck.
Events/Event_Desc_LTR_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 牌手轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制。 人类「抓两张」保卫王城！每回合抓两张牌，确保你永远不会缺乏支援。 囤兵控制聚集一支巨大的半兽人／军队，然后利用萨茹曼的强力咒语扭转战局。 囤兵快攻魔多大军出击，利用猛袭策略打穿敌人防线，为了索隆的荣耀不惜牺牲自己。 力量很重要中洲™许多强大生灵栖息于郊野，例如恩特、食人妖，还有高贵的突击队。 食品永远不要小看霍比特人！这副身材矮小的猛袭套牌充分利用食品衍生物，让慷慨提供的第二次茶点发挥更大功效。 衍生物从世俗的珍宝到飞翔的精怪，这种策略以铺场为中心，渐渐压倒敌人。 咒语吸收中洲最强大法术师的知识和魔法，持续施放瞬间和法术，见证威力逐步增长。 牺牲回收你的生物重新利用，召唤各种骇人的惊惧兽，包括那兹古尔及座下的恶兽。 人类铺场响应召唤，冲进战场！这些人类集结起来的军队足以击溃所有敌人。 占卜精灵魔法能让你一瞥众多可能的未来。只要小心选择，获胜之道就在你的牌库顶。

Events/Event_Desc_LTR_Quick_Draft.oracleText:
Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win!

Bot Draft - Draft against AI with no waiting & no pick timers
Events/Event_Desc_LTR_Quick_Draft.translation:
轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！

电脑轮抽～与AI一同进行轮抽，无需等待，没有抽选时间限制
