Events/Event_Desc_Ladder.oracleText: Standard uses cards only from recent sets. Results will affect your Constructed rank.
Events/Event_Desc_Ladder.translation: 标准模式只使用最近发售的几个系列的卡牌。对局结果会影响你的构筑赛段位。

Events/Event_Desc_Limited_Ladder.oracleText: Results will affect your Limited rank.
Events/Event_Desc_Limited_Ladder.translation: 对局结果会影响你的限制赛段位。

Events/Event_Desc_Limited_Traditional.oracleText: Play a best-2-out-of-3 match with sideboarding.
Events/Event_Desc_Limited_Traditional.translation: 进行三局两胜制，有备牌局的对战。

Events/Event_Desc_Lore_WAR1.oracleText: Part I is Momir. No deck required, we'll provide a deck for you to play consisting of basic lands and the 36 WAR planeswalkers! Ravnica. City of Guilds. Anything and everything can be found on this worldwide cityscape. Grand halls, decrepit slums and ancient ruins are interwoven amid the maze of streets, bustling markets and shadowy back alleys. For the citizens of Ravnica, intrigue and opportunity are abundant as the ten ruling guilds vie for power, wealth, and influence. Balanced on the edge of a precarious peace, the city grew and flourished... until the Planar Bridge opens, unleashing death and destruction.
Events/Event_Desc_Lore_WAR1.translation: 第I部分为「莫秘维」。无需事先构筑套牌，游戏会为牌手备好一副包含基本地和36位火花之战鹏洛客的套牌！ 拉尼卡。公会城。天下景观齐聚这座世界性的城市。巨大厅堂、破旧的贫民窟及古老的遗迹在拉尼卡错综复杂的街道、繁华的闹市与阴暗的陋巷中交织。拉尼卡的十个公会彼此争夺着力量、财富和权力，对于拉尼卡的居民来说，这是一个到处是阴谋和机会的世界。城市在脆弱又来之不易的和平中发展壮大…直到时空渡桥开启，将死亡与毁灭引入这里。

Events/Event_Desc_Lore_WAR2.oracleText: Part II is Pauper. Bring a deck using only commons! Persistent Petitioners is banned. As the Dreadhorde army advances, Planeswalkers from across the blind eternities answer the call for aid. Some come willingly, aware of Nicol Bolas's schemes and what it means for the multiverse if he were to succeed. Others are simply drawn by the inexplicable power of the interplanar beacon. But this is all according to Nicol Bolas's plan. With the Immortal Sun now on Ravnica, any planeswalkers who sets foot onto Ravnica find themselves unable to leave.
Events/Event_Desc_Lore_WAR2.translation: 第II部分为「纯普」。使用事先组好的套牌参赛，但该套牌仅能以「普通」稀有度牌张组成。执着诉愿人在此赛制中禁用。 随着震惧军的大肆行进，来自黑暗虚空的鹏洛客们纷纷回应了求救的信号。有些鹏洛客早已察觉到尼可波拉斯的计划及其对多重宇宙的危害，所以甘愿前往。另一些鹏洛客则只是被跨时空信标的奇妙力量吸引而来。但这些都是尼可波拉斯计划的一部分。随着永生圣阳现身拉尼卡，任何踏足此世界的鹏洛客都发现自己无法脱身离去。

Events/Event_Desc_Lore_WAR3.oracleText: Part III is Singleton. Bring a deck with no more than one copy of any card (other than basic lands). An alternate "London" mulligan rule will be used for this event. Across Ravnica, the districts are mobilizing to confront the Elder Dragon. United behind a common cause native Ravnicans begin the counterattack, unleashing powerful weapons and champions of their own against the Eternals. Others set their eyes on Bolas, intent on storming his citadel and bringing him down. But as a magical flare rises from the dragon's throne, the Planeswalkers on Ravnica learn exactly what Bolas has planned for them...
Events/Event_Desc_Lore_WAR3.translation: 第III部分为「无双」。使用事先组好的套牌进行对局，但该套牌中每种牌至多只能有一张（基本地除外）。本赛事将采用新的「伦敦」再调度规则。 拉尼卡各城区齐心动员共抗长老龙。拉尼卡本地居民同仇敌忾，拿出强力武器、派出精兵良将反击永生者。其他人则意欲直取波拉斯，打算猛攻尊殿而将他一举击败。但看到巨龙王座上一道魔法亮光闪过，拉尼卡上的鹏洛客仿佛已经知道波拉斯为其安排的下场为何…

Events/Event_Desc_Lore_WAR4.oracleText: Part IV is Counters. Bring a deck with cards this emblem will put a lot of counters on! The Elderspell has been cast. The dreadhorde continues its advance, further empowered as the God-Eternals enter the fray. Time is running out, as are the options. With each failure, Nicol Bolas grows stronger, as each Spark consumed serves to fuel his ascension to godhood. The endgame has begun.
Events/Event_Desc_Lore_WAR4.translation: 第IV部分为「指示物」。使用事先组好的套牌参赛，不过这个徽记会让你牌上的指示物满溢，因此请务必留意能与之互动的牌张！ 波拉斯施放了至尊咒。震惧军继续前进，而永生煞神参战令他们更加势不可挡。时间所剩无多，方法也越来越少。每次失败都让波拉斯更加强大，而每颗收下的火花也让波拉斯更显神格。终局将至。

Events/Event_Desc_Lore_WAR5.oracleText: Part V is Ravnica. Bring your deck with only cards from Guilds of Ravnica, Ravnica Allegiance, and War of the Spark! Gates Ablaze is banned. For over a hundred years, everything had led to this moment. Every battle, every betrayal, every death. By serving Nicol Bolas, Liliana would finally remain at the height of her power – forever. But serving Nicol Bolas for eternity was not a life worth living. As Liliana Vess prepares herself for death, an old friend makes a sacrifice of his own, giving Liliana the strength and time needed to bring down Nicol Bolas once and for all.
Events/Event_Desc_Lore_WAR5.translation: 第V部分为「拉尼卡」。使用事先组好的套牌参赛，但该牌套仅限利用出自烽会拉尼卡、效忠拉尼卡和火花之战这三个系列的牌张组成。城门失火在此赛事中禁用。 这一百多年以来的一切都引向这一时刻。所有的战斗，所有的背叛，所有的死亡。莉莲娜原本以为，效忠波拉斯就将自身力量始终保持巅峰～直到永远。但永生效忠波拉斯，却会让自己的命途黯淡无光。正当莉莲娜准备拥抱死亡之时，一位旧友挺身而出，甘愿牺牲自己让莉莲娜有足够的时间积攒力量，一举彻底击溃波拉斯。

Events/Event_Desc_M19_Cascade_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating 15-card draft packs, but with a twist: The first spell you cast each turn will first have you reveal cards from the top of your library until you find a card with a lower converted mana cost. You can cast that card without paying its mana cost. Two spells for the price of one! You'll keep all cards drafted, then play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win.
Events/Event_Desc_M19_Cascade_Draft.translation: 15张牌的轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。但这次有些不一样：你每回合施放的第一个咒语会先从你的牌库顶开始展示牌，直到展示出一张法术力值比它低的牌为止。你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。付一得二！你所有抽到的牌都归你所有，不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_M19_Comp_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating 15-card draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win!
Events/Event_Desc_M19_Comp_Draft.translation: 15张牌的轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。你所选择的牌张会加入你的收藏，且你会用你抽到的这些牌加上基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌参赛。不断进行对局，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！

Events/Event_Desc_M19_Omniscience_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating 15-card draft packs, but with a twist: Spells don't cost any mana! Keep the lands out of your deck, you don't need them. Your starting hand size is 3.  You'll keep all cards drafted, then play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! (Note that activated abilities and other mana payments function normally.)
Events/Event_Desc_M19_Omniscience_Draft.translation: 15张牌的轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。但这次有些不一样：咒语无需费用即可施放！套牌中不必加入地，你已不需要它们。你的起始手牌数量为3。  你所有抽到的牌都归你所有，不断进行对局，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！（请注意：起动式异能和其他需要支付法术力才能办到的事情仍会正常作用。）

Events/Event_Desc_M19_Quick_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Note: This set is not legal in Standard.
Events/Event_Desc_M19_Quick_Draft.translation: 轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！

Events/Event_Desc_M19_Quick_Draft_Explor.oracleText: In Exploration, Magic's rules are changed: You can play two lands per turn, your starting hand size is nine, and you have no maximum hand size! Select one card at a time from rotating 14-card draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win!
Events/Event_Desc_M19_Quick_Draft_Explor.translation: 「探险」玩法的万智牌规则略有不同：你每个回合可以使用两个地，你的起始手牌数量为九，且没有手牌上限！14张牌的补充包将在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。你所选择的牌张会加入你的收藏，且你会用你抽到的这些牌加上基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌参赛。不断进行对局，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！

Events/Event_Desc_M19_StressTest_Draft.oracleText: A special event for our July 20 stress test, this event has the same rewards as Quick Draft, but only requires half the normal entry to join! Draft cards using 15-card draft packs and build a 40-card deck to battle others. You'll receive rewards based on how many wins you earn and you get to keep all the cards you choose! Keep playing until you reach seven wins or three losses.
Events/Event_Desc_M19_StressTest_Draft.translation: 作为7月20日压力测试的特别活动，本赛事的奖励跟快速轮抽赛相同，但报名费减半！用15张牌的补充包进行轮抽，精心挑选牌张，构筑一副40张的套牌与其他牌手对战。最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励，而且所抽选的牌都归你所有！持续游戏，直到取得七胜或三败为止。

Events/Event_Desc_M19_Treasure_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating 15-card draft packs, but with a twist: At the beginning of each of your turns, you'll get a Treasure token which you can sacrifice for a mana of any color. Accelerate by one mana each turn, or save them up to cast an expensive spell in half the time! You'll keep all cards drafted, then play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win.
Events/Event_Desc_M19_Treasure_Draft.translation: 15张牌的轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。不过这次有些不一样：在你的每个回合开始时，你会获得一个珍宝衍生物，牺牲它可以产生一点任意颜色的法术力。你可以每回合都用它来加速一点法术力，也可以把它们都留起来提前施放大型咒语！你所有抽到的牌都归你所有，不断进行对局，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_M20_Comp_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win!
Events/Event_Desc_M20_Comp_Draft.translation: 轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！

Events/Event_Desc_M20_Omniscience_Draft.oracleText: In Omniscience Draft, draft three packs and keep the cards you draft, but with a twist: You don't have to pay the mana costs for spells you cast! No need to put lands in your deck. You'll also get one mana of each color each turn to use for abilities, and every player starts with three cards in their hand instead of seven.
Events/Event_Desc_M20_Omniscience_Draft.translation: 在「全知全能轮抽」中，依然是利用三包补充包进行轮抽，且你所抽到的牌张都会加入你的收藏，不过有些不一样：牌张不需法术力费用即可施放！套牌中不再需要留出地牌位置，你的法术力池中每个回合都会加入每种颜色各一点的法术力，供你起动异能之用，同时每位牌手的起始手牌数量改为三张（而非原本的七张）。

Events/Event_Desc_MAT_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Knights Knights have assembled from around the multiverse! Keeping a steady supply of these gallant creatures will help press your advantage each turn. Graveyard Mill everyone. Your forces will improve with more strategies and greater power as each graveyard fills. Sacrifice Desperate times call for desperate measures. Sacrifice your artifacts and creatures to pave a path to victory. Battles Get ready to liberate your favorite plane from the Phyrexians! Prioritize Battles, Magic's newest card type, and smash through opposing defenses to save the day. +1/+1 Counters It's time to buff up! Arm your creatures with +1/+1 counters to outclass the opposition. Phyrexian Looking to play the villain? Seek out Phyrexians of all sorts to take advantage of them and their swarms of little hatching Incubator tokens. Convoke Your creatures are here to help withstand the invasion. Build an army early and they'll help you cast powerful spells with convoke. Incubate Go big and generate tons of mana to play bigger creatures and incubate larger tokens. Backup Find a good partner and tag-team those Phyrexians. Use the backup mechanic to find the right combination of abilities to build toward your victory each turn. Transform Life is always more fun with some change. Take your cards to the next level by winning battles and turning Incubator tokens and creatures into their Phyrexian selves.
Events/Event_Desc_MAT_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 牌手轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制。 骑士整个多重宇宙的骑士均已集结于此！持续派出这些英勇的生物，助你每回合都能建立优势。 坟场大家齐磨牌。所有坟墓场中的牌越多，你的手下就有更多选择，也会因此愈加强大。 牺牲绝望之时更需殊死之策。牺牲神器生物，开辟胜利通途。 战役准备好从非瑞克西亚人手中拯救自己的最爱时空。优先应对战役这一万智牌中最新的牌张类别，随后洞穿敌人防线，力挽狂澜。 +1/+1指示物现在是加成时间！用+1/+1指示物武装你的生物，完胜对手。 非瑞克西亚想当大反派？留意各类非瑞人，然后充分利用他们和成群待孵化的抚育器衍生物。 召集你的生物可助你抵御非瑞克西亚大军。早期就构建起庞大军势，之后便可利用它们来协助施放具召集异能的强大咒语。 抚育积极扩充法术力基础，产生大量的法术力来派遣大型生物或抚育大型衍生物。 后援寻找合适战友，结伴对抗非瑞克西亚。利用后援机制，探寻正确的异能组合，每回合都迈出踏向胜利的坚实脚步。 转化有改变，生命才更精彩。打赢战役，或是将抚育器衍生物转化变成非瑞人生物，让牌张强度再上一层楼。

Events/Event_Desc_MH3_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players This set is not legal in Standard. Energy Fliers Play flying creatures that get stronger the more energy you have. Use them to attack your opponent or otherwise find tricky ways to get past your opponent's blockers. Card Draw This classic UB control deck employs a variety of ways to draw additional cards, then leverages them for additional effects to dominate the battlefield. Artifacts Start small and go big. This BR deck uses a variety of artifact synergies, including the infamous affinity, to summon powerhouses from Magic's past and future. Eldrazi Spawn Even the smallest Eldrazi are worthy of fear. Overwhelm your opponent with your terrifying Eldrazi horde, aided by Eldrazi Spawn tokens, in this RG deck. Modified Bestow Bestow gives you the versatility to play creatures or use them as Auras to buff others. Go tall and then dare your opponent to stop you from going wide if they can weather the first storm. Modified Dies In this unique take on a WB sacrifice deck, you're going to be modifying your creatures with counters, Equipment, and Auras for long-term advantages. Energy Midrange Embrace your inner mad scientist! UR Energy gives you plenty of ways to manage different types of engine-like permanents to generate overwhelming advantage over your opponents. Modified Adapt This BG adapt deck uses +1/+1 counters to great effect, giving creatures additional spell-like triggers to dominate the battlefield. Energy Aggro There's no point hoarding your excess energy here, so spend it and smash! This aggressive RW deck will do whatever it takes with energy to keep attacking turn after turn. Eldrazi Ramp In this GU deck, generate Eldrazi Spawn and then use them to summon their much larger kin—and proceed to devour the Multiverse.
Events/Event_Desc_MH3_Premier_Draft.translation: 每次从传过来的轮抽包中选一张牌，这些牌会加入你的收藏，你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。开始游戏并基于胜场获得奖励！ 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽 注意：此系列不能在标准赛中使用。 能量飞行生物 打出拥有的能量越多便越强大的飞行生物。利用它们对敌方发动进攻，或找到巧妙的方法来突破对手的拦截。 抽牌 这套经典蓝黑控采用多种方式抽取额外牌张，然后利用它们获得额外的效应来主宰战场。 神器 以小见大。这套红黑通过各种神器协同作用，包括那些恶名昭彰的共鸣，召唤万智牌过去与未来的强者。 奥札奇后裔 哪怕是最微小的奥札奇也不容小觑。这套红绿借助奥札奇后裔衍生物之力，以可怕的奥札奇部落压服对手。 饰装神授 神授可以让你决定打出生物或将其用作灵气来为其他生物提供属性。打造强大的生物，而后挑战你的对手，若其能经受住第一波风暴，他们才有机会阻止你铺场。 饰装死亡 在此独特的黑白牺牲套牌中你将通过指示物、武具和灵气饰装你的生物，以获得长期优势。 能量中速 接纳内心的疯狂科学家！红蓝能量为你提供了多种不同类别的类引擎永久物的管理方法，助你在战局中取得压倒性优势。 饰装演化 这套黑绿采用+1/+1指示物以达到更好的效应，给予生物额外的类咒语触发以制服对手。 能量猛袭 没有必要在此围积多余的能量，消耗能量进行破坏吧！这套红白快攻积极进攻不惜一切能量保持接二连三的攻势。 奥札奇加速 这套蓝绿生成奥札奇后裔，而后用其召唤更为强大的亲族，进一步吞噬多重宇宙。

Events/Event_Desc_MH3_Trad_Draft.translation: 每次从传过来的轮抽包中选一张牌，这些牌会加入你的收藏，你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。进行BO3对局并基于胜场获得奖励！ 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽 能量飞行生物 打出拥有的能量越多便越强大的飞行生物。利用它们对敌方发动进攻，或找到巧妙的方法来突破对手的拦截。 抽牌 这套经典蓝黑控采用多种方式抽取额外牌张，然后利用它们获得额外的效应来主宰战场。 神器 以小见大。这套红黑通过各种神器协同作用，包括那些恶名昭彰的共鸣，召唤万智牌过去与未来的强者。 奥札奇后裔 哪怕是最微小的奥札奇也不容小觑。这套红绿借助奥札奇后裔衍生物之力，以可怕的奥札奇部落压服对手。 饰装神授 神授可以让你决定打出生物或将其用作灵气来为其他生物提供属性。打造强大的生物，而后挑战你的对手，若其能经受住第一波风暴，他们才有机会阻止你铺场。 饰装死亡 在此独特的黑白牺牲套牌中你将通过指示物、武具和灵气饰装你的生物，以获得长期优势。 能量中速 接纳内心的疯狂科学家！红蓝能量为你提供了多种不同类别的类引擎永久物的管理方法，助你在战局中取得压倒性优势。 饰装演化 这套黑绿采用+1/+1指示物以达到更好的效应，给予生物额外的类咒语触发以制服对手。 能量猛袭 没有必要在此围积多余的能量，消耗能量进行破坏吧！这套红白快攻积极进攻不惜一切能量保持接二连三的攻势。 奥札奇加速 这套蓝绿生成奥札奇后裔，而后用其召唤更为强大的亲族，进一步吞噬多重宇宙。

Events/Event_Desc_MID_Sealed.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Midnight Hunt Sealed: Open six packs and add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, then play against other players as much as you want. This event is phantom. Events/Event_Desc_MID_Sealed.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是黯夜猎踪现开：利用6包补充包和基本地构组一副40张的套牌，并与其他牌手进行对战，且无次数限制。 此赛事为虚拟活动。你抽选的牌张不会加入你的收藏。

Events/Event_Desc_MKM_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Detectives Get on your opponent's case with this fast midrange strategy. Leverage Detective typal bonuses to overwhelm your opponent's defenses, and sacrifice Clues to refill your hand in the late game. Clues Control Use defensive spells to extend the game and generate Clues, then turn the excess mana into a card advantage that will bury your opponent in a mountain of value. Suspect Aggro Suspected creatures have menace and can't block. Keep attacking with your suspicious characters, and your opponents will be helpless to stop them. Big Disguise Spend the early game accelerating your mana and setting up a face-down board state, then beat down your opponent's side of the board by flipping over haymaker after haymaker. Go-Wide Disguise Flood the battlefield with face-down creatures and accrue impressive rewards whenever they're turned face up. Pint-Size Disguise Face-down creatures bolster your strategy, which rewards playing creatures with power 2 or less and boosting them to become more impressive attackers. Artifact Sacrifice Generate and sacrifice Clue tokens strategically to gain a massive card advantage over your opponent. Then, chip away at their defenses by attacking with evasive Thopters that bring death from above. Gravebreak Use the collect evidence mechanic and raise the dead to support a long-game strategy that gives you extra value whenever a creature card leaves your graveyard. Battalion This classic Ravnican strategy adds extra punch to aggressive red and white creatures by providing a bonus whenever you attack with three or more of them. Collect Evidence Rapidly fill up your graveyard and collect evidence to power up your spells while amassing permanents that reward you each time you do so.
Events/Event_Desc_MKM_Premier_Draft.translation: 从传过来的轮抽补充包中一次选一张牌。这些牌会加入你的收藏。你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一套40张的套牌。进行游戏并基于你的胜场获得奖励！ 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽 集结侦探 以这种快节奏中速策略来解决对手：充分利用侦探特有的额外价值压垮对手的防线并在游戏后期牺牲线索补充手牌。 线索控制 使用防御咒语拉长战线并派出线索，然后将多余的法术力转化成手牌优势最终以海量资源埋葬对手。 怀疑快攻 遭疑生物具有威慑异能且不能阻挡。用遭疑角色持续进攻，在他们的攻势下你的对手会陷入绝望。 巨型伪装 在游戏前期加速法术力并将匿伏生物铺满你的版图，接着将它们翻面施以拳拳重击击倒对手。 铺场伪装 召唤海量匿伏生物，每当他们翻面时，不断获取惊人回报。 微型伪装 通过匿伏生物帮助实现你的计策：通过打出力量等于或小于2的生物获得回报并增强他们使之成为更有力的进攻者。 神器牺牲 机智地派出和牺牲线索衍生物来赢得巨大的卡差优势，然后用带穿透的振翼机进攻蚕食对手防线，从空中击败对手。 破坟而出 利用搜证机制和掘坟来支撑该长盘战略：每当一张生物牌离开你的坟场时给予你额外价值。 集结军队 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时能提供额外价值——这种经典的拉尼卡策略让本身就极具进攻性的红白生物如虎添翼。 搜集证据 快速填充你的坟场并通过搜证强化你的咒语，同时积攒让你每次搜证获得回报的永久物。

The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Knights Knights have assembled from around the multiverse! Keeping a steady supply of these gallant creatures will help press your advantage each turn. Graveyard Mill everyone. Your forces will improve with more strategies and greater power as each graveyard fills. Sacrifice Desperate times call for desperate measures. Sacrifice your artifacts and creatures to pave a path to victory. Battles Get ready to liberate your favorite plane from the Phyrexians! Prioritize Battles, Magic's newest card type, and smash through opposing defenses to save the day. +1/+1 Counters It's time to buff up! Arm your creatures with +1/+1 counters to outclass the opposition. Phyrexian Looking to play the villain? Seek out Phyrexians of all sorts to take advantage of them and their swarms of little hatching Incubator tokens. Convoke Your creatures are here to help withstand the invasion. Build an army early and they'll help you cast powerful spells with convoke. Incubate Go big and generate tons of mana to play bigger creatures and incubate larger tokens. Backup Find a good partner and tag-team those Phyrexians. Use the backup mechanic to find the right combination of abilities to build toward your victory each turn. Transform Life is always more fun with some change. Take your cards to the next level by winning battles and turning Incubator tokens and creatures into their Phyrexian selves.
Events/Event_Desc_MOM_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 牌手轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制。 骑士整个多重宇宙的骑士均已集结于此！持续派出这些英勇的生物，助你每回合都能建立优势。 坟场大家齐磨牌。所有坟墓场中的牌越多，你的手下就有更多选择，也会因此愈加强大。 牺牲绝望之时更需殊死之策。牺牲神器生物，开辟胜利通途。 战役准备好从非瑞克西亚人手中拯救自己的最爱时空。优先应对战役这一万智牌中最新的牌张类别，随后洞穿敌人防线，力挽狂澜。 +1/+1指示物现在是加成时间！用+1/+1指示物武装你的生物，完胜对手。 非瑞克西亚想当大反派？留意各类非瑞人，然后充分利用他们和成群待孵化的抚育器衍生物。 召集你的生物可助你抵御非瑞克西亚大军。早期就构建起庞大军势，之后便可利用它们来协助施放具召集异能的强大咒语。 抚育积极扩充法术力基础，产生大量的法术力来派遣大型生物或抚育大型衍生物。 后援寻找合适战友，结伴对抗非瑞克西亚。利用后援机制，探寻正确的异能组合，每回合都迈出踏向胜利的坚实脚步。 转化有改变，生命才更精彩。打赢战役，或是将抚育器衍生物转化变成非瑞人生物，让牌张强度再上一层楼。

Sacrifice your artifacts and creatures to pave a path to victory. Battles Get ready to liberate your favorite plane from the Phyrexians! Prioritize Battles, Magic's newest card type, and smash through opposing defenses to save the day. +1/+1 Counters It's time to buff up! Arm your creatures with +1/+1 counters to outclass the opposition. Phyrexian Looking to play the villain? Seek out Phyrexians of all sorts to take advantage of them and their swarms of little hatching Incubator tokens. Convoke Your creatures are here to help withstand the invasion. Build an army early and they'll help you cast powerful spells with convoke. Incubate Go big and generate tons of mana to play bigger creatures and incubate larger tokens. Backup Find a good partner and tag-team those Phyrexians. Use the backup mechanic to find the right combination of abilities to build toward your victory each turn. Transform Life is always more fun with some change. Take your cards to the next level by winning battles and turning Incubator tokens and creatures into their Phyrexian selves.
Events/Event_Desc_MOM_Trad_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励！ 牌手轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制。 骑士整个多重宇宙的骑士均已集结于此！持续派出这些英勇的生物，助你每回合都能建立优势。 坟场大家齐磨牌。所有坟墓场中的牌越多，你的手下就有更多选择，也会因此愈加强大。 牺牲绝望之时更需殊死之策。牺牲神器生物，开辟胜利通途。 战役准备好从非瑞克西亚人手中拯救自己的最爱时空。优先应对战役这一万智牌中最新的牌张类别，随后洞穿敌人防线，力挽狂澜。 +1/+1指示物现在是加成时间！用+1/+1指示物武装你的生物，完胜对手。 非瑞克西亚想当大反派？留意各类非瑞人，然后充分利用他们和成群待孵化的抚育器衍生物。 召集你的生物可助你抵御非瑞克西亚大军。早期就构建起庞大军势，之后便可利用它们来协助施放具召集异能的强大咒语。 抚育积极扩充法术力基础，产生大量的法术力来派遣大型生物或抚育大型衍生物。 后援寻找合适战友，结伴对抗非瑞克西亚。利用后援机制，探寻正确的异能组合，每回合都迈出踏向胜利的坚实脚步。 转化有改变，生命才更精彩。打赢战役，或是将抚育器衍生物转化变成非瑞人生物，让牌张强度再上一层楼。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_3Sets.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is On the Edge: Bring a 60-card deck only using cards from Magic: The Gathering Foundations and the last three Standard sets.  That means cards from Marvel Super Heroes, Secrets of Strixhaven, and Magic: The Gathering® | Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles are Legal. With only these Standard sets to work with, you'll need cutting-edge strategies to find victory!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_3Sets.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！MTG竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是剑走偏锋：使用一副60张的套牌，仅限使用万智牌：基石构筑和最近三个标准系列的牌。这意味着漫威超级英雄、斯翠海文的秘密和万智牌丨忍者神龟中的牌都是合法的。在只有这些标准系列可用的情况下，你需要剑走偏锋的策略来取得胜利！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Alchemy.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Alchemy: Bring a 60-card Alchemy deck. Break out the latest and greatest from the lab, or maybe find a new favorite!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Alchemy.translation:
欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！

本周赛事是炼金：带上60张牌的炼金套牌。看看实验室的最新和最伟大的作品，也许能找到一个新的最爱。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_AlchemyPrecons.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Into the Future: The latest set of Alchemy cards is here, and it's time to hit the laboratory! To get things started, we've arranged a few samples that will get you off and running. Give them a try, and you just might find the seed for your next masterpiece!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_AlchemyPrecons.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

本周的活动是步入未来：最新炼金系列现已登场，如今正是实验好时机！为帮助各位快速熟悉赛场趋势，我们事先准备了一些示例套牌供大家上手尝试。不妨把玩一下，或许这就是你下一副杰作套牌的灵感源泉！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Alchemy_AllAccess.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Alchemy All Access: While you'll still bring a Alchemy deck, you won't need the cards! Try out that new deck you've had your eye on, or create something new!

欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！

本周赛事是炼金全卡模式：你可以构筑一个炼金套牌，并且你不需要拥有其中的卡牌！尝试那些你感兴趣的套牌，或构筑一些新的！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Alchemy_Ladder_Sho.oracleText:

This week's event is Alchemy Ladder Deck Showcase: Select from five different competitive Alchemy constructed decks and test them out on the Alchemy Ladder! Change decks as often as you like.

This week's event is Artisan: Bring a 60-card Alchemy deck, but using only commons, uncommons, and basic lands. Without rares, the common folk can truly be heard!

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Chimil_Historic.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Chimil, the Inner Sun Historic: at the end of each of your turns, Discover a spell with cost 5 or lower! What a bargain! All you'll need to play is a 60-card Historic deck.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Chimil_Historic.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是内阳奇密理史迹：在每个你的回合，倾探5费及以下的咒语！这太划算了！你只需要构筑一套60张的史迹套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Cube_BotDraft.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Chromatic Cube Bot Draft: Try out the biggest and boldest curated draft format on MTG Arena! Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs against AI with no waiting and no pick timers. Add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, and play against other players as much as you want. This event is phantom. Cards you draft are not added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Cube_BotDraft.translation: 欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！ 本周赛事是五彩方盒人机轮抽：在MTGA上尝试最新的精选轮抽赛制！轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌以对抗AI，无需等待，也无需选择计时器。而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌，不断进行对战随你所愿！ 这是一个幻影活动。你所抓取的牌张不会添加到你的收藏当中。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_DFTConstructed.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Aetherdrift Constructed: Bring a 60-card deck with only cards from the most recent set and demonstrate your mastery of the new cards!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_DFTConstructed.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是乙太飘移构筑赛：使用事先组好的60张套牌进行游戏，但套牌仅限利用最近刚刚推出之前述系列的的牌张，展示你对新牌的掌握！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_DFT_BotDraft.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！ 本周赛事是乙太飘移人机轮抽：与AI进行轮抽，每次从轮转的轮抽包中选择一张牌，无需等待，也没有抽选时间限制。加入基本地，组建一副40张牌的套牌，尽情与其他玩家对战。 此赛事为幻影赛事，您所轮抽的牌将不会加入您的收藏。 神器价值 在场面上积累神器，最后用你的竞速机器人大军碾压对手！ 神器血祭 机器人与诡异玩具的完美配合，让对手在恐惧中不断流失生命。 速度极限快攻 加速到速度极限，将对手碾为赛道尘埃。 竭绝中速 烧光所有燃料，让窜天鬼队成长为不可阻挡的庞然大物！ 载具&坐骑中速 阿拉奇亚捷兽队的卓越驾手将驾驭你的坐骑与载具冲过终点线。 速度极限消耗 阿芒凯豪杰队紧踩油门直到速度极限，释放僵尸军团发起猛攻。 弃牌快攻 预备！通过循环和弃牌来强化海盗，将对手从甲板上扔出去。 坟墓场 填满坟墓场并不断复活威胁，从赛道残骸中崛起制胜。 载具&坐骑快攻 路怒症发作！鼎云侠队的凶猛攻势将迫使对手节节败退。 竭绝Ramp 乙太流浪者队法术力充足，用异能作为燃料为生物注入爆发巨力。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_FIN_BotDraft.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Magic: The Gathering®—FINAL FANTASY Bot Draft: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs against AI with no waiting and no pick timers. Add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, and play against other players as much as you want. This event is phantom. Cards you draft are not added to your collection. Find out more details about this and upcoming Midweek Magic events HERE. Artifacts Calling all Machinists! Build up your arsenal by playing artifacts, including artifact creatures and token generating Equipment, then gain extra bonuses for playing those artifacts.   Control Scheme and act in secret. Dominate the long game with strategies like removal spells, card draw, and tricky creatures. Cast flashback spells to crush foes under the weight of the past! Black Mage Aggro Play the aggressive game with creatures that reward you whenever you cast a noncreature spell. Look for cards that create Wizard tokens and turn those spells into a barrage of damage! Landfall Aggro Play creatures with landfall abilities, like Chocobos, and earn bonuses as you play lands. Look for ways to play extra lands and strengthen your creatures even further! Go Wide Call forth a battalion of formidable fighters and play cards that make tokens. Either reinforce your standing army or leverage your high creature count to cast hard-hitting spells! Artifact and Creature Sacrifice Sacrifice your artifacts and creatures, especially ones with death effects, to steadily gain the upper hand. Token generating Equipment gives you two things to sacrifice! Big Noncreatures Whenever you cast spells that cost 4 or more mana, you'll gain bonuses in battle. Find ways to generate tokens, like with special Equipment, so that your noncreature spells can add to your forces! Graveyard Value Slow and steady wins the game! Mill to fill your graveyard early with powerful creatures and flashback spells, then bring them back to the fight late in the game to achieve victory. Equipment Aggro Grab your favorite iconic weapon and rush into battle! Look for creatures that want to be equipped or cards that reward you for having Equipment, then gear up to outclass your opponent. Town Ramp Travel the overworld! Towns are lands that grant more perks the more of them you have, so play a bunch and reap the rewards. You'll even want to play some Towns that aren't blue or green, so be sure to splash in some other colors, too!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_FIN_BotDraft.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智夜！MTG竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周活动是万智牌～最终幻想人机轮抽：你将与电脑一道，从在桌上轮转的轮抽补充包中抽选牌张，无需等待，也没有抽选时间限制。之后加入基本地构组一副40张的套牌，并与其他牌手进行对战，且无次数限制。 此为幻影赛事。你抽选的牌张不会加入你的收藏。 了解更多本周及未来周中万智牌活动详情请点击此处。 神器 机工士集结！使用神器——包括神器生物和派出衍生物的武具——来建立你的军火库，然后从神器中赚取额外收益！ 控制 暗中策划并行动。通过使用诸如去除咒语、抓牌和诡计生物等策略来主宰长盘。施放返照咒语，用回忆的分量碾压敌人！ 黑魔法师快攻 使用那些在你施放非生物咒语时有所回报的生物打出进攻性。寻找能派出法术师衍生物的牌，将这些咒语转化为一连串的伤害！ 地落快攻 使用具有地落异能的生物（如陆行鸟），让你在使用地时获得奖励。寻找额外使用地的方法，进一步强化你的生物！ 横向展开 召唤一支强大的战士队伍，并使用能派出衍生物的牌。要么增援你的常备军，要么利用你的生物数量施放强力咒语！ 神器与生物牺牲 牺牲你的神器和生物，尤其是那些具有死去效应的，以此稳步获得优势。派出衍生物的武具为你提供了两样可以牺牲的东西！ 高费非生物 每当你施放费用等于或大于4的咒语时，你将在战斗中获得奖励。寻找派出衍生物的方法（如特殊武具），这样你的非生物咒语也能增强你的部队！ 坟场价值 稳扎稳打赢得比赛！早期通过磨牌将强力生物和返照咒语放入坟墓场，然后在游戏后期将它们带回战斗以获得胜利。 武具快攻 拿起你最爱的标志性武器，冲入战场！寻找那些希望被装备的生物或在你拥有武具时有所收益的牌，然后装备起来超越你的对手！ 市镇加速 环游世界！市镇作为地牌，当你拥有的越多，它们提供的额外好处就越多，所以使用一堆市镇来收获奖励。你甚至可以使用一些非蓝非绿的市镇，所以别忘了混些其他颜色！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_FutureAlchemy.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Future Alchemy: Get a jump on next year's format! Bring a 60-card deck using only cards from the last year of Alchemy, starting with Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, whether they're in your collection or not. Out with the old and in with the new!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_FutureAlchemy.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是未来炼金：尝试明年的赛制！使用事先组好的60张套牌参赛，但仅限包含来自最近一年炼金赛制中的牌张，且不受收藏中已有牌张限制（从依尼翠：黯夜猎踪开始）。告别旧伙伴，迎接新朋友！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_FuturePrecon.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

Today's event is Future Precons: These preconstructed decks are gearing up for the future, using only cards from the last year of sets! Change decks as often as you like.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_FuturePrecon.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

今天的活动是未来预组：这些预组套牌只使用了最近一年发售系列的卡牌，为未来做好准备！你可以随心所欲地更换套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_GladiatorPrecons.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

Welcome to Gladiator, one of the most popular fan formats for MTG Arena!

Gladiator uses 100-card singleton Historic decks with a minimal banned list. You'll face off in best-of-one matches, so every game matters. With no sideboards, what you bring is what you've got—so make it count!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_GladiatorPrecons.translation:
欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！

欢迎来到角斗，这是万智牌竞技场最受欢迎的粉丝赛制之一！

角斗使用100张无双史迹套牌和最低限度的禁牌表。然后，你将在一盘胜负制的比赛中对峙，让你有机会从双方玩家的套牌中看到广泛的可能性。没有备牌，所以你带来的就是你所拥有的！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_GoldenSealed.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's enjoy this silly, chaotic experience by playing Golden Booster Sealed with twelve boosters. Add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, then play against other players as much as you want! This event is phantom. Cards you draft are not added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_GoldenSealed.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！MTG竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是十二个补充包的黄金补充包现开，尽享欢乐混乱的游戏体验。添加基本地构组一副40张的套牌，然后与其他牌手尽情对战，没有次数限制！ 此活动为幻影活动。你抽选的牌张不会加入你的收藏。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HBG_BotDraft.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Alchemy Horizons: Baldur's Gate Bot Draft: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs against AI with no waiting and no pick timers. Add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, and play against other players as much as you want. This event is phantom. Cards you draft are not added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HBG_BotDraft.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是电脑轮抽：炼金新篇：博德之门：你将与电脑一道，从在桌上轮转的轮抽补充包中抽选牌张，无需等待，也没有抽选时间限制。之后加入基本地构组一副40张的套牌，并与其他牌手进行对战，且无次数限制。 此赛事为虚拟活动。你抽选的牌张不会加入你的收藏。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Halloween2024_Seal.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! Celebrate Halloween with a spooky return trip to Innistrad as you've never seen it before! You'll play with 3 Innistrad: Double Feature and 4 Shadows Over Innistrad Remastered packs. Add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, then play against other players as much as you want! This event is phantom. Cards you draft are not added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Halloween2024_Seal.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！MTGA每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 以一次前所未有的惊悚方式重返依尼翠，共同庆祝万圣节吧！您将使用3包依尼翠：双系列和4包依尼翠暗影重制版补充包进行游戏。添加基本地牌来组成一副40张的套牌，然后尽情与其他玩家对战吧！ 此赛事为幻影活动。你抽选的牌张不会加入你的收藏。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HappyBrawlidays.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Brawl: Bring a 60-card deck led by your favorite legendary creature or planeswalker in Standard. Choose your champion and fight to the top of the heap! This event is All Access (Brawl Access?), meaning you can use cards outside of your collection!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HappyBrawlidays.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

本周的活动是争锋：使用事先组好的60张套牌进行游戏，并由你最喜爱的标准赛制传奇生物或鹏洛客统帅！选择你的勇士，战至顶峰！此活动为牌张任用（牌争任用？），这意味着你可以利用不在收藏中的牌张！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Historic.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!
This week's event is Historic: Bring a 60-card deck from among any cards available on MTG Arena. Put old favorites and new contenders toe-to-toe!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Historic.translation:
欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！
本周赛事是史迹：构筑一副60张的套牌，MTGA任何可用的牌都可以。让老牌劲旅和新的竞争者一较高下!

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HistoricArtisan.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Historic Artisan: Bring a 60-card deck using only commons, uncommons, and basic lands from any set in MTG Arena. Without rares, the common folk can truly be heard!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HistoricArtisan.translation: 欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！ 本周赛事是史迹巧匠：构筑一副60张的套牌，但只能使用MTGA任何系列的普通牌、非凡牌和基本地。没有稀有，才能真正听到普通人的声音！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HistoricBrawl.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Brawl: Bring a 100-card deck using any cards in MTG Arena, led by your favorite legendary creature or planeswalker!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HistoricBrawl.translation:
欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一种不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！

本周活动是争锋：围绕你最喜爱的传奇生物或鹏洛客，使用万智牌竞技场中任意可用牌张构筑一副100张的套牌！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HistoricBrawlPreco.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Historic Brawl Showcase: Take these Historic Brawl preconstructed decks for a spin, and see if you find a new favorite! Change decks as often as you like.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HistoricBrawlPreco.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

今天的活动是史迹争锋展威：拿上这些史迹争锋预组套牌一试身手，瞧瞧能否找到新的心头好！你可以随心所欲地更换套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HistoricPauper.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Historic Pauper: Bring a 60-card Historic deck that contains only commons and basic lands. Look for some common ground with all those cards you've drafted and build something new!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HistoricPauper.translation:
欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！

本周赛事是史迹全铁：构筑一副60张的史迹套牌，只可使用普通牌和基本地。寻找你抓取到的所有卡牌的共同点，并构建新的东西！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HistoricShakeup.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Historic Shakeup: We're removing some of Historic's most popular and powerful cards. Search for new strategies and bring the best 60-card deck you can create!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HistoricShakeup.translation:
欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！

本周赛事是史迹革新：我们正在移除一些史迹赛制最受欢迎和最强大的卡牌。寻找新策略，带上你能创造的最好的60张牌套牌！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HistoricSingletonA.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Historic Singleton All-Access: Bring a 60-card Historic deck with no duplicates besides basic lands–including cards outside your collection! Once you find the winning recipe, try your deck in the Phyrexia: All Will Be One Festival events!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_HistoricSingletonA.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是史迹无双牌张任用：使用事先组好的60张无重复（除基本地外）史迹套牌参赛，可以使用你收藏之外的牌。找到你的制胜配方，并在非瑞克西亚：万界归一节庆活动中一试身手！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Historic_AllAccess.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Historic All Access: While you'll still bring a Historic deck, you won't need the cards! Try out that new deck you've had your eye on, or create something new!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Historic_AllAccess.translation:
欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！

本周赛事是史迹全卡：虽然你仍然会带上史迹套牌，但你不需要拥有该卡牌！试试你关注的新套牌，或者创造一些新的东西！！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_InnistradCons.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Innistrad Constructed: Bring a 60-card deck using only cards from Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, Innistrad: Crimson Vow, and Shadows Over Innistrad Remastered (including all 4 Shadows of the Past). Search these spooky sets for the best strategies, then haunt your opponent's nightmares!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_InnistradCons.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是依尼翠构组：使用事先组好的60张套牌进行游戏，但仅限利用出自依尼翠：黯夜猎踪、依尼翠：腥红婚誓和依尼翠暗影：重制版（包含全部4个往昔暗影）系列的牌张。从这些可怖的系列中寻找最佳策略，然后让你的对手陷入噩梦！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_IxalanForward.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Blast From the Past: Bring a 60-card deck, but you have access to every Standard set since MTG Arena came to Open Beta, starting with Ixalan! Standard has been through a lot since then. Can you find the strategy that will hold up across time?
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_IxalanForward.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是往日重现：使用事先组好的60张套牌参赛，但你可以使用万智牌竞技场自公测以来的所有标准系列，上可追溯至依夏兰！多年以来标准赛已经过诸多变革。你是否能够找到经时不衰的必胜策略？

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is phantom Jump! You will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes in Through the Omenpaths. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go. Unlike regular Jump In, cards from this event will not be added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！MTG竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是幻影速学！你需要从穿越预兆路的多种不同主题的半副套牌中选择两种，将它们组合在一起，就有了一副能够即时开战的套牌。与往常的「速学！」不同，本次活动的牌张不会加入你的收藏。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_ECL.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Jump into Lorwyn Eclipsed! You will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes from the latest set. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_ECL.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智牌！MTG竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

本周的活动是投身洛温：暗影笼罩！你需要从最新系列的多种不同主题的半副套牌中选择两种，将它们组合在一起，就有了一副能够即时开战的套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_EOE.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is phantom Jump! You will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes in Edge of Eternities. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go. Unlike regular Jump In, cards from this event will not be added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_EOE.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！MTG竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是幻影速学！你需要从虚空边域的多种不同主题的半副套牌中选择两种，将它们组合在一起，就有了一副能够即时开战的套牌。与往常的「速学！」不同，本次活动的牌张不会加入你的收藏。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_MKM.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is phantom Jump In featuring only cards from Murders at Karlov Manor! You will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes in Alchemy. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go. Unlike regular Jump In, cards from this event will not be added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_MKM.translation: 欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！ 本周赛事是卡洛夫庄园谋杀案的幻影速学！你可以炼金赛制的各种主题中选择两个不同的「半套牌」补充包，将它们混合起来，你就有一副可以立刻开玩的套牌了！但与通常的速学赛事不同的是，你所选的套牌不会添加到你的收藏当中。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_SOS.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Jump into Secrets of Strixhaven! You will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes from the latest set. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go. Unlike regular Jump In, cards from this event will not be added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_SOS.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！MTG竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是幻影速学！你需要从斯翠海文的秘密的多种不同主题的半副套牌中选择两种，将它们组合在一起，就有了一副能够即时开战的套牌。与往常的「速学！」不同，本次活动的牌张不会加入你的收藏。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_TDM.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is phantom Jump! You will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes in Tarkir: Dragonstorm. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go. Unlike regular Jump In, cards from this event will not be added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_TDM.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！万智牌竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是幻影速学！你需要从鞑契龙岚录的多种不同主题的半副套牌中选择两种，将它们组合在一起，就有了一副能够即时开战的套牌。与往常的「速学！」不同，本次活动的牌张不会加入你的收藏。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_TLA.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Jump into Magic: The Gathering | Avatar: The Last Airbender™! You will get to select two different half-decks from a variety of themes from the latest set. Combine them, and you'll have a deck that's ready to go. Unlike regular Jump In, cards from this event will not be added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_TLA.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！MTG竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是投身万智牌丨降世神通：最后的气宗！你需要从最新系列的多种不同主题的半副套牌中选择两种，将它们组合在一起，就有了一副能够即时开战的套牌。与往常的「速学！」不同，本次活动的牌张不会加入你的收藏。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_JumpIn_TMT.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is One For All: Choose your deck from out of every card on Arena. Nothing is banned, but you can use only one copy of each! What's in your toolbox?
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_OneForAll.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

本周的活动是独一无二：从《竞技场》的所有牌张中挑选套牌。没有禁牌，但同名牌只能使用一张！你的会有什么新惊喜？

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_PIO_Sealed.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Pioneer Masters Sealed: Open six packs and add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, then play against other players as much as you want. This event is phantom. Cards you draft are not added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_PIO_Sealed.translation: 欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！ 本周的活动是 先驱大师 现开赛：打开六个卡包，再将基本地加入其中，组成40张的套牌与其他玩家对战，不限对局次数。 这是一个幻影活动。你所抓取的牌张不会添加到你的收藏当中。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_PioneerLegal.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is What Was Written: Bring a 60-card deck using the original versions of any cards on MTG Arena from only as far back as the Return to Ravnica set. Without the most potent pieces from Historic and the newest additions from Alchemy, what strategies will rise to the top?
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_PioneerLegal.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是原影重现：使用事先组好的60张套牌参赛，套牌可由在《MTG竞技场》上登场的牌张构成，但仅限出自再访拉尼卡系列之后的原版牌张。倘若没有史迹强力牌张与炼金最新补充加持，哪种策略能笑到最后？

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_PostMalone.oracleText: Post Malone has come to put on a showstopping concert for MTG Arena and Congratulations, everyone gets a front row seat! Play one of 5 musically inclined decks to join in on this Rockstar jam session. As you run Circles around your opponents, you'll earn sleeves from the Secret Lair X Post Malone: the Lands collection. There are 5 different sleeves to collect! Wow. For more details on this concert, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_PostMalone.translation: Post Malone降临MTG竞技场，奉献精彩演出。恭喜各位，你们都能在头排尽享盛宴！ 从5副音乐主题套牌中选择一副，与摇滚巨星共奏美妙旋律。当你利用Circles征服对手后，你就能获得来自Secret Lair X Post Malone: the Lands珍品系列的牌套。共有5种牌套供你收集！精彩绝伦。 关于本次演唱会的更多信息，请点击此处。 活动结束后，参加者会自动获得所有未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_RuleOfLaw.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Rule of Law: We'll provide a deck for you to play, and every card can be cast for free... but you can only cast one spell each turn. Your opening hand and starting life are reduced, so choose carefully! Every turn can be critical!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_RuleOfLaw.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

本周的活动是依法治理：我们将提供套牌供你使用，且所有牌都能免费施放...但你每回合只能施放一个咒语。你的起手手牌数量与起始总生命也有相应削减，因此请务必谨慎选择！每个回合都可能一招致命！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_SIR_Sealed.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Shadows Over Innistrad Remastered Sealed: Open six packs and add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, then play against other players as much as you want. This event is phantom. Cards you draft are not added to your collection. This Week's Shadows of the Past: Fatal Flashback! Haunting Spirits Establish a ghostly presence as you take to the skies with Spirits and other unlikely allies. Relentless Zombies Destroy enemy creatures with removal spells, reload your hand with card draw, and march on with a horde of Zombies. Vampire Madness Your vampire army helps you to discard cards, cast spells for their madness costs, and secure victory. The key is striking the right balance between discard outlets and madness cards. Wolves Attack Transform your Werewolves with a combination of instants and activated abilities. Your outsized creatures will overrun your opponents in no time. Super-Humans Stack up Auras and Equipment on your Humans to swing in for the kill with your larger-than-life creatures. Valuable Sacrifice Expendable resources are everywhere in white-black. Sacrifice creatures and pay life liberally for value. Spell Science Noncreature spells perform double duty here if you pick up enough creatures that reward you for playing them. Graveyard Shift Stock your graveyard to get extra value from powerful delirium cards. Your deck will just need a wide variety of card types to turn it on. Righteous Fury Run down your opponent with cheap, powerful threats and well-timed combat tricks. Let's Investigate Play defense while you build up a supply of Clues. You'll soon learn enough to overwhelm your opponent with card advantage and large monsters.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_SIR_Sealed.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是依尼翠暗影：重制版现开：利用6包补充包和基本地构组一副40张的套牌，并与其他牌手进行对战，且无次数限制。 此赛事为虚拟活动。你抽选的牌张不会加入你的收藏。 本周的往昔暗影是：致命返照！ 闹鬼精怪利用精怪及其他奇诡生物统治天空，如鬼魅一般统治战场。 无情灵俑利用去除咒语消灭对手生物，借助抓牌手段重整手牌，派出灵俑大军横扫一切。 吸血鬼疯魔想要不断弃牌、利用疯魔施放咒语，最终确保胜利吗？你的吸血鬼大军能帮你。关键在于找好弃牌源与疯魔牌张之间的平衡所在。 狼群扑袭利用瞬间和起动式异能掌控时机转化狼人，之后这些身材拔群的生物便会在转瞬之间淹没对手。 超级人类在人类身上堆满灵气武具，然后利用你超凡生物打出最后一击。 牺牲有价白黑色组当中满是各类炮灰材料，你大可自如牺牲生物、支付生命来换取更大收益。 咒语科学本系列中有许多生物会在你施放非生物咒语时给予回报。如果你抓到足够多的此类生物，当你施放非生物咒语时就会有双重收获。 坟场变幻不断堆填坟墓场，好充分发挥强力躁狂卡牌的额外价值。你只需确保你牌库中充满了各类牌张类别，便可轻松坐收渔利。 正义之怒利用低费的强大威胁，辅以适时的战斗诡计，快速终结对手。 深入探查在坚守阵地的同时不断积累线索数量。你很快便占据手牌优势并派出大型怪兽，从而击溃对手。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_SNC_BotDraft.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Streets of New Capenna Bot Draft: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs against AI with no waiting and no pick timers. Add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, and play against other players as much as you want. This event is phantom. Cards you draft are not added to your collection. The Five Families The Obscura: Craft the perfect draws and use superior intelligence over a long game to engineer a route to victory. Use the family's connive mechanic to draw, then discard - giving your creatures +1/+1 counters along the way! The Maestros: Hire expendable underlings as your family's muscle on the streets. Then use the casualty mechanic to sacrifice those minions, copy your spells, and blast your opponent. The Riveteers: The Riveteers rumble with large creatures. Give your creatures haste with the blitz mechanic, then sacrifice them at the end of your turn to draw a card. Keep that pressure up! Then press your advantage to crush your opponents. The Cabaretti: Flood the board with tokens and small creatures to overwhelm the opposition. The family knows how to collaborate for greater gain: alliance abilities give you additional effects whenever another creature enters the battlefield under your control. The Brokers: The Brokers are always ready to take down your opponents one notch at a time. Attack relentlessly to deal small amounts of damage, and mount an impenetrable defense - legal or otherwise! - by amassing shield counters on your creatures.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_SNC_BotDraft.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是新卡佩纳：喧嚣黑街电脑轮抽：与AI进行轮抽，你每次需从轮转的轮抽用补充包中选择一张牌，无需等待，也没有抽选时间限制。加入基本地以组成40张的套牌，然后便可不限次数地与其他牌手对战。 此赛事为虚拟活动。抽选的牌张不会加入你的收藏。 五大家族 秘闻帮：巧妙利用完美抓牌和情报优势，在长盘对局中开辟通往胜利的道路。利用家族特有的筹谋机制来抓牌弃牌～同时还能让生物得到+1/+1！ 绝艺盟：当你的家族在街头火拼时，别忘雇佣一些炮灰手下。然后利用催命机制牺牲它们，复制咒语，猛击对手。 勤工联：勤工联以大块头兴事。利用急袭机制子让生物获得敏捷异能，然后在回合结束时牺牲它们好抓一张牌！持续维持压力！然后利用优势击溃对手。 乐舞会：在战场上铺满衍生物和小生物冲垮对手。此家族深谙合作共赢之道：联手异能能在另一生物在你操控下进战场时让你获得额外效应。 扶济社：扶济社随时准备蚕食对手。无情攻击，多次造成少量伤害，同时在自己生物上布置后盾指示物构建一道防御天堑～无论是法律方面还是现实方面。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_SOS_CascadeBotDraf.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Secrets of Strixhavent Bot Draft: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs against AI with no waiting and no pick timers. Add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, and play against other players as much as you want. In Cascade Draft, the Cascade Emblem will make the first spell you cast on your turn exile cards from the top of your library until you exile one thats mana value is less than the original spell cast. You can then cast that new spell at no cost! This event is phantom. Cards you draft are not added to your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_SOS_CascadeBotDraf.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！MTG竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是斯翠海文的秘密人机轮抽：你将与电脑一道，从在桌上轮转的轮抽补充包中抽选牌张，无需等待，也没有抽选时间限制。之后加入基本地构组一副40张的套牌，并与其他牌手进行对战，且无次数限制。 在倾曳轮抽中，倾曳徽记会让你在你的回合施放首个咒语时从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张法术力值低于原施放咒语的牌为止。然后你可以免费施放那张新牌！ 此赛事为幻影活动。你抽选的牌张不会加入你的收藏。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_SOS_Sealed.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Secrets of Strixhaven Sealed: Open six packs and add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, then play against other players as much as you want. This event is phantom. Cards you open are not added to your collection. $/Events/SOS_Limited_Archetypes$
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_SOS_Sealed.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！MTG竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是斯翠海文的秘密现开赛：打开六个卡包，再将基本地加入其中，组成40张的套牌与其他玩家对战，不限对局次数。 这是一个幻影活动。你所开启的牌张不会添加到你的收藏当中。 $/Events/SOS_Limited_Archetypes$

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_SeededDecks.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! Make Deckbuilding a little easier in this week's event Tarkir: Dragonstorm Stepping Stone Sealed.  Every player will start with the same 22 cards (Listed Below) and a random Rare before they open 5 more packs of Tarkir: Dragonstorm.  With that, build a 40-card deck where, for the first time, every player will have the same 22 commons as a foundation to their pool, but how you use these with your rares and packs is up to you! Play as much as you like, but 3 wins are needed to claim all of your rewards. Cards in Every Pool Mardu Devotee Riling Dawnbreaker Stormplain Detainment Temur Devotee Dirgur Island Dragon Riverwalk Technique Abzan Devotee Feral Deathgorger Dragon's Prey Jeskai Devotee Stormshriek Feral Narset's Rebuke Sultai Devotee Sagu Wildling Sarkhan's Resolve Reigning Victor Temur Tawnyback Reputable Merchant Monastery Messenger Gurmag Nightwatch Boulderborn Dragon Evolving Wilds
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_SeededDecks.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周赛事鞑契龙岚录垫脚石现开让组牌更轻松。每位牌手开局将获得相同的22张牌（如下所列）和一张随机稀有牌，随后再打开5包鞑契龙岚录补充包。用这些牌组建40张的套牌——首次采用所有牌手共享22张普通牌作为牌池基础，但如何搭配你的稀有牌和补充包就全看你的策略了！ 尽情对战，但需取得3场胜利才能领取全部奖励。 公共牌池包含： 玛尔都信徒 易怒破晓龙 风暴原拘留 铁木尔信徒 敦古岛巨龙 水上漂 阿布赞信徒 野性噬尸龙 巨龙捕猎 洁斯凯信徒 鸣霆狂野龙 娜尔施的拒斥 苏勒台信徒 萨谷野生龙 萨坎的决心 卫冕胜者 铁木尔褐毛兽 佳誉商人 寺院信使 谷尔玛夜巡卫 石生巨龙 成形野地

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Singleton.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Singleton: Bring a 60-card Alchemy deck with no duplicates besides basic lands! Every game is a unique experience!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Singleton.translation:
欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！

本周赛事是单张：带上除了基本地之外没有重复的60张标准套牌！每场比赛都是一次独特的体验！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_SlowStart.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Slow Start: Going first is always such a treat, but sometimes it's nice to go second instead. To help smooth things out, the player who goes first will have their first land enter the battlefield tapped. Just take it easy for a turn!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_SlowStart.translation:
欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！

本周赛事是慢热启动：第一个出场总是那么令人愉快，但有时第二个出场也不错。为了使事情顺利进行，先出手的玩家的第一张地会横置进入战场。悠着点儿来一轮儿!

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Standard.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Standard: Bring a 60-card Standard deck, battle against the competition, and claim victory in the premier constructed format!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Standard.translation:
欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！

本周赛事是标准：带上一副60的标准套牌，与竞争对手一决高下，并在首屈一指的构筑赛制中取得胜利！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StandardBrawl.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Brawl: Bring a 60-card deck led by your favorite legendary creature or planeswalker in Standard. Choose your champion and fight to the top of the heap!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StandardBrawl.translation:
欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一种不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！

本周活动是争锋：围绕你最喜爱的传奇生物或鹏洛客，使用标准赛制中中任意可用牌张构筑一副60张的争锋套牌！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StandardPauper.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Standard Pauper: Bring a 60-card Standard deck that contains only commons and basic lands. Look for some common ground with all those cards you've drafted and build something new!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StandardPauper.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智牌！万智牌：竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

本周的活动是标准全铁：使用事先组好的60张标准套牌进行游戏，但套牌仅限普通牌和基本地牌，利用你轮抽所得的普通牌来构筑全新套牌！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StandardPrecons.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Standard Deck Duels! The latest set of Standard cards is here, and it's time to hit the laboratory! To get things started, we've arranged a few samples that will get you off and running. Give them a try, and you just might find the seed for your next masterpiece!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StandardPrecons.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智牌！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

本周的活动是标准套牌对决。最新标准系列卡牌现已面世，是时候实验一番了！为了让你尽快上手，我们为你准备了一些样本。试一试，说不定就能为你的下一个杰作找到灵感！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StandardPrecons_FI.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Magic: the Gathering—FINAL FANTASY Showcase: Take these Magic: the Gathering—FINAL FANTASY preconstructed decks for a spin, and see if you find a new favorite! Change decks as often as you like.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StandardPrecons_FI.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智牌！MTG竞技场每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

本周的活动是万智牌～最终幻想展览：带上这些万智牌～最终幻想预组套牌一试身手，看看能否找到新的最爱！你可以随时更换套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StandardShakeup.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Standard Shakeup: We're removing some of Standard's most popular and powerful cards. Search for new strategies and bring the best 60-card deck you can create!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StandardShakeup.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

本周的活动是标准革新：我们移去标准赛制中使用最广、威力最大的牌张。是时候尝试探寻新策略，组出一副最强的60张新套牌来一试身手！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StandardSingletonA.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Slow Start: Going first is always such a treat, but we all have to go second sometimes. To help smooth things out, the player who goes first will have their first land enter the battlefield tapped. Just take it easy for a turn!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StandardSingletonA.translation:
欢迎来到周中万智牌！ 每周尝试不同的方式玩万智牌竞技场！

本周的赛事是“慢热启动”：先手是一种享受，但我们总有时会后手。 为了让事情顺利进行，先手的牌手须将其第一块地横置进入战场。 轻松度过回合吧！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Standard_Cascade.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Standard Cascade: The first time you cast a spell each turn, you'll get to cast another, less expensive card from your library without paying its mana cost. What a bargain! All you'll need to play is a 60-card Standard deck,
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Standard_Cascade.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！

本周赛事是标准倾曳：你每回合首度施放咒语时，你将能从你的牌库中施放另一张法术力值较低的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。真是超值！只需一副60张的标准套牌即可参加。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Standard_Showcase.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Standard Deck Showcase: Select from five different competitive Standard constructed decks and test them out! Change decks as often as you like.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_Standard_Showcase.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

本周的活动是标准套牌展：从五副强大的标准构筑套牌中选择一副，并一试身手。你可以随心所欲地更换套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_StarStandard.translation:

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_TDM_BotDraft.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is Tarkir: Dragonstorm Bot Draft: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs against AI with no waiting and no pick timers. Add basic lands to make a 40-card deck, and play against other players as much as you want. This event is phantom. Cards you draft are not added to your collection. Mardu Mobilize Create additional tokens to help aid in your attack. Go Wide Tokens Blitz by your opponent with sheer numbers. Use Mobilize tokens and Flurry rewards to build impressive battlefields. Jeskai Flurry Cast two (or more!) spells in a single turn to overwhelm your opponent. Two Spells Use Harmonize spells frequently in order to reap the rewards from Flurry. Temur Harmonize Cast your spells twice with help of your biggest creatures. Leaves the Graveyard Fill up your graveyard, then use Mobilize or Renew and others to get bonuses for cards leaving your graveyard. Sultai Renew Use the power of the graveyard to make your creatures stronger. Counters Use counters of any kind, not just +1/+1 counters, to make your creatures impressive in combat. Abzan Endure Your creatures are versatile! Outsize your opponents with +1/+1 counters or outflank them with spirit tokens. SacrificeSacrifice your extra creatures, such as your temporary creatures from Horde to get extra use out of those creatures.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_TDM_BotDraft.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智牌！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是人机轮抽鞑契龙岚录：你将与电脑一道，从在桌上轮转的轮抽补充包中抽选牌张，无需等待，也没有抽选时间限制。之后加入基本地构组一副40张的套牌，并与其他牌手进行对战，且无次数限制。 此赛事为幻影活动。你抽选的牌张不会加入你的收藏。 玛尔都动员 派出额外的衍生物来帮助你进行攻击。 衍生物铺场 用数量优势冲击你的对手。使用动员的衍生物和连咒收益来建立非凡场面。 洁斯凯连咒 在一个回合内施放两个（或更多！）咒语来压倒你的对手。 两次咒语 频繁使用谐颂咒语以获取连咒收益。 铁木尔谐颂 让你最大的生物帮助你施放两次咒语。 离开坟场 填满你的坟墓场，然后使用动员或复新之类的获得卡牌离开你坟墓场的奖励。 苏勒台复新 利用坟墓场的力量使你的生物更强大。 指示物 使用任何类型的指示物，不仅仅是+1/+1指示物，让你的生物在战斗中鹤立鸡群。 阿布赞续战 你的生物多才多艺！用+1/+1指示物压倒对手或用精怪衍生物包抄他们。 牺牲 牺牲你的额外生物，比如从战群获得的临时生物，充分利用这些生物。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_UltimateShowdown20.oracleText: For years, the different player types have lived together in harmony. But today, everything changes. Today, it's time to stop being polite and start learning the empirically correct, clearly superior, and unambiguously best way to play the game. But who will reign supreme? Will it be Timmy, master of monsters? Johnny, the ingenious inventor? Cutthroat card-slinger Spike? Or perhaps the lore-loving Vorthos? Each of these iconic archetypes has brought their own deck to this contest, and we've ripped the mana costs off so they can get right down to business. Welcome to the Ultimate Showdown! In this Omniscience event, each deck brings the essence of a player archetype to the table. Play as much as you want and change decks whenever you like. And if you find the archetype that truly speaks to your soul, you can add their avatar and sleeve to your collection in the Store!
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_UltimateShowdown20.translation: 多年来，不同类型的玩家和谐共处。但今天，一切都变了。今天，是时候停止客气，开始学习经验上正确的、明显优越的、毫不含糊的最佳游戏方式了。 但谁将统治至高无上？会是怪物大师蒂米吗？天才发明家强尼？残酷的卡牌投掷者斯派克？或者也许是热爱绝杀的沃尔托斯？这些标志性的原型都带来了他们自己的卡组参加这次比赛，而且我们已经取消了法力成本，所以他们可以直接开展业务了。欢迎来到终极对决！ 在这个全知全能的赛事中，每一副牌都会将一个玩家原型的精髓带到桌上。想玩多少就玩多少，想换牌就换牌。如果你找到了真正与你的灵魂对话的原型，你可以在商店里把他们的头像和牌套添加到你的收藏中！

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_WorldsShowcase.translation: 欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！ 本周的活动是世界赛选手标准套牌！从万智牌最出色的牌手和套牌中选择一副进行对战，然后切记在于本周五到周日进行的第二十七届世界冠军赛上关注他们的表现！所有你需了解的信息尽在这里。

Events/Event_Desc_MWM_YargleDay2024.oracleText: Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena! This week's event is GNSHAAGHKKAPPHRIIBITGNSHAAGHKKAPPHRIIBIT When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body. Today, we celebrate that spirit, everyone's pal, Yargle! What?! Yargle has consumed Midweek Magic, turning it into an All Access Brawl Frog Free-For-All!! Choose any legendary frog (or Toad Rider) on Arena and build a Brawl deck without needing the cards! And Yargle's magic makes all of your frogs better than ever: they're cheaper to play and are hungry for power.
Events/Event_Desc_MWM_YargleDay2024.translation: 欢迎来到周中万智牌！每周尝试一个不同的方式来游玩万智牌竞技场！ 本周的活动是 GNSHAAGHKKAPPHRIIBITGNSHAAGHKKAPPHRIIBIT 贝赞洛的副手雅库开始展露野心，恶魔领主便把他变成一条蛆虫。有只青蛙吞下了这条蛆虫后不断变大，最终贪食的精怪从其体内破膛而出。今天，我们庆贺这个精怪，每个人的朋友，雅骨尔！ 什么？！雅骨尔已经吞噬了周中万智牌，将其变成了“全卡蛙争锋统统免费”！！在竞技场里选择任意一只传奇蛙（或乘蟾人），无需卡牌即可构筑蛙争锋套牌！而且，雅骨尔的魔法会让你的所有蛙变得前所未有的强大：它们更低费，而且更渴望力量。

Events/Event_Desc_MadScience_VOW.oracleText: This was never the plan. The machine was intended to capture energy from spellcasting so it could be reused, put to better purpose. Creating zombies bent to your will was not the purpose you had in mind - but then again, who's to say it's not a better one after all? Think of the good you could do, the recognition you could earn, the doubters who who would finally eat those words...or be eaten, if necessary... In this event, your Alchemy deck will let you show them all! When you cast an instant or sorcery, you will create a Zombie Army token based on its mana value. The more spells you cast, the larger your creation will grow, until your legion covers the countryside! When your mad rampage comes to an end, you'll receive Eternal Night card styles from Innistrad: Crimson Vow. There are 12 styles to collect! For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles your experiments can uncover, click here.
Events/Event_Desc_MadScience_VOW.translation: 计划绝非如此。这机器原本是用来捕捉施法时产生的能量，便于事后另作他用。但生产听从你号令的灵俑可从来你不是你设想的「其他用途」～不过话说回来，谁又敢说这不是更好的结果呢？想想你因此能做的各种好事，你因此能收获的各种认可，以及看到质疑你的人吞下批评...不然就要被吞下... 在本次活动中，你的炼金套牌会火力全开！当你施放瞬间或法术咒语时，便会根据其法术力值派出相应的灵俑／军队衍生物。你施放的咒语越多，你的造物就越强大，直到它们淹没整片原野！最后当你结束疯狂举动后，你便会来自依尼翠：腥红婚誓系列的永夜卡牌样式。总共有12种待你收集！ 关于此赛制的更多信息，以及可于实验中发现的卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。

Events/Event_Desc_Magic30_Premier_Draft.oracleText: This weekend, we conclude the yearlong celebration of Magic's 30th anniversary! MTG Arena is getting in on the action with Mixed-Up Draft, featuring mixed-together cards from many different sets in every pack. All players who enter will receive a special sleeve, and then you'll show down with cards from all across the game's history! Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players
Events/Event_Desc_Magic30_Premier_Draft.translation: 为期一整年的万智牌30周年庆典，即将在本周末隆重谢幕！MTG竞技场内现正推出混合轮抽，利用来自不同系列牌张组成的补充包进行轮抽。每位参加本活动的牌手都会获得一个特别牌套，你也会有机会亲自用出本游戏历史上的各式强牌！ 轮抽用补充包将在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！ 牌手轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制。

Events/Event_Desc_ManaLink_Draft.oracleText:
In Mana Link Draft, draft three packs and keep the cards you draft like normal, but there are some new rules. First, you will receive a land token automatically each turn. Second, you can cast any number of spells that you have enough lands to afford.

Will you stay low to the ground and flood the board once you hit three lands? Or defend yourself enough to hit those expensive cards that will take control of the game? You can even still play lands from your hand to further accelerate yourself, but risk running out of action later on. You'll start with fewer cards and less life than normal, so be ready to jump right into the fray!

Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win!

Bot Draft - Draft against AI with no waiting & no pick timers
Events/Event_Desc_ManaLink_Draft.translation:
在法力链接轮抽中，像往常一样轮抽三包并持有你轮抽的牌，但有一些新规则。首先，你将每回合自动收到一个地衍生物。其次，你可以施放任何数量的咒语，只要你有足够的地能负担得起。

你会一直保持低姿态，一旦打出三张地就淹没战场？还是积极防御，打出那些高法术力的牌来控制游戏？你甚至还可以从你的手牌中打出地来进一步加快自己的速度，但却要冒着以后无法行动的风险。你的开局手牌和开场生命值都会比正常情况下少，所以要准备好直接战斗吧!

每次从传过来的轮抽卡包中选一张牌，这些牌会加入你的收藏，你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑40张的套牌开始游戏。你将得到的奖励取决于你的胜场!

人机轮抽～与AI进行轮抽，无需等待，也不限制选牌时间

Events/Event_Desc_MixedUp_Ravnica_Premie.translation: 混沌轮抽会在一场轮抽中用到多个系列的补充包！本次轮抽只会用到出自拉尼卡时空系列的牌张：烽会拉尼卡、效忠拉尼卡和卡洛夫庄园谋杀案。 轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！ 牌手轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制

Events/Event_Desc_Momir.oracleText: Each turn, click on Momir on the left side of your battlefield, pay X mana, and discard a card to create a random token copy of a creature from all of MTG Arena with mana value X. No deck required, we'll provide a deck of 12 copies each of the five basic lands. Give in to Momir's Madness, won't you?
Events/Event_Desc_Momir.translation: 在每个回合中，你都可以点击位于战场左侧的莫秘维，支付X点法术力并弃一张牌，游戏便会从万智牌竞技场所有法术力值为X的生物当中随机挑选一个，为你派出该生物之复制品衍生物。无需事先构筑套牌，游戏会为备好一副每种基本地各12张的套牌。你会不会屈从于莫秘维的疯狂呢？

Events/Event_Desc_Momir_PW.oracleText: In this event, we'll provide a deck for you to play consisting of basic lands and planeswalkers. Use the Momir emblem to generate creature tokens. You can cast planeswalkers normally as spells, or discard them to activate the Momir emblem.
Events/Event_Desc_Momir_PW.translation: 在本次赛事中，我们将提供一套由基本地和鹏洛客组成的套牌供你使用。使用莫秘维徽记来生成衍生生物。你可以以咒语形式正常施放鹏洛客，或弃掉它们来启动莫秘维徽记。

Events/Event_Desc_Monthly_Brawl.oracleText: Join this event to play any number of Brawl games until the event ends. The following cards are banned in Brawl: Oko, Thief of Crowns Sorcerous Spyglass Note: This event ends on January 16, 2020 at 20:00 UTC.
Events/Event_Desc_Monthly_Brawl.translation: 加入活动，在活动结束之前尽享争锋对战。 争锋赛禁用以下牌张： 窃冠瓯柯 巫视望远镜 注意：本活动的结束时间为UTC时间2020年1月16日20:00。

Events/Event_Desc_Monthly_Brawl_CraftHis.oracleText: Until this event ends, the card awarded for your first win can't be crafted and is only legal in MTG: Arena Brawl and Direct Challenge. Afterward, it can be crafted and will be playable in Historic, as well as MTG: Arena Brawl.
Events/Event_Desc_Monthly_Brawl_CraftHis.translation: 在此赛事结束之前，你无法制作首胜获得的卡牌，这些卡牌仅在MTGA争锋和直接对战中有效。赛事结束之后，首胜获得的卡牌可以被制作出来并可以在史迹以及MTGA争锋中游玩。

Events/Event_Desc_Monthly_Brawl_CraftHis.oracleText: The card awarded for your first win is playable in Historic, and MTG: Arena Brawl. The card can also be crafted.
Events/Event_Desc_Monthly_Brawl_CraftHis.translation: 首胜获得的卡牌可以被制作出来，并可以在史迹以及MTGA争锋中游玩。

Events/Event_Desc_Monthly_Brawl_NoCountd.oracleText: Join this event to play as many Brawl games as you would like until the event ends on January 31, 2020 at 16:00 UTC.
Events/Event_Desc_Monthly_Brawl_NoCountd.translation: 加入此活动便可尽享争锋对战，直至活动结束（UTC时间2020年1月31日16:00）。

Events/Event_Desc_Monthly_Brawl_Rotation.oracleText: The card will remain legal in Brawl in MTG: Arena indefinitely.
Events/Event_Desc_Monthly_Brawl_Rotation.translation: 这张牌在MTGA争锋中将无限期可用。

Events/Event_Desc_Monthly_Brawl_Rotation.oracleText: It will rotate out of Brawl when Standard rotates in Fall 2021.
Events/Event_Desc_Monthly_Brawl_Rotation.translation: 当标准在 2021 年秋季轮换时，它将轮换出争锋。

Events/Event_Desc_NBL_Historic.oracleText:
Create a Historic deck using the most powerful cards on MTG Arena! After the last No Banned List Historic Event, we wanted to see what a few adjustments would do.  For details check out this week's <u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/mtg-arena/mtg-arena-announcements-october-30-2023#historicevent>Arena Announcements</link></u>!

This event is All-Access, meaning you can even use cards outside of your collection.
Events/Event_Desc_NBL_Historic.translation:
使用MTGA上最强力的单卡构组一套史记套牌！在最后一次无禁史记活动结束后，我们计划对史记的禁牌表做些改动。详情请看<u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/mtg-arena/mtg-arena-announcements-october-30-2023#historicevent>MTGA公告</link></u>！

这是一个全卡活动，你可以使用不在你收藏当中的牌张。

Events/Event_Desc_NEO_Quick_Draft.oracleText:
Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win!

每次从传过来的轮抽卡包中选一张牌，这些牌会加入你的收藏，你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑40张的套牌开始游戏。你将得到的奖励取决于你的胜场!

The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players

Events/Event_Desc_NeonArcade_NEO.oracleText: The Neon Arcade is the hottest spot for the best players in the city. Are you a whiz at pinball? A fighting-game master? A hero of jukebox dance-offs? No matter your play style, this is where you can turn that skill into ultimate gaming glory. So drop in your coin, rack up all the points you can, and shoot for the stars! Bring a Singleton deck and try to set a new high score! Each time you cast a spell that's bigger than you've cast before, you'll get a Treasure token that can help push you even higher. When your credits are finally spent, you'll score Soft Glow styles from Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty. There are 20 styles to collect! For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles available in the arcade, click here.
Events/Event_Desc_NeonArcade_NEO.translation: 霓朝机厅是城市中头号玩家的热门聚集地。你是弹球高手？格斗游戏大师？还是点唱机舞会的英雄？无论你的游戏风格如何，在这里你都可以将你的强项转化为终极游戏荣耀。只管投币、得分、目标摘天揽月！ 使用一套无双套牌参赛，尝试刷新得分记录！每当你施放一个比之前更大的咒语时，你都会得到一个珍宝衍生物，助你之后再上一层楼。当你的接关数全部耗尽后，便会获得来自神河霓朝纪系列的柔光样式。总共有20款待你收集！ 关于此赛制的更多信息，以及可于街机厅中收集的卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。

Events/Event_Desc_NewHistoric.oracleText: Seeing the maturation of the Historic format over time has been exciting, but we recently got to thinking. Have we lost sight of what got us here in the first place? Is this truly honoring the historical traditions of Magic? Not exactly, but it could! It's time to take Historic back to how things were really meant to be. In the olden days, decks could be as small as 40 cards! And you could play as many of a card as you wanted, not just four! And there weren't any banned cards to worry about! Doesn't that sound great? This is such an obviously great way to play, we've even enabled All Access so that everyone can participate. We're still debating the fate of existing "Old Historic" queues and events, but in the meantime, enjoy the new look of Historic here. Have fun! Build a 40-card deck with no limit on copies of a card. Every card on MTG Arena is legal and available, whether it's in your collection or not. (Yes, even that card.) Play as much as you want!
Events/Event_Desc_NewHistoric.translation: 见证史迹赛制随着时间推移而逐渐成熟，当真令人兴奋，但我们最近却开始思考：我们是否忽视了创造史迹赛的原本的动机？它真的是为了纪念万智牌史迹传统而生的吗？虽然略有出入，但仍能不忘初心！现在是时候让史迹赛重归原点了。 在过去，一副套牌最少40张就能参赛！而且同一张牌用多少张都行，而不是只能放四张！而且还不用担心什么乱七八糟的禁牌！听起来是不是很厉害？ 这显然是一种很棒的游戏方式，我们甚至允许牌张任用，好让大家都能参与其间。虽然我们仍在争论现有「旧版史迹」队列活动去留，但现在请各位先来享受全新史迹。祝大家玩得开心！ 构组一副40张套牌，而其中每张牌的数量没有限制。《MTG竞技场》的所有牌张都合法并可使用，无论你收藏中是否已经拥有。（是的，即使是那张牌。）请尽情对局！

Events/Event_Desc_OM1_Brawl_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! And Commanders! Players will select a Commander from their Card Pool. Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players
Events/Event_Desc_OM1_Brawl_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 并且还有指挥官！牌手将从他们的牌池中选择一位指挥官。 真人轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制

Events/Event_Desc_OM1_PickTwo_Draft.oracleText: Select two cards at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 3 other players Modified - Use Auras, Equipment, and counters to both arm and armor your hard-to-block creatures and sneak in for surprising amounts of damage!  Connive Graveyard - Use the connive mechanic to draw cards, discard cards, and plan to destroy your opponent with the perfect hand and graveyard.  BR Mayhem - Discard mayhem cards and play them from your graveyard. Mayhem cards reward a reckless playstyle that pushes aggression forward.  RG Large Spells - Ramp into big spells or reduce their cost to make big plays, then reap the benefits for casting them!  Enweb - Using the enweb mechanic, return creatures to your hand to tempo out powerful creatures and reuse the abilities of your smaller creatures for recurring value.
Events/Event_Desc_OM1_PickTwo_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择两张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 真人轮抽～与3位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制。 饰装 - 运用灵气、武具和指示物来武装你那些难以阻挡的生物，既能增强防御又能造成出其不意的伤害！ 筹谋坟场 - 通过筹谋机制抓牌弃牌，精心策划手牌和坟墓场的完美配合击溃对手。 红黑疯乱 - 弃掉疯乱牌并从坟墓场使用它们。疯乱牌奖励激进的打法，让你在狂乱进攻中占据优势。 红绿大咒语 - 通过加速施放大咒语或降低其费用来打出强力效果，然后享受施放它们带来的丰厚回报！ 缠网 - 利用缠网机制将生物移回手牌，通过节奏控制来反复使用强力生物，并从小型生物的异能中获取持续价值。

The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Modified - Use Auras, Equipment, and counters to both arm and armor your hard-to-block creatures and sneak in for surprising amounts of damage! Connive Graveyard - Use the connive mechanic to draw cards, discard cards, and plan to destroy your opponent with the perfect hand and graveyard. BR Mayhem - Discard mayhem cards and play them from your graveyard. Mayhem cards reward a reckless playstyle that pushes aggression forward. RG Large Spells - Ramp into big spells or reduce their cost to make big plays, then reap the benefits for casting them! Enweb - Using the enweb mechanic, return creatures to your hand to tempo out powerful creatures and reuse the abilities of your smaller creatures for recurring value.
Events/Event_Desc_OM1_Trad_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择两张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励！ 真人轮抽～与其他7位牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制 饰装 - 运用灵气、武具和指示物来武装你那些难以阻挡的生物，既能增强防御又能造成出其不意的伤害！ 筹谋坟场 - 通过筹谋机制抓牌弃牌，精心策划手牌和坟墓场的完美配合击溃对手。 红黑疯乱 - 弃掉疯乱牌并从坟墓场使用它们。疯乱牌奖励激进的打法，让你在狂乱进攻中占据优势。 红绿大咒语 - 通过加速施放大咒语或降低其费用来打出强力效果，然后享受施放它们带来的丰厚回报！ 缠网 - 利用缠网机制将生物移回手牌，通过节奏控制来反复使用强力生物，并从小型生物的异能中获取持续价值。

Events/Event_Desc_ONE_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Artifacts Phyrexia is filled with glorious artifacts. Gather as many of these artifacts as you can to outmaneuver your opponent. Proliferate Control Use proliferate to spread the glory of Phyrexia—oil counters, poison counters, and loyalty counters are all ready to be proliferated. Oil Counters & Sacrifice All Phyrexians are valuable, even (and sometimes especially) in death. Use your creatures and artifacts to generate oil counters when they die. Oil Counters Midrange The more things with oil counters you have, the merrier. Use these oil counters to get the biggest, smashiest creatures you can. Toxic Aggro Take advantage of small toxic creatures, especially Mite tokens, to swarm your opponent. Corrupted Give your opponent three or more poison counters, then your corrupted cards become even more powerful. Oil Counters & Noncreature Spells Build up your oil counters and overwhelm your opponent by casting a variety of artifacts, enchantments, instants, sorceries, and yes, even planeswalkers! Poison Victory You have the biggest baddest creature with toxic. Use them to get your opponent to 10 poison counters. For Mirrodin! Equipment Someone's got to fight against the Phyrexians! Your rebels can use equipment to stave them off! Proliferate & Poison Two great tastes that go great together. Use green creatures with toxic to deal out serious poison counters, then proliferate to finish the job.
Events/Event_Desc_ONE_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 牌手轮抽～与其他7位牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制 神器非瑞克西亚神器阵容壮丽无匹。尽量多收集神器来降伏对手。 增殖控制利用增殖散播非瑞克西亚荣光～烁油指示物、中毒指示物和忠诚指示物都可以增殖。 烁油指示物和牺牲非瑞克西亚人不论死活都极具价值（有时死的更有用）。充分运用在死去时会产生烁油指示物的生物和神器。 烁油指示物中速烁油指示物多多益善。利用这些烁油指示物得到最强悍的大生物。 下毒猛袭利用小型下毒生物（尤其是虫械衍生物）大举淹没你的对手。 腐化让对手获得三个或更多中毒指示物后，你的腐化牌就会变得更强大。 烁油指示物和非生物咒语壮大烁油指示物的数量，并施放各种神器、结界、瞬间、法术甚至是鹏洛客来击溃对手。 用毒致胜你有最大最凶的下毒生物。利用它们让对手获得十个中毒指示物。 「秘罗万岁！」武具总得有人站出来同非瑞克西亚人斗争！反抗军可用武具来抵挡他们的进攻！ 增殖和中毒这两个好东西能完美契合。利用具下毒异能的绿色生物让对手获得大量中毒指示物，然后通过增殖来决定战局。
