Events/Event_Desc_ShowcasePlayIn_Bo3.translation: 现在是第一届竞技场冠军赛的时间！本周末，MTGA的32名最优秀的玩家将展开对决，争夺竞技场冠军头衔和第二十七届世界万智牌冠军赛的席位。对于我们其他人来说，现在开始向下一个竞技场冠军攀登还不算太晚，一切都可以从这里开始。如果你尚未获得资格，请在此入围赛中获得全部四场胜利，以赢得你在下一个资格赛周末的席位。 本次资格赛赛事是竞技场冠军赛展示赛，包括带备牌的三盘两胜比赛和个人计时器。选择本周末竞技场冠军赛参赛者正在使用的炼金套牌之一，并与他们将面临的相同场地进行对决。如果你赢了四场比赛，请在10 月15日回来参加资格赛周末！ 必须年满18岁才能参加。并非在所有地区/领地都可用。禁止的地方无效。附加条款和条件适用。请参阅此处了解完整详情。

Events/Event_Desc_Singleton_Challenge.oracleText: Ready to take your singleton deck to the next level? The Singleton Challenge offers the ability to win more prizes than our usual singleton event! Decks in this event can't have more than one copy of any card, except for basic lands.
Events/Event_Desc_Singleton_Challenge.translation: 准备好用自己的无双套牌迎接新的挑战了吗？「无双挑战」奖品较普通无双赛更为丰盛，让你能有更多收获。用于参加本赛事的套牌受「同名牌不超过一张」规则限制，基本地除外。

Events/Event_Desc_Singleton_Standard.oracleText: Bring your constructed deck and play games, with a twist! Decks can only have one copy of any cards (other than basic lands). You'll receive gold and cards based on how many games you win! Each uncommon card reward can get upgraded to a rare or mythic (15%).
Events/Event_Desc_Singleton_Standard.translation: 使用事先组好的套牌进行游戏，但这次有些不一样！套牌中每种牌只能有一张（基本地除外）。最后根据胜场数量赢得金币和牌张！所得之非凡牌奖励都有机会升级为稀有或秘稀牌（15%）。

Events/Event_Desc_SleeperAgents_DMU.oracleText: This pitiful world. So flawed, so painfully imperfect, but at least it is malleable. Easy to construct a shell. The shell is gruesome and inelegant, but no more so than those already here. They will not notice. Too concerned with individual things. They claim to be united. They do not yet know of true unity. They do not yet know the Machine Orthodoxy. But they will. In this 60-card Singleton event, you never know who's on whose side–every turn, a random creature in your hand will be revealed to be a Phyrexian sleeper agent! Will you adopt a compleatly different strategy? As you play, you'll earn Stained Glass Showcase card styles from Dominaria United, featuring key figures from the invasion! For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles, click here. When this event ends, entrants will receive any unclaimed rewards automatically.
Events/Event_Desc_SleeperAgents_DMU.translation: 这个可怜的世界。如此有缺陷，如此痛苦地不完美，但至少它是可塑的，易于构建外壳。外壳令人毛骨悚然且不雅，但不比那些已经在这里的外壳更糟糕。他们不会注意到的，他们太在意个人的事情，虽然他们声称是团结的。他们还不知道真正的团结。他们还不知道机器正统所在，但他们迟早会知道的。 在这个60张无双赛事中，你永远不知道谁站在谁一边——每一轮，你手中的一个随机生物都会被揭示为非瑞克西亚潜藏密探！你会采取完全不同的策略吗？玩游戏时，你将获得来自 多明纳里亚：众志成城 的花窗展示卡牌样式，其中包含入侵的关键人物！ 了解有关此赛制的更多详细信息，包括卡牌样式的完整列表，请单击此处. 当这个赛事结束时，参赛者将自动收到未领取的奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Spark_Ladder.oracleText: Play against other Planeswalkers here to level up, earn rewards, and harness your spark!
Events/Event_Desc_Spark_Ladder.translation: 在这里与其他鹏洛客对战，从而提升段位、赢取奖励、驾驭火花！

Events/Event_Desc_SparkyChallenge.oracleText:
Welcome to Sparky's Challenge, where you challenge...me! This is a Preconstructed event where I've given you a choice of some of my favorite starter decks to play with against me as you become more familiar with your Planeswalker spark!

This event has no entry fee, so you can keep challenging me, your greatest test yet! That is until you've won three games and I've decided you're ready to face even greater competition, Planeswalker!
Events/Event_Desc_SparkyChallenge.translation:
欢迎来到火花精灵挑战，在这里你将要挑战我！这是一个预组活动，我给你准备了一些我最喜欢的新手套牌作为选项。

这是一个免费活动，你可以一直挑战我，直到你赢得了三次胜利。

Events/Event_Desc_SparkyDay2025.oracleText: It's Sparky's birthday! After years of helping Planeswalkers get back on their feet, it's time to thank our favorite blue spark with a multiversal celebration! In Planeswalker Party!, select a 60-card preconstructed deck helmed by a Planeswalker Commander and ignite some fun! Each planeswalker is bringing an extra color to the festivities, so get ready for some surprises with each battle.
Events/Event_Desc_SparkyDay2025.translation: 火花精灵的生日到了！在帮助无数鹏洛客重新站起来的这些年后，是时候通过一场多元宇宙庆典来感谢我们最喜爱的蓝色小火花了！ 在鹏洛客派对！中，选择一副由鹏洛客指挥官率领的60张预组套牌，点燃欢乐！每位鹏洛客都会为庆典带来额外的一种颜色，准备好在每场战斗中迎接惊喜吧。

Events/Event_Desc_Standard_Challenge.oracleText: Bring your Standard deck and play best-of-three matches! You'll receive rewards based on how many matches you win.
Events/Event_Desc_Standard_Challenge.translation: 使用标准构筑套牌与对手进行三盘两胜的对局！最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Standard_Shakeup.oracleText: We're shaking Standard up with an additional banned list for this event only! For the full details on this format, including a list of banned cards, click <u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/mtga-standard-shakeup>here</link></u>.
Events/Event_Desc_Standard_Shakeup.translation: 我们将在本次赛事中为标准模式增加一份额外禁牌表！关于这一赛制的全部细节，包括禁牌表，请点击<u><link=https://magic.wizards.com/mtga-standard-shakeup>这里</link></u>。

Events/Event_Desc_Standard_Shakeup_Alt.oracleText: We're shaking Standard up with an alternative banned list for this event only! Click the button below to examine the banned cards.
Events/Event_Desc_Standard_Shakeup_Alt.translation: 我们将在本次赛事中为标准模式增加一份额外禁牌表！点击下方按钮查看禁牌表。

Events/Event_Desc_Standard_Shakeup_Alt2.oracleText:

我们将在本次赛事中为标准模式增加一份额外禁牌表！点击下方按钮查看禁牌表或者阅读一下禁牌表：

Events/Event_Desc_Streamer_Amazonian.oracleText: We're giving Draft new house rules with Amazonian (twitch.tv/amazonian). Amy loves building crazy decks with lots of potential. So together we created AMAZONIAN'S PLAY ANYTHING DRAFT, where you can have unlimited potential. Because you don't have to pay the mana cost to play any card! No need to put lands in your deck, as every card's mana cost is waived when you cast it. Draft Core Set 2019, keep the cards you draft, and build a 40-card deck that takes advantage of the biggest cards. You'll also get one mana of each color in your mana pool each turn that you can use for abilities, and every player also starts with three cards in hand instead of seven.
Events/Event_Desc_Streamer_Amazonian.translation: 我们与Amazonian（twitch.tv/amazonian）一道，为轮抽赛事拟定全新自订规则。Amy钟爱构筑疯狂套牌，从不扼杀一切可能。我们由此推出「Amazonian的万物尽出轮抽」，让你释放无限潜能。牌张不需法术力费用即可施放，你不再需要为费用问题绞尽脑汁！套牌中不再需要留出地牌位置，所有牌张的法术力费用都变作免费，你可以在任何回合施放任何东西。使用2019核心系列进行轮抽，抽选到的牌即归你所有，之后利用它们构筑一副40张的套牌，利用高费咒语占据战场主动。你的法术力池中每个回合都会加入每种颜色各一点的法术力，供你起动异能之用，同时每位牌手的起始手牌数量改为三张（而非原本的七张）。

Events/Event_Desc_Streamer_Kibler.oracleText: We're giving Constructed new house rules with Brian Kibler (twitch.tv/bmkibler). Kibler loves putting big creatures on the battlefield. So together we created KIBLER'S GIANT MONSTERS, where every time you cast a creature with converted mana cost of four or greater, you draw a card. That's more value for your powerful critters! Bring a 60-card deck full of larger creatures that take advantage of the card draw and put it to the test!
Events/Event_Desc_Streamer_Kibler.translation: 我们与Brian Kibler（twitch.tv/bmkibler）一道，为构筑赛事拟定全新自订规则。Kibler钟爱派出巨怪猛兽主宰战场。由此我们特别推出「Kibler的威凛巨兽」规则。在此规则下，每当你施放法术力值等于或大于四的生物时，你便抓一张牌。强劲生物价值更增一分！本次请善用大生物进战场带来的额外抓牌效应，利用事先组好的60张套牌迎接对手挑战！

Events/Event_Desc_Streamer_Kripp.oracleText: We're giving Draft new house rules with Kripp (twitch.tv/nl_kripp). Kripp loves playing decks using three or four colors. So together we created KRIPP'S TREASURE DRAFT. Draft Guilds of Ravnica like normal and then play a game of Magic with unique rules. At the beginning of your turn you get a new Treasure Token, which is an artifact that can be sacrificed for one mana of any color. The combination of Guilds of Ravnica multicolor cards and an extra mana of any color each turn makes three or four colors an inevitability in your 40-card deck.
Events/Event_Desc_Streamer_Kripp.translation: 我们与Kripp（twitch.tv/nl_kripp）一道，为轮抽赛事拟定全新自订规则。Kripp对三色或四色套牌情有独钟。由此我们特别推出「Kripp的珍宝轮轴」。利用烽会拉尼卡系列的补充包如常进行轮抽，但随后进行的万智牌游戏中会有特殊规则生效。在你的每个回合开始时，你都会新获得一个珍宝衍生物，其具有「牺牲之：加一点任意颜色的法术力。」烽会拉尼卡系列当中本来就有丰富的多色搭配，如今每个回合都能多获得一点任意颜色的法术力，更能使你在40张套牌内得心应手地同时驾驭三到四色。

Events/Event_Desc_Streamer_Nox.oracleText: We're giving Constructed new house rules with Nox (twitch.tv/professornoxlive). Nox loves brewing wacky decks and loves Sunbird's Invocation. So together we created CASCADE CONSTRUCTED, where the first card you play each turn has Cascade: when you cast that card, you exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland permanent with a converted mana cost less than the spell you cast, then you get to play that card without paying its mana cost and put all other exiled cards on the bottom of your library. That's two cards for the mana cost of one! Build a 60-card deck that can take advantage of Cascade and put it to the test!
Events/Event_Desc_Streamer_Nox.translation: 我们与Nox（twitch.tv/professornoxlive）一道，为构筑赛事拟定全新自订规则。Nox喜欢自创思路奇特的套牌，尤其钟爱阳禽祝愿这张牌。由此我们特别推出「倾曳构筑」。在此玩法中，你每回合施放的第一个咒语具有倾曳异能：当你施放该咒语时，从你的牌库顶开始放逐牌，直到放逐一张法术力值比所施放之咒语小的非地牌为止，然后你可以施放该牌且不需支付其法术力费用，并将所有其他以此法放逐的牌置于你的牌库底。付一得二！构筑一副60张的套牌，充分发挥倾曳优势，迎接对手挑战！

Events/Event_Desc_StressTest_Constructed.oracleText: A special event for our July 20 stress test, this event awards cards as you earn up to seven wins, and even packs at higher win counts. A loss will end your progress, but you don't need gold or gems to play to join again! Each uncommon card reward can get upgraded to a rare or mythic (15%).
Events/Event_Desc_StressTest_Constructed.translation: 7月20日压力测试特别活动。参赛牌手会随着胜场数的增加而赢得牌张奖励（至多七胜），取得较高胜场的牌手更能赢得补充包。一旦落败便会前功尽废，但不需付出金币或宝石便可重新参赛！所得之非凡牌奖励都有机会升级为稀有或秘稀牌（15%）。

Events/Event_Desc_TDM_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Mardu Mobilize Create additional tokens to help aid in your attack. Go Wide Tokens Blitz by your opponent with sheer numbers. Use Mobilize tokens and Flurry rewards to build impressive battlefields. Jeskai Flurry Cast two (or more!) spells in a single turn to overwhelm your opponent. Two Spells Use Harmonize spells frequently in order to reap the rewards from Flurry. Temur Harmonize Cast your spells twice with help of your biggest creatures. Leaves the Graveyard Fill up your graveyard, then use Mobilize or Renew and others to get bonuses for cards leaving your graveyard. Sultai Renew Use the power of the graveyard to make your creatures stronger. Counters Use counters of any kind, not just +1/+1 counters, to make your creatures impressive in combat. Abzan Endure Your creatures are versatile! Outsize your opponents with +1/+1 counters or outflank them with spirit tokens. Sacrifice Sacrifice your extra creatures, such as your temporary creatures from Horde to get extra use out of those creatures.
Events/Event_Desc_TDM_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 真人轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制。 玛尔都动员 派出额外的衍生物来帮助你进行攻击。 衍生物铺场 用数量优势冲击你的对手。使用动员的衍生物和连咒收益来建立非凡场面。 洁斯凯连咒 在一个回合内施放两个（或更多！）咒语来压倒你的对手。 两次咒语 频繁使用谐颂咒语以获取连咒收益。 铁木尔谐颂 让你最大的生物帮助你施放两次咒语。 离开坟场 填满你的坟墓场，然后使用动员或复新之类的获得卡牌离开你坟墓场的奖励。 苏勒台复新 利用坟墓场的力量使你的生物更强大。 指示物 使用任何类型的指示物，不仅仅是+1/+1指示物，让你的生物在战斗中鹤立鸡群。 阿布赞续战 你的生物多才多艺！用+1/+1指示物压倒对手或用精怪衍生物包抄他们。 牺牲 牺牲你的额外生物，比如从战群获得的临时生物，充分利用这些生物。

Events/Event_Desc_THB_Comp_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win!
Events/Event_Desc_THB_Comp_Draft.translation: 轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！

Events/Event_Desc_THB_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. Events/Event_Desc_Taste_ELD.oracleText: Explore the Realm and the Wilds of Eldraine! We'll provide the decks for you to get a quick taste of the new set.
Events/Event_Desc_Taste_ELD.translation: 深入探索艾卓时空的世境与幻野！选择游戏提供的预组套牌，抢先体验全新系列。

Events/Event_Desc_Test_Artisan.oracleText: Construct your deck using only common and uncommon cards, then win as many games as you can!
Events/Event_Desc_Test_Artisan.translation: 仅使用普通卡和非凡卡构建你的套牌，然后尽可能多地赢得比赛！

Events/Event_Desc_Test_ExtraLife2019.oracleText: In this event, players start at 21 life and all creatures get an extra point of toughness.
Events/Event_Desc_Test_ExtraLife2019.translation: 在此活动中，牌手的起始生命值为21点，所有生物还将额外获得一点防御力。

Events/Event_Desc_Test_OkosMadness.oracleText: Both players start with a deck of basic lands. Click the emblem on the left side of the battlefield, pay one mana, and discard a card to get a creature token, but that trickster, Oko, is...turning everyone into elks? Huh?
Events/Event_Desc_Test_OkosMadness.translation: 两位牌手都从一副基本地牌开始。点击战场左侧的徽记，支付一点法术力，弃掉一张牌，得到一个衍生生物，但那个骗子瓯柯，正在……把所有人都变成麋鹿？嗯？

Events/Event_Desc_Test_PlaytestLeagueFin.oracleText: This is the final event of the MTG Arena Playtest League! You can play up to 5 games of Standard, regardless of your record.  Join the event only once.
Events/Event_Desc_Test_PlaytestLeagueFin.translation: 这是MTGA游戏测试联赛的最后一场比赛! 无论你的战绩如何，你最多可以玩5场标准赛。只能参加一次活动。

Events/Event_Desc_Timeless_AA_Challenge.oracleText: Play best-of-one matches of Timeless to compete for fantastic rewards including powerful Prize Packs.
Events/Event_Desc_Timeless_AA_Challenge.translation: 进行永恒赛制的一盘胜负制对局，以角逐包括强力奖励包在内的精彩奖励。

Events/Event_Desc_Timeless_Challenge.oracleText: Bring your Timeless deck and play best-of-three matches! You'll receive rewards based on how many matches you win.
Events/Event_Desc_Timeless_Challenge.translation: 使用你事先组好的永恒赛制套牌，不断进行三局两胜对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！

Events/Event_Desc_Timeless_Ladder.oracleText: Timeless uses every card on MTG Arena. Results will affect your constructed rank.
Events/Event_Desc_Timeless_Ladder.translation: 永恒赛制可以使用所有存在于MTGA上的牌张。对局结果会影响你的构筑赛段位。

Events/Event_Desc_Timeless_Traditional_L.oracleText: Timeless uses every card on MTG Arena. Play a best-2-out-of-3 match with sideboarding. Results will affect your constructed rank.
Events/Event_Desc_Timeless_Traditional_L.translation: 永恒赛制可以使用所有存在于MTGA上的牌张。进行三局两胜制，有备牌局的对战。对局结果会影响你的构筑赛段位。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_AFR.oracleText: You'll receive 6 fourteen-card packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win!
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_AFR.translation: 你将获得6个14张的补充包。 这些牌会加入你的收藏。 你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑40张的套牌进行bo3对战。 你将得到的奖励取决于你的胜场!

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_BLB.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Bloomburrow packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Birdfolk Birds bring bonuses! Cast fliers who air-drop buffs on your non-flying creatures. Make sure to have a healthy balance of fliers and non-fliers so you always have a target. Ratfolk Slow down your opponent with strong blockers and creature removal. Fill up your graveyard to unlock your Rats' Threshold abilities, then use them to close out the game. Lizardfolk Start small and go big. This BR deck uses a variety of artifact synergies, including the infamous affinity, to summon powerhouses from Magic's past and future. Raccoonfolk Ramp up your mana early to cast big Raccoons that dominate the battlefield. Include a few extra cards with high mana values to help trigger the Expend ability, but not so many that you fall behind early in the game. Rabbitfolk Assemble as many Rabbits and Rabbit tokens as you can. Look for spells and effects that reward you for having lots of creatures in play or pump up your whole team in combat. Batfolk Deploy an army of flying Bats and reap rewards for gaining or losing life during your turn. Mix in some good blockers and defensive spells to slow your opponent down while you attack in the air. Otterfolk Otters love when you cast instant and sorcery spells and will reward you for doing so. Aim for fewer creatures and varied spells, especially ones that help you control the battlefield. Squirrelfolk Dominate the mid game with big creatures and creature removal spells. Look for ways to fill your graveyard and create Food to take advantage of the Squirrels' Forage mechanic. Mousefolk Mice always prefer to be on the attack, so include plenty of aggressive, low mana value creatures. Support them with Equipment and combat-enhancing spells and abilities to trigger the Valiant ability. Frogfolk Make use of creatures with abilities that trigger when they enter the battlefield. Many Frogs have ways of blinking creatures or returning them to your hand. With all that extra value, you'll be strong in the late game.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_BLB.translation: 你将收到6包斑隆洛补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。不断进行BO3对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！ 鸟民 鸟群的奖赏！施放飞行生物从空中增益你的非飞行生物。确保飞行生物与地面生物之间合理平衡以便你总有可以被增益的目标。 老鼠民 使用强大的阻挡者和生物去除延缓对手。填充坟场来解锁鼠群的门槛异能，然后用它们来终结对局。 蜥蜴民 开局弱小，逐步壮大。这套红黑运用了各种各样的神器配合，包括臭名昭著的神器共鸣，来唤起万智牌未往的强大力量。 浣熊民 尽早跳费以便施放大型浣熊主宰战场。再组进几张能帮助触发花销异能的高费牌，但也不要太多，避免你在游戏早期节奏落后。 兔民 集结尽可能多的兔和兔衍生物。再找些铺场回馈或战斗膨胀全体的咒语和效应。 蝙蝠民 部署飞行的蝙蝠大军并在自己回合获得或失去生命时获取回报。掺入些优质阻挡者和防御咒语以便你从空中进攻同时能拖垮对手。 水獭民 水獭们喜爱你施放瞬间或法术咒语时的样子并会为此给你回报。加入更少的生物，更多样的咒语，能帮你掌控战局的尤佳。 松鼠民 通过大型生物和生物去除在游戏中期主宰战局。找些填坟和派出食品的手段来充分利用松鼠们的觅粮机制。 家鼠民 家鼠们总是喜欢进攻，所以将大量低费快攻生物组进套牌。再辅以武具和强化战斗咒语来触发英武异能。 蛙民 充分利用带有进场触发异能的生物。许多蛙们能够云移生物或使生物回手。利用这些额外价值，你会在游戏后期变得十分强大。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_BRO.oracleText: You'll receive 6 The Brothers' War packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Soldiers Gather your Soldiers and overwhelm your opponent on the ground and in the skies. Draw Power Draw a multitude of cards from your deck to keep the knowledge flowing and strengthen your creatures at the same time! Artifact Sacrifice Fuel the fight by sacrificing artifacts. Powerstones rev your engines and can later be sacrificed for more power! Don't forget artifacts with unearth can be sacrificed twice! Mechanized Stompy Use Powerstones to deploy your biggest threats quickly. Back them up with power-boosting spells to dominate every fight! Artifacts Enter the Battlefield Assemble your crew of creatures that are enhanced when artifacts enter the battlefield, then use Powerstones, Soldier tokens, and unearthed creatures to power up your attacks. Scrappy Swarm Deploy your army early, but don't be afraid to fill the graveyard. Creatures with mana value three or less offer more than you might expect, alive or dead. Prowess Aggro Round up a squad of inventors and wizards that can utilize cheap artifacts, instants, and sorcery spells to press their advantage. Graveyard Counter In an endless war, your creatures that rely on a populated graveyard will be pleased as their power increases well into the late game. Unearth Aggro Start your aggression early, and the second wave that comes back with Unearth may just be the last you need. Powerstone Ramp Accumulate Powerstones to help build your defenses, and soon no one will stand a chance against your colossal army of colossuses.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_BRO.translation: 你会得到6包兄弟之战补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励！ 士兵 召集士兵，从陆空两路碾压对手。 抓牌之力 从套牌里抓起大量牌张，让知识保持流动，同时强化你的生物！ 神器牺牲 牺牲神器来燃旺战火。魔力石让你的引擎快速运行，之后还能牺牲来获得更多能量！别忘了，具破坟异能的神器可以牺牲两次！ 机械化猛袭 利用魔力石尽快部署你最强大的威胁。用增加力量的咒语辅助它们打赢每一次战斗！ 神器登场 集结会因为神器进战场而变强的生物，然后利用魔力石、士兵衍生物和破坟生物来让攻势更加猛烈。 废品大军尽早部署军队，放胆填充坟墓场。法术力值为三或更低的生物都大有可为，无论生死。 灵技快攻 集合一支发明家小队，利用低费的神器、瞬间和法术咒语来获得优势。 坟场回击 在一场无止尽的战争中，你那些依赖丰沛坟墓场的生物会非常高兴，随着游戏进入后期，它们会变得愈发强力。 破坟快攻 尽早开始攻势，利用破坟异能发动的第二波攻势或许就能决定胜负。 魔力石加速 积累魔力石，用以组织起防线，很快就没人能抵挡你的巨像大军。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_DAR.oracleText: This set is only legal in Historic and Pioneer. You'll receive 6 Dominaria packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win!
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_DAR.translation: 此系列仅可在史迹赛与先驱赛中使用。 你将得到6包多明纳里亚补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制对局，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_DFT.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Aetherdrift packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Artifact Value Build up a board full of artifacts until your rival is overwhelmed by your racing Robot army! Artifact Bleeder Scare your opponent silly with a combination of Robots and possessed toys that pressure your opponent's life total. Max Speed Aggro Ensure you reach max speed to drive your rivals into the pavement. Exhaust Midrange Burn everything in the tank to enhance the Goblin Rocketeers to impressive size! Vehicles & Mounts Midrange The Alacrian Quickbeasts have skilled pilots who will ride your Mounts and Vehicles across the finish line. Max Speed Attrition The Champions of Amonkhet keep their feet on the gas to reach max speed and unleash a Zombie onslaught. Discard Aggro Avast! Cycle and discard away unneeded cards to improve your Pirates so they can throw your opponent overboard. Graveyard Fill up your graveyard and keep returning your threats to rise above the roadkill. Vehicles & Mounts Aggro Road rage! Keep driving forward with the Cloudspire crew's offense to make your opponent backpedal. Exhaust Ramp The Aether Rangers have mana to burn, fueling abilities that grant their creatures a huge burst of power.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_DFT.translation: 你会得到6包乙太飘移补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励！ 神器价值 在场面上积累神器，最后用你的竞速机器人大军碾压对手！ 神器血祭 机器人与诡异玩具的完美配合，让对手在恐惧中不断流失生命。 速度极限快攻 加速到速度极限，将对手碾为赛道尘埃。 竭绝中速 烧光所有燃料，让窜天鬼队成长为不可阻挡的庞然大物！ 载具&坐骑中速 阿拉奇亚捷兽队的卓越驾手将驾驭你的坐骑与载具冲过终点线。 速度极限消耗 阿芒凯豪杰队紧踩油门直到速度极限，释放僵尸军团发起猛攻。 弃牌快攻 预备！通过循环和弃牌来强化海盗，将对手从甲板上扔出去。 坟墓场 填满坟墓场并不断复活威胁，从赛道残骸中崛起制胜。 载具&坐骑快攻 路怒症发作！鼎云侠队的凶猛攻势将迫使对手节节败退。 竭绝Ramp 乙太流浪者队法术力充足，用异能作为燃料为生物注入爆发巨力。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_DMU.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Dominaria United packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Fliers Tempo Hold your ground with tokens and defensive instants and sorceries, all while attacking from the air. Control Develop a long-term advantage with card draw and creature removal spells, then go after your opponent directly in the late game. Reckless Aggro Throw caution to the wind and assault your opponent, clearing a path with creature removal spells or by simply trading your creatures for theirs. Domain Stompy Rule the board by attacking with the largest creatures on the battlefield, boosted by the domain mechanic. Domain Tokens Assemble a massive army of creatures and tokens, then dominate the mid-game with the domain mechanic. Creature Sacrifice Ruthlessly sacrifice your small creatures or tokens for profit, then bring creatures back from the graveyard to overwhelm your opponent. Spells Aggro Cast instant and sorcery spells to bolster aggressive creatures and clear a path to victory. Domain Midrange Get maximum value out of your cards with huge creatures, bringing cards back from the graveyard, and domain rewards. Tokens Aggro Go wide with an aggressive army of small creatures and tokens, punching through your opponent's defenses with spells and effects that boost your whole team. Kicker Ramp Build up your mana to get additional value from kicking your spells. Splash in some other colors to take advantage of powerful multicolor cards and the domain mechanic.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_DMU.translation: 你将收到6包多明纳里亚：众志成城补充包卡牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。不断进行Bo3对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！ 飞行节奏 用衍生物和防御性的瞬间和法术进行地面防御，同时从空中进行攻击。 控制 利用抓牌和生物移除咒语形成长期优势，然后在游戏后期直接追击你的对手。 无情快攻 将谨慎抛诸脑后，直接攻击你的对手，用生物移除咒语扫清道路，或者简单地用你的生物交换他们的生物。 领土风暴 通过使用战场上最大的生物进行攻击，在领土机制的推动下，统治棋盘。 领土衍生物 组建一支庞大的生物和衍生物大军，然后用领土机制主宰游戏中期。 生物牺牲 无情地牺牲你的小生物或衍生物以获得收益，然后将生物从坟墓场带回来压倒你的对手。 法术快攻释放瞬间和法术咒语来振励好斗异能生物，并扫清通往胜利的道路。 领土中速 使用巨大的生物让你的牌发挥最大价值，将牌从坟墓场中带回，并获得领土的加成效果。 衍生物快攻 使用由小生物和衍生物组成的侵略性大军，用可以提升整个团队的咒语和效应来突破对手的防御。 增幅暴费 使用增幅类咒语获得额外法术力建立优势，加上一些其它颜色卡牌以更好利用多色和领土优势。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_DSK.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Duskmourn: House of Horror packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Eerie Investigation Search the House! Play lots of enchantments and unlock Rooms to power up your creatures and get around all the horrifying blockers the house might throw your way. Eerie Domination Live out your worst nightmares and share them with your opponent, unlocking Rooms and playing enchantments to kill off their creatures and seize control of the game. BR Serial Sacrifice Want to slash through opposing creatures and your opponent with ease? Pay the price for strength by sacrificing your own creatures and old Rooms. Delirious Rampage Fill your deck with artifact and enchantment creatures (along with other card types), then start attacking early and often. Once you get four different card types into your graveyard, your cards power up. Now go for the jugular! Survival Utilize all of Duskmourn's tricks to power up your creatures and help them smash their way to safety. Find other ways to tap them and hide until the danger's past. Cultic Reanimation All hail Valgavoth! Slow your opponent down while you get enormous monsters into your graveyard and then perform the rituals to return them to life. Room after Room The House never ends! Trap your opponent going in circles as you unlock Rooms to build up control of more and more territory, then unleash the ghosts held within for a frightening finish. Grinding Delirium Prioritize getting a wide variety of card types, then gum up the board as you fill your graveyard with them. Once you've got four types, grind your opponent to dust by recycling what you've thrown away. Childhood Fears Fill your deck with toys and clowns that have 2 or less power and start attacking! Smash your opponents swiftly by clearing out their blockers and buffing your little creatures. Manifest Dread Something's lurking in the shadows. Manifest face-down creatures and get them into combat, then surprise your opponent with their true forms to outsize the competition.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_DSK.translation: 你将得到6包暮悲邸：鬼屋惊魂补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行BO3对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 异景调查 搜索这座宅邸！多多使用结界和解锁房间来强化你的生物，绕过宅邸抛给你的所有恐怖阻挡者。 异景支配 体验你最糟糕的噩梦并与对手分享，解锁房间并使用结界来消灭他们的生物，夺取游戏的控制权。 红黑连环牺牲 想轻松斩杀对手的生物和对手吗？通过牺牲由你操控的生物和旧房间作为代价以换取力量。 狂暴横行 用神器和结界生物（以及其他牌张类别）填满你的套牌，然后尽早频繁地攻击。一旦你在坟墓场中拥有四种不同的牌张类别，你的牌就会被强化。现在，直击要害吧！ 生还 利用暮悲邸的所有诡计来强化你的生物，帮助他们一路打破阻碍，安全脱身。找到其他方式来横置它们，躲避直到危险过去。 邪教复生 瓦伽沃万岁！减缓你的对手，同时将巨大的怪物送入你的坟墓场，然后进行仪式将它们复活。 房间接着房间 这座宅邸永无止境！当你解锁房间以建立对更多领地的控制时，让你的对手晕头转向，然后释放其中隐藏的幽灵，迎接恐怖终局。 碾磨躁狂 优先获得各种不同的牌张类别，当你用它们填满坟墓场时，阻碍场面威胁。一旦你拥有四种类别，通过循环利用你丢弃的东西，将对手碾为尘土。 童年阴影 用力量等于或小于2的玩具和小丑填满你的套牌，开始攻击！清除他们的阻挡者并强化你的小生物，迅速击败对手。 显化惧象 有东西潜伏在阴影中。显化牌面朝下的生物并让它们进入战斗，然后用它们的真面目给对手一个惊喜，扭转胜局。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_ECL.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Lorwyn Eclipsed packs to make a deck with. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! $/Events/ECL_Limited_Archetypes$
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_ECL.translation: 你会得到6包洛温：暗影笼罩补充包用于构组套牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励！ $/Events/ECL_Limited_Archetypes$

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_EOE.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Edge of Eternities packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Second Spell Cast your second spell in a turn and earn additional bonuses to overwhelm your opponent. Artifact Control Assemble an artifact-based deck to grind out your opponent's resources turn by turn. Void Use the void mechanic at the cost of creatures and artifacts—then trigger devastating events! Landers & Landfall Use Lander tokens and landfall to create mana advantage. Landers can help to trigger landfall more easily! +1/+1 Counters Boost your entire army with +1/+1 counters—stack ‘em up and watch the enemies fall. Go Wide Assemble the largest battlefield in the system and conquer your opponents with sheer numbers. Artifact Aggro Play cheap artifacts you've uncovered on your travels to quickly overpower the field with supreme synergies. Graveyard Salvage long-forgotten ships and fallen warriors with a graveyard strategy that keeps you coming back. Space Stations Station your Spacecrafts by tapping creatures, then reap the rewards of your dedicated crew. Ramp Explore Sothera's furthest regions and worlds by controlling the largest monsters and ships in the system.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_EOE.translation: 你将得到6包虚空边域补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励！ 二重咒语 在一回合中施放第二个咒语可获得额外加成，彻底压制对手。 神器控制 组建以神器为核心的套牌，逐步消耗对手的资源。 空洞 以牺牲生物和神器为代价发动空洞机制——进而触发毁灭性效果！ 探地器与地落 利用探地器衍生物和地落效应创造法术力优势。探地器能让你更轻松触发地落！ +1/+1指示物 用+1/+1指示物强化整支军队——不断叠加，见证敌军溃败。 横向展开 在星系中构建最庞大的战场，以绝对数量征服对手。 神器快攻 使用旅途中发掘的低费神器，通过极致配合迅速掌控战局。 坟墓场 通过坟场策略打捞被遗忘的飞船与阵亡战士，实现持续返场。 太空船蓄势 通过横置生物来蓄势太空船，随后收获忠诚船员带来的回报。 加速 掌控星系中体型最庞大的怪物与飞船，探索索瑟拉最遥远的疆域与世界。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_FDN.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Magic: The Gathering Foundations packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Flying Assemble a squadron of winged allies to strike down your enemies from the skies! Graveyard Control the battlefield using removal spells and card draw, while filling your graveyard to enact your master plans. Raid Attack relentlessly with resilient creatures, whittling down your opponent's life total and triggering your Raid abilities. Power Generate extra mana to play large creatures and outsize your enemies. +1/+1 Counters Command efficient creatures that grow ever larger as you boost them with +1/+1 counters.  Life Gain Support your forces by healing yourself, putting you out of the opposition's reach while you strengthen your creatures.  Spells Channel your inner spellslinger—cast instants and sorceries to empower your Prowess creatures and outmaneuver your opponent.  Morbid Get the most out of the cycle of life and death! Morbid turns the long game in your favor, adding value when you sacrifice your disposable minions or remove enemy threats.  Aggro Attack your opponent quickly with fast, low-cost creatures and buff them up to surge to victory! Ramp Defend yourself early and accelerate your mana, then go over the top with huge creatures and the most impressive spells in the Multiverse. You'll receive 6 Magic: The Gathering Foundations packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win!
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_FDN.translation: 你将得到6包万智牌：基石构筑补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！ 飞行 组建一支空中军团，从天际打击你的敌人！ 坟墓 运用去除咒语和抓牌来掌控战场，同时填充你的坟墓场来实现你的终极计划。 突击 用顽强的生物持续进攻，削减对手的生命值并触发你的突击异能。 力量 产出额外法术力来施放巨大生物，以压倒性优势击败敌人。 +1/+1指示物 统帅高效的生物，通过+1/+1指示物让它们不断成长。 回血 通过治疗自己来支援你的军队，在强化生物的同时远离对手的威胁。 咒语 释放你内心的施咒师——施放瞬间与法术来强化你的灵技生物，智取对手。 丧心 充分利用生死轮回！丧心让你在长期对局中占据优势，当你牺牲可消耗的随从或去除敌方威胁时获得额外价值。 快攻 用快速、低费的生物迅速攻击对手，并强化它们冲向胜利！ Ramp 在前期保护自己并加速法术力，然后使用巨型生物和多重宇宙中最令人印象深刻的咒语碾压对手。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_FIN.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Magic: The Gathering—FINAL FANTASY packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Artifacts Calling all Machinists! Build up your arsenal by playing artifacts, including artifact creatures and token generating Equipment, then gain extra bonuses for playing those artifacts.   Control Scheme and act in secret. Dominate the long game with strategies like removal spells, card draw, and tricky creatures. Cast flashback spells to crush foes under the weight of the past! Black Mage Aggro Play the aggressive game with creatures that reward you whenever you cast a noncreature spell. Look for cards that create Wizard tokens and turn those spells into a barrage of damage! Landfall Aggro Play creatures with landfall abilities, like Chocobos, and earn bonuses as you play lands. Look for ways to play extra lands and strengthen your creatures even further! Go Wide Call forth a battalion of formidable fighters and play cards that make tokens. Either reinforce your standing army or leverage your high creature count to cast hard-hitting spells! Artifact and Creature Sacrifice Sacrifice your artifacts and creatures, especially ones with death effects, to steadily gain the upper hand. Token generating Equipment gives you two things to sacrifice! Big Noncreatures Whenever you cast spells that cost 4 or more mana, you'll gain bonuses in battle. Find ways to generate tokens, like with special Equipment, so that your noncreature spells can add to your forces! Graveyard Value Slow and steady wins the game! Mill to fill your graveyard early with powerful creatures and flashback spells, then bring them back to the fight late in the game to achieve victory. Equipment Aggro Grab your favorite iconic weapon and rush into battle! Look for creatures that want to be equipped or cards that reward you for having Equipment, then gear up to outclass your opponent. Town Ramp Travel the overworld! Towns are lands that grant more perks the more of them you have, so play a bunch and reap the rewards. You'll even want to play some Towns that aren't blue or green, so be sure to splash in some other colors, too!
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_FIN.translation: 你会得到6包万智牌～最终幻想补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励！ 神器 机工士集结！使用神器——包括神器生物和派出衍生物的武具——来建立你的军火库，然后从神器中赚取额外收益！ 控制 暗中策划并行动。通过使用诸如去除咒语、抓牌和诡计生物等策略来主宰长盘。施放返照咒语，用回忆的分量碾压敌人！ 黑魔法师快攻 使用那些在你施放非生物咒语时有所回报的生物打出进攻性。寻找能派出法术师衍生物的牌，将这些咒语转化为一连串的伤害！ 地落快攻 使用具有地落异能的生物（如陆行鸟），让你在使用地时获得奖励。寻找额外使用地的方法，进一步强化你的生物！ 横向展开 召唤一支强大的战士队伍，并使用能派出衍生物的牌。要么增援你的常备军，要么利用你的生物数量施放强力咒语！ 神器与生物牺牲 牺牲你的神器和生物，尤其是那些具有死去效应的，以此稳步获得优势。派出衍生物的武具为你提供了两样可以牺牲的东西！ 高费非生物 每当你施放费用等于或大于4的咒语时，你将在战斗中获得奖励。寻找派出衍生物的方法（如特殊武具），这样你的非生物咒语也能增强你的部队！ 坟场价值 稳扎稳打赢得比赛！早期通过磨牌将强力生物和返照咒语放入坟墓场，然后在游戏后期将它们带回战斗以获得胜利。 武具快攻 拿起你最爱的标志性武器，冲入战场！寻找那些希望被装备的生物或在你拥有武具时有所收益的牌，然后装备起来超越你的对手！ 市镇加速 环游世界！市镇作为地牌，当你拥有的越多，它们提供的额外好处就越多，所以使用一堆市镇来收获奖励。你甚至可以使用一些非蓝非绿的市镇，所以别忘了混些其他颜色！

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_HBG.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Alchemy Horizons: Baldur's Gate packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Flicker your creatures in and out of play to produce as many triggers as possible! Control the battlefield and sneak in creatures to deal damage to your opponent. The real treasure will be the treasure you make along the way. DRAGONS! The best offense is a good defense? Gain life so you can lower theirs! Earn bonuses every time your creatures leave the battlefield. MORE DRAGONS! What's dead may never die... but may live again? Prepare for trouble! Use the new Double Team mechanic to cast creatures with the same name. EVEN MORE DRAGONS!
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_HBG.translation: 你会得到6包炼金新篇：博德之门补充包。补充包内的牌张都会加入你的收藏，而你将利用这些牌外加基本地来构组一副40张的套牌进行游戏。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励！ 闪动自己的生物反复进场，由此产生大量触发令自己获益！ 牢牢掌控战场形势，利用隐匿生物向对手造成伤害。 一路上创造的珍宝才是你的真正财富。 龙！ 严防死守才是最强攻势？得之我幸，失之敌命！ 你的生物每次离开战场都能让你更有所得。 更多的龙！ 逝者不死...还能再起？ 准备好应对之策！利用全新的双打机制，反复施放同名生物。 更多更多的龙！

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_KHM.oracleText: You'll receive 6 fifteen-card packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win!
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_KHM.translation: 你将获得6个15张的补充包。这些牌会加入你的收藏。你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑40张的套牌进行bo3对战。你将得到的奖励取决于你的胜场！

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_KTK.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Khans of Tarkir packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Abzan Counters Each creature you add to your army makes the others stronger. Use Outlast to buff your creatures and overrun your opponent! Jeskai Spellcast Redirect your opponent and use their own overextension against them. Cast spells to play tricks and make powerful threats out of your small creatures. Sultai Graveyard Get ahead of the curve by stocking your graveyard and recycling it into large creatures and impactful spells. The cycle of life and death is as inevitable as your victory! Mardu Warriors Ride with the Horde and go aggro! Attack to trigger your Raid bonuses and buff all your creatures to finish your opponent in one shot. Temur Behemoths Overwhelm your opponent with huge creatures hiding just out of sight. Plus, your ferocious beasts enhance your other spells to stomp all over the enemy.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_KTK.translation: 你会得到6包鞑契可汗补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 阿布赞指示物 你军队中的每个新兵都能增加同袍战力。利用延生异能加强生物，最终击溃对手！ 洁斯凯施咒 以彼之道还之彼身，巧用对手的过度扩张反制对手。施放咒语、善用诡计，让你的小小生物变作大大威胁。 苏勒台坟场 不断填充坟墓场，利用其来召唤大型生物或施放强力咒语，领先法术力曲线抢得先机。你的胜利就跟生死循环一般难以打破！ 玛尔都战士 与部族一道策马快攻！不断进攻并从突击异能获益，然后适时增强全军，一举拿下对手。 铁木尔巨兽 利用转瞬之间便能增长身躯的巨大生物碾压对手。此外，你的威猛惧兽还能增强你的其他咒语，助你更胜一筹。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_LCI.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Lost Caverns of Ixalan packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Oltec Ingenuity Buy time with blockers, removal, and lifegain while you assemble an array of wondrous artifacts to take over the late game. Echoes of the Dead Set up to block while you fill your graveyard, then drag your opponent into the deep end with high-cost creatures, card draw, and recursive threats. Going Down! Keep your creatures growing by attacking viciously to make your opponent block or throwing permanents into the graveyard yourself. Then keep them down with creature removal. Dinosaurs of the Sun Empire Summon gigantic dinosaurs to crush the opposition, supporting them with ways to make more mana or break through blockers.   Malamet Tactics Keep the pressure on with low-cost creatures. When your opponent tries to set up a defense, it's time to pounce by powering up your forces. Dusk Legion Pilgrimage Sacrifice little creatures and artifacts for the glory of Aclazotz (and additional resources). Once you smell blood, seal their fate with a few larger creatures. Pirates' Plunder Set sail with a rowdy crew and their haul of Equipment and Treasure. When those landlubbers try to stop you, fly over the top or throw their blockers overboard. Fungal Festering Muck up the battlefield with sticky creatures while you fill your graveyard. Once you've descended enough to power your side up, start grinding your way through the opposing blockers. Thousand-Moon Legion Launch your military campaign with lots of small creatures and artifacts, then tactically tap those resources to activate your forces and rout the invaders. River Herald Expedition Go exploring to stock your side with lands and powerful creatures, then sink your extra mana into activated abilities and card draw to drown the opposition in value.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_LCI.translation: 你将获得6包依夏兰迷窟补充包。这些牌会加入你的收藏。你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一套40张的套牌。进行bo3对局并基于你的胜场获得奖励！ 欧尔特克智谋 通过阻挡者、去除和生命回复拖延时间，借机集结神器大军在游戏后期出奇制胜。 亡者回响 设防阻挡并借机填坟，再通过高费生物、抽牌手段和无尽威胁将对手拖入深渊。 给我倒下！ 通过猛烈地进攻迫使对手阻挡或自己将永久物扔入坟场让你的生物逐步膨胀，再不断使用去除击倒对手的生物。 烈阳帝国恐龙大军 召唤巨型恐龙压垮对手并通过产出更多法术力或突破阻挡者的手段支援它们。 豹族计策 通过低费生物持续制造压力。对手试图构筑防线之时即是你膨胀军队猛扑之际。 暮影军团朝圣 牺牲小生物和神器来重现阿洛佐兹的荣光（并获取额外资源）。一旦你闻到敌人的鲜血，用更强大的生物了结他们的性命。 海盗劫掠 带领一批残暴的船员和他们抢来的武器和财宝扬帆启航。当那些航海菜鸟试图挡你去路时，飞过他们头顶或直接把他们的阻挡者扔下海。 真菌溃烂 将黏糊糊的生物铺满战场并借机填坟。一旦你已落坟足够多次以强大你的阵线，那就开始逐步蚕食突破对手的阻挡者吧。 千月军团 通过大量小生物和神器开展你的军事行动，然后策略性地横置那些资源以激活你的军队并击溃入侵者。 川流使探险队 进行勘察为你的阵线积累土地和强大生物，然后将你额外的法术力投入起动式异能和抓牌来赚取价值淹没对手。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_LTR.oracleText: You'll receive 6 The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! "Draw Two" Humans Defend the citadel ! Drawing two cards every turn will ensure you never run out of reinforcements. Amass Control Grow a massive Orc Army , then wield Saruman's mighty suite of spells to turn the tide of battle in your favor. Amass Aggro The forces of Mordor will rush out of your hands and through the enemy's defenses with this aggressive strategy, sacrificing themselves for the glory of Sauron. Power Matters The wilds of Middle-earth™ are home to many of its strongest denizens, such as Ents, Trolls, and the noble Rangers. Use them to overwhelm your opponent with great numbers. Food Never underestimate a Hobbit! This low-to-the-ground aggressive deck uses Food tokens for a lot more than the occasional second-refreshment. Tokens From earthen Treasures to soaring Spirits and everything in-between, this strategy revolves around going wide and eventually overwhelming the opponent. Spells Draw on the knowledge and magic of Middle-earth's most powerful Wizards to cast a stream of increasingly impressive instants and sorceries. Sacrifice Repurpose and recycle your creatures to summon a frightening assortment of terrors, including the Nazgûl and their Fell Beasts. Go-Wide Humans Answer the call and charge into battle! These Humans combine to create a force capable of slicing through any foe. Scry Elvish magic offers you a glimpse at many possible futures. Choose wisely and you'll find victory waiting at the top of your deck.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_LTR.translation: 你将得到6包魔戒：中洲传说补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励！ 人类「抓两张」保卫王城！每回合抓两张牌，确保你永远不会缺乏支援。 囤兵控制聚集一支巨大的半兽人／军队，然后利用萨茹曼的强力咒语扭转战局。 囤兵快攻魔多大军出击，利用猛袭策略打穿敌人防线，为了索隆的荣耀不惜牺牲自己。 力量很重要中洲™许多强大生灵栖息于郊野，例如恩特、食人妖，还有高贵的突击队。 食品永远不要小看霍比特人！这副身材矮小的猛袭套牌充分利用食品衍生物，让慷慨提供的第二次茶点发挥更大功效。 衍生物从世俗的珍宝到飞翔的精怪，这种策略以铺场为中心，渐渐压倒敌人。 咒语吸收中洲最强大法术师的知识和魔法，持续施放瞬间和法术，见证威力逐步增长。 牺牲回收你的生物重新利用，召唤各种骇人的惊惧兽，包括那兹古尔及座下的恶兽。 人类铺场响应召唤，冲进战场！这些人类集结起来的军队足以击溃所有敌人。 占卜精灵魔法能让你一瞥众多可能的未来。只要小心选择，获胜之道就在你的牌库顶。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_MH3.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Modern Horizons 3 packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Energy Fliers Play flying creatures that get stronger the more energy you have. Use them to attack your opponent or otherwise find tricky ways to get past your opponent's blockers. Card Draw This classic UB control deck employs a variety of ways to draw additional cards, then leverages them for additional effects to dominate the battlefield. Artifacts Start small and go big. This BR deck uses a variety of artifact synergies, including the infamous affinity, to summon powerhouses from Magic's past and future. Eldrazi Spawn Even the smallest Eldrazi are worthy of fear. Overwhelm your opponent with your terrifying Eldrazi horde, aided by Eldrazi Spawn tokens, in this RG deck. Modified Bestow Bestow gives you the versatility to play creatures or use them as Auras to buff others. Go tall and then dare your opponent to stop you from going wide if they can weather the first storm. Modified Dies In this unique take on a WB sacrifice deck, you're going to be modifying your creatures with counters, Equipment, and Auras for long-term advantages. Energy Midrange Embrace your inner mad scientist! UR Energy gives you plenty of ways to manage different types of engine-like permanents to generate overwhelming advantage over your opponents. Modified Adapt This BG adapt deck uses +1/+1 counters to great effect, giving creatures additional spell-like triggers to dominate the battlefield. Energy Aggro There's no point hoarding your excess energy here, so spend it and smash! This aggressive RW deck will do whatever it takes with energy to keep attacking turn after turn. Eldrazi Ramp In this GU deck, generate Eldrazi Spawn and then use them to summon their much larger kin—and proceed to devour the Multiverse.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_MH3.translation: 你将获得6包摩登新篇3补充包。这些牌会加入你的收藏，你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。进行BO3对局并基于胜场获得奖励！ 能量飞行生物 打出拥有的能量越多便越强大的飞行生物。利用它们对敌方发动进攻，或找到巧妙的方法来突破对手的拦截。 抽牌 这套经典蓝黑控采用多种方式抽取额外牌张，然后利用它们获得额外的效应来主宰战场。 神器 以小见大。这套红黑通过各种神器协同作用，包括那些恶名昭彰的共鸣，召唤万智牌过去与未来的强者。 奥札奇后裔 哪怕是最微小的奥札奇也不容小觑。这套红绿借助奥札奇后裔衍生物之力，以可怕的奥札奇部落压服对手。 饰装神授 神授可以让你决定打出生物或将其用作灵气来为其他生物提供属性。打造强大的生物，而后挑战你的对手，若其能经受住第一波风暴，他们才有机会阻止你铺场。 饰装死亡 在此独特的黑白牺牲套牌中你将通过指示物、武具和灵气饰装你的生物，以获得长期优势。 能量中速 接纳内心的疯狂科学家！红蓝能量为你提供了多种不同类别的类引擎永久物的管理方法，助你在战局中取得压倒性优势。 饰装演化 这套黑绿采用+1/+1指示物以达到更好的效应，给予生物额外的类咒语触发以制服对手。 能量猛袭 没有必要在此围积多余的能量，消耗能量进行破坏吧！这套红白快攻积极进攻不惜一切能量保持接二连三的攻势。 奥札奇加速 这套蓝绿生成奥札奇后裔，而后用其召唤更为强大的亲族，进一步吞噬多重宇宙。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_MID.oracleText: You'll receive 6 fourteen-card packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win!
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_MID.translation: 你将获得6个14张的补充包。 这些牌会加入你的收藏。 你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑40张的套牌进行bo3对战。 你将得到的奖励取决于你的胜场!

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_MKM.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Murders at Karlov Manor packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Detectives Get on your opponent's case with this fast midrange strategy. Leverage Detective typal bonuses to overwhelm your opponent's defenses, and sacrifice Clues to refill your hand in the late game. Clues Control Use defensive spells to extend the game and generate Clues, then turn the excess mana into a card advantage that will bury your opponent in a mountain of value. Suspect Aggro Suspected creatures have menace and can't block. Keep attacking with your suspicious characters, and your opponents will be helpless to stop them. Big Disguise Spend the early game accelerating your mana and setting up a face-down board state, then beat down your opponent's side of the board by flipping over haymaker after haymaker. Go-Wide Disguise Flood the battlefield with face-down creatures and accrue impressive rewards whenever they're turned face up. Pint-Size Disguise Face-down creatures bolster your strategy, which rewards playing creatures with power 2 or less and boosting them to become more impressive attackers. Artifact Sacrifice Generate and sacrifice Clue tokens strategically to gain a massive card advantage over your opponent. Then, chip away at their defenses by attacking with evasive Thopters that bring death from above. Gravebreak Use the collect evidence mechanic and raise the dead to support a long-game strategy that gives you extra value whenever a creature card leaves your graveyard. Battalion This classic Ravnican strategy adds extra punch to aggressive red and white creatures by providing a bonus whenever you attack with three or more of them. Collect Evidence Rapidly fill up your graveyard and collect evidence to power up your spells while amassing permanents that reward you each time you do so.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_MKM.translation: 你将获得6包卡洛夫庄园谋杀案补充包。这些牌会加入你的收藏。你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一套40张的套牌。进行三局两胜游戏并基于你的胜场获得奖励！ 集结侦探 以这种快节奏中速策略来解决对手：充分利用侦探特有的额外价值压垮对手的防线并在游戏后期牺牲线索补充手牌。 线索控制 使用防御咒语拉长战线并派出线索，然后将多余的法术力转化成手牌优势最终以海量资源埋葬对手。 怀疑快攻 遭疑生物具有威慑异能且不能阻挡。用遭疑角色持续进攻，在他们的攻势下你的对手会陷入绝望。 巨型伪装 在游戏前期加速法术力并将匿伏生物铺满你的版图，接着将它们翻面施以拳拳重击击倒对手。 铺场伪装 召唤海量匿伏生物，每当他们翻面时，不断获取惊人回报。 微型伪装 通过匿伏生物帮助实现你的计策：通过打出力量等于或小于2的生物获得回报并增强他们使之成为更有力的进攻者。 神器牺牲 机智地派出和牺牲线索衍生物来赢得巨大的卡差优势，然后用带穿透的振翼机进攻蚕食对手防线，从空中击败对手。 破坟而出 利用搜证机制和掘坟来支撑该长盘战略：每当一张生物牌离开你的坟场时给予你额外价值。 集结军队 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时能提供额外价值——这种经典的拉尼卡策略让本身就极具进攻性的红白生物如虎添翼。 搜集证据 快速填充你的坟场并通过搜证强化你的咒语，同时积攒让你每次搜证获得回报的永久物。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_MOM.oracleText: You'll receive 6 March of the Machine packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Knights Knights have assembled from around the multiverse! Keeping a steady supply of these gallant creatures will help press your advantage each turn. Graveyard Mill everyone. Your forces will improve with more strategies and greater power as each graveyard fills. Sacrifice Desperate times call for desperate measures. Sacrifice your artifacts and creatures to pave a path to victory. Battles Get ready to liberate your favorite plane from the Phyrexians! Prioritize Battles, Magic's newest card type, and smash through opposing defenses to save the day. +1/+1 Counters It's time to buff up! Arm your creatures with +1/+1 counters to outclass the opposition. Phyrexian Looking to play the villain? Seek out Phyrexians of all sorts to take advantage of them and their swarms of little hatching Incubator tokens. Convoke Your creatures are here to help withstand the invasion. Build an army early and they'll help you cast powerful spells with convoke. Incubate Go big and generate tons of mana to play bigger creatures and incubate larger tokens. Backup Find a good partner and tag-team those Phyrexians. Use the backup mechanic to find the right combination of abilities to build toward your victory each turn. Transform Life is always more fun with some change. Take your cards to the next level by winning battles and turning Incubator tokens and creatures into their Phyrexian selves.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_MOM.translation: 你将得到6包邪军压境补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励！ 骑士整个多重宇宙的骑士均已集结于此！持续派出这些英勇的生物，助你每回合都能建立优势。 坟场大家齐磨牌。所有坟墓场中的牌越多，你的手下就有更多选择，也会因此愈加强大。 牺牲绝望之时更需殊死之策。牺牲神器生物，开辟胜利通途。 战役准备好从非瑞克西亚人手中拯救自己的最爱时空。优先应对战役这一万智牌中最新的牌张类别，随后洞穿敌人防线，力挽狂澜。 +1/+1指示物现在是加成时间！用+1/+1指示物武装你的生物，完胜对手。 非瑞克西亚想当大反派？留意各类非瑞人，然后充分利用他们和成群待孵化的抚育器衍生物。 召集你的生物可助你抵御非瑞克西亚大军。早期就构建起庞大军势，之后便可利用它们来协助施放具召集异能的强大咒语。 抚育积极扩充法术力基础，产生大量的法术力来派遣大型生物或抚育大型衍生物。 后援寻找合适战友，结伴对抗非瑞克西亚。利用后援机制，探寻正确的异能组合，每回合都迈出踏向胜利的坚实脚步。 转化有改变，生命才更精彩。打赢战役，或是将抚育器衍生物转化变成非瑞人生物，让牌张强度再上一层楼。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_MSH.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Marvel Super Heroes packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! $/Events/MSH_Limited_Archetypes$
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_MSH.translation: 你会得到6包漫威超级英雄补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ $/Events/MSH_Limited_Archetypes$

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_NEO.oracleText: You'll receive 6 15-card packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win!
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_NEO.translation: 你将获得6个15张的补充包。这些牌会加入你的收藏。你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑40张的套牌进行bo3对战。你将得到的奖励取决于你的胜场！

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_OM1.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Through the Omenpaths packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Modified - Use Auras, Equipment, and counters to both arm and armor your hard-to-block creatures and sneak in for surprising amounts of damage!  Connive Graveyard - Use the connive mechanic to draw cards, discard cards, and plan to destroy your opponent with the perfect hand and graveyard.  BR Mayhem - Discard mayhem cards and play them from your graveyard. Mayhem cards reward a reckless playstyle that pushes aggression forward.  RG Large Spells - Ramp into big spells or reduce their cost to make big plays, then reap the benefits for casting them!  Enweb - Using the enweb mechanic, return creatures to your hand to tempo out powerful creatures and reuse the abilities of your smaller creatures for recurring value.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_OM1.translation: 你将得到6包穿越预兆路补充包。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行三盘两胜制的对局，最后根据胜局数量赢得奖励！ 饰装 - 运用灵气、武具和指示物来武装你那些难以阻挡的生物，既能增强防御又能造成出其不意的伤害！ 筹谋坟场 - 通过筹谋机制抓牌弃牌，精心策划手牌和坟墓场的完美配合击溃对手。 红黑疯乱 - 弃掉疯乱牌并从坟墓场使用它们。疯乱牌奖励激进的打法，让你在狂乱进攻中占据优势。 红绿大咒语 - 通过加速施放大咒语或降低其费用来打出强力效果，然后享受施放它们带来的丰厚回报！ 缠网 - 利用缠网机制将生物移回手牌，通过节奏控制来反复使用强力生物，并从小型生物的异能中获取持续价值。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_ONE.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Phyrexia: All Will Be One packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Artifacts Phyrexia is filled with glorious artifacts. Gather as many of these artifacts as you can to outmaneuver your opponent. Proliferate Control Use proliferate to spread the glory of Phyrexia—oil counters, poison counters, and loyalty counters are all ready to be proliferated. Oil Counters & Sacrifice All Phyrexians are valuable, even (and sometimes especially) in death. Use your creatures and artifacts to generate oil counters when they die. Oil Counters Midrange The more things with oil counters you have, the merrier. Use these oil counters to get the biggest, smashiest creatures you can. Toxic Aggro Take advantage of small toxic creatures, especially Mite tokens, to swarm your opponent. Corrupted Give your opponent three or more poison counters, then your corrupted cards become even more powerful. Oil Counters & Noncreature Spells Build up your oil counters and overwhelm your opponent by casting a variety of artifacts, enchantments, instants, sorceries, and yes, even planeswalkers! Poison Victory You have the biggest baddest creature with toxic. Use them to get your opponent to 10 poison counters. For Mirrodin! Equipment Someone's got to fight against the Phyrexians! Your rebels can use equipment to stave them off! Proliferate & Poison Two great tastes that go great together. Use green creatures with toxic to deal out serious poison counters, then proliferate to finish the job.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_ONE.translation: 你将得到6包非瑞克西亚：万界归一补充包。补充包内的牌张都会加入你的收藏，而你将利用这些牌外加基本地来构组一副40张的套牌参赛。不断进行三局两胜制的对局，最后根据你的胜局数量赢得奖励！ 神器非瑞克西亚神器阵容壮丽无匹。尽量多收集神器来降伏对手。 增殖控制利用增殖散播非瑞克西亚荣光～烁油指示物、中毒指示物和忠诚指示物都可以增殖。 烁油指示物和牺牲非瑞克西亚人不论死活都极具价值（有时死的更有用）。充分运用在死去时会产生烁油指示物的生物和神器。 烁油指示物中速烁油指示物多多益善。利用这些烁油指示物得到最强悍的大生物。 下毒猛袭利用小型下毒生物（尤其是虫械衍生物）大举淹没你的对手。 腐化让对手获得三个或更多中毒指示物后，你的腐化牌就会变得更强大。 烁油指示物和非生物咒语壮大烁油指示物的数量，并施放各种神器、结界、瞬间、法术甚至是鹏洛客来击溃对手。 用毒致胜你有最大最凶的下毒生物。利用它们让对手获得十个中毒指示物。 「秘罗万岁！」武具总得有人站出来同非瑞克西亚人斗争！反抗军可用武具来抵挡他们的进攻！ 增殖和中毒这两个好东西能完美契合。利用具下毒异能的绿色生物让对手获得大量中毒指示物，然后通过增殖来决定战局。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_OTJ.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Outlaws of Thunder Junction packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Take a Break Keep your guard up. Use the plot mechanic and cards with flash to pass your turn with mana available, ready for anything. Crimes Keep targeting your opponents and their stuff turn after turn. You're looking to play a long game, but your constant heists will leave your opponents less than prepared. Outlaws Assemble a crew of Assassins, Mercenaries, Pirates, Rogues, and Warlocks. This motley crew of outlaws will find ways to work together to wear down your opponents. Power 4+ Big creatures are usually their own reward, but this set steps it up. Boost your forces with spells or Mercenary tokens and let the onslaught begin. Mount There's a whole stable of Mounts eager to charge into battle. Every time a Mount attacks backed by some skilled riders, you'll reap more rewards. Saddle up! Attrition Your permanents are here for a good time, not a long time. Sacrifice shamelessly, block fearlessly, and attack aggressively. Every loss is another opportunity for a larger gain. Second Spell Sling your spells in one-two bursts. Low mana value cards and plotted cards enable combinations of two or more spells in a turn, unlocking a flurry of bonuses. Creatures in the Graveyard You only live once? Hardly. Your cards can bring fallen creatures back to the fray or simply take advantage of the number of creature cards in your graveyard. Mercenary Aggro You might not have the biggest creatures, but you have the most aggressive ones. Mercenary tokens will pump the power of your creatures so you can keep making good attacks when opposition arrives. Plot Set your mastermind plans into motion with the plot mechanic. Your opponents may see them coming but that doesn't mean they'll be able to stop them. Control the battlefield and strike when the time is right.
Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_OTJ.translation: 你将得到6包光雷驿镖客补充包。这些牌会加入你的收藏。你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一套40张的套牌。进行BO3游戏并基于你的胜场获得奖励！ 暂做休整 保持戒备。运用设谋机制和带有闪现异能的卡牌，让过回合并保持法术力开放，准备好直面一切挑战。 罪行 不断以对手为目标，掠夺对手的资源。这是一场持久战，你接连不断的劫掠会让对手疲于奔命。 狂徒 召集一帮杀手、佣兵、海盗、浪客和邪术师。这帮形形色色的狂徒能通力合作，想办法耗尽对手的资源。 力量4+ 大块头生物本身就厉害，但在这个系列更上一层楼。使用咒语或佣兵衍生物让你的生物更强，用摧枯拉朽的进攻席卷全场。 坐骑 一整排坐骑蓄势待发，随时准备冲锋陷阵。每当坐骑在老练骑手的驾驭下发起进攻，你都能获得更加丰厚的战果。策马扬鞭！ 无惧消耗 你的永久物只需一刻绚烂。肆意牺牲，无畏阻挡，奋勇进攻。每一次损失，都是为了下次更大的收获。 第二个咒语 连环施放咒语。低法术力值的牌和设谋牌使你能在一回合内使用两个或更多咒语，释放出猛烈的连锁反应。 坟墓场生物 只活一世就够了？可别这么想。你的牌可以将倒下的生物拉回战场，或直接利用你坟墓场中生物牌的数量。 佣兵快攻 你或许没有最强大的生物，但你有最具侵略性的帮手。佣兵衍生物会提升你生物的力量，即使敌人有防守，你仍能保持凌厉的攻势。 设谋 运用设谋机制，推进宏图伟业。对手或许能看穿你的行动，但这不代表他们可以阻止。掌控战局，伺机出击，一举制胜。

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_SIRa.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Shadows Over Innistrad Remastered packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! This Week's Shadows of the Past: Creature Type Terror! Click Here to Learn More about the rotating Shadows of the Past in Shadows Over Innistrad Remastered Limited Events! Haunting Spirits Establish a ghostly presence as you take to the skies with Spirits and other unlikely allies. Relentless Zombies Destroy enemy creatures with removal spells, reload your hand with card draw, and march on with a horde of Zombies. Vampire Madness Your vampire army helps you to discard cards, cast spells for their madness costs, and secure victory. The key is striking the right balance between discard outlets and madness cards. Wolves Attack Transform your Werewolves with a combination of instants and activated abilities. Your outsized creatures will overrun your opponents in no time. Super-Humans Stack up Auras and Equipment on your Humans to swing in for the kill with your larger-than-life creatures. Valuable Sacrifice Expendable resources are everywhere in white-black. Sacrifice creatures and pay life liberally for value. Spell Science Noncreature spells perform double duty here if you pick up enough creatures that reward you for playing them. Graveyard Shift Stock your graveyard to get extra value from powerful delirium cards. Your deck will just need a wide variety of card types to turn it on. Righteous Fury Run down your opponent with cheap, powerful threats and well-timed combat tricks. Let's Investigate Play defense while you build up a supply of Clues. You'll soon learn enough to overwhelm your opponent with card advantage and large monsters.

Events/Event_Desc_Trad_Sealed_SNC.oracleText: You'll receive 6 Streets of New Capenna packs. The cards will be added to your collection and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! The Five Families The Obscura: Craft the perfect draws and use superior intelligence over a long game to engineer a route to victory. Use the family's connive mechanic to draw, then discard - giving your creatures +1/+1 counters along the way! The Maestros: Hire expendable underlings as your family's muscle on the streets. Then use the casualty mechanic to sacrifice those minions, copy your spells, and blast your opponent. The Riveteers: The Riveteers rumble with large creatures. Give your creatures haste with the blitz mechanic, then sacrifice them at the end of your turn to draw a card. Keep that pressure up! Then press your advantage to crush your opponents. The Cabaretti: Flood the board with tokens and small creatures to overwhelm the opposition. The family knows how to collaborate for greater gain: alliance abilities give you additional effects whenever another creature enters the battlefield under your control. The Brokers: The Brokers are always ready to take down your opponents one notch at a time. Attack relentlessly to deal small amounts of damage, and mount an impenetrable defense - legal or otherwise! - by amassing shield counters on your creatures.

Pale as Snow Make use of the bargain and Role mechanics and get rewarded for your creatures and enchantments going to the graveyard.   The Magician's Misstep Go aggressive or be more controlling with a flurry of bewitching instants and sorceries to keep your opponent off balance. Greta, Witch Hunter Creature removal and life gain will help stave off your opponent's attacks until you're able to command the board with big creatures and Food rewards. Brawl at the Grand Ball Enhance your creatures with Roles and take advantage of the celebration mechanic with low-mana aggressive creatures and spells. The Kingdom of Storms Use defensive creatures and spells to buy time while you build up your lands. Reward yourself by casting spells that cost five mana or more to dominate the late game.

Events/Event_Desc_Twitchcon_Day9.oracleText: We're giving Constructed new house rules with Day[9] (twitch.tv/day9tv). Day[9] has always had a burning displeasure for counters and tricks. So together we created INSTA-BAN, where you bring a 60-card deck with zero instant-speed spells in it. That's right, all instants and cards with flash are banned from this event!
Events/Event_Desc_Twitchcon_Day9.translation: 我们与Day[9]（twitch.tv/day9tv）一道，为构筑赛事拟定全新自订规则。Day[9]无比憎恨反击和诡计。所以我们特别推出「无瞬间」。在此玩法中，你依然要组一副60张的套牌，但里面一张瞬间速度的咒语都不能有。没错，本赛事中禁用所有瞬间和具闪现异能的牌！

Events/Event_Desc_Twitchcon_Gaby.oracleText: We're giving Draft new house rules with Gaby Spartz (twitch.tv/gabyspartz). Gaby loves drafting and building ambitious decks. So together we are running a GREEDY DOMINARIA DRAFT. Draft 3 packs of Dominaria around a few unique rules in this game of Magic. Everyone can play two lands per turn, starts with 9 cards, and has no maximum hand size.
Events/Event_Desc_Twitchcon_Gaby.translation: 我们与Gaby Spartz（twitch.tv/gabyspartz）一道，为轮抽赛事拟定全新自订规则。Gaby喜欢在轮抽中抽选和构筑另类套牌。所以我们隆重推出「贪婪多明纳里亚轮抽」。牌手还是利用3包多明纳里亚补充包进行轮抽，但随后进行的万智牌游戏会有些特殊规则生效。所有人每回合都能使用两个地，以9张手牌起手，没有手牌上限。

There are 12 styles to collect! For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles available to those who prove worthy, click here.
