Events/Event_Desc_WOE_Quick_Draft.translation: 从传递中的轮抽补充包中一次选一张牌。这些牌会加入你的收藏。你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一套40张的套牌。进行游戏并基于你的胜场获得奖励！ 人机轮抽 - 与AI机器人轮抽，选牌无等待不限时 冰霜女王通过横置对手的生物和带领飞行大军遨游天际掌控战斗的走向。 迷人醉眠集结一队飞行仙灵并辅以诡计咒语和生物去除来赢得长盘胜利。 黑暗笛手派出潮水般的老鼠衍生物淹没对手的防线。保持激进并善用卡牌让你从进攻生物的战斗交换中获得回报。 小红玉与恶狼召唤强大的高攻生物或利用角色灵气和战斗诡计增强弱小生物，从中唤醒潜藏在艾卓幻野的神秘力量。 娅蒙与野兽集结一队生物大军并通过结附角色及其他灵气获益。当你取得场面优势时全力进攻。 苍白如雪充分利用加码和角色机制让你的生物和结界进入坟墓场时给予回报。 魔术师的失策激进地进攻或走控制：通过施放法术和瞬间搅乱战场让对手场面失衡。 女巫猎人格蕾特在生物去除和生命回复的帮助下拖延对手的进攻直到你能够通过强大生物和食品回报掌控战场。 堂皇舞宴喧闹用角色灵气增强你的生物并通过低费进攻生物和咒语来善加利用欢庆机制。 风暴王国使用防御性生物和咒语为你积累足够地牌拖延时间，最终通过施放5费及以上咒语获取回报接管游戏后期。

Events/Event_Desc_WOE_Trad_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play best-of-three-game matches and receive prizes based on how many matches you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players The Frost Queen Control the flow of combat by tapping your opponent's creatures and taking to the sky with fliers. Enchanting Slumber Assemble a team of flying Faeries and support them with tricky spells and creature removal to win the long game. The Dark Piper Create a massive number of Rat tokens to swarm past your opponent's defenses. Be aggressive and take advantage of cards that reward you for your attackers trading off in combat. Ruby and the Wolf Call forth what lurks in the wilderness of Eldraine , summoning high-powered creatures or enhancing your small creatures with Roles and combat tricks. Armont and the Beasts Gather an army of creatures and get bonuses for enchanting them with Roles and other Auras, then go all-out when you have the upper hand. Pale as Snow Make use of the bargain and Role mechanics and get rewarded for your creatures and enchantments going to the graveyard.   The Magician's Misstep Go aggressive or be more controlling with a flurry of bewitching instants and sorceries to keep your opponent off balance. Greta, Witch Hunter Creature removal and life gain will help stave off your opponent's attacks until you're able to command the board with big creatures and Food rewards. Brawl at the Grand Ball Enhance your creatures with Roles and take advantage of the celebration mechanic with low-mana aggressive creatures and spells. The Kingdom of Storms Use defensive creatures and spells to buy time while you build up your lands. Reward yourself by casting spells that cost five mana or more to dominate the late game.
Events/Event_Desc_WOE_Trad_Draft.translation: 从传递中的轮抽补充包中一次选一张牌。这些牌会加入你的收藏。你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一套40张的套牌。进行bo3对局并基于你的胜场获得奖励！ 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽 冰霜女王通过横置对手的生物和带领飞行大军遨游天际掌控战斗的走向。 迷人醉眠集结一队飞行仙灵并辅以诡计咒语和生物去除来赢得长盘胜利。 黑暗笛手派出潮水般的老鼠衍生物淹没对手的防线。保持激进并善用卡牌让你从进攻生物的战斗交换中获得回报。 小红玉与恶狼召唤强大的高攻生物或利用角色灵气和战斗诡计增强弱小生物，从中唤醒潜藏在艾卓幻野的神秘力量。 娅蒙与野兽集结一队生物大军并通过结附角色及其他灵气获益。当你取得场面优势时全力进攻。 苍白如雪充分利用加码和角色机制让你的生物和结界进入坟墓场时给予回报。 魔术师的失策激进地进攻或走控制：通过施放法术和瞬间搅乱战场让对手场面失衡。 女巫猎人格蕾特在生物去除和生命回复的帮助下拖延对手的进攻直到你能够通过强大生物和食品回报掌控战场。 堂皇舞宴喧闹用角色灵气增强你的生物并通过低费进攻生物和咒语来善加利用欢庆机制。 风暴王国使用防御性生物和咒语为你积累足够地牌拖延时间，最终通过施放5费及以上咒语获取回报接管游戏后期。

Events/Event_Desc_WeddingCrashers.oracleText: It's the biggest wedding of the season, and everyone who's anyone will be in attendance. This is no time to stay on the sidelines! It's time to mix it up and celebrate these new bonds of matrimony! Even if you're not technically on the invite list, you can still make your way inside and enjoy the festivities, the scintillating company, and, of course, the dinner service. Word is, it's all simply to die for. Bring a 60-card Standard deck with no more than three of any card other than basic lands - and then make sure your cards find their partners before the ushers find you, because whenever you cast a spell that has a match in your battlefield or graveyard, you'll collect two Blood tokens. When you finally get tossed from the premises, you'll receive Fang card styles from Innistrad: Crimson Vow for the new friends you made along the way. There are 19 styles to collect! For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles available at the wedding, click here.
Events/Event_Desc_WeddingCrashers.translation: 这是本季度最隆重的婚礼，所有人都受邀出席。现在不是在场边枯站着的时间！一起躁动起来欢庆联姻之喜！就算你不在宴请名单上，你也能设法进入会场享受奢华典礼、迷醉活动，以及必不可少的盛筵佳肴。已经有人传出话来说，保证让人醉生梦死。 使用事先组好的60张标准套牌参赛，但除基本地外每种牌不得超过三张～然后千万确保在礼宾员找到你之前为自己的牌张找到伙伴，因为每当你施放一个与已在战场上或坟墓场中之牌相同的咒语时，你就会得到两个血滴衍生物。当你最终被扔出场地时，你都会获得一张来自依尼翠：腥红婚誓系列的尖牙卡牌样式，作为一路上找到伙伴的纪念。总共有19种待你收集！ 关于此赛制的更多信息，以及可于婚礼中收集的卡牌样式完整列表，请点击此处。

Events/Event_Desc_Welcome_Weekend_Single.oracleText: Welcome to the MTG Arena Open Beta! To celebrate, we're running a Singleton event where players can only have one copy of a card in their decks (other than basic lands). No gold or gems are required to join, and you have the opportunity to win card rewards based on your wins! Each uncommon card reward can get upgraded to a rare or mythic (15%).
Events/Event_Desc_Welcome_Weekend_Single.translation: 欢迎加入万智牌竞技场公开测试！我们正在举办无双赛事以示庆贺！无双赛正如其名，牌手的套牌中同名牌只能有一张（基本地除外）参加比赛无需支付金币或宝石，且有机会根据胜场数量赢取牌张奖励！所得之非凡牌奖励都有机会升级为稀有或秘稀牌（15%）。

Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Artisan.oracleText: "One should never consider themselves disadvantaged by a lesser or uncommon tool. You should be able to find victory when using even the most incomplete materials. To tell you the truth, it's sometimes this challenge that's the most enjoyable part! Try out these Artisan decks and I'll show you why you shouldn't be so eager to cast the common or uncommon options aside." - Feldon
Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Artisan.translation: “永远不要认为自己被一种次要或不常见的工具置于不利地位。即使使用最不完整的材料，你也应该能够找到胜利。说实话，有时候这个挑战才是最有趣的部分！试试这些银铁套牌，我会告诉你为什么不应该如此急切地放弃普通或非凡选项。” - 费顿

Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Brawl.oracleText: "These decks were crafted around either a legendary creature or planeswalker who will serve as your commander. Don't worry - like any good commander they're resilient. If your first choice doesn't work for you, you can always change your selection. You can cause all the trouble you want with these until the dust settles and the event comes to a close." - Feldon
Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Brawl.translation: “这些套牌是围绕将担任你指挥官的传奇生物或鹏洛客制作的。别担心——就像任何优秀的指挥官一样，他们有韧性。如果你的第一选择不适合你，你可以随时更改你的选择。你可以用这些来制造你想要的所有麻烦，直到尘埃落定，赛事结束。” - 费顿

Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Draft_IKO.oracleText: "I'm of the belief that there's nothing wrong with standing on the shoulders of those who have come before us, and these draft decks are a perfect example of that! These Ikoria: Lair of Behemoth's draft decks have already proven themselves worthy and act as an example of what a commendable draft deck should look like." - Feldon
Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Draft_IKO.translation: “我相信站在前人的肩膀上并没有错，而这些轮抽套牌就是一个完美的例子！这些 依克黎：巨兽时空的轮抽套牌已经证明了自己的价值，并作为值得称道的轮抽套牌的典范。” - 费顿

Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Draft_THB.oracleText: "I'm of the belief that there's nothing wrong with standing on the shoulders of those who have come before us, and these draft decks are a perfect example of that! These Theros Beyond Death draft decks have already proven themselves worthy and act as an example of what a commendable draft deck should look like." - Feldon
Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Draft_THB.translation: “我相信站在前人的肩膀上并没有错，而这些轮抽套牌就是一个完美的例子！这些 塞洛斯：冥途求生的轮抽套牌已经证明了自己的价值，并作为值得称道的轮抽套牌的典范。” - 费顿

Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_GuildBattle.oracleText: "There are certain elements that are drawn to each other and then there are others that oppose - sometimes violently. What you're about to walk into is that volatile situation and I've prepared some options that will help you stand your ground. There exists a synergy between the cards you have in your hand, but they will react fiercely against the opponent." - Feldon
Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_GuildBattle.translation: “某些元素相互吸引，而另一些元素则相互反对——有时是暴力的。你将要面对的是动荡的局势，我已经准备了一些选项来帮助你站稳脚跟。你手中的牌之间存在协同作用，但它们会对对手做出激烈的反应。” - 费顿

Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Historic.oracleText: " These may have seen their share of conflicts, but the scars of battle show that you fought, and most importantly, survived. There are times when you need those who have stood the test of time at your side, so I put these away in safe keeping for such a time as this. If you'll only wipe away the dust, I assure you - you'll wipe that smile off your opponent's face." - Feldon
Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Historic.translation: “这些可能已经看到了他们的冲突，但战斗的伤疤表明你战斗过，最重要的是，你活下来了。有时候，你需要那些经受住时间考验的人在你身边，所以我把它们妥善保管，以备不时之需。如果你只需擦去灰尘，我向你保证--你会把这种笑容从你的对手脸上擦掉。” - 费顿

Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_HistoricPaupe.oracleText: "In this Pauper event, these decks bring together well-known warriors of the past, who are only common in name and not in might. Great things can be achieved through this collective action when focused and aimed in the right direction." - Feldon
Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_HistoricPaupe.translation: “在这次全铁赛事中，这些套牌汇集了过去著名的战士，他们只是名存实亡，实力不济。通过这种集体行动，只要重点突出，方向正确，就能取得伟大的成就。” - 费顿

Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Mastermind.oracleText: "You'll only get stronger if you keep bearing heavier loads, so I'll be honest with you - this one is going to require you to stay focused and to think critically. I'm sending you out with no lands, but instead I want you to discard a card in exchange for a land token that will make any color of mana. Get creative and get wins!" - Feldon
Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Mastermind.translation: “只有不断承受更重的负荷，你才会变得更强壮，所以我跟你说实话--这一次需要你保持专注，并进行批判性思考。我派你出去时没有地，但我希望你弃掉一张牌，以换取一个可以产生任何颜色法术力的地衍生物。发挥创意并获得胜利！” - 费顿

Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_NoCardLimit.oracleText: This might sound mad, but I removed the maximum count restriction from these. Use them wisely, as this will certainly require a different strategy than you might be used to. However, if you can take advantage of these effectively, well...there is great power in numbers after all. - Feldon
Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_NoCardLimit.translation: “这听起来可能很疯狂，但我取消了这些东西的最大数量限制。明智地使用它们，因为这肯定需要一个与你可能习惯的不同的策略。但是，如果你可以有效地利用这些优势，那么……毕竟人数众多。” - 费顿

Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_OffMeta.oracleText: "So, you're itching to try something a little different, eh? Well I've got just the thing for you! You won't find the decks everyone else is playing, but that doesn't mean that they don't still pack a serious punch! If you want to have some fun and experiment with some cards that are, let's say 'off the beaten path,' then give these a go!" - Feldon
Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_OffMeta.translation: “那么，你渴望尝试一些不同的东西，是吗？那么，我为你准备了合适的东西！你不会发现其他人都在玩的套牌，但这并不意味着它们不具备严重的冲击力！如果你想找点乐子，并尝试使用一些牌，比方说"不走寻常路"，那就试试这些卡牌吧！” - 费顿

Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Staircase.oracleText: "In life there's never a shortage of the unremarkable, but often you need to climb the proverbial mountain to set your eyes upon the extraordinary. While maybe not as profound, these decks reflect that sentiment in regards to their rarity counts. Specifically there will be a single copy of any mythic card, two copies of a rare, three of uncommon, and four of any common." - Feldon
Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_Staircase.translation: “生活中从不缺少平凡，但往往你需要爬上众所周知的山，才能看到非凡。虽然可能没有那么深刻，但这些套牌在稀有性方面反映了这种情绪。具体来说，将有一张任意秘稀牌的副本、两张稀有牌、三张非凡牌和四张普通牌。” - 费顿

Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_TasteOfIkoria.oracleText: "Heading out to unfamiliar new lands for the first time can be equal parts exciting and unnerving. To help prepare you for some of the things you'll encounter, I've put together a bit of a sampler, or test run of sorts, of what you can expect from this plane. Give them all a try and you'll come out the other side significantly more prepared for the real thing." - Feldon
Events/Event_Desc_Workshop_TasteOfIkoria.translation: “第一次前往陌生的新土地可能既令人兴奋又令人不安。为了帮助你为你将遇到的一些事情做好准备，我已经把你可以从时空期待获取的东西放在一起，或者说是试运行。试一试，你会为真正的事情做好充分的准备。” - 费顿

Events/Event_Desc_Worlds_2020.oracleText: The Magic World Championship XXVI is happening this weekend on MTG Arena! Tune in to live event coverage and see which of the 16 incredible competitors will win the title of World Champion and their share of the $1,000,000 prize pool. Join the fun and #FindYourChampion by selecting a Worlds competitor! We'll provide decks for use during this event. Matches are best-of-one, and you can swap decks between games.
Events/Event_Desc_Worlds_2020.translation: 第XXVI届万智牌世界冠军赛将于本周末在MTG竞技场举行！敬请锁定现场赛事报道，16位顶尖选手将为瓜分高达1,000,000美金的奖金展开激烈角逐，亲眼见证他们的征程，目睹世界冠军的诞生。 参加「#FindYourChampion」活动亲身参与其中！选择一位世界赛参赛选手，本活动中我们将为你提供相应套牌。对局采三局两胜制，你可以在两盘游戏之间交换套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_Worlds_2021.oracleText: The Magic World Championship XXVII is happening this weekend on MTG Arena! Tune in to live event coverage and follow these 16 incredible competitors as they fight for the title of World Champion! Join in on the fun by selecting a Worlds competitor and taking their deck for a spin. See if you have what it takes to play with the best of the best! Matches are best-of-one, and you can swap decks as much as you want.
Events/Event_Desc_Worlds_2021.translation: 第XXVII届万智牌世界冠军赛本周末正在MTG竞技场激战正酣！敬请锁定赛事直播。16位顶尖选手将展开激烈角逐，你能够亲眼见证赛事征程，目睹世界冠军诞生！ 你还有机会拿起套牌亲自体验！选择一位世界赛参赛选手，拿起他们的套牌加入活动。看看你是否有实力驾驭高手神兵！活动对局为一盘定胜负，且你可以任意更换套牌。

Events/Event_Desc_XLN_Quick_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win!
Events/Event_Desc_XLN_Quick_Draft.translation: 轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！

Events/Event_Desc_Y22SNC_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs that include cards from the latest Alchemy release. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players The Five Families The Obscura: Craft the perfect draws and use superior intelligence over a long game to engineer a route to victory. Use the family's connive mechanic to draw, then discard - giving your creatures +1/+1 counters along the way! The Maestros: Hire expendable underlings as your family's muscle on the streets. Then use the casualty mechanic to sacrifice those minions, copy your spells, and blast your opponent. The Riveteers: The Riveteers rumble with large creatures. Give your creatures haste with the blitz mechanic, then sacrifice them at the end of your turn to draw a card. Keep that pressure up! Then press your advantage to crush your opponents. The Cabaretti: Flood the board with tokens and small creatures to overwhelm the opposition. The family knows how to collaborate for greater gain: alliance abilities give you additional effects whenever another creature enters the battlefield under your control. The Brokers: The Brokers are always ready to take down your opponents one notch at a time. Attack relentlessly to deal small amounts of damage, and mount an impenetrable defense - legal or otherwise! - by amassing shield counters on your creatures.
Events/Event_Desc_Y22SNC_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽用炼金补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！ 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽 五大家族 秘闻帮：在漫长的比赛中制作完美的平局并使用卓越的智慧来设计通往胜利的路线。使用家族的筹谋机制来抓牌，然后弃牌——在你的生物上放置 +1/+1 指示物! 绝艺盟: 雇佣可消耗的下属作为你的家族在街头的力量。然后利用催命机制来牺牲这些小兵，复制你的咒语，并轰击你的对手。 勤工联: 铆工们用大型生物轰鸣。用急袭机制给你的生物以敏捷异能，然后在你的回合结束时牺牲它们来抽一张牌。保持这种压力! 然后发挥你的优势，击溃你的对手。 乐舞会: 用指示物和小生物铺满桌面以压制对手。家族知道如何合作以获得更大的收益：每当另一个生物在你的控制下进入战场，联手异能附加额外效应。 扶济社: 扶济社总是有所准备，将对手层层击溃。无情攻击造成少量伤害，但建立坚不可摧的防御 - 合法或其他！ - 通过在你的生物上积累后盾指示物。

Events/Event_Desc_Y23BRO_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs that include cards from the latest Alchemy release. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Soldiers Gather your Soldiers and overwhelm your opponent on the ground and in the skies. Draw Power Draw a multitude of cards from your deck to keep the knowledge flowing and strengthen your creatures at the same time! Artifact Sacrifice Fuel the fight by sacrificing artifacts. Powerstones rev your engines and can later be sacrificed for more power! Don't forget artifacts with unearth can be sacrificed twice! Mechanized Stompy Use Powerstones to deploy your biggest threats quickly. Back them up with power-boosting spells to dominate every fight! Artifacts Enter the Battlefield Assemble your crew of creatures that are enhanced when artifacts enter the battlefield, then use Powerstones, Soldier tokens, and unearthed creatures to power up your attacks. Scrappy Swarm Deploy your army early, but don't be afraid to fill the graveyard. Creatures with mana value three or less offer more than you might expect, alive or dead. Prowess Aggro Round up a squad of inventors and wizards that can utilize cheap artifacts, instants, and sorcery spells to press their advantage. Graveyard Counter In an endless war, your creatures that rely on a populated graveyard will be pleased as their power increases well into the late game. Unearth Aggro Start your aggression early, and the second wave that comes back with Unearth may just be the last you need. Powerstone Ramp Accumulate Powerstones to help build your defenses, and soon no one will stand a chance against your colossal army of colossuses.
Events/Event_Desc_Y23BRO_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，最新炼金系列的牌张也包含其中，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！ 牌手轮抽～与其他7位牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制 士兵 召集士兵，从陆空两路碾压对手。 抓牌之力 从套牌里抓起大量牌张，让知识保持流动，同时强化你的生物！ 神器牺牲 牺牲神器来燃旺战火。魔力石让你的引擎快速运行，之后还能牺牲来获得更多能量！别忘了，具破坟异能的神器可以牺牲两次！ 机械化猛袭 利用魔力石尽快部署你最强大的威胁。用增加力量的咒语辅助它们打赢每一次战斗！ 神器登场 集结会因为神器进战场而变强的生物，然后利用魔力石、士兵衍生物和破坟生物来让攻势更加猛烈。 废品大军尽早部署军队，放胆填充坟墓场。法术力值为三或更低的生物都大有可为，无论生死。 灵技快攻 集合一支发明家小队，利用低费的神器、瞬间和法术咒语来获得优势。 坟场回击 在一场无止尽的战争中，你那些依赖丰沛坟墓场的生物会非常高兴，随着游戏进入后期，它们会变得愈发强力。 破坟快攻 尽早开始攻势，利用破坟异能发动的第二波攻势或许就能决定胜负。 魔力石加速 积累魔力石，用以组织起防线，很快就没人能抵挡你的巨像大军。

Events/Event_Desc_Y23DMU_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs that include cards from the latest Alchemy release. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Fliers Tempo Hold your ground with tokens and defensive instants and sorceries, all while attacking from the air. Control Develop a long-term advantage with card draw and creature removal spells, then go after your opponent directly in the late game. Reckless Aggro Throw caution to the wind and assault your opponent, clearing a path with creature removal spells or by simply trading your creatures for theirs. Domain Stompy Rule the board by attacking with the largest creatures on the battlefield, boosted by the domain mechanic. Domain Tokens Assemble a massive army of creatures and tokens, then dominate the mid-game with the domain mechanic. Creature Sacrifice Ruthlessly sacrifice your small creatures or tokens for profit, then bring creatures back from the graveyard to overwhelm your opponent. Spells Aggro Cast instant and sorcery spells to bolster aggressive creatures and clear a path to victory. Domain Midrange Get maximum value out of your cards with huge creatures, bringing cards back from the graveyard, and domain rewards. Tokens Aggro Go wide with an aggressive army of small creatures and tokens, punching through your opponent's defenses with spells and effects that boost your whole team. Kicker Ramp Build up your mana to get additional value from kicking your spells. Splash in some other colors to take advantage of powerful multicolor cards and the domain mechanic.
Events/Event_Desc_Y23DMU_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽用炼金补充包在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构筑一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！ 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽 飞行节奏 用衍生物和防御性的瞬间和法术进行地面防御，同时从空中进行攻击。 控制 利用抓牌和生物移除咒语形成长期优势，然后在游戏后期直接追击你的对手。 无情快攻 将谨慎抛诸脑后，直接攻击你的对手，用生物移除咒语扫清道路，或者简单地用你的生物交换他们的生物。 领土风暴 通过使用战场上最大的生物进行攻击，在领土机制的推动下，统治棋盘。 领土衍生物 组建一支庞大的生物和衍生物大军，然后用领土机制主宰游戏中期。 生物牺牲 无情地牺牲你的小生物或衍生物以获得收益，然后将生物从坟墓场带回来压倒你的对手。 法术快攻释放瞬间和法术咒语来振励好斗异能生物，并扫清通往胜利的道路。 领土中速 使用巨大的生物让你的牌发挥最大价值，将牌从坟墓场中带回，并获得领土的加成效果。 衍生物快攻 使用由小生物和衍生物组成的侵略性大军，用可以提升整个团队的咒语和效应来突破对手的防御。 增幅暴费 使用增幅类咒语获得额外法术力建立优势，加上一些其它颜色卡牌以更好利用多色和领土优势。

Events/Event_Desc_Y23ONE_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs that include cards from the latest Alchemy release. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Artifacts Phyrexia is filled with glorious artifacts. Gather as many of these artifacts as you can to outmaneuver your opponent. Proliferate Control Use proliferate to spread the glory of Phyrexia—oil counters, poison counters, and loyalty counters are all ready to be proliferated. Oil Counters & Sacrifice All Phyrexians are valuable, even (and sometimes especially) in death. Use your creatures and artifacts to generate oil counters when they die. Oil Counters Midrange The more things with oil counters you have, the merrier. Use these oil counters to get the biggest, smashiest creatures you can. Toxic Aggro Take advantage of small toxic creatures, especially Mite tokens, to swarm your opponent. Corrupted Give your opponent three or more poison counters, then your corrupted cards become even more powerful. Oil Counters & Noncreature Spells Build up your oil counters and overwhelm your opponent by casting a variety of artifacts, enchantments, instants, sorceries, and yes, even planeswalkers! Poison Victory You have the biggest baddest creature with toxic. Use them to get your opponent to 10 poison counters. For Mirrodin! Equipment Someone's got to fight against the Phyrexians! Your rebels can use equipment to stave them off! Proliferate & Poison Two great tastes that go great together. Use green creatures with toxic to deal out serious poison counters, then proliferate to finish the job.
Events/Event_Desc_Y23ONE_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，其中包含最新炼金系列牌张，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 牌手轮抽～与其他7位牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制 神器非瑞克西亚神器阵容壮丽无匹。尽量多收集神器来降伏对手。 增殖控制利用增殖散播非瑞克西亚荣光～烁油指示物、中毒指示物和忠诚指示物都可以增殖。 烁油指示物和牺牲非瑞克西亚人不论死活都极具价值（有时死的更有用）。充分运用在死去时会产生烁油指示物的生物和神器。 烁油指示物中速烁油指示物多多益善。利用这些烁油指示物得到最强悍的大生物。 下毒猛袭利用小型下毒生物（尤其是虫械衍生物）大举淹没你的对手。 腐化让对手获得三个或更多中毒指示物后，你的腐化牌就会变得更强大。 烁油指示物和非生物咒语壮大烁油指示物的数量，并施放各种神器、结界、瞬间、法术甚至是鹏洛客来击溃对手。 用毒致胜你有最大最凶的下毒生物。利用它们让对手获得十个中毒指示物。 「秘罗万岁！」武具总得有人站出来同非瑞克西亚人斗争！反抗军可用武具来抵挡他们的进攻！ 增殖和中毒这两个好东西能完美契合。利用具下毒异能的绿色生物让对手获得大量中毒指示物，然后通过增殖来决定战局。

Events/Event_Desc_Y24LCI_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs that include cards from the latest Alchemy release. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Oltec Ingenuity Buy time with blockers, removal, and lifegain while you assemble an array of wondrous artifacts to take over the late game. Echoes of the Dead Set up to block while you fill your graveyard, then drag your opponent into the deep end with high-cost creatures, card draw, and recursive threats. Going Down! Keep your creatures growing by attacking viciously to make your opponent block or throwing permanents into the graveyard yourself. Then keep them down with creature removal. Dinosaurs of the Sun Empire Summon gigantic dinosaurs to crush the opposition, supporting them with ways to make more mana or break through blockers. Malamet Tactics Keep the pressure on with low-cost creatures. When your opponent tries to set up a defense, it's time to pounce by powering up your forces. Dusk Legion Pilgrimage Sacrifice little creatures and artifacts for the glory of Aclazotz (and additional resources). Once you smell blood, seal their fate with a few larger creatures. Pirates' Plunder Set sail with a rowdy crew and their haul of Equipment and Treasure. When those landlubbers try to stop you, fly over the top or throw their blockers overboard. Fungal Festering Muck up the battlefield with sticky creatures while you fill your graveyard. Once you've descended enough to power your side up, start grinding your way through the opposing blockers. Thousand-Moon Legion Launch your military campaign with lots of small creatures and artifacts, then tactically tap those resources to activate your forces and rout the invaders. River Herald Expedition Go exploring to stock your side with lands and powerful creatures, then sink your extra mana into activated abilities and card draw to drown the opposition in value.
Events/Event_Desc_Y24LCI_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包（包含最新炼金系列）在桌上轮转，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 牌手轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制。 欧尔特克巧艺利用阻挡生物、去除咒语和获得生命争取喘息之机，同时拼组强力神器以在游戏后期掌控战局。 念世亡灵利用生物构筑强力防线，同时设法填充自己的坟墓场，最后利用高费生物、抓牌咒语和重用威胁将对手拖入绝望深渊。 一落到底！猛烈攻击，逼迫对手阻挡，甚至主动将永久物送入坟墓场，如此来持续壮大你的生物。然后利用生物去除咒语压制敌人。 烈阳帝国恐龙召唤巨型恐龙粉碎对手，利用各种产生法术力的方式将它们带进战场，驱使它们突破敌方防线。 豹族战法利用大量低费用生物持续施加压力。倘若对手试图巩固防线，便可以增强自身生物，重拳出击。 暮影军团朝圣牺牲小型生物和神器换取阿洛佐兹的荣耀（和其他资源）。一旦你闻到血腥味，便可以派出少数大型生物终结对战。 海盗劫夺集结好事船员，带上武具和珍宝，扬帆起航。如果有旱鸭子想要阻止你，那就飞越它们，或者把对手的阻挡者扔进海里。 真菌溃伤利用坚韧的生物搅乱战场，同时填充自己的坟墓场。待到已有足够落坟来增强己方军势，便可一路碾压对手防线，直捣黄龙。 千月军团派出大量小型生物和神器发动攻势，然后利用这些资源横置对手取得战术优势，令己方部队占据上风，将入侵者全数击溃。 川流使探险不断勘察，利用地牌和强力生物不断增强己方实力，然后将额外的法术力用于起动异能或施放抓牌咒语，好用资源优势淹没对手。

Events/Event_Desc_Y24MKM_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs that include cards from the latest Alchemy release. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Detectives Get on your opponent's case with this fast midrange strategy. Leverage Detective typal bonuses to overwhelm your opponent's defenses, and sacrifice Clues to refill your hand in the late game. Clues Control Use defensive spells to extend the game and generate Clues, then turn the excess mana into a card advantage that will bury your opponent in a mountain of value. Suspect Aggro Suspected creatures have menace and can't block. Keep attacking with your suspicious characters, and your opponents will be helpless to stop them. Big Disguise Spend the early game accelerating your mana and setting up a face-down board state, then beat down your opponent's side of the board by flipping over haymaker after haymaker. Go-Wide Disguise Flood the battlefield with face-down creatures and accrue impressive rewards whenever they're turned face up. Pint-Size Disguise Face-down creatures bolster your strategy, which rewards playing creatures with power 2 or less and boosting them to become more impressive attackers. Artifact Sacrifice Generate and sacrifice Clue tokens strategically to gain a massive card advantage over your opponent. Then, chip away at their defenses by attacking with evasive Thopters that bring death from above. Gravebreak Use the collect evidence mechanic and raise the dead to support a long-game strategy that gives you extra value whenever a creature card leaves your graveyard. Battalion This classic Ravnican strategy adds extra punch to aggressive red and white creatures by providing a bonus whenever you attack with three or more of them. Collect Evidence Rapidly fill up your graveyard and collect evidence to power up your spells while amassing permanents that reward you each time you do so.
Events/Event_Desc_Y24MKM_Premier_Draft.translation: 从传过来的最新炼金系列轮抽补充包中一次选一张牌。这些牌会加入你的收藏。你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一套40张的套牌。进行游戏并基于你的胜场获得奖励！ 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽 集结侦探 以这种快节奏中速策略来解决对手：充分利用侦探特有的额外价值压垮对手的防线并在游戏后期牺牲线索补充手牌。 线索控制 使用防御咒语拉长战线并派出线索，然后将多余的法术力转化成手牌优势最终以海量资源埋葬对手。 怀疑快攻 遭疑生物具有威慑异能且不能阻挡。用遭疑角色持续进攻，在他们的攻势下你的对手会陷入绝望。 巨型伪装 在游戏前期加速法术力并将匿伏生物铺满你的版图，接着将它们翻面施以拳拳重击击倒对手。 铺场伪装 召唤海量匿伏生物，每当他们翻面时，不断获取惊人回报。 微型伪装 通过匿伏生物帮助实现你的计策：通过打出力量等于或小于2的生物获得回报并增强他们使之成为更有力的进攻者。 神器牺牲 机智地派出和牺牲线索衍生物来赢得巨大的卡差优势，然后用带穿透的振翼机进攻蚕食对手防线，从空中击败对手。 破坟而出 利用搜证机制和掘坟来支撑该长盘战略：每当一张生物牌离开你的坟场时给予你额外价值。 集结军队 每当你以三个或更多生物攻击时能提供额外价值——这种经典的拉尼卡策略让本身就极具进攻性的红白生物如虎添翼。 搜集证据 快速填充你的坟场并通过搜证强化你的咒语，同时积攒让你每次搜证获得回报的永久物。

Events/Event_Desc_Y24OTJ_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs that include cards from the latest Alchemy release. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Take a Break Keep your guard up. Use the plot mechanic and cards with flash to pass your turn with mana available, ready for anything. Crimes Keep targeting your opponents and their stuff turn after turn. You're looking to play a long game, but your constant heists will leave your opponents less than prepared. Outlaws Assemble a crew of Assassins, Mercenaries, Pirates, Rogues, and Warlocks. This motley crew of outlaws will find ways to work together to wear down your opponents. Power 4+ Big creatures are usually their own reward, but this set steps it up. Boost your forces with spells or Mercenary tokens and let the onslaught begin. Mount There's a whole stable of Mounts eager to charge into battle. Every time a Mount attacks backed by some skilled riders, you'll reap more rewards. Saddle up! Attrition Your permanents are here for a good time, not a long time. Sacrifice shamelessly, block fearlessly, and attack aggressively. Every loss is another opportunity for a larger gain. Second Spell Sling your spells in one-two bursts. Low mana value cards and plotted cards enable combinations of two or more spells in a turn, unlocking a flurry of bonuses. Creatures in the Graveyard You only live once? Hardly. Your cards can bring fallen creatures back to the fray or simply take advantage of the number of creature cards in your graveyard. Mercenary Aggro You might not have the biggest creatures, but you have the most aggressive ones. Mercenary tokens will pump the power of your creatures so you can keep making good attacks when opposition arrives. Plot Set your mastermind plans into motion with the plot mechanic. Your opponents may see them coming but that doesn't mean they'll be able to stop them. Control the battlefield and strike when the time is right.

Enchanting Slumber Assemble a team of flying Faeries and support them with tricky spells and creature removal to win the long game. The Dark Piper Create a massive number of Rat tokens to swarm past your opponent's defenses. Be aggressive and take advantage of cards that reward you for your attackers trading off in combat. Ruby and the Wolf Call forth what lurks in the wilderness of Eldraine , summoning high-powered creatures or enhancing your small creatures with Roles and combat tricks. Armont and the Beasts Gather an army of creatures and get bonuses for enchanting them with Roles and other Auras, then go all-out when you have the upper hand. Pale as Snow Make use of the bargain and Role mechanics and get rewarded for your creatures and enchantments going to the graveyard. The Magician's Misstep Go aggressive or be more controlling with a flurry of bewitching instants and sorceries to keep your opponent off balance. Greta, Witch Hunter Creature removal and life gain will help stave off your opponent's attacks until you're able to command the board with big creatures and Food rewards. Brawl at the Grand Ball Enhance your creatures with Roles and take advantage of the celebration mechanic with low-mana aggressive creatures and spells. The Kingdom of Storms Use defensive creatures and spells to buy time while you build up your lands. Reward yourself by casting spells that cost five mana or more to dominate the late game.
Events/Event_Desc_Y24WOE_Premier_Draft.translation: 从传递中的最新炼金系列轮抽补充包中一次选一张牌。这些牌会加入你的收藏。你将使用这些牌加上基本地来构筑一套40张的套牌。进行游戏并基于你的胜场获得奖励！ 真人轮抽～和其他七位玩家共同进行的限时轮抽 冰霜女王通过横置对手的生物和带领飞行大军遨游天际掌控战斗的走向。 迷人醉眠集结一队飞行仙灵并辅以诡计咒语和生物去除来赢得长盘胜利。 黑暗笛手派出潮水般的老鼠衍生物淹没对手的防线。保持激进并善用卡牌让你从进攻生物的战斗交换中获得回报。 小红玉与恶狼召唤强大的高攻生物或利用角色灵气和战斗诡计增强弱小生物，从中唤醒潜藏在艾卓幻野的神秘力量。 娅蒙与野兽集结一队生物大军并通过结附角色及其他灵气获益。当你取得场面优势时全力进攻。 苍白如雪充分利用加码和角色机制让你的生物和结界进入坟墓场时给予回报。 魔术师的失策激进地进攻或走控制：通过施放法术和瞬间搅乱战场让对手场面失衡。 女巫猎人格蕾特在生物去除和生命回复的帮助下拖延对手的进攻直到你能够通过强大生物和食品回报掌控战场。 堂皇舞宴喧闹用角色灵气增强你的生物并通过低费进攻生物和咒语来善加利用欢庆机制。 风暴王国使用防御性生物和咒语为你积累足够地牌拖延时间，最终通过施放5费及以上咒语获取回报接管游戏后期。

Events/Event_Desc_Y25BLB_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs that include cards from the latest Alchemy release. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Birdfolk Birds bring bonuses! Cast fliers who air-drop buffs on your non-flying creatures. Make sure to have a healthy balance of fliers and non-fliers so you always have a target. Ratfolk Slow down your opponent with strong blockers and creature removal. Fill up your graveyard to unlock your Rats' Threshold abilities, then use them to close out the game. Lizardfolk Start small and go big. This BR deck uses a variety of artifact synergies, including the infamous affinity, to summon powerhouses from Magic's past and future. Raccoonfolk Ramp up your mana early to cast big Raccoons that dominate the battlefield. Include a few extra cards with high mana values to help trigger the Expend ability, but not so many that you fall behind early in the game. Rabbitfolk Assemble as many Rabbits and Rabbit tokens as you can. Look for spells and effects that reward you for having lots of creatures in play or pump up your whole team in combat. Batfolk Deploy an army of flying Bats and reap rewards for gaining or losing life during your turn. Mix in some good blockers and defensive spells to slow your opponent down while you attack in the air. Otterfolk Otters love when you cast instant and sorcery spells and will reward you for doing so. Aim for fewer creatures and varied spells, especially ones that help you control the battlefield. Squirrelfolk Dominate the mid game with big creatures and creature removal spells. Look for ways to fill your graveyard and create Food to take advantage of the Squirrels' Forage mechanic. Mousefolk Mice always prefer to be on the attack, so include plenty of aggressive, low mana value creatures. Support them with Equipment and combat-enhancing spells and abilities to trigger the Valiant ability. Frogfolk Make use of creatures with abilities that trigger when they enter the battlefield. Many Frogs have ways of blinking creatures or returning them to your hand. With all that extra value, you'll be strong in the late game.

Events/Event_Desc_Y25DFT_Premier_Draft.translation: 从包含最新炼金系列牌张的轮抽补充包中每次选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 真人轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制 神器价值 在场面上积累神器，最后用你的竞速机器人大军碾压对手！ 神器血祭 机器人与诡异玩具的完美配合，让对手在恐惧中不断流失生命。 速度极限快攻 加速到速度极限，将对手碾为赛道尘埃。 竭绝中速 烧光所有燃料，让窜天鬼队成长为不可阻挡的庞然大物！ 载具&坐骑中速 阿拉奇亚捷兽队的卓越驾手将驾驭你的坐骑与载具冲过终点线。 速度极限消耗 阿芒凯豪杰队紧踩油门直到速度极限，释放僵尸军团发起猛攻。 弃牌快攻 预备！通过循环和弃牌来强化海盗，将对手从甲板上扔出去。 坟墓场 填满坟墓场并不断复活威胁，从赛道残骸中崛起制胜。 载具&坐骑快攻 路怒症发作！鼎云侠队的凶猛攻势将迫使对手节节败退。 竭绝Ramp 乙太流浪者队法术力充足，用异能作为燃料为生物注入爆发巨力。

Events/Event_Desc_Y25DSK_Premier_Draft.oracleText: Select one card at a time from rotating draft packs that include cards from the latest Alchemy release. The cards will be added to your collection, and you'll use them plus basic lands to build a 40-card deck. Play games and receive prizes based on how many games you win! Player Draft - A timed draft with 7 other players Eerie Investigation Search the House! Play lots of enchantments and unlock Rooms to power up your creatures and get around all the horrifying blockers the house might throw your way. Eerie Domination Live out your worst nightmares and share them with your opponent, unlocking Rooms and playing enchantments to kill off their creatures and seize control of the game. BR Serial Sacrifice Want to slash through opposing creatures and your opponent with ease? Pay the price for strength by sacrificing your own creatures and old Rooms. Delirious Rampage Fill your deck with artifact and enchantment creatures (along with other card types), then start attacking early and often. Once you get four different card types into your graveyard, your cards power up. Now go for the jugular! Survival Utilize all of Duskmourn's tricks to power up your creatures and help them smash their way to safety. Find other ways to tap them and hide until the danger's past. Cultic Reanimation All hail Valgavoth! Slow your opponent down while you get enormous monsters into your graveyard and then perform the rituals to return them to life. Room after Room The House never ends! Trap your opponent going in circles as you unlock Rooms to build up control of more and more territory, then unleash the ghosts held within for a frightening finish. Grinding Delirium Prioritize getting a wide variety of card types, then gum up the board as you fill your graveyard with them. Once you've got four types, grind your opponent to dust by recycling what you've thrown away. Childhood Fears Fill your deck with toys and clowns that have 2 or less power and start attacking! Smash your opponents swiftly by clearing out their blockers and buffing your little creatures. Manifest Dread Something's lurking in the shadows. Manifest face-down creatures and get them into combat, then surprise your opponent with their true forms to outsize the competition.
Events/Event_Desc_Y25DSK_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽用补充包在桌上轮转，最新炼金系列的牌张也包含其中，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据你的胜场数量赢得奖励！ 真人轮抽～与7位其他牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制。 异景调查 搜索这座宅邸！多多使用结界和解锁房间来强化你的生物，绕过宅邸抛给你的所有恐怖阻挡者。 异景支配 体验你最糟糕的噩梦并与对手分享，解锁房间并使用结界来消灭他们的生物，夺取游戏的控制权。 红黑连环牺牲 想轻松斩杀对手的生物和对手吗？通过牺牲由你操控的生物和旧房间作为代价以换取力量。 狂暴横行 用神器和结界生物（以及其他牌张类别）填满你的套牌，然后尽早频繁地攻击。一旦你在坟墓场中拥有四种不同的牌张类别，你的牌就会被强化。现在，直击要害吧！ 生还 利用暮悲邸的所有诡计来强化你的生物，帮助他们一路打破阻碍，安全脱身。找到其他方式来横置它们，躲避直到危险过去。 邪教复生 瓦伽沃万岁！减缓你的对手，同时将巨大的怪物送入你的坟墓场，然后进行仪式将它们复活。 房间接着房间 这座宅邸永无止境！当你解锁房间以建立对更多领地的控制时，让你的对手晕头转向，然后释放其中隐藏的幽灵，迎接恐怖终局。 碾磨躁狂 优先获得各种不同的牌张类别，当你用它们填满坟墓场时，阻碍场面威胁。一旦你拥有四种类别，通过循环利用你丢弃的东西，将对手碾为尘土。 童年阴影 用力量等于或小于2的玩具和小丑填满你的套牌，开始攻击！清除他们的阻挡者并强化你的小生物，迅速击败对手。 显化惧象 有东西潜伏在阴影中。显化牌面朝下的生物并让它们进入战斗，然后用它们的真面目给对手一个惊喜，扭转胜局。

Events/Event_Desc_Y25TDM_Premier_Draft.translation: 轮抽补充包在桌上轮转，其中包含最新炼金系列牌张，你每次需从中选择一张牌。这些牌张将加入你的收藏，而你将使用它们和基本地来构组一副40张的套牌。不断进行对战，最后根据胜场数量赢得奖励！ 真人轮抽～与其他7位牌手一同进行轮抽，有抽选时间限制 玛尔都动员 派出额外的衍生物来帮助你进行攻击。 衍生物铺场 用数量优势冲击你的对手。使用动员的衍生物和连咒收益来建立非凡场面。 洁斯凯连咒 在一个回合内施放两个（或更多！）咒语来压倒你的对手。 两次咒语 频繁使用谐颂咒语以获取连咒收益。 铁木尔谐颂 让你最大的生物帮助你施放两次咒语。 离开坟场 填满你的坟墓场，然后使用动员或复新之类的获得卡牌离开你坟墓场的奖励。 苏勒台复新 利用坟墓场的力量使你的生物更强大。 指示物 使用任何类型的指示物，不仅仅是+1/+1指示物，让你的生物在战斗中鹤立鸡群。 阿布赞续战 你的生物多才多艺！用+1/+1指示物压倒对手或用精怪衍生物包抄他们。 牺牲 牺牲你的额外生物，比如从战群获得的临时生物，充分利用这些生物。

Events/Event_Desc_Yargle_Day_2020.oracleText:
When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body. Today, we celebrate that spirit, everyone's pal, Yargle!

We asked Yargle how best to celebrate, and here's how we interpreted its gurgles and shrieks:
- Yargle makes the rules! Yargle has provided decks for everyone to use, and we've even cleaned most of the slime off of them.
- Yargle is the center of attention! Yargle is the only non-common card allowed, and you'll have plenty of extras so you won't run out.
- Yargle is special! Yargle will be faster to get into the fight, so nobody has to have fun alone.

Join us for a rip-roaring good time with a spirit of a frog which ate a maggot that was actually a transformed lieutenant of a demon. Happy Yargle Day, everyone!
Events/Event_Desc_Yargle_Day_2020.translation:
贝赞洛的副手雅库开始展露野心，恶魔领主便把他变成一条蛆虫。有只青蛙吞下了这条蛆虫后不断变大，最终贪食的精怪从其体内破膛而出。今天，我们庆祝这种精神，每个人的朋友，雅骨尔！

我们询问了雅骨尔如何最好地庆祝，以下是我们如何解释它的咯咯声和尖叫声：
- 雅骨尔制定了规则! 雅骨尔提供了套牌供大家使用，我们甚至已经把套牌上的大部分粘液清理干净了。
- 雅骨尔是关注的焦点! 雅骨尔是唯一允许使用的非普通卡，你会有大量的额外卡，所以你不会用完。
- 雅骨尔很特别! 雅骨尔会更快地进入战斗，所以没有人必须独自享受乐趣。

加入我们的行列，与一只吃了蛆的青蛙精怪一起度过一段撕心裂肺的美好时光，这只青蛙实际上是一个恶魔的变身副官。各位，雅骨尔日快乐！

Events/Event_Desc_Yargle_Day_2021.oracleText:

This year, Yargle has invited several friends who share its interests and general lopsidedness, and everyone's squaring off in a Historic Brawl showdown. Of course, it's Yargle's day, so the rules might be a little lopsided to boot, but who's counting? Choose your favorite champion and celebrate in style! Happy Yargle Day, everyone!

Events/Event_Desc_YawningPortal.oracleText: "Welcome to the Yawning Portal, finest tavern in Waterdeep! You look like you've come to try your luck down the Well, right? I hope you've come ready, for your sake." At the center of this boisterous tavern is a 40-foot-wide, seemingly bottomless stone-rimmed well. It leads to the treacherous dungeon of Undermountain, for those bold enough to make the descent. You step up and grip the rope, wondering what you will face down below... Bring a 60-card Singleton deck that's ready to explore: when you cast two spells during a turn, you'll venture into the dungeon. At the end of your run, you'll receive rulebook card styles from Adventures in the Forgotten Realms as loot. There are 27 styles to collect! For more details on this format, including a full list of card styles available to find in the dungeon, click here.
Events/Event_Desc_YawningPortal.translation: “欢迎来到打呵欠之门，深水城最好的酒馆！你看起来是来井下试试运气的，对吧？我希望你已经准备好了，为你着想。” 在这个喧闹的小酒馆的中心是一口40英尺宽、看似无底的石缘井。对于那些胆大妄为的人来说，它通向地脉迷城的危险地城。你站起来抓住绳子，想知道你会在下面面对什么...... 带上60张无双套牌探索吧：当你在一个回合中施放两个咒语时，你将深入地城。在你的旅程结束时，你会从被遗忘国度战记 获得规则书卡牌样式作为战利品。有 27 种款式可供收藏！ 有关此赛制的更多详细信息，包括可在地牢中找到的卡牌样式的完整列表，请单击此处。

Events/Event_FIN_DraftArchetypes.oracleText:
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU">  Artifacts    
Calling all Machinists! Build up your arsenal by playing artifacts, including artifact creatures and token generating Equipment, then gain extra bonuses for playing those artifacts.  
  
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"> Control    
Scheme and act in secret. Dominate the long game with strategies like removal spells, card draw, and tricky creatures. Cast flashback spells to crush foes under the weight of the past!  
 
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR">  Black Mage Aggro    
Play the aggressive game with creatures that reward you whenever you cast a noncreature spell. Look for cards that create Wizard tokens and turn those spells into a barrage of damage! 
   
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xG">  Landfall Aggro    
Play creatures with landfall abilities, like Chocobos, and earn bonuses as you play lands. Look for ways to play extra lands and strengthen your creatures even further!
    
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xG"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW">  Go Wide    
Call forth a battalion of formidable fighters and play cards that make tokens. Either reinforce your standing army or leverage your high creature count to cast hard-hitting spells!  
  
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB">  Artifact and Creature Sacrifice    
Sacrifice your artifacts and creatures, especially ones with death effects, to steadily gain the upper hand. Token generating Equipment gives you two things to sacrifice!    

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR">  Big Noncreatures    
Whenever you cast spells that cost 4 or more mana, you'll gain bonuses in battle. Find ways to generate tokens, like with special Equipment, so that your noncreature spells can add to your forces! 
   
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xG">  Graveyard Value    
Slow and steady wins the game! Mill to fill your graveyard early with powerful creatures and flashback spells, then bring them back to the fight late in the game to achieve victory.  
  
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW">  Equipment Aggro    
Grab your favorite iconic weapon and rush into battle! Look for creatures that want to be equipped or cards that reward you for having Equipment, then gear up to outclass your opponent. 
   
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xG"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU">  Town Ramp    
Travel the overworld! Towns are lands that grant more perks the more of them you have, so play a bunch and reap the rewards. You'll even want to play some Towns that aren't blue or green, so be sure to splash in some other colors, too!
Events/Event_FIN_DraftArchetypes.translation:
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"> 神器
机工士集结！使用神器——包括神器生物和派出衍生物的武具——来建立你的军火库，然后从神器中赚取额外收益！

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"> 控制
暗中策划并行动。通过使用诸如去除咒语、抓牌和诡计生物等策略来主宰长盘。施放返照咒语，用回忆的分量碾压敌人！

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR"> 黑魔法师快攻
使用那些在你施放非生物咒语时有所回报的生物打出进攻性。寻找能派出法术师衍生物的牌，将这些咒语转化为一连串的伤害！

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xG"> 地落快攻
使用具有地落异能的生物（如陆行鸟），让你在使用地时获得奖励。寻找额外使用地的方法，进一步强化你的生物！

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xG"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW"> 横向展开
召唤一支强大的战士队伍，并使用能派出衍生物的牌。要么增援你的常备军，要么利用你的生物数量施放强力咒语！

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"> 神器与生物牺牲
牺牲你的神器和生物，尤其是那些具有死去效应的，以此稳步获得优势。派出衍生物的武具为你提供了两样可以牺牲的东西！

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR"> 高费非生物
每当你施放费用等于或大于4的咒语时，你将在战斗中获得奖励。寻找派出衍生物的方法（如特殊武具），这样你的非生物咒语也能增强你的部队！

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xG"> 坟场价值
稳扎稳打赢得比赛！早期通过磨牌将强力生物和返照咒语放入坟墓场，然后在游戏后期将它们带回战斗以获得胜利。

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW"> 武具快攻
拿起你最爱的标志性武器，冲入战场！寻找那些希望被装备的生物或在你拥有武具时有所收益的牌，然后装备起来超越你的对手！

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xG"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"> 市镇加速
环游世界！市镇作为地牌，当你拥有的越多，它们提供的额外好处就越多，所以使用一堆市镇来收获奖励。你甚至可以使用一些非蓝非绿的市镇，所以别忘了混些其他颜色！

Events/Event_Preview_Desc_black.oracleText: Beautiful, cunning, and ambitious to a fault, Liliana has mastered the dark art of necromancy. Her spells reanimate the dead and corrupt the living.
Events/Event_Preview_Desc_black.translation: 美丽，狡猾，而充满野心的莉莲娜，擅长运用暗黑魔法死灵术。她的咒语能够操弄亡者，腐化生灵。

Events/Event_Preview_Desc_blue.oracleText: Jace is a master of mental magic: spells of illusion, deception, and mind reading. His powers allow him to manipulate enemies by countering their magic or using their spells against them.
Events/Event_Preview_Desc_blue.translation: 杰斯擅长心灵魔法：幻影、欺瞒，以及读取心灵的咒语。他的力量让他能反击敌对法师的魔法，或以其道反治其身。

Events/Event_Preview_Desc_green.oracleText: Vivien's homeworld was deeply divided between the forest dwellers and an advanced civilization that encircled the dwindling woodlands; she belonged to the Smaragdi, sworn to protect the forest.
Events/Event_Preview_Desc_green.translation: 薇薇安的家园时空有着鲜明的族群对立～栖居深林的原始住民与侵蚀自然土地之先进文明一直冲突不断；碧玉族誓死保卫林地家园，而薇薇安正是其中一员。

Events/Event_Preview_Desc_red.oracleText: There is no virtue in subtlety, at least not as far as Chandra is concerned. She's a confident, ardent, defiant Planeswalker whose specialty is pyromancy: spells of fire, fire, and more fire.
Events/Event_Preview_Desc_red.translation: 缜密没什么好处～至少茜卓纳拉从不挂心这点。她是一名自信满盈，热情似火，桀骜不驯的鹏洛客，她的专长就是烈焰：火焰咒语，火焰，以及更猛的火焰。

Events/Event_Preview_Desc_white.oracleText: Ajani is torn between his leonin ferocity and his sense of justice. Born on Naya, and an outcast within his own family, an albino leonin never accepted by the rest of his pride.
Events/Event_Preview_Desc_white.translation: 金鬃阿耶尼正为狮族天生的凶猛与自己的正义感间的拉锯而烦恼着。他出生于纳雅，却因为是白狮而无法被狮群所接受，遭自己的族类驱逐。

Events/Event_Title_MWM_Cascade_Alchemy_D.oracleText:
Welcome to Midweek Magic! Each week, try out a different way to play MTG Arena!

This week's event is Cascade Alchemy: The first time you cast a spell each turn, you'll get to cast another, less expensive card from your library without paying its mana cost. What a bargain! All you'll need to play is a 60-card Alchemy deck.
Events/Event_Title_MWM_Cascade_Alchemy_D.translation:
欢迎参加周中万智夜！《MTG竞技场》每周玩法花样百出，次次活动都有全新感受！

本周的活动是倾曳炼金：你每回合首度施放咒语时，你将能从你的牌库中施放另一张法术力值较低的牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。真是超值！只需一副60张的炼金套牌即可参加。

Events/MSH_Limited_Archetypes.oracleText: Teamwork - Call on your team to supercharge your instants and sorceries. Find ways to untap those creatures and they'll be available for offense, strategic tap abilities, and protection! Draw Second Card - Be the calculating mastermind and draw two or more cards in a turn. While extra cards are good on their own, clever use of connive will magnify your rewards! Villains Matter - More Villains mean more chaos. Keep adding Villains to the battlefield and overwhelm your adversaries with the unified power of pure evil! Power-Up - Hit hard with great feats of strength. Generate extra lands and mana to bring out the might of your creatures with their power-up abilities. Heroes Matter - Assemble as many Heroes as you can! Go wide with a full roster of fearless fighters and defend the world against any threat. Attack Alone - Send your best operative on a stealthy mission to attack alone, backed up by a support team that's ready to defend you as well. Artifacts - A steady stream of artifacts allows you to invent your way out of impossible odds. Spend Treasures to fund your more advanced research projects. Creatures in Graveyard - Your fallen forces didn't die in vain—reclaim their power with a vengeance! Make more potent plays while there are two or more creature cards in your graveyard. Noncreature Spells - Arrive on the scene quickly with creatures and then back them up with blasty instants and sorceries and crafty artifacts and enchantments. Look for key moments to turn the tables on your foes. +1/+1 Counters - Adjust and adapt to every situation. Keep evolving your creatures by adding counters with your cards or by using their own power-up abilities.
Events/MSH_Limited_Archetypes.translation: 联合 - 召唤你的队伍来为你的瞬间和法术充能。找到重置那些生物的方法，它们就能用于进攻、战略性横置，以及提供保护！ 抓第二张牌 - 成为精于算计的谋士，在一回合内抓两张或更多牌。额外的牌本身就很不错，而巧妙运用筹谋将放大你的收益！ 反派决定一切 - 反派越多，混乱越甚。不断将反派加入战场，用纯粹邪恶的合力压倒你的对手！ 超能 - 凭借强大的力量猛力出击。创造额外的地和法术力，用来释放超能异能的威力。 英雄决定一切 - 尽可能多地集结英雄！用一整队无畏的战士铺开场面，保卫世界抵御任何威胁。 单独攻击 - 派遣你最强的特工执行隐秘任务，进行单独攻击，并由一支随时准备为你提供防御的支援队伍作为后盾。 神器 - 源源不断的神器让你能够通过发明来摆脱绝境。花费珍宝来资助你更先进的研究项目。 坟场生物 - 你倒下的部队并非白白牺牲——带着复仇之心夺回它们的力量！当你的坟墓场中有两张或更多生物牌时，做出更强大的行动。 非生物咒语 - 快速用生物登场，然后用爆炸性的瞬间和法术、以及精巧的神器和结界来支援它们。寻找关键时机来扭转战局，反制你的敌人。 +1/+1指示物 - 调整并适应每一种情况。演化你的生物，运用你的牌张添加指示物，或利用生物自身的超能异能。

Events/SOS_Limited_Archetypes.oracleText:
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"> Silverquill Repartee Aggro — Inspire your creatures with words of affirmation or hurl cutting critiques at your enemies. Either way, get rewarded for casting targeted spells while you press the attack. 

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR"> Prismari Opus Spellcasting — Load up your deck with instants and sorceries and paint the battlefield red and blue! Fire off cheap spells or get a showstopping bonus from spending five or more mana on your opus. 

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xG"> Witherbloom Lifegain Swarm — Build up an army of Pests and other creatures to gain lots of life and overwhelm your opponents. Steady lifegain will also infuse your spells with boosted effects! 

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW"> Lorehold Flashback Excavation — Fill your graveyard and then dig it back up again. When cards leave your graveyard, you'll uncover the power for history-making plays! 

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xG"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"> Quandrix Incremental Value — Grow your creatures with counters as you cast bigger and bigger spells! Accelerate your mana, draw cards, and attack with huge creatures—math isn't just for blockers here.
Events/SOS_Limited_Archetypes.translation:
<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"> 银毫：连辞快攻——以激励之语鼓舞你的生物，或以尖锐的讥讽打击对手。无论方式如何，在你持续进攻的同时，施放指向性咒语都将为你带来额外回报。

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR"> 粹丽：炫丽施法——在套牌中装填大量瞬间与法术，让战场染上红与蓝的色彩！既可连发低费咒语，也可通过投入五点或更多法术力触发炫示，收获震撼全场的额外效果。 

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xB"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xG"> 靡华：生命涌流——集结害虫与其他生物构筑军势，通过持续获取生命值压倒对手。稳定的生命增长还会为你的咒语注入强化效果！

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xR"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xW"> 衡鉴：返照发掘——先填充你的坟墓场，再将其一一发掘。当牌张离开坟墓场时，你将释放足以改写历史的力量！

<sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xG"><sprite="SpriteSheet_ManaIcons" name="xU"> 量析：递增优势——随着你施放费用愈发高昂的咒语，为生物不断累积指示物并壮大它们！加速法术力、抽取牌张，并以巨型生物发起进攻——数学在这里可不只是用来防守的。

Events/TLA_Limited_Archetypes.oracleText: Flyers Take to the skies with Aang and his friends! Gather a team of flyers and soar like an Airbender. Draw Two Hunt for knowledge, using Clues and other draw effects to trigger your second-draw reward cards. The long game is yours! Fire Nation Aggro Everything changes when the Fire Nation attacks! Be aggressive with firebending and burn it on extra effects. Earth Rumble Ramp Use mana ramp and earthbending to create 4+ power creatures, then rack up the bonuses to claim the title belt. Allies A world united is unstoppable. Play Allies and generate tokens to go wide and hit your enemies hard from all sides. Sacrifice Victory comes at a cost. Play small creatures and clues, then gain the upper hand when you sacrifice them. Combat Lessons Play creatures that care about casting noncreature spells, then teach your foes a lesson with your martial prowess! +1/+1 Counters Accrue power by any means! Stack up counters to gain bonuses and control the Earth Kingdom from within. Go Wide Aggro Lead the rebellion with an army of Allies and tokens that you can enhance for devastating attacks. Ramp + Lessons Turn your knowledge into power! Ramp and draw cards to play big creatures while getting Lessons in your graveyard.
Events/TLA_Limited_Archetypes.translation: 飞行生物 与安昂和他的朋友们一起翱翔天际！召集一群飞行生物，像截气师一样展翅高飞。 抓两张牌 探寻知识，利用线索和其他抓牌效应触发你的二次抓牌回报。这场持久战由你掌控！ 烈火国快攻 当烈火国进击之时，一切从此改变！用振火术展开凌厉攻势，并利用额外效果造成重创。 震土赛加速 利用法术力加速和运土术创造力量等于或大于4的生物，然后积累奖励，夺取冠军头衔。 伙伴 团结的世界不可阻挡。打出伙伴并派出衍生物，从四面八方展开全面进攻，给敌人沉重打击。 牺牲 胜利需要付出代价。派出小型生物和线索，然后通过牺牲它们来占据上风。 战斗课程 打出那些与施放非生物咒语相关的生物，然后用你的战技给对手一个教训！ +1/+1指示物 不择手段地积累力量！叠加指示物以获取奖励，并从内部掌控土强国。 横向展开快攻 率领由伙伴和衍生物组成的起义军，强化它们以发动毁灭性攻击。 加速 + 课程 将你的知识转化为力量！加速并抓牌，以便打出大型生物，同时让课程牌进入你的坟墓场。

Events/TMT_Limited_Archetypes.oracleText: Sneaky Ninjas – Strike from the shadows with Leonardo, Splinter, and even the Foot Clan! The Sneak mechanic introduces an element of surprise, perfect for disrupting your enemy's plans. Machines – Take a cue from Donatello and invent your way out of problems by assembling robots and multidimensional artifacts into an unstoppable force! Disappear – As a party dude, Michelangelo makes Pizza disappear. Whenever a permanent you control leaves the battlefield, utilize special abilities to make your opponents disappear too! Alliance - Raphael collects a misfit band of outcasts and loners that help each other overcome any obstacle. As new members join the crew, your creatures pump up their power! Mutagen – Pull the team together with an ever-growing assemblage of Mutants that use Mutagen tokens to grow bigger and weirder!
Events/TMT_Limited_Archetypes.translation: 奇袭忍者——与莱昂纳多、斯普林特乃至大脚帮忍者一同从暗影中出击！奇袭机制带来出其不意的元素，最适合打乱敌人的计划。 机器——效法多纳泰罗，将机器人与多维神器组装成无可阻挡的力量，用发明创造解决问题！ 消失——作为派对狂人，米开朗基罗能让披萨消失无踪。每当你操控的一个永久物离开战场时，利用特殊能力让你的对手也消失！ 联手——拉斐尔召集了一群格格不入的弃儿与独行侠，他们互相帮助以克服任何障碍。随着新成员加入队伍，你的生物会提升力量！ 突变剂——用不断壮大的变异体队伍凝聚团队，它们利用突变剂衍生物变得更大、更怪异！

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Aaron/Desc.oracleText: Aaron: Attack with a 1/1 Nyxbloom Ancient.
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Aaron/Desc.translation: Aaron：以一个1/1的「天华先人」进行攻击。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Adam/Desc.oracleText: Adam: Win the game the same turn you cast Burn Down the House and still control Flubs, the Fool
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Adam/Desc.translation: Adam：在你施放「焚毁房屋」的同一回合赢得游戏，并且仍然操控「愚者法布斯」。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Andy/Desc.oracleText: Andy: Have a human with haste blocked by a cat survive combat
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Andy/Desc.translation: Andy：让一个具敏捷异能的人类被一只猫阻挡并在战斗中存活下来。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Bella/Desc.oracleText: Bella: Have Glasspool Mimic enter as a copy of a bird creature.
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Bella/Desc.translation: Bella：使「璃池拟态妖」当成任一鸟生物的复制品来进入场。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/BenE/Desc.oracleText: Ben E.: Have aninsect creature die who was dealt damage by Soldiers you control.
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/BenE/Desc.translation: Ben E.：让一个曾受到由你操控的士兵伤害的昆虫生物死去。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/BenF/Desc.oracleText: Ben F.: Defeat 2 oozes while you have a full party (cleric, rogue, warrior, wizard)
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/BenF/Desc.translation: Ben F.：在你的冒险团满编（僧侣、浪客、战士、法术师）时击败2个流浆。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Derrik/Desc.oracleText: Derrik: Put a rope on the top of your library (rope or Fifty feet of rope)
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Derrik/Desc.translation: Derrik：将一根绳子放置于你的牌库顶（绳子或「五十英尺长绳」）

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Grace/Desc.oracleText: Grace: Crew a vehicle with charge counters on it with a dog.
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Grace/Desc.translation: Grace：用狗来搭载一个上面有充电指示物的载具。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Grace/Title.oracleText: Take Your Pet to Work Day

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Guy/Desc.oracleText: Guy: Control an Esoteric Duplicator and have it copy a Rogue creature
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Guy/Desc.translation: Guy：操控一个「秘传复制仪」并使其复制一个浪客生物。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Harry/Desc.oracleText: Harry: Deal damage to a wall with Farideh's Fireball and have that wall deal damage to an opponent.
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Harry/Desc.translation: Harry：用「法莉黛的火球」对墙造成伤害，并让该墙对一个对手造成伤害。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/IanA/Desc.oracleText: Ian A.: Attack with gollum and have them guess incorrectly
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/IanA/Desc.translation: Ian A.：用咕噜进行攻击，并让他们猜错。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/IanJ/Desc.oracleText: Ian J.: Attack with a Vehicle with flying that was crewed by a Cat, while you control a Gate to Seatower
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/IanJ/Desc.translation: Ian J.：使用由猫搭载且具飞行异能的载具进行攻击，同时你操控着「海塔之门」。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Jeremy/Desc.oracleText: Jeremy: Cast Gild on an artifact.

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Jordan/Desc.oracleText: Jordan: Destroy Curse of Leeches or Leeching Lurker while you control a cat.
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Jordan/Desc.translation: Jordan：在你操控一只猫的情况下，消灭「血蛭诅咒」或「吮血潜伏妖」。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Luke/Desc.oracleText: Luke: Have night turn to day while you control a camel
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Luke/Desc.translation: Luke：在你操控骆驼时，将黑夜变为白昼。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/MattV/Desc.oracleText: Matt V.: Have a 3 robot creatures die who were dealt damage by Soldiers you control.
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/MattV/Desc.translation: Matt V.：让三个曾受到由你操控的士兵伤害的机器人生物死去。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/MattV_extra.oracleText: (max note: had to redo this one. Original was "Defeat 10 insects and artifact creatures using red, white, and blue sources you control")
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/MattV_extra.translation: （Max注记：这个要重做。原版是"使用由你操控的红色、白色和蓝色来源，击败10个昆虫和神器生物。"）

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Paul/Desc.oracleText: Paul: Attack with a Vehicle with flying that was crewed by an Elk, while you control a Gate to Seatower
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Paul/Desc.translation: Paul：使用由麋鹿搭载且具飞行异能的载具进行攻击，同时你操控着「海塔之门」。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/RyanG/Desc.oracleText: Ryan G.: On the same turn that each player has had a dragon die, end the turn controlling dragon throne of Tarkir
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/RyanG/Desc.translation: Ryan G.：在同一回合中每位牌手都有龙死去，结束回合时操控着「鞑契龙座」。

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Scott/Desc.oracleText: Scott: Eat a hot pocket. (Make tinybones trinket thief -> food and cast coming on hot on it)
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Scott/Desc.translation: Scott：吃一个热口袋。（将「琐物窃贼细骨」变成食品，并对其施放「火热来袭」）

ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Stephanie/Desc.oracleText: Stephanie: Have night turn to day you control at least 10 clowns
ExperimentalFrenzy/Mancom/Stephanie/Desc.translation: Stephanie：在你操控至少10个小丑时，将黑夜变为白昼。

Gatherings/Button/FindFriendsDiscord.translation: 在 <sprite="SpriteSheet_MiscIcons" name="discord_logo_white"> 上寻找好友

Gatherings/CreateAGathering/PrivateGathe.oracleText: Join-by-invite (or request) only. These Gatherings are limited to people approved by the Owner or Admins. Best for groups of friends, or smaller, more controlled communities.
Gatherings/CreateAGathering/PrivateGathe.translation: 仅限邀请（或申请）加入。这些集会仅限所有者或管理员批准的人员进入。最适合好友群组，或是规模较小、易于管理的社群。

Gatherings/CreateAGathering/PublicGather.oracleText: Anyone with the Invite Code can join. These Gatherings are open to all players and may show up in search results in the future. A good choice if you want to meet new people and grow a larger community.
Gatherings/CreateAGathering/PublicGather.translation: 任何拥有邀请码的人均可加入。这些集会对所有玩家开放，且未来可能会出现在搜索结果中。如果你想结识新朋友并发展更庞大的社群，这是一个好选择。

Gatherings/MagicIsBetter.translation: 万智牌与友同乐更精彩。

Gatherings/SystemMessage/ConfirmUnlinkin.oracleText: This will unlink your Arena account from your Discord account.
Gatherings/SystemMessage/ConfirmUnlinkin.translation: 这将解除您的竞技场账号与Discord账号的关联。

Gatherings/SystemMessage/ConnectingText.oracleText: Please accept the connection request via the Discord application.
Gatherings/SystemMessage/ConnectingText.translation: 请通过Discord应用程序接受连接请求。

Gatherings/SystemMessage/ConnectionArena.oracleText: Visible across Discord and all games linked to your account.
Gatherings/SystemMessage/ConnectionArena.translation: 在Discord及所有关联至您账号的游戏中均可见。

Gatherings/SystemMessage/ConnectionArena.oracleText: Only visible when you are logged into Arena and Discord.
Gatherings/SystemMessage/ConnectionArena.translation: 仅在您同时登录竞技场和Discord时可见。

Gatherings/SystemMessage/ConnectionSucce.oracleText: You have successfully connected your Discord account, and can now chat with your friends no matter what plane they walk. Friends you add on Arena will be in-game friends only.
Gatherings/SystemMessage/ConnectionSucce.translation: 您已成功连接Discord账号，现在无论您的好友漫步于哪个时空，您都能与他们随心交流。您在竞技场中添加的好友将仅限为游戏内好友。

Gatherings/SystemMessage/FailedConnectTe.oracleText: There was an issue connecting to Discord.

Gatherings/SystemMessage/UnlinkConfirmed.translation: 账号已成功与Discord解除关联。

Intro/Cinematic/ECL_1.oracleText: Welcome, traveler, to the plane of Lorwyn.
Intro/Cinematic/ECL_1.translation: 欢迎来到洛温时空，旅行者。

Intro/Cinematic/ECL_10.oracleText: It is a world of conflict and unpredictability, where only the strong and the clever survive.
Intro/Cinematic/ECL_10.translation: 这是一个充满冲突与无常的世界，唯有强者与智者能得以幸存。

Intro/Cinematic/ECL_11.oracleText: But if you embrace the danger and step into the darkness, you may find power beyond your wildest dreams.
Intro/Cinematic/ECL_11.translation: 但若你拥抱危险，踏入黑暗，便可能获得比你的狂野梦想更甚的力量。

Intro/Cinematic/ECL_12.oracleText: But what of the places where light and shadow meet? What other mysteries lurk on the boundary of Lorwyn and Shadowmoor? Enter the aurora and discover the answers for yourself!
Intro/Cinematic/ECL_12.translation: 那么光与影交汇之处又是怎样的景象？洛温与暗影荒原的边界还潜藏着哪些奥秘？进入极光之中，亲自探寻答案吧！

Intro/Cinematic/ECL_2.oracleText: Lorwyn is a world of eternal daylight that brims with potent magic.
Intro/Cinematic/ECL_2.translation: 洛温是一个永恒白昼的世界，充盈着强大的魔法。

Intro/Cinematic/ECL_3.oracleText: Most of Lorwyn's inhabitants value harmony above conflict. (wryly) Whenever possible.
Intro/Cinematic/ECL_3.translation: 洛温的大部分居民都重视和谐胜于冲突……（撇嘴）如果可能的话。

Intro/Cinematic/ECL_4.oracleText: Then there are those who are... less agreeable. The world is shifting, and conflict is inevitable.
Intro/Cinematic/ECL_4.translation: 然而，还有一些人……不那么认同。世界正在转变，冲突不可避免。

Intro/Cinematic/ECL_5.oracleText: In Lorwyn, you'll find wonders beyond imagination and possibilities beyond your wildest dreams.
Intro/Cinematic/ECL_5.translation: 在洛温，你将发现超乎想象的奇迹与超越梦想的可能性。

Intro/Cinematic/ECL_6.oracleText: But when the Aurora passes over, the plane twists into something dark and sinister.
Intro/Cinematic/ECL_6.translation: 但当极光掠过，整个时空便会扭曲成黑暗与邪恶的形态。

Intro/Cinematic/ECL_7.oracleText: The shining light of Lorwyn gives way to the unfathomable darkness of Shadowmoor.
Intro/Cinematic/ECL_7.translation: 洛温的璀璨光芒正让位于暗影荒原的深邃黑暗。

Intro/Cinematic/ECL_8.oracleText: Deadly secrets lurk behind every corner, and the plane's inhabitants become selfish and paranoid.
Intro/Cinematic/ECL_8.translation: 致命的秘密潜伏在每个角落，这个时空的居民变得自私又多疑。

Intro/Cinematic/ECL_9.oracleText: Here, everyone fights for themselves, striving to reach their full potential by any means necessary.
Intro/Cinematic/ECL_9.translation: 在这里，每个人都为自己而战，不择手段地追求发挥自身的全部潜力。

Intro/Cinematic/EOE_11.oracleText: ...the greatest danger might be what they're carrying...
Intro/Cinematic/EOE_11.translation: …最大的危险可能源于他们携带之物…

Intro/Cinematic/EOE_2.oracleText: ...over the fate of a dying star.

Intro/Cinematic/EOE_3.oracleText: A squire of the Sunstar Free Company...
Intro/Cinematic/EOE_3.translation: 辉星自由连的一名扈从…

Intro/Cinematic/EOE_8.translation: 面对着层出不穷的敌人…

MainNav/Draft/EventDescription.oracleText:
When you draft, you'll open a Limited booster, pick a card, then pass the rest to another player. Pick a card from what you get passed, then keep going. After three packs like that, build a 40-card deck with basic lands and the cards you picked.
Play against other people and their draft decks. Lose three times, and you're done. The more you win, the more prizes you accumulate!
MainNav/Draft/EventDescription.translation:
轮抽的流程如下：你打开一包限制赛补充包，从中挑选一张牌，然后将剩余的牌传给下一位牌手。之后你接过别人传给你的牌，从中挑选一张，以此类推。在如此重复三包之后，你需要利用你抽到的牌加上适当数量的基本地，构筑出一副40张的套牌。
之后你就用这副套牌跟其他牌手组出的轮抽套牌进行对局。三败之后你的征途即告终结，但你胜得越多，累积的奖品也就越多！

MainNav/General/AlchemySplash_EverySet.oracleText: About a month after each set, an Alchemy pack for the set will come out adding new digital-only cards for it. These are legal in Alchemy and Historic, and in the future could be rebalanced.
MainNav/General/AlchemySplash_EverySet.translation: 待相应系列发售约一个月后，该系列的炼金补充包便会随之上架，加入该系列特有的全新仅电子牌张。这些牌可在炼金和史迹赛制中使用，且将来或会受到平衡调整。

MainNav/General/AlchemySplash_ForMore.oracleText: For more information on Alchemy, click <link=https://magic.wizards.com/en/mtga-alchemy><u>here</u></link>
MainNav/General/AlchemySplash_ForMore.translation: 有关炼金的更多信息，请单击<link=https://magic.wizards.com/en/mtga-alchemy><u>此处</u></link>

MainNav/General/AlchemySplash_Grant.oracleText: To help you get started in Alchemy, you'll receive three Alchemy: Innistrad packs, plus six rare and one mythic individual card reward from Alchemy: Innistrad!
MainNav/General/AlchemySplash_Grant.translation: 为助你在炼金赛制中赢得先机，你会获得三包《炼金：依尼翠》补充包，以及出自《炼金：依尼翠》系列的六张稀有和一张秘稀的单卡奖励！

MainNav/General/AlchemySplash_NewFormat.oracleText: Alchemy is a new format to Arena, like Standard or Historic.
MainNav/General/AlchemySplash_NewFormat.translation: 炼金是竞技场的一种新赛制，就像标准或历史赛制一样。

MainNav/General/AlchemySplash_RotationAn.oracleText: Alchemy rotates every year, following the pattern of Standard. It has Play and Ranked support, and is available in best-of-one and best-of-three.
MainNav/General/AlchemySplash_RotationAn.translation: 炼金赛会追随标准赛的步伐，每年轮替一次。游戏中提供该赛制的普通对战和排名对战，且包括一盘定胜负和三盘两胜制两种模式。

MainNav/General/EntryReward.oracleText: All players who enter the event receive this reward.
MainNav/General/EntryReward.translation: 所有参加本活动的牌手都会获得此奖励。

MainNav/General/ExplorerPack_Desc.oracleText: Packs will be of a random Pioneer legal set on MTG Arena
MainNav/General/ExplorerPack_Desc.translation: 补充包将是MTG竞技场中的随机先驱系列

MainNav/General/NonStandardPack_Desc.oracleText: Packs will be of a random non-Standard set on MTG Arena
MainNav/General/NonStandardPack_Desc.translation: 将获得随机的非标准系列卡包

MainNav/Login/PasswordRules.oracleText:
Passwords must contain at least:
- 8 characters
- An upper-case and lower-case character
Passwords must not contain:
- EmailAddress
- Display Name
- Same character repeated 3 or more times
MainNav/Login/PasswordRules.translation:
"密码须至少包含：
- 8个字符
- 一个大写字母和一个小写字母
密码不得包含：
- 电子邮件地址
- 显示名称r
- 重复3次以上的相同字符"

MainNav/Login/Password_Character_Repeate.oracleText: Password cannot contain same character repeated 3 times
MainNav/Login/Password_Character_Repeate.translation: 密码不得包含重复3次的相同字符

MainNav/Login/Password_Contains_Display_.oracleText: Password cannot be based on display name
MainNav/Login/Password_Contains_Display_.translation: 密码不得与显示名称近似

MainNav/Login/Password_Contains_Email_Fe.oracleText: Password cannot be based on email address
MainNav/Login/Password_Contains_Email_Fe.translation: 密码不得与电子邮件地址近似

MainNav/Login/Password_Length_Feedback.translation: 密码必须介于8-64个字符之间。

MainNav/Login/Password_Too_Simple.oracleText: Password too simple. Try increasing length and/or combining numbers, symbols, or upper and lowercase characters.
MainNav/Login/Password_Too_Simple.translation: 密码太简单。请增加密码长度和／或加入数字、符号，或大小写字母。
