MainNav/Login/UpdateAccountTermsBody_Tap.translation: By tapping 'Submit' and continuing to use the services, you agree to Wizards of the Coast's updated:

MainNav/Login/Upgraded_Account_Descripti.oracleText: Your account must be migrated to the new account system. Please confirm the information below.
MainNav/Login/Upgraded_Account_Descripti.translation: 您的帐户必须迁移至新的帐户系统。请确认以下信息。

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Ajani.oracleText:
"I have seen tyrants whose ambitions knew no limits. Creatures who styled themselves gods or praetors or consuls but thought only of their own desires, not of those they ruled. Whole populations deceived. Civilzations plunged into war. People who were simply trying to live made to suffer. To die. Never again. Until all have found their place, I will keep watch."

~ Ajani Goldmane, War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Ajani.translation:
「我曾亲眼目睹野心无度的暴君，他们自诩为神明、国君、执政，却只顾满足自己的私欲，从不考虑子民的需求，由此欺瞒全体子民，将整个文明拖入战火。只想安居乐业的人民却被迫遭受苦难，生命垂危。我绝不会让这些重演。在万物各得归属前，我将挚诚守护。」

～金鬃阿耶尼，《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Angrath.oracleText:
"Eh, you don't have to worry about me," he huffed with some internal bitterness. "All I want is to defeat the damn dragon so I can get back to my daughters."

~ Angrath, War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Angrath.translation:
「呃，你不必担心我，」他大声回复，但面露难色。「我现在只想击败那条该死的龙，好快点回到我的女儿身边。」

～安戈斯，《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Arlinn.oracleText:
"If you don't speak wolf, allow me to translate: 'one step closer and I'll rip out your throat.'"

~ Arlinn Kord
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Arlinn.translation:
「如果你听不懂狼语，那就让我来翻译一下：『再敢靠近一步，我就撕开你的喉咙。』」

～雅琳珂德

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Ashiok.oracleText:
"Events on this plane will inspire nightmares for generations to come."

~ Ashiok
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Ashiok.translation:
「这个时空眼下所遭遇的一切，将成为连绵数代的噩梦。」

～安梭苛

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Chandra.oracleText:
Chandra took a deep breath... and ignited her entire body from the inside out. She wouldn't sacrifie her Spark, but she'd sure as hell use it to fuel her flames. She burned so brightly, the others all had to cover their eyes and take a few more steps back.

~ War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Chandra.translation:
茜卓深深吸了一口气…而后由内而外引燃全身。她绝不会牺牲自己的火花，但她却甘心用其来加亮身上光辉。而今她全身火焰烧得如此旺盛，令周遭众人不由得举手护住双眼，后退数步。

～《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Davriel.oracleText:
"This Liliana person seems to have very poor negotiating skills. Who signs a contract with demons and doesn't bother to read the fine print? That's the most important part."

~ Davriel Cane
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Davriel.translation:
「这个叫莉莲娜的家伙好像不太懂得谈判技巧。哪有人跟恶魔签订契约却不去仔细阅读细则的？这才是最重要的地方啊。」

～达夫黎凯恩

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Domri.oracleText:
"Hey dragon! I am Domri Rade, champion and master of all the Gruul Clans! You and I should be talkin', mate! How 'bout I swear allegiance to you and yours! We'll burn Ravnica to the ground!"

~ Domri Rade, War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Domri.translation:
「嘿，巨龙！我是多密雷德，古鲁各部族最强大的斗士与领袖！我们应该来谈一谈，伙计！我要加入你和你们的军队！这样我们就能把整个拉尼卡烧成平地！」

～多密雷德，《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Dovin.oracleText:
"Then I suppose," he went on, "it will come as no suprise that I'm thoroughly prepared for each of you, with thopters designed specifically to neutralize your skills while exploiting your weaknesses."

~ Dovin Baan, War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Dovin.translation:
「那么，」他接着说：「要是说我为你们每个人都做了充分准备，还设计了振翼机专门用来针对各位并找寻弱点，想必你们也不会太惊讶吧？」

～多温班恩，《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Gideon.oracleText:
He unsheathed his sword with intentional dramatic effect, raising it high into the air. "This is Blackblade. It has already slain one Elder Dragon, and it can destroy Bolas, as well. With it, I hereby vow to take back this world. Who's with me?"

~ Gideon Jura, War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Gideon.translation:
他郑重地拔出利刃，高举空中。「此乃乌锋。它曾让长老龙溅血，也定能夺取波拉斯性命。我发誓必用此剑拯救这个世界。谁要来跟我一起？」

～基定尤拉，火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Huatli.oracleText: Staring down at the lazotep-clad bodies scattered around her, Huatli considered the opening lines of a poem in their honor. The warriors of Amonkhet deserved that much.
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Huatli.translation: 华特莉环视身边具具被拉佐特石包覆的尸身，心头已想好颂赞其荣耀的诗歌开篇。拉佐特石当中的阿芒凯战士应配得上这一切。

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Jace.oracleText: As the relentless horde of Eternals poured into the plaza, Jace smiled, unable to completely master his curiosity despite the dire circumstances. Would the undead take the illusory bait or bee-line directly for his Spark? Either way, the results would certainly prove interesting.
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Jace.translation: 看着永生者大军蜂拥杀进广场，杰斯竟然还笑了笑。尽管情况严峻，但他仍忍不住好奇：这些亡灵会不会被幻象引诱？还是会径直朝自己冲来？无论是哪一种，结局都会很有趣。

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Jaya.oracleText:
Peril is in the eye of the beholder. At least, if your aim is good.

~ Jaya Ballard
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Jaya.translation:
各人看到的危险各不相同。至少，你得先看得准。

～雅亚巴拉德

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/JiangYanggu.oracleText:
"How did you cross the Blind Eternities with a dog?" Gideon asked, perplexed. 

"He's a magic dog," Jiang said with a shrug, as if that explained everything.

~ Gideon Jura and Jiang Yanggu, War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/JiangYanggu.translation:
「你是怎么带着一条狗一起穿越黑暗虚空的？」基定不解地问道。

「这是一条有魔力的狗，」姜旸谷耸耸肩，仿佛这已能说明一切。

～基定尤拉与姜旸谷，《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Karn.oracleText: Karn's heavy metal form sprang into motion with surprising agility. Before Dack could blink, three eternals lay shattered on the cobblestones. "Watch your back," the golem rumbled.
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Karn.translation: 卡恩的金属身躯突然以迅雷不及掩耳之势跃起。戴克还来不及眨眼，就看到三个永生者被击碎倒在鹅卵石地面。「小心身后，」魔像缓缓说道。

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Kasmina.oracleText:
"So many lives lost. So much potential wasted. The dragon's selfishness will cost the Multiverse dearly."

~ Kasmina
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Kasmina.translation:
「生灵涂炭，才俊尽失。这条龙的私心将让多重宇宙付出沉重的代价。」

～克蜜娜

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Kaya.oracleText:
Kaya wasn't just a Planeswalker. She was also a highly trained ghost-assassin. That wasn't a metaphor. She killed ghosts for a living.

~ War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Kaya.translation:
卡娅不只是一位鹏洛客，还是一位训练有素的鬼魂杀手。这并不是什么比喻的说法。她真的以驱鬼为生。

～《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Kiora.oracleText: The endless sea of stone set Kiora's nerves on edge. Yet beneath it all, she could feel deep waters and within them, something ancient stirring. She reached out with her mind, calling it to the surface.
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Kiora.translation: 无边无际的建物大海让奇奥拉心烦意乱。不过她感受得到，这片石林之下还有深邃汪洋，其中还有远古生灵待人唤醒。于是她静下心来用意念呼唤，将它唤醒召至地面。

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Liliana.oracleText:
Long ago, she had been a Planeswalker when that term still meant something. Back when the Spark that granted the power to traverse worlds wasn't handed to every Beefslab who could wield a sword or child who could summon up a bit of fire. Back then, Planeswalkers were immortal. Back then, Planeswalkers were nothing short of gods.

And Liliana Vess was a—goddess!


~ War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Liliana.translation:
从很久以前，鹏洛客还是一个强大的存在时，她就一直是鹏洛客了。那时候，能够穿越世界的火花之力，舞剑蛮汉或召火毛孩都无从获得。那时候，鹏洛客还是永生的。那时候，鹏洛客就是神灵一般的存在。

莉莲娜当时就是女神！


～《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Nahiri.oracleText: Molten blades whirled around Nahiri, parrying the vampire's blows with graceful ease. She would make Sorin wish he'd never escaped the prison she made for him.
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Nahiri.translation: 娜希丽身边熔石刀剑飞舞，轻松化解吸血鬼的攻势。她会让索霖后悔逃出她专为他建立的囚笼。

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Narset.oracleText:
"In the disarray of battle, an enemy's attack may be your most convenient weapon."

~ Narset
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Narset.translation:
「在乱战之中，敌人的攻击可能就是你最称手的武器。」

～娜尔施

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/NicolBolas.oracleText:
The entire plan had been flawless. Every contingency addressed. Every potential threat neutralizied. Bolas had been doing this kind of thing for millennia, yet even he was impressed. Over his endless lifetime, Nicol Bolas had seen everything. And still, the Elderspell was a sight to behold.

~ War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/NicolBolas.translation:
整个计划完美无瑕。所有意外都有备案。所有威胁都已消除。虽然波拉斯几千年来一直在做同样的事情，但这次仍令其难忘。纵使尼可波拉斯在永恒生命中已见过一切事物。但他仍为至尊咒的壮丽景象所折服。

～《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Nissa.oracleText:
"Let me make this clear: without a perfect act of unity from every single guild in concert, the plan has no hope of succeeding. You must put all grievances—petty or otherwise—behind you."

~ Nissa Revane, War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Nissa.translation:
「让我把话说清楚：这个计划必须所有公会团结一心，联合行动才有希望成功。无论你们之间有什么成见与不满，都给我统统放下。」

～妮莎瑞文，《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/ObNixilis.oracleText:
Ob Nixilis flexed his wings and took flight, attacking the Eternals from above, raining fire down upon them. Once he'd cleared a fiery circle, he landed, grabbed an Eternal and ripped off its limbs. He proceeded to tear apart and/or burn Eternals with his flaming hands, and Dack watched as the demon seemed to grow fiercer, more powerful—and larger—with every victory.

~ War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/ObNixilis.translation:
欧尼希兹振翅高飞，准备从上空向永生者发动攻击。顿时只见焰流向敌人倾注而下。在火焰散去之后，他降落地面，随手抓起永生者将其撕碎抛出。他继续前行，或而将永生者化为碎片，或而用双手将其烧成灰烬。戴克默默地注视这位恶魔，仿佛每次胜利都会让他变得更凶残，更强大，甚至更庞巨。

～《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Ral.oracleText:
He was lucky lazotep was such a good conductor. With a little effort, he created a circuit between himself and the dozen Eternals. They squirmed and jerked like butterflies pinned to a wall until he shut the electricity off, and as one they dropped to the cobblestones, smoking.
~ War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Ral.translation:
幸运的是，拉佐特石是优良的导体。他不费吹灰之力，就在他和十几个永生者只见建成回路。转瞬之间他们就像被钉在墙上的蝴蝶一般，不停舞动、抽搐。直到拉尔停止电流，他们便齐刷刷地倒在鹅卵石地面上，身上青烟直冒。
～《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Saheeli.oracleText:
Saheeli pulled out a small silver whistle. She puckered her lips and blew; the whistle emitted no audible sound. But the three remaining flying bandar heard its call and sprang into action, each latching onto a horse-sized thopter to take full control of its clockwork mechanisms. Saheeli smiled.

"Baan's not the only one who has prepared for his opponents."

~ Saheeli Rai, War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Saheeli.translation:
莎希莉掏出了一个小巧的银哨。她噘起嘴将其吹鸣。虽然未发出任何声响，但剩余的三只飞猴听到了呼唤，齐齐开始行动～跳落马匹大小的振翼机中掌控其发条装置。莎希莉露出了微笑。

「为对手做准备的可不止班恩一个。」

～莎希莉莱伊，《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Samut.oracleText:
Samut fought with a fury and passion Teyo had never seen before. She seemed to know the names of every single one of her lazotep foes, grimly saying, "You are free, Eknet. You are free, Temmet. You are free, Neit," as she slew each one.

~ War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Samut.translation:
撒姆特以一种泰佑从未在她身上见过的狂怒与激愤作战。她似乎知道每个包覆在拉佐特石下的敌人名字。她每杀一个，便会冷冷说道：「你自由了，埃尼特。你自由了，蒂穆特。你自由了，内特。」

～《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Sarkhan.oracleText:
"You once brought havoc to my home and ruined my mind. I'm here to return the favor, Bolas."

~ Sarkhan Vol
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Sarkhan.translation:
「你曾经破坏我的家园，摧毁我的心智。现在我来找你寻仇了，波拉斯。」

～萨坎沃

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Sorin.oracleText: Even as the chaos of battle raged about him, Sorin could feel the familiar presence. He was certain now—she was here. Sweeping aside the strange undead creatures that swarmed to attack him, he strode forward with grim purpose. Nothing would keep him from his revenge.
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Sorin.translation: 就算身边被战斗的混乱所笼罩，索霖仍能隐约感受到一种令人熟悉的存在。他现在确定了～她就在这里。在扫清蜂拥朝他扑来的不死生物之后，他满脸严肃地径直前行：没有人能阻止他复仇雪恨。

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Tamiyo.oracleText: Tamiyo wished only to observe the war, but she soon realized neutrality was not an option.
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Tamiyo.translation: 多美代原本只想旁观战乱进展，但她很快就意识到自己根本没法抽身事外。

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Teferi.oracleText:
Knocked off his feet, Teyo saw the eternal raise its scimitar to strike, but its stroke never fell. It stood frozen, trapped in concentric rings of magical force that shifted and rotated like clockwork. "Don't just lie there," said a warm voice from behind him. "Even my spells don't last forever. At least, not anymore."

~ Teferi
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Teferi.translation:
泰佑被击倒后，眼睁睁地看着永生者举起弯刀行将砍下，但这一刀永远没落下来。只见它呆站原地，被困在如漩涡转动的魔力圆环之中。「别干躺在那里，」身后传来一阵温暖话语。「我的咒语也不能永远困住它，至少现在不能了。」

～泰菲力

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Teyo.oracleText:
He claimed to be a novice shieldmage, and the boy was clearly operating at the point of near-exhaustion, but he did his part, protecting their backs, their fronts, their sides. He was quick and smart and if the situation weren't half so desperate, Kaya might have been amused at the way he was constantly surprised by his own rapidly growing skills.

~ War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Teyo.translation:
这男孩声称自己只是一名盾法师新手，如今已明显精疲力竭咬牙硬撑。但他圆满地完成了自己的任务～保护他们身后、身前、身侧不受攻击。他敏捷、聪颖，经常面对自己技艺飞速增长露出迷惑不解的表情。要不是战况过于激烈，卡娅可能会仔细看着他，并以这滑稽表情为乐。

～《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/TheWanderer.oracleText:
Davriel stood back to back with the mysterious stranger as Eternals closed in from all sides. "Nice hat," he remarked, trying to sound as unflappable as she looked.
The Wanderer sliced through three of the approaching undead with an effortless sweep of her broadsword. "Nice mask," she replied, with more than a hint of sarcasm.

~ The Wanderer and Davriel Cane
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/TheWanderer.translation:
随着永生者大军从四面逼近，达夫黎和神秘人被逼到圆圈中央，背对而立。「你的帽子不错。」他攀谈道，竭力想要装得跟对方神色一般泰然。
飘萍挥舞阔剑，转眼砍倒三个扑上来的亡灵。「你的面具也不错。」她回了一句，但语气之中却带有一些讥讽。

～飘萍与达夫黎凯恩

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Ugin.oracleText:
"Help me now, and I will place a living Bolas in an eternal prison with myself as his eternal jailer. You'll be rid of us both. Forever. It isn't simply the safer course, it is the only course that guarantees the safety of the Multiverse."

~ Ugin, War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Ugin.translation:
「帮助我，我要生擒波拉斯，把他囚禁在永恒牢笼之中，而我将永远看着他。我们两个将永远消失，永远。这不是较安全的做法，而是保证多重宇宙安全的唯一可行之道。」

～乌金，《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Vivien.oracleText:
She spoke for the first time, anger rising steadily in her voice: "My name is Vivien Reid. And I don't want to help. I want to kill the dragon myself." 

"As long he as ends up dead," Ajani said. 

She inhaled, trying to rein in her rage. She succeeded. "As long as he ends up dead," she agreed.

~ Vivien Reid and Ajani Goldmane, War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Vivien.translation:
她终于开口说话，但声音中满是愤怒：「我叫薇薇安瑞德。我不是来帮忙的。我只想亲手宰了那条龙。」

「只要他死。」阿耶尼说。

她深吸了一口气，试图平复自己的愤怒。她成功了。「只要他死。」她同意道。

～薇薇安瑞德与金鬃阿耶尼，《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Vraska.oracleText:
"All across the city, the Golgari are opening up pathways to safety for every Ravnican they can find. We are fighting Bolas' army and preserving life." And then—more for show than anything—she added with bitter sarcasm, "You're welcome."

~ Vraska, War of the Spark: Ravnica by Greg Weisman
MainNav/LoreText/WAR/Vraska.translation:
「葛加理正在遍寻全城，为每位能找到的拉尼卡人发掘逃生通路。我们在抗击波拉斯军队的同时，也在保全生命。」然后，也许只是为了摆摆样子，她由略带讥讽地补充道：「不用谢我。」

～瓦丝卡，《火花之战：拉尼卡》，格雷格·韦斯曼著

MainNav/Mailbox/2024_35_0_MKM_StudioXPuz.oracleText:
Highly impressive. Looks like this is case closed. 

Your work has intrigued me for quite some time. You, like me, are an artist. You wield the brush of logic, the chisel of observation, the knife of deduction. You delight in unraveling the deceptions that cloud the truth. But will you prove to be an asset or a rival? That remains to be seen—and I'll enjoy finding out. 

For now, take this token of my admiration. You've certainly earned it. 

Until we meet again, 

A.P.
MainNav/Mailbox/2024_35_0_MKM_StudioXPuz.translation:
令人印象非常深刻。 看起来这个案子已经结案了。

你的工作引起了我相当长一段时间的兴趣。 你和我一样，都是一位艺术家。 你挥舞着逻辑的画笔、观察的凿子、演绎的刀。 你乐于揭开掩盖真相的谎言。 但你会证明自己是一位朋友还是一位竞争对手？ 这还有待观察——我很乐意找出答案。

现在，请收下我的钦佩之物。 你已经赢得了它。

直到我们再次见面，

A.P.

MainNav/Mailbox/2024_38_0_Prizewall_Anno.oracleText:
In lieu of a Mastery Pass, MH3 will have the Psychic Frog's Horizon Hideaway! Here's a brief rundown of how it works:

- Earn Tickets for the Hideaway by completing Daily Quests.

- Once you've gotten your Tickets, you can pick your prizes in any order you want! Spend a few Tickets on multiple Card Styles right away, or save up to get Avatars, Packs, or even a Draft Token!

- You earn Tickets regardless of if you've purchased entrance to the Psychic Frog's Horizon Hideaway, but you can only redeem them if you've purchased entrance.

- The Psychic Frog's Horizon Hideaway will only be around for Modern Horizons 3, and Tickets will not carry over into subsequent releases.

Check out the Psychic Frog's Horizon Hideaway in the Store today!

- 无论您是否购买了灵能蛙的新篇藏身处，您都可以获得票，但只有购买了门票才能兑换票。

- 灵能蛙的新篇藏身处只会在摩登新篇3中出现，而且票不会带入后续版本。

立即到商店查看灵能蛙的新篇藏身处！

MainNav/Mailbox/2024_41_0_DSK_Announceme.oracleText:
One, two, the Razorkin are coming for you.

Three, four, don't open that door!

five, six, beware the gremlins tricks.

seven, eight, your fears will dominate.

nine, ten, looks like you're lost again!

Don't get spooked! Take these 3 packs and basic lands to help you survive as long as you can!

一呀么二，锐器人就要找来。

三呀么四，打开偏门要出事！

五呀么六，小心怪灵把你诱。

七呀么八，心中恐惧再难压。

MainNav/Mailbox/2024_42_0_HalloweenTreat.oracleText:
Trick or Treat! It's that time of the year when goblins, spirits, skeletons, and more arise to have a day of spooky fun. We've got something special for you too...will it be a sweet treat, or will it bite back? Only one way to find out!

Claim your treat (or trick) by clicking below now!

不给糖就捣蛋！又到了鬼怪、精怪、骷髅妖等各路妖孽纷纷现身，享受惊悚乐趣的时节。我们也为您准备了一份特别的惊喜……会是香甜的糖果，还是会反咬一口呢？只有一个办法能知道！

MainNav/Mailbox/2024_42_0_Y25DSK_Announc.oracleText: Not many have lasted as long as you have in Duskmourn. But there's no time to rest on your laurels, there's still countless terrors lurking around Arena. Take these 3 packs to protect yourself before we make it off Duskmourn!
MainNav/Mailbox/2024_42_0_Y25DSK_Announc.translation: 在暮悲邸中，能像你这样坚持至今的人并不多。但现在还不是歇息的时候，竞技场中仍潜伏着无数恐怖。在我们离开暮悲邸之前，拿上这3包补充包来保护自己吧！

MainNav/Mailbox/2024_43_0_FDN_Announceme.oracleText:
Your favorite legends and Planeswalkers are here with quintessential magic from across the Multiverse! Take these 3 packs and some basic lands to help you ignite your Spark and start your journey, or help round out your best decks! 

Foundations is also introducing a change to blockers. Instead of ordering how your creatures attack, you'll assign damage to individual blockers directly. This damage is dealt immediately after assignment, without a priority window for casting spells or activating abilities.

While Foundations will be in Standard until at least 2029, it will rotate out of the Alchemy Format in 2025, along with Alchemy: Bloomburrow and Alchemy: Duskmourn.
MainNav/Mailbox/2024_43_0_FDN_Announceme.translation:
你最喜爱的传奇生物与鹏洛客携带着多重宇宙中的精粹魔法闪亮登场！拿上这三包补充包和一些基本地牌，点燃你的火花，开启你的旅程，或是完善你最强的套牌！

基石构筑系列还引入了阻挡规则的变化。你不再需要排列生物的攻击顺序，而是直接为每个阻挡者分配伤害。这些伤害在分配后立即造成，中间没有施放咒语或起动异能的优先权窗口。

虽然基石构筑会在标准赛制中至少保留到2029年，但它将与炼金：班隆洛和炼金：暮悲邸一同于2025年轮替出炼金赛制。

MainNav/Mailbox/2024_44_0_PM1_Announceme.oracleText: Are you ready explore more Magic? Take these 3 pack to begin playing with Pioneer Masters.
MainNav/Mailbox/2024_44_0_PM1_Announceme.translation: 准备好在万智牌中继续探险了吗？拿上这三包补充包开始游玩先驱大师吧。

MainNav/Mailbox/2024_WhatIsFDN_Descripti.oracleText:
Whether you're taking your first steps into Magic, finishing up your Standard deck, or diving deep into Modern, Commander, and more—Magic: The Gathering Foundations is the best place to begin. This set was made for past, present, and future Magic players, featuring products for players fresh or famous and filled with cards legal in Standard, at least until 2029!

Click the link below to read more, and get excited for Standard Staples for years to come!
MainNav/Mailbox/2024_WhatIsFDN_Descripti.translation:
无论您是刚踏入万智牌的新手，还是在完善标准套牌的老手，或是正在深入探索摩登、指挥官等赛制的玩家——万智牌：基石构筑都是最佳起点。本系列专为过去、现在和未来的万智牌玩家精心打造，推出适合新手和资深玩家的产品，收录的卡牌至少到2029年在标准赛制中合法！

点击下方链接了解更多详情，一起期待这些在未来数年中都将成为标准赛制主力的卡牌吧！

MainNav/Mailbox/2025_50_0_EOE_Announceme.oracleText:
Crew log 278:

It's been a while since we crossed over into the Sothera system. I remember the excitement that beat in my heart when we first set out – that sense of wonder, that anything was possible. It has not lessened with time. 

The things I have seen in the Edge are indescribable. Pictures and words do it no justice. I'm giving you these packs and basic lands, in the hopes that you too may experience what I have on this journey. 

Go forth, battle bravely, and thrive!
MainNav/Mailbox/2025_50_0_EOE_Announceme.translation:
航行日志278：

自我们踏入索瑟拉星系已有些时日。犹记得初次启程时心中激荡的兴奋——那种万物皆有可能的奇妙悸动。这份悸动至今未减分毫。

在边域目睹的奇观难以言表，影像与文字皆无法传递其神韵。我将这些补充包与基本地赠予你，愿你能在这趟旅程中亲历我所见证的奇迹。

勇往直前，无畏征战，绽放属于你的荣光！

MainNav/Mailbox/2025_50_0_EOE_Announceme.oracleText: To the Edge of the Eternities!

MainNav/Mailbox/2025_51_0_Y25EOE_Announc.oracleText:
Crew log 299:

Much more time has passed, and the Edge still fills me with wonder. Every time I think I have seen it all, we stumble across another astonishing surprise. Some benign, some dangerous, but all beautiful.

We're departing now, but take these 3 packs to help fortify you for your own journey ahead!
MainNav/Mailbox/2025_51_0_Y25EOE_Announc.translation:
航行日志299：

时光飞逝，而边域仍令我惊叹不已。每当我以为已见识过所有奇观，我们总会邂逅新的惊人发现。有些平和无害，有些危机四伏，但无不美不胜收。

我们即将启程，带上这3包补充包为你的前路傍身吧！

MainNav/Mailbox/2025_51_0_Y25EOE_Announc.oracleText: Our Journey Through the Edge Continues
MainNav/Mailbox/2025_51_0_Y25EOE_Announc.translation: 我们的边域之旅仍在继续

MainNav/Mailbox/2025_EOE_SparkRank_Desc.oracleText:
Starting now, Spark Ranked will use cards from the Standard card pool rather than the Alchemy card pool. This means that digital-only cards will no longer be allowed; if any of your decks contain digital-only cards, they will need to be removed from the deck to continue using that deck in Spark Ranked. Rebalanced cards will revert to their non-rebalanced versions.

The preconstructed Starter Decks all remain legal.
MainNav/Mailbox/2025_EOE_SparkRank_Desc.translation:
即日起，火花排位将使用标准牌池而非炼金牌池。这意味着数字专属牌张将不再被允许使用；若您的套牌中包含数字专属牌张，则需将其移除以继续在火花排位中使用该套牌。经过再平衡的牌张将恢复为平衡前的版本。

所有预组新手套牌仍可合法使用。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026.59.30_SPMAnnounceme.oracleText:
You read it correctly! Magic: The Gathering® | Marvel's Spider-Man (SPM) is coming to Arena! When it does, to respect the equivalency between Magic: The Gathering® | Marvel's Spider-Man and Through the Omenpaths sets, we'll be performing a one-time grant:

For every Through the Omenpaths card you own, you'll automatically receive its equivalent Magic: The Gathering® | Marvel's Spider-Man  card.

You will continue to own each of your Through the Omenpath cards as Card Styles.

To ensure we don't miss any cards through this one-time grant, we're taking an additional step with this update. The first time you log in after the update on June 16, all unopened Through the Omenpaths packs will automatically be opened.

Read more at the link below!
MainNav/Mailbox/2026.59.30_SPMAnnounceme.translation:
你没看错！万智牌丨漫威的蜘蛛侠（SPM）即将登陆竞技场！届时，为体现万智牌丨漫威的蜘蛛侠与穿越预兆路系列之间的对等关系，我们将进行一次性发放：

你拥有的每张穿越预兆路牌张，都将自动获得其对应的万智牌丨漫威的蜘蛛侠牌张。

你原有的穿越预兆路牌张将作为卡牌样式继续保留。

为确保此次一次性发放不遗漏任何牌，我们将在本次更新中采取额外步骤。6月16日更新后首次登录时，所有未开启的穿越预兆路补充包将自动打开。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide1.oracleText: Welcome, traveler, to the plane of Lorwyn.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide1.translation: 欢迎来到洛温时空，旅行者。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide1.oracleText: It is a world of conflict and unpredictability, where only the strong and the clever survive.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide1.translation: 这是一个充满冲突与无常的世界，唯有强者与智者能得以幸存。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide1.oracleText: But if you embrace the danger and step into the darkness, you may find power beyond your wildest dreams.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide1.translation: 但若你拥抱危险，踏入黑暗，便可能获得比你的狂野梦想更甚的力量。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide1.oracleText: But what of the places where light and shadow meet? What other mysteries lurk on the boundary of Lorwyn and Shadowmoor? Enter the aurora and discover the answers for yourself!
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide1.translation: 那么光与影交汇之处又是怎样的景象？洛温与暗影荒原的边界还潜藏着哪些奥秘？进入极光之中，亲自探寻答案吧！

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide2.oracleText: Lorwyn is a world of eternal daylight that brims with potent magic.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide2.translation: 洛温是一个永恒白昼的世界，充盈着强大的魔法。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide3.oracleText: Most of Lorwyn's inhabitants value harmony above conflict. (wryly) Whenever possible.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide3.translation: 洛温的大部分居民都重视和谐胜于冲突……（撇嘴）如果可能的话。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide4.oracleText: Then there are those who are... less agreeable. The world is shifting, and conflict is inevitable.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide4.translation: 然而，还有一些人……不那么认同。世界正在转变，冲突不可避免。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide5.oracleText: In Lorwyn, you'll find wonders beyond imagination and possibilities beyond your wildest dreams.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide5.translation: 在洛温，你将发现超乎想象的奇迹与超越梦想的可能性。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide6.oracleText: But when the Aurora passes over, the plane twists into something dark and sinister.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide6.translation: 但当极光掠过，整个时空便会扭曲成黑暗与邪恶的形态。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide7.oracleText: The shining light of Lorwyn gives way to the unfathomable darkness of Shadowmoor.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide7.translation: 洛温的璀璨光芒正让位于暗影荒原的深邃黑暗。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide8.oracleText: Deadly secrets lurk behind every corner, and the plane's inhabitants become selfish and paranoid.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide8.translation: 致命的秘密潜伏在每个角落，这个时空的居民变得自私又多疑。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide9.oracleText: Here, everyone fights for themselves, striving to reach their full potential by any means necessary.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_ECLCinematic_Slide9.translation: 在这里，每个人都为自己而战，不择手段地追求发挥自身的全部潜力。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_IDOP_Announcement_G.oracleText:
International Day of Play is a global celebration of the power of play—bringing people together, building confidence, and creating connections. We're proud to have Magic: The Gathering Arena be part of it alongside Magic: The Gathering and Dungeons & Dragons, opening the door for more players to jump in and play together. Join the celebration this June in the following ways:

* On MTG Arena: Jump into a FREE Phantom Premier Draft—no entry cost, no card collection required. Just draft and play.
* In-store: Bring a friend to Avengers Academy, a Magic: The Gathering Learn-to-Play event at participating WPN stores starting June 12-18, where you can team up to battle and earn rewards. Find a store near you by clicking the button below!

However you play—teaching a friend, drafting online, or exploring something new—it's a great time to join us and be part of a global moment celebrating the power of play. See you in-game or at your local store!
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_IDOP_Announcement_G.translation:
国际游玩日是一场全球性的庆典，旨在庆祝游玩的力量——它让人们相聚，建立自信，并创造联系。我们很自豪能让万智牌：竞技场与《万智牌》和《龙与地下城》一同参与其中，为更多玩家打开大门，让他们能够加入并一起游玩。请通过以下方式参与今年六月的庆祝活动：

* 在MTG竞技场上：参加一场免费的幻影竞技轮抽——无需入场费用，也无需拥有牌张收藏。只管轮抽和游玩。
* 在牌店中：从6月12日至18日起，带一位朋友前往参与活动的WPN店铺，参加万智牌新手教学赛事复仇者学院，你们可以组队对战并赢取奖励。点击下方按钮，查找你附近的店铺！

无论你以何种方式参与游玩——无论是教导朋友、在线轮抽，还是探索新事物——现在都是加入我们、成为这场全球性庆祝游玩力量活动一份子的绝佳时机。期待在线上游戏或你当地的牌店中见到你！

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_MTG_Anniversary_Gen.oracleText: On August 5th, 1993, Magic: the Gathering released its first set! To celebrate, have a slice of cake (and a little bit of XP) on us!
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_MTG_Anniversary_Gen.translation: 1993年8月5日，万智牌推出了首个系列！作为庆祝，我们为您准备了一块蛋糕（以及一点经验）！

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_MagcPresents_OpenAr.oracleText: Strixhaven often plays host to a variety of Planeswalkers and personalities, this time is no exception! Magic Presents: Open the Archives is a Booster Draft event with some exceptional prizes happening at your local game store. This time we're 'amping' things up by giving you the Ral Zarek Avatar for participating in one of these events. Find an event today!
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_MagcPresents_OpenAr.translation: 斯翠海文经常招待各种鹏洛客和人物，这次也不例外！万智牌呈现：打开秘典是一场在你本地牌店举办的补充包轮抽赛事，附带一些特别的奖品。此次我们特别“加码”，参与这些赛事之一即可获得拉尔查雷克头像。今天就去参与赛事吧！

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_MagcPresents_OpenAr.oracleText: Open the Archives May 22-June 14 at your LGS to welcome Ral Zarek
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_MagcPresents_OpenAr.translation: 5月22日至6月14日，前往您当地的牌店打开秘典，迎接拉尔查雷克

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_MagcPresents_OpenAr.oracleText: We hope that the Mystical Archives were kind to you at this installment of Magic Presents. Whether you walked away with the winner's prize or not, the Ral Zarek Avatar is yours as a thanks for joining in on the fun!
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_MagcPresents_OpenAr.translation: 我们希望本次万智牌呈现的秘典对各位友善。无论你是否赢得胜者奖品，拉尔查雷克头像都是你的，以感谢你参与其中！

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_MagcPresents_OpenAr.oracleText: Thank you for joining us at Magic Presents: Open the Archives!
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_MagcPresents_OpenAr.translation: 感谢参加万智牌呈现：打开秘典！

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_Maintenence_May4th_.oracleText: Magic: The Gathering Arena will be undergoing maintenance on May 4th, beginning at 4am Pacific Time. The maintenance is expected to last 5 hours, but could extend if necessary. During this time, all of our services will be down and the play queues will be inaccessible. Click the link below to see more status updates, and thank you for your patience!
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_Maintenence_May4th_.translation: 万智牌：竞技场将于5月4日太平洋时间凌晨4点起进行维护。预计维护将持续5小时，但必要时可能延长。在此期间，所有服务将暂停，游戏队列将无法使用。请点击下方链接查看最新状态更新，感谢您的耐心等待！

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide1.oracleText: Welcome to Strixhaven University, the greatest repository of magical knowledge in the Multiverse!
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide1.translation: 欢迎来到斯翠海文学院，这是多元宇宙中最大的魔法知识宝库。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide1.oracleText: Scholars must journey off campus to unravel the mystery of what has enraged these ancient forces of nature.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide1.translation: 学者们必须走出学院，去揭开究竟是什么激怒了这些古老的自然之力。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide1.oracleText: The five schools will need to band together like never before...
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide1.translation: 五大学院将不得不以前所未有的方式团结起来……
……去面对他们迄今为止最严峻的考验！

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide2.oracleText: The Founder Dragons formed this institution to explore the duality of the natural world.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide2.translation: 创院巨龙创立此学院，旨在探究自然界的二元性。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide3.oracleText: Strixhaven students choose one of five colleges to direct their study.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide3.translation: 斯翠海文的学生需在五个学院中选择其一，以决定其学业方向。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide4.oracleText: The eloquent orators of Silverquill research linguistic magic,
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide4.translation: 银毫学院的演说家们专研语言魔法，

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide5.oracleText: while the creative mages of Prismari breathe beauty into their works of art.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide5.translation: 而粹丽学院充满创意的法师则将美注入他们的艺术创作之中。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide6.oracleText: Witherbloom's necromancers harness the power of life and death
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide6.translation: 靡华学院的死灵法师驾驭生与死的力量。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide7.oracleText: and Lorehold's archaeomancers uncover mysteries and bring history to life.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide7.translation: 而衡鉴学院的考古法师则揭开诸多奥秘，使历史重现于世。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide8.oracleText: Last but not least, the numeromancers of Quandrix combine magic and math to calculate the infinite.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide8.translation: 最后，量析学院的数术法师融合魔法与数学，计算无穷。

MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide9.oracleText: However, something is dangerously wrong on Arcavios. The normally docile archaics have begun rampaging.
MainNav/Mailbox/2026_SOSCinematic_Slide9.translation: 然而，阿凯维沃正出现危险的异变。一向温顺的古旅人已开始肆虐。

MainNav/Mailbox/CosmeticCallout_Descript.oracleText:
Did you know that you can change the cosmetics of each of your decks individually? That means that your decks can have even more distinctive personality, and you don't have to change your default cosmetics every time you want a new look! The steps are simple:

Go to your ‘Decks' tab

Select the deck you want to change the cosmetics for, and click ‘edit deck'

Click on the ‘Deck Name' panel

Click on the Avatars, Pets, and Card Sleeves buttons to change which cosmetics are applied to that deck!

And voilà! Your deck is now even more beautiful and unique!
MainNav/Mailbox/CosmeticCallout_Descript.translation:
您知道您可以单独更改每套牌的外观吗？ 这意味着您的套牌可以具有更加独特的个性，并且您不必每次想要新外观时都更改默认外观！ 步骤很简单：

转到您的“套牌”选项卡

选择您想要更改饰品的牌组，然后单击“编辑牌组”

单击“卡组名称”面板

单击头像、宠物和牌套按钮来更改应用于该牌组的饰品！

瞧！ 您的套牌现在更加美丽和独特！

MainNav/Mailbox/FleemAnnouncement_Descri.oracleText:
We've heard how much you love Fleem! We love him too, and we're working hard to get some unique cosmetics made to celebrate. Fleem wasn't expecting to be so popular, and all the attention has made him a bit shy. We need your help to draw him back out of his shell. If you do at least one of the following before September 30th:

* Open 10 or more OM1 store packs 
* Play in 1 or more OM1 Draft or Sealed events
* Purchase the OM1 Mastery Pass

We'll send you a special Fleem Avatar, Sleeve, and Sticker on October 1st to celebrate his rise to fame!
MainNav/Mailbox/FleemAnnouncement_Descri.translation:
我们听说了大家有多喜爱弗莱姆！我们也超爱他，正在努力制作特别的饰品来庆祝。弗林姆没想到自己会这么受欢迎，突如其来的关注让他有点害羞。我们需要你的帮助让他重新活跃起来。只要在9月30日前完成以下任意一项：

* 开启10包或更多OM1补充包
* 参加1场或更多OM1轮抽/现开赛
* 购买OM1精研通行证

我们就会在10月1日赠予你特别的弗莱姆头像、牌套和贴纸，庆祝他声名鹊起！

MainNav/Mailbox/MOMPodcast_Description.oracleText:
Lore enthusiasts rejoice! The Magic Story Podcast is back.
 
Join Wizards of the Coast official hosts Harless Snyder (Product Marketing Manager) and Natalie Kreider (Game Producer) as they take you through the multiverse like never before. Whether you have been playing Magic for years or just discovered it yesterday, the podcast is intended to be a convenient entry point to dive deeper into the various characters, settings, and stories that make up Magic.  
 
Click the link below to learn more, and to access the archive!

MainNav/Mailbox/MagicAnniversaryGiveaway.oracleText:
It's our anniversary! We released Arena on September 27th, 2019, and have had the privilege of continuing to improve it every day since.

We're so honored to have you here with us, whether you started playing all the way back in the beta or just joined us recently. Our players remind us that Magic is for everyone, all around the world, at any time. You're what makes working on this game great. Every fun piece of art, every whacky mechanic, and every cool new feature we do is with all of you mind.

Thanks for being with us, and we hope you continue to stick around and make Magic with us going forward! We've attached a special thank-you to this message, press the claim button below to receive it! See you on the battlefield!

(Unclaimed messages will be automatically granted upon message expiration)
MainNav/Mailbox/MagicAnniversaryGiveaway.translation:
这是我们的周年纪念日！ 我们于 2019 年 9 月 27 日发布了 Arena，并有幸从那时起每天都在不断改进它。

我们非常荣幸您能来到这里，无论您是在测试版中就开始玩游戏还是最近才加入我们。 我们的玩家提醒我们，万智牌适合世界各地的每个人。 是你们让这款游戏的工作变得精彩。 我们所做的每一件有趣的艺术品、每一个古怪的机制以及每一个很酷的新功能都与你们所有人有关。

感谢您与我们在一起，我们希望您继续留下来，与我们一起让万智牌走向未来！ 我们在此消息中附上了特别的感谢，请按下面的领取按钮来接收它！ 战场上见！

（未被领取的消息将在消息过期后自动授予）

MainNav/Mailbox/NewFormat_Timeless_Annou.oracleText:
Charge up your Lightning Bolt and hold onto your Counterspell because today we are introducing Timeless, a new Constructed Format where all cards on Magic: The Gathering Arena are playable. We expect Timeless to be filled with fast, fun, and exciting games as players will have access to the most powerful cards in MTG: Arena.

To contain all these powerful cards, Timeless will be the first format on Arena to have a Restricted List. If a card is on the restricted list, only a single copy of that card may be included in your deck and sideboard.

Ranked and Play queues will be available right away. During this time, we are going to be watching the format very closely for cards that should be added to the restricted list. Come be one of the first players to test it out, and click the link below to read more about it!
MainNav/Mailbox/NewFormat_Timeless_Annou.translation:
为你的闪电箭充能，握牢你的反制咒语，因为今天我们正式推出全新的永恒构筑赛制：在万智牌竞技场中，所有的卡牌都可以使用。我们期待永恒将带来快速、有趣和激动人心的对局，因为玩家们将可以使用竞技场中最强大的牌张。

为了控制这些强大的牌张，永恒将成为竞技场上首个引入限牌表的赛制。如果一张牌在此表中，你的套牌和备用牌中只能包含一张该牌。

MainNav/Mailbox/Painless_Reprints_Descri.oracleText: We've made some exciting changes to our card collection system to make building collections easier than ever! Painless Reprints – After collecting four copies of a card, you'll only need to collect one additional copy of a reprint to use four copies of that reprint. Previously, every printing required four copies! Faster Duplicate Protection & Set Completion – Since it's faster to collect a full set (four copies) of reprinted cards, duplicate protection kicks in sooner than before! Any Card, Any Style – You no longer need to own a specific printing of a card to use its style in a deck. Now, you can apply a card style to any version of a card with the same name! Craft Using Lowest Rarity – Crafting a card now costs one wildcard of the lowest printed rarity that card has ever appeared at on Arena — regardless of which version you're crafting! Better Preconstructed Deck Discounts - Preconstructed deck discounts will now be based on the cards in your collection with the same name as the cards in your deck. Previously, decks were only discounted if they contained cards with the exact same printing. Card Ownership Visual Improvements – We've improved how your collection is displayed in the Deck Builder to better reflect these changes. We hope you enjoy the new changes, and for more details, follow the link below!
MainNav/Mailbox/Painless_Reprints_Descri.translation: 我们为牌张收藏系统带来了一些激动人心的改进，让构建收藏变得前所未有的轻松！ 无痛重印 - 当你收集了某张牌的4张后，只需再收集1张该牌的重印版本，就能使用4张该重印牌。在以前，每个版本都需要收集4张！ 更快的重复保护与系列收集 - 由于现在能更快收集齐重印牌（4张），重复保护机制会比以前更早生效！ 任意牌张，任意样式 - 现在你无需拥有某张牌的特定版本就能在套牌中使用其样式。可以对任何同名牌张应用卡牌样式！ 按最低稀有度合成 - 现在合成牌张只需消耗1张该牌在竞技场中曾出现过的最低稀有度的万用牌——无论你要合成的是哪个版本！ 更好的预组套牌折扣 - 预组套牌折扣现在会根据与你套牌中牌张同名的已收集牌来计算。以前只有完全相同的版本才能享受折扣。 持有牌张视觉优化 - 我们改进了套牌构筑器中收藏的显示方式，以更好地反映这些变化。 希望您喜欢这些新变化，更多详情请点击下方链接！

MainNav/Mailbox/PreferredPrinting_Descri.oracleText:
We are happy to announce that you can now select your favorite printing of each card in your collection! Yes, this means you can select your favorite basic lands!

Multiple printings for a single card are now collapsed down to a single entry. You can toggle the expand button on a card to see all the printings you have and toggle it again to close them up. From the expanded view you can tap on the heart to set a favorite, which is the printing the game will use by default. Your current favorite card is the first one used when you add it to your deck or when auto-adding lands.

Here are a few tips and tricks to help you start selecting your Preferred Printing of cards:

-- The easiest way to see this in action is to go to your collection, and sort to your lands.

-- From there, expand a card by using the button displayed in the upper left of any card that has multiple printings.

-- Select a favorite by clicking the heart button in the lower right corner of your favorite printing.

-- If you do not have a favorite selected, it defaults to the newest printing of that card in your collection.

-- If you would like a deck to NOT use your favorite, expand the list and select the printing you want for that deck.

-- If you have less printings of your favorite than you use, the most recent printing is also used.

-- Limited modes will keep the non-land cards to the ones in that set. For example: If the set has Opt, you'll see that set's Opt in your deck, not your preferred version.
MainNav/Mailbox/PreferredPrinting_Descri.translation:
朗报！现已可以为收藏中的每张牌分别指定偏好牌面版次！没错，你现在可以随意指定最喜爱的基本地图案了！

同一种牌的不同版次现已合并作同一张牌。你可以点一次牌面上放的展开按钮，来查看该牌你已获得的各版次，然后再点一次按钮即可收回。在展开视图中，你可以轻点相应版次上的心形图标来将之设为个人偏好，如此游戏便会默认利用之。当你将相应牌张加入套牌，或是自动添加地时，它们便会以你设定的偏好版次加入。

若要立刻着手为牌张选择偏好版次，不妨先看看以下建议和诀窍：

-- 熟悉相应的最快方式，便是从地牌入手：进入牌张收藏界面，然后点按「地」的图标。

-- 待显示所有地牌之后，若某牌有数个版次，你便可以点按该牌左上角的按钮来展开所有牌面。

-- 点击相应牌面右下角的心形按钮，便可以将之设为你的个人偏好。

-- 对于你未设置偏好版次的牌张，游戏会默认采用你收藏中该牌的最新版本。

-- 如果你想在某副套牌中「不使用」偏好版次，则需要展开列表，从中选择你要在套牌中利用的版次。

-- 如果你拥有的某版次牌张数量，少于你在套牌中的用量，则不足部分也会用该牌的最新版本来补足。

-- 在限制赛模式中，非地牌会始终利用相应系列中的版次不作变动。举例来说，如果限制赛中用到的系列含有抉择，则你套牌中的抉择就会是该系列的版本，而非你偏好的其他版次。

MainNav/Mailbox/VAT_Update_Description.oracleText:
Starting with the update on May 18, Magic: The Gathering Arena is making some adjustments to its storefront in order to create pricing parity across devices and platforms throughout Europe to better account for value-added tax. 

First, players who are paying in Euros on PC will see approximately a 10% increase in prices. This will bring PC prices closer to being in line with mobile prices, which will not change. 

Additionally, we will be removing the ability to switch between paying in Euros and Dollars. Players in Europe will now only be able to pay in Euros. 

As an example, here are the price updates for Gem packages: 

750 gems: 4.99 USD/EUR -> 5.49 EUR 
1,600 gems: 9.99 USD/EUR -> 10.99 EUR 
3,400 gems: 19.99 USD/EUR -> 21.99 EUR 
9,200 gems: 49.99 USD/EUR -> 53.99 EUR 
20,000 gems: 99.99 USD/EUR -> 107.99 EUR 

These changes are effective immediately and will not affect other regions.
MainNav/Mailbox/VAT_Update_Description.translation:
自5月18日起，万智牌竞技场将对其商店进行调整，以在整个欧洲设备和平台间平衡价格，并更好地考虑增值税。

首先，使用欧元在PC端支付的玩家将会看到价格约增加10%。这将使PC端的价格更接近于移动端的价格，而移动端的价格则不会有任何变化。

此外，我们将取消美元与欧元支付之间的切换功能。现在，欧洲地区的玩家只能使用欧元进行支付。

以下是宝石包的价格更新示例：

750颗宝石：4.99美元/欧元 -> 5.49欧元
1,600颗宝石：9.99美元/欧元 -> 10.99欧元
3,400颗宝石：19.99美元/欧元 -> 21.99欧元
9,200颗宝石：49.99美元/欧元 -> 53.99欧元
20,000颗宝石：99.99美元/欧元 -> 107.99欧元

这些变更立即生效，且不会影响其他地区。

MainNav/Mailbox/VAT_Update_Description_A.oracleText: These changes are effective May 18, 2023, and will not affect other regions.
MainNav/Mailbox/VAT_Update_Description_A.translation: 这些变更将于2023年5月18日生效，且不会影响其他地区。

MainNav/Mailbox/Y24MKM_ScavengerHunt_1_D.oracleText: Hello, detective. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance. A mysterious figure has been leaving cryptic clues all over Arena. We'll need your help to crack the case. Solve the riddle below, and enter the Code in the store for a prize! The first clue we found is easy: "Who is known as the ‘Master Sleuth' on Ravnica?" Good luck, detective! More clues may appear in Arena over the next few days, so stay vigilant. We must solve all five clues before we leave Ravnica on April 9th. --A Friend PS - Remember! Your code phrases cannot contain spaces.
MainNav/Mailbox/Y24MKM_ScavengerHunt_1_D.translation: 你好，侦探。 很高兴认识你。 一个神秘人物在竞技场各处留下了神秘的线索。 我们需要你的帮助来破案。 解决下面的谜题，并在商店中输入代码即可获得奖品！ 我们发现的第一条线索很简单：“谁在拉尼卡被称为‘大侦探’？” 祝你好运，侦探！ 未来几天，竞技场中可能会出现更多线索，因此请保持警惕。 我们必须在 4 月 9 日离开拉尼卡之前解决所有五个线索。 —— 一位朋友 PS-记住！ 你的代码短语不能包含空格。

MainNav/Mailbox/Y24MKM_ScavengerHunt_2_D.oracleText: Good work tracking down clues so far, detective. The only lead we have right now is what you just found in the Store. It's the Dossier card style of a fellow sleuth. How does it describe the Homicide Investigator's approach to solving crime? Remember, once you have the answer, enter it as a Code to get a reward. Best of luck. --A Friend PS - Remember! Your code phrases cannot contain spaces.
MainNav/Mailbox/Y24MKM_ScavengerHunt_2_D.translation: 侦探，线索一直找得不错，干得很好。 现在我们手头上有的提示就是你刚在商店里看到的那些。出现在一位侦探同行的卷宗卡牌样式上。 它上面是怎么说凶案遍侦员的破案手法的？ 记住，你解出答案后，将其作为代码输入便能获得奖励。祝你好运。 ～一位朋友 PS - 记住！您的代码短语不能包含空格。

MainNav/Mailbox/Y24MKM_ScavengerHunt_3_D.oracleText: Congratulations, detective. You've found the next clue. A mysterious figure left this for us to find outside of Karlov Manor: "Across Ravnica, fear has been nurtured, and an evil plot have been furthered, as poor Teysa Karlov has been tragically '________'" Who would write such a horrible rhyme? Remember once you have the answer to enter it as a Code to get a reward. Good luck, detective! And stay safe. --A Friend PS - Remember! Your code phrases cannot contain spaces.
MainNav/Mailbox/Y24MKM_ScavengerHunt_3_D.translation: 侦探，恭喜。你找到了下一条线索。有位神秘人物在卡洛夫庄园外给我们留下了这个： 「拉尼卡内外，恐惧遍开花， 邪恶阴谋散，疑云尽天涯， 泰莎卡洛夫，可怜遭『____』。」 谁会写出押韵如此糟糕的文章？记住，你解出答案后，将其作为代码输入便能获得奖励。侦探，祝你好运！注意安全。 ～一位朋友 PS - 记住！您的代码短语不能包含空格。

MainNav/Mailbox/Y24MKM_ScavengerHunt_4_D.oracleText: Hello again, detective. Thank you for your tireless hunt—we wouldn't be making much headway without you. Here's the next clue: Enter the passphrase 'Ravnica Lineup' in the Deckbuilder. You will be presented with a number of notable figures. The high and mighty of our fair city. But someone is missing. What is the pattern, and who--or what--is not included in this rogues' gallery? Submit your answer into the Code entry in the store, and you'll be well on your way to cracking this case! PS - If you're stumped, make sure to filter for unowned cards to see all 9 Ravnica legends! And remember, your code phrases cannot contain spaces. -- A Friend
MainNav/Mailbox/Y24MKM_ScavengerHunt_4_D.translation: 又见到你了，侦探。感谢你不懈的追查——没有你，我们几乎无法取得任何进展。这里是下一个线索： 在卡组构建器中输入密码短语「Ravnica Lineup」。你将会看到一些显要人物，我们公平城市的高高在上者。但有人不见了。有什么规律，以及谁——或什么——没有被包括在这个恶棍画廊里？ 将你的答案输入到商店里的代码处，你就会在破解这个案件的路上更进一步！ 附言 - 如果你感到困惑，确保过滤未拥有的卡牌以查看全部9位拉尼卡传奇人物！记住，你的代码短语中不能包含空格。 ～一位朋友

MainNav/Mailbox/Y24MKM_ScavengerHunt_5_D.oracleText: Welcome back, detective. Our hunt is almost at its end. Trostani is really three sisters Cim, Oba, and Ses Within Vitu-Ghazi discord festers And one dryad must confess Blooms burning in rage With a sickly aroma The sweet pollen shows That the killer was ___ Once you have the answer, enter it as a Code for your final reward. --A Friend PS - Remember! Your code phrases cannot contain spaces.
MainNav/Mailbox/Y24MKM_ScavengerHunt_5_D.translation: 侦探，欢迎回来。我们的搜寻行动即将接近尾声。 卓塔妮是三姊妹 希姆欧芭和赛丝 维图加基谐音碎 有位树灵要认罪 花朵怒绽发 浓郁香气佳 甜美花粉撒 凶手是____ 记住，你解出答案后，将其作为代码输入便能获得奖励。 ～一位朋友 PS - 记住！您的代码短语不能包含空格。

MainNav/Mailbox/Y24MKM_ScavengerHunt_Alm.oracleText:
You almost got the right answer! You're close, detective, don't give up.

Try finding a synonym to what you've already entered. You've got this!

--A Friend

PS - Remember! Your code phrases cannot contain spaces.
MainNav/Mailbox/Y24MKM_ScavengerHunt_Alm.translation:
你几乎找到了正确答案！ 你已经很接近了，侦探，不要放弃。

尝试找到你已输入内容的同义词。 你肯定行！

——一位朋友

PS-记住！ 你的代码短语不能包含空格。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Adventurer_Bio.oracleText: A hooded figure stands in the doorway, their face obscured by shadows. They do not speak, but mysterious power crackles at their fingertips. Who are they? What do they want? Their fate has yet to be written.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Adventurer_Bio.translation: 戴着兜帽的人站在门口，他们的脸被阴影遮住了。他们没有说话，但神秘的力量在他们的指尖噼啪作响。他们是谁？他们想要什么？他们的命运还有待书写。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/AjaniGoldmane_Bi.oracleText: Ajani Goldmane is a leonin Planeswalker who fiercely believes in justice, though his methods for achieving it have changed over the years. He fell under Phyrexian control as a pawn in their invasion scheme, but his mind and body were restored after the war.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/AjaniGoldmane_Bi.translation: 金鬃阿耶尼是一位坚信正义的狮子鹏洛客，尽管多年来他实现正义的方式已经发生了变化。 他作为非瑞克西亚入侵阴谋的一枚棋子，落入非瑞人的控制之下，但战后他的心灵和身体都得到了恢复。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Ajani_DMU_Bio.oracleText: A leonin warrior and healer once known throughout the Multiverse for his heroic deeds, the Planeswalker Ajani made the perfect sleeper agent for the Phyrexian praetor Sheoldred's dark plans. Once a champion of the Coalition, Ajani has become one of its most feared enemies, striking terror and despair in the hearts of those he hunts.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Ajani_DMU_Bio.translation: 一位狮子战士和治疗师，曾经因其英勇事迹而闻名于多重宇宙，鹏洛客阿耶尼现在成为了非瑞克西亚魔判官希欧蕊的黑暗计划中完美的潜藏密探。曾经是联盟冠军的阿耶尼，现在已成为联盟最可怕的敌人之一，被他所捕猎的人，心中充满了恐惧和绝望。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/AlenaHalana_VOW_.oracleText: Partners in both work and life, Halana and Alena protect travelers through the Ulvenwald, an ancient forest that is home to werewolves, vampires, and other dangerous creatures. With the onset of eternal night, their battles against these terrors have become more harrowing than ever before.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/AlenaHalana_VOW_.translation: 荷拉娜与阿雷娜是工作和生活中的伙伴，她们保护旅行者穿越沃文森森林，这是一个古老的森林，是狼人、吸血鬼和其他危险生物的家园。随着永夜的到来，她们与这些恐怖怪物的战斗变得比以往任何时候都更加惨烈。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Angrath_Bio.oracleText: Angrath is driven by a feeling of restless impatience, like a caged animal awaiting its moment of freedom. This fuels his wild temper and spurs him on in an endless series of raids upon the coastal towns of the Sun Empire.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Angrath_Bio.translation: 安戈斯犹如久囚笼中的野兽，因渴望自由而焦躁。他本就易怒，如今更是火上加油，不断驱使船员去劫掠烈阳帝国的沿海城镇。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Astarion_HBG_Bio.oracleText: Astarion prowled the night as a vampire spawn for centuries, serving a sadistic master until he was snatched away. Now he can walk in the light, but can he leave his wicked past behind?
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Astarion_HBG_Bio.translation: 阿斯代伦是一个徘徊在夜幕下的吸血鬼后裔，他已经活了几百年，期间一直侍奉着他那虐待成性的主人，直到他被掳走。现在他可以行走在阳光下，但他能舍去他那扭曲的过往吗？

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Atraxa_MOM_Bio.oracleText: Originally an angel from Mirrodin who was "blessed" with compleation, Atraxa serves as the voice of Elesh Norn and spreads her words (and glistening oil) across the Multiverse. During the invasion, she's tasked with destroying New Capenna and its source of Halo—but Atraxa may not be prepared for what she finds there . . .
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Atraxa_MOM_Bio.translation: 亚崔夏原本是来自秘罗地的天使，经完化「祝福」后，她便成为了艾蕾侬之声，将其福音（与烁油）传遍多重宇宙。在大侵攻期间，她的任务是摧毁新卡佩纳和金圆来源～但她可能没有准备好应付此间变故...

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Aurelia_Bio.oracleText: Aurelia argues that true justice isn't merely the enforcement of the letter of existing laws; but the establishment of equitable and compassionate relationships among all of Ravnica's people.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Aurelia_Bio.translation: 欧瑞梨认为，仅用强权维系法条权威算不上守护正义，唯有使平等互助理念长植民心，方才能在拉尼卡实现公义。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Aan.oracleText: Aang is the Avatar, master of all four elements and inheritor of reincarnated power and experience. But more importantly, Aang is a kind-hearted boy who strives to help those around him. While sometimes overwhelmed by his heavy burden, he never lets go of his idealism.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Aan.translation: 安昂是降世神通，他不仅是精通四种元素的宗师，更继承了历代神通转世而来的力量与经验。但比这些身份更重要的是，他是一个内心无比善良的男孩，总是竭尽全力去帮助身边的每一个人。尽管肩负的重任有时会让他不堪重负，但他从未抛弃自己那份理想主义的纯真。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Abi.oracleText: A deaf Silverquill student, Abigale has always had a way with words, able to conjure vivid images and powerful emotions in the minds of others. She prefers to carefully observe the people around her and take time to compose her ideas thoughtfully and intentionally.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Abi.translation: 银毫学院一位失聪的学生艾比苟，向来擅长驾驭文字，能在他人心中幻变出栩栩如生的意象与强烈的情感。她偏爱细心观察周遭的人，并花时间深思熟虑、字斟句酌地构思自己的想法。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Adv.oracleText: A hooded figure stands in the doorway, their face obscured by shadows. They do not speak, but mysterious power crackles at their fingertips. Who are they? What do they want? Their fate has yet to be written.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Adv.translation: 戴着兜帽的人站在门口，他们的脸被阴影遮住了。他们没有说话，但神秘的力量在他们的指尖噼啪作响。他们是谁？他们想要什么？他们的命运还有待书写。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Aja.oracleText: Ajani Goldmane is a leonin Planeswalker who fiercely believes in justice, though his methods for achieving it have changed over the years. He fell under Phyrexian control as a pawn in their invasion scheme, but his mind and body were restored after the war.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Aja.translation: 金鬃阿耶尼是一位坚信正义的狮子鹏洛客，尽管多年来他实现正义的方式已经发生了变化。 他作为非瑞克西亚入侵阴谋的一枚棋子，落入非瑞人的控制之下，但战后他的心灵和身体都得到了恢复。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Aja.oracleText: A leonin warrior and healer once known throughout the Multiverse for his heroic deeds, the Planeswalker Ajani made the perfect sleeper agent for the Phyrexian praetor Sheoldred's dark plans. Once a champion of the Coalition, Ajani has become one of its most feared enemies, striking terror and despair in the hearts of those he hunts.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Aja.translation: 一位狮子战士和治疗师，曾经因其英勇事迹而闻名于多重宇宙，鹏洛客阿耶尼现在成为了非瑞克西亚魔判官希欧蕊的黑暗计划中完美的潜藏密探。曾经是联盟冠军的阿耶尼，现在已成为联盟最可怕的敌人之一，被他所捕猎的人，心中充满了恐惧和绝望。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Aja.oracleText: Ajani Goldmane is a leonin Planeswalker who fiercely believes in justice, though his methods for achieving it have changed over the years. He fell under Phyrexian control as a pawn in their invasion scheme, but his mind and body were restored after the war.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Aja.translation: 金鬃阿耶尼是位狮族鹏洛客。他坚信正道毫不动摇，但随着时间流逝，他践行正义的方式也有所改变。在非瑞克西亚大侵攻期间，他曾一度受其操控，沦为其入侵计划的马前卒，所幸战后心灵和身躯都恢复如初。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Aja.oracleText: Ajani Goldmane is a leonin Planeswalker who fiercely believes in justice, though his methods for achieving it have changed over the years. He fell under Phyrexian control as a pawn in their invasion scheme, but his mind and body were restored after the war.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Aja.translation: 金鬃阿耶尼是位狮族鹏洛客。他坚信正道毫不动摇，但随着时间流逝，他践行正义的方式也有所改变。在非瑞克西亚大侵攻期间，他曾一度受其操控，沦为其入侵计划的马前卒，所幸战后心灵和身躯都恢复如初。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ale.oracleText: Partners in both work and life, Halana and Alena protect travelers through the Ulvenwald, an ancient forest that is home to werewolves, vampires, and other dangerous creatures. With the onset of eternal night, their battles against these terrors have become more harrowing than ever before.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ale.translation: 荷拉娜与阿雷娜是工作和生活中的伙伴，她们保护旅行者穿越沃文森森林，这是一个古老的森林，是狼人、吸血鬼和其他危险生物的家园。随着永夜的到来，她们与这些恐怖怪物的战斗变得比以往任何时候都更加惨烈。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Alp.oracleText: A mysterious and powerful mage delving deep into the secrets of the past, this aven seeks to turn history into Dominaria's most potent weapon.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Alp.translation: 布罗格生前是个工匠，用他在乌尔博格找到的废品拼凑出机械的小玩意。现在他已经死了，但他还在继续修补，组装沼泽苔藓和尸体材料，为他繁荣的社交圈添砖加瓦。在他的工场外，可以看到布罗格和他的好朋友丁骨，丁骨偶尔会抢劫他。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Alp.oracleText: A mysterious and powerful mage delving deep into the secrets of the past, this aven seeks to turn history into Dominaria's most potent weapon.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Alp.translation: 这位神秘而强大的法师深入研究过去的秘密，试图将历史变成多明纳里亚最有力的武器。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Alp.oracleText: Alpharael is a young acolyte who's spent his entire life inside the Monoist monastery. His faith wavers after he received the impossible task of eliminating the Sunstar Free Company's foothold in Sothera. But a mysterious artifact may help Alpharael escape his fate . . .
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Alp.translation: 阿法雷是位年轻的奇相教侍僧，一生都在修道院中度过。当他接到铲除辉星自由连在索瑟拉的据点这项不可能完成的任务时，信仰产生了动摇。但一件神秘的神器或许能帮助阿法雷逃脱他的宿命...

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ang.oracleText: Angrath is driven by a feeling of restless impatience, like a caged animal awaiting its moment of freedom. This fuels his wild temper and spurs him on in an endless series of raids upon the coastal towns of the Sun Empire.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ang.translation: 安戈斯犹如久囚笼中的野兽，因渴望自由而焦躁。他本就易怒，如今更是火上加油，不断驱使船员去劫掠烈阳帝国的沿海城镇。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_App.oracleText: Appa is a sky bison that can fly using airbending. He is Aang's loyal companion and Team Avatar's primary means of transport. Though he's very gentle, his massive size allows him to protect others from smaller threats.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_App.translation: 阿柏是一只飞天野牛，能凭借截气翱翔天际。他不仅是安昂最忠诚的伙伴，也是神通小队赖以远行的主要交通方式。尽管阿柏性情温顺，可他庞大的身躯也足以保护大家，抵御寻常的危险。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Apr.oracleText: If there's a scoop out there in New York City, intrepid freelance reporter April O'Neil is determined to find it! April is a pivotal human ally to the Turtles, also supporting them as a dedicated friend, a budding scientist, and a martial artist in training.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Apr.translation: 如果纽约市里有任何独家新闻，勇敢的自由记者艾普·奥尼尔都决心要找到它！艾普是忍者神龟们至关重要的人类伙伴，同时她也是一位忠诚的朋友、一位崭露头角的科学家和一位正在接受训练的武术家。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Apr.oracleText: If there's a scoop out there in New York City, intrepid freelance reporter April O'Neil is determined to find it! April is a pivotal human ally to the Turtles, also supporting them as a dedicated friend, a budding scientist, and a martial artist in training.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Apr.translation: 如果纽约市里有任何独家新闻，勇敢的自由记者艾普·奥尼尔都决心要找到它！艾普是忍者神龟们至关重要的人类伙伴，同时她也是一位忠诚的朋友、一位崭露头角的科学家和一位正在接受训练的武术家。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ara.oracleText: Aragorn, legendary Ranger of the North, is a man of many destinies. As the descendant of Isildur, Aragorn wields his ancestor's reforged blade and joined the Fellowship of the Ring to settle his family's legacy. After the war, he claims the throne of Gondor and weds Arwen, his true love.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ara.translation: 阿拉贡，传说中的北方游侠，一个命运多舛的人。 作为伊熙尔铎的后裔，阿拉贡挥舞着他祖先的重铸剑，并加入了魔戒远征队来继承他家族的遗产。 战争结束后，他获得了刚铎的王位，并与他的真爱阿尔温结婚。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Arv.oracleText: Once a proud Benalish knight, Arvad was turned into a vampire by a descendent of the notorious Sengir line. Wielding the same holy magic that lets him withstand sunlight and suppress his hunger for blood, Arvad guards his companions aboard the Weatherlight from the Phyrexian invaders.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Arv.translation: 亚瓦德曾经是一名骄傲的宾纳里亚骑士，被臭名昭著的森吉尔家族的后裔变成了吸血鬼。挥舞着同样的神圣魔法，让他能够抵御阳光并抑制对血液的渴望，亚瓦德守护着他在晴空号上的同伴们，使他们免受非瑞克西亚入侵者的侵扰。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ash.oracleText: Cloaked in darkness and mystery, Ashiok has the power to turn nightmares into reality. Ashiok claims to act in the name of equality—and believes there is no greater equalizer than fear.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ash.translation: 隐藏在黑暗和神秘之中，安梭苛拥有将噩梦变为现实的力量。 安梭苛声称以平等的名义行事——并相信没有比恐惧更能平衡的东西了。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ash.oracleText: Ashiok is an elegant being of nightmare who draws on fear, creating twisted physical manifestations of each victim's darkest dreams. Ashiok's motives and origin are unknown, but most who encounter this sinister entity quickly conclude that some mysteries are better left unraveled.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ash.translation: 安梭苛是一个优雅的噩梦生物，利用恐惧，为每个受害者最黑暗的梦想创造扭曲的物理表现。安梭苛的动机和来源不明，但大多数遇到这个邪恶的实体的人很快就会得出结论，有些谜团最好不要被揭开。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ash.oracleText: Ashling is a flamekin dancer and a lifelong pilgrim who has wrestled with the duality of her existence between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor. After further journeys, she has come to realize that the clash of light and shadow will eventually lead to wholeness and greater understanding.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ash.translation: 灰儿是一位炎身舞者，也是一名终身的朝圣者，她一直在洛温与暗影荒原之间的双重存在中挣扎。几经旅程后，她逐渐意识到光与影的冲突终将导向完满与深刻的理解。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ash.oracleText: Ashling is a nimble flamekin from the plane of Lorwyn with the ability to cast magic through her dancing. All her life, she felt a calling to seek out a mythic elemental being—knowing nothing of the destiny that awaited her on her pilgrimage.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ash.translation: 灰儿是洛温时空的一名敏捷的炎族，她能够通过舞蹈施展魔法。她一生都觉得自己受到了召唤，要去寻找一个神秘的元素生物——但她对朝圣之旅中等待她的命运一无所知。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ast.oracleText: Astarion prowled the night as a vampire spawn for centuries, serving a sadistic master until he was snatched away. Now he can walk in the light, but can he leave his wicked past behind?
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ast.translation: 阿斯代伦是一个徘徊在夜幕下的吸血鬼后裔，他已经活了几百年，期间一直侍奉着他那虐待成性的主人，直到他被掳走。现在他可以行走在阳光下，但他能舍去他那扭曲的过往吗？

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Atr.oracleText: Originally an angel from Mirrodin who was "blessed" with compleation, Atraxa serves as the voice of Elesh Norn and spreads her words (and glistening oil) across the Multiverse. During the invasion, she's tasked with destroying New Capenna and its source of Halo—but Atraxa may not be prepared for what she finds there . . .
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Atr.translation: 亚崔夏原本是来自秘罗地的天使，被“祝福”完化，她为艾蕾侬代言，并将她的话语（和烁油）传播到多重宇宙。 在入侵期间，她的任务是摧毁新卡佩纳及其金圆源头，但亚崔夏可能还没有为她在那里发现的东西做好准备……

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Aur.oracleText: Aurelia argues that true justice isn't merely the enforcement of the letter of existing laws; but the establishment of equitable and compassionate relationships among all of Ravnica's people.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Aur.translation: 欧瑞梨认为，仅用强权维系法条权威算不上守护正义，唯有使平等互助理念长植民心，方才能在拉尼卡实现公义。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Azu.oracleText: Princess Azula of the Fire Nation is refined, manipulative, and cruel. She's a firebending prodigy and a skilled liar, making her the Fire Lord's favorite child and most trusted agent. Despite her incredible talents, she is deeply insecure and threatens others to maintain her confidence.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Azu.translation: 烈火国的阿祖拉公主，集优雅、狡诈与残酷于一身。她是不世出的振火奇才，也是个天生的谎言家，因此深得烈火君的宠爱与信赖，成为他手下最得力的干将。然而，在她惊人天赋的背后，是难以掩饰的内心惶恐，她需要靠不断地威慑旁人来巩固自己摇摇欲坠的信心。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bal.oracleText: Balthier would describe himself as a noble thief, stealing only from those who deserve it. He goes where he pleases, swearing fealty to no one. Fran is as much at ease with a sword as she is her bare hands. Her proficiency with a blade is matched only by her skill with a wrench, as she also handles the maintenance of Balthier's airship, the Strahl.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bal.translation: 巴夫雷尔是一位以其爱机——最快的飞空艇光辉号而闻名、并以义贼身份活跃的青年。他是阿凯迪亚帝国要人西德的儿子，曾是掌管帝国法律与秩序的「审判长」之一。但由于与父亲的矛盾，他离开了国家，作为一名自由的空贼活动至今。芙兰有着兔子般长耳朵，是森之民维埃拉族的美女。她在那厌恶与其他种族交流的族群中是个例外，融入了普通人类尘族的社会，从事着空贼的行当。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bas.oracleText: For most of his life, Basri Ket was utterly devoted to Oketra, god of loyalty and solidarity. When she was slain in the Hour of Devastation, his world was shattered. But rather than let it break him, he took up one of her massive arrows as a spear and vowed to champion her ideals across the Multiverse.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bas.translation: 巴席利柯特一生中的大部分时间都完全献给了团结之神。当她在毁灭时刻被杀时，他的世界被打碎了。但他并没有因此而崩溃，而是拿起她的一支巨箭作为长矛，发誓要在整个多重宇宙捍卫她的理想。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bay.oracleText: When their farm came under attack by Calamity Beasts, Baylen's only option was to repurpose their scythe for combat. Many seasons later, they've honed their warrior talents with magic from the lizardfolk, channeling fiery passion with every swing of the blade.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bay.translation: 当他们的农场遭到灾兽的袭击时，拜棱别无选择，只能将镰刀改用于战斗。许多个季节过去了，他们利用蜥蜴民的魔法磨练了战斗技巧，每一次挥动镰刀都能释放出炽热的激情。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Beb.oracleText: The menacing mutants known as Bebop and Rocksteady are rarely seen apart and always causing trouble. Both were humans who mutated through animal DNA, applying their enhanced strength and durability to enact Shredder's villainous plans (just as long as there's no deep thinking involved).
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Beb.translation: 人称比博与洛克斯代迪的这对凶恶突变体总是形影不离，四处惹是生非。二者皆是因动物DNA变异的人类，凭借强化后的力量与耐力执行施瑞德的邪恶计划（只要不涉及复杂思考就行）。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Beb.oracleText: The menacing mutant known as Bebop is rarely seen apart from his co-conspirator Rocksteady. The former human was mutated through animal DNA into a warthog, but he's retained plenty of his punk attitude and his signature mohawk and glasses.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Beb.translation: 人称比博的凶恶突变体很少与他的共犯洛克斯代迪分开出现。这位前人类因动物DNA变异为疣猪，但仍保留了大量朋克精神及其标志性的莫霍克发型和眼镜。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bla.oracleText: T'Challa serves the nation of Wakanda as its king and sworn protector known as the Black Panther. Enhanced with strength, agility, and a Vibranium suit, he defends Wakanda against threats both internal and external. Defying tradition, he also assists the greater world—often as an Avenger.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bla.translation: 特查拉作为瓦坎达的国王与誓约守护者，以黑豹之名效力于国家。凭借力量、敏捷和振金战衣增强自身能力，保卫瓦坎达免受内外威胁。他打破传统，也常常以复仇者的身份协助更广阔的世界。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bla.oracleText: The enigmatic Natasha Romanoff proves that some heroes work best in the shadows. Operating at peak human condition with expert combat training, deadly gadgets, and fluency in multiple languages, the Black Widow is S.H.I.E.L.D.'s weapon of choice for any covert mission.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bla.translation: 神秘的娜塔莎·罗曼诺夫证明了有些英雄最适合在暗处行动。黑寡妇以人类巅峰体能、专业格斗训练、致命装备和精通多国语言的能力，成为神盾局执行秘密任务的首选武器。
黑寡妇娜塔莎·罗曼诺夫

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bol.oracleText: A force of villainous destruction, crushing all that stand in his way.  Elder dragon and tyrant of worlds, Nicol Bolas is one of the oldest known beings in the Multiverse.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bol.translation: 龙族的长老，世界的暴君；尼可波拉斯是多重宇宙中已知的最古老人物之一。他掌握着邪恶的毁灭力量，能够粉碎一切敢阻止他的魔法和生灵。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bor.oracleText: When the Machine Legion invades Ravnica, two unlikely heroes rise to defend it: Borborygmos, the enormous cyclopean leader of the Gruul clans, and Fblthp, a tiny homunculus with the worst sense of direction in the Multiverse. They're opposites in many ways, but when it comes to protecting Ravnica, they see perfectly eye to eye.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bor.translation: 当非瑞克西亚邪军侵攻拉尼卡时，两位体型相差悬殊的英雄挺身而出，携手护卫家园：古鲁部族身躯庞大的独眼巨人领袖咕噜力莫，和多重宇宙方向感最差的迷你造妖夫毕佐。虽然他们许多方面大相径庭，但在保护拉尼卡方面，他们眼眼相惜。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bor.oracleText: Boromir, the eldest son of the Steward of Gondor, is a proud fighter and a member of the Fellowship of the Ring. Tempted by the Ring's power, he attempts and fails to seize it from Frodo. When Uruk-hai attack the Fellowship at Amon Hen, Boromir meets a tragic end.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bor.translation: 波洛米尔，刚铎宰相长子，英勇战士，魔戒同盟一员。受魔戒力量引诱，他曾试图从弗罗多手中将其夺走，最终未能得手。当远征队于阿蒙汉山遭乌鲁克族攻击时，波洛米尔不幸战死。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bra.oracleText: Centuries ago, Braids was a powerful mage for the Cabal until a near-death experience left her trapped in dementia space. There she was trapped, torn apart again and again by her own nightmares, until a desperate conclave of summoners performed a ritual to drag her back to Dominaria (and unfortunately blew up all their heads in the process).
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bra.translation: 几个世纪前，布蕾德是柯帮的一名强大法师，直到一次濒临死亡的经历让她被困在惧像空间。她被困在那里，一次又一次地被自己的噩梦撕裂，直到一个穷途末路的惧像召唤师协会举行仪式将她拖回多明纳里亚（不幸的是，在这个过程中他们的头都被炸掉了）。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bra.oracleText: Beckett Brass is the steady leader of the Brazen Coalition. Hoping to bounce back in the wake of the Phyrexian invasion, Brass marshals her pirate crew toward the rumored wealth and power hidden below the surface.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bra.translation: 贝克蒂霸司是莽霸联盟的沉着领导者。霸司带领她的海盗船员动身寻找传说中隐藏在地面下的财富和权力，希望能在非瑞人入侵后卷土重来。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bri.oracleText: After helping in the fight against Oona, Brigid the kithkin opted for a simple life as a trainer of the Goldmeadow city watch, happy to live without the oppressive yoke of the elves. She's gruff, but remains a steadfast ally to those in need.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Bri.translation: 在协助对抗欧娜的战斗后，洁英布莉姬选择在金牧地卫队担任教官，乐于过上摆脱妖精压迫枷锁后的简单生活。她性格粗犷，但对需要帮助的人来说始终是坚定的伙伴。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cac.oracleText: A mysterious creature resembling a cactus. Often shy and timid, it uses quick and nimble movements to dodge player attacks and counter with its powerful '1000 Needles' technique.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cac.translation: 形如仙人掌的不可思议生物，性格多半害羞且胆小。它能以敏捷的动作躲避玩家的攻击，并用其堪称代名词的强力招式「千针刺」向玩家发动攻击。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cap.oracleText: As a scrawny, sickly teen in the earliest days of World War II, Steve volunteered for an experimental program that would grant him strength to fight for his country. Frozen under ice for decades, Steve awoke in the modern era to lead the Avengers.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cap.translation: 在二战初期，瘦弱多病的史蒂夫自愿参加了一个实验项目，获得为祖国而战的力量。被冰封数十年后，史蒂夫在现代苏醒，领导复仇者联盟。
美国队长史蒂夫·罗杰斯

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cap.oracleText: Carol wasn't the first to be called "Captain Marvel," but she's taking the mantle higher, further, and faster than ever before. The former Air Force pilot was exposed to a Kree alien device, rewiring her DNA and giving her powerful cosmic abilities.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cap.translation: 卡罗尔并非第一个被称为「惊奇队长」的人，但她将这一称号提升到了前所未有的高度。这位前空军飞行员曾接触克里人外星装置，改写了她的DNA，赋予她强大的宇宙异能。
惊奇队长卡罗尔·丹弗斯

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cas.oracleText: New York is a big city, and four turtles can't protect it all—that's where Casey Jones comes in. This vigilante crime fighter's signature style is a hockey mask and a dangerous arsenal of sporting equipment. At least he's working for the good guys!
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cas.translation: 纽约是个大城市，四只乌龟可没法全盘保护——这正是凯西·琼斯出场的时机。这位义务警员的标志性装扮是曲棍球面具和一套危险的运动装备武具。至少他是在为正义一方效力！

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cas.oracleText: New York is a big city, and four turtles can't protect it all—that's where Casey Jones comes in. This vigilante crime fighter's signature style is a hockey mask and a dangerous arsenal of sporting equipment. At least he's working for the good guys!
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cas.translation: 纽约是个大城市，四只乌龟可没法全盘保护——这正是凯西·琼斯出场的时机。这位义务警员的标志性装扮是曲棍球面具和一套危险的运动装备武具。至少他是在为正义一方效力！

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cas.oracleText: A cheerful gatekeeper of the dwarven castle in the underground world.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cas.translation: 地下世界矮人城的开朗门卫。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cha.oracleText: There is no virtue in subtlety, at least not as far as Chandra Nalaar is concerned. She's a confident, ardent, defiant Planeswalker whose specialty is pyromancy: spells of fire, fire, and more fire.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cha.translation: 缜密没什么好处～至少茜卓纳拉从不挂心这点。她是一名自信满盈，热情似火，桀骜不驯的鹏洛客，她的专长就是烈焰：火焰咒语，火焰，以及更猛的火焰。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cha.oracleText: An impulsive and immensely powerful pyromancer, Chandra Nalaar is still growing into the hero she is destined to become.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cha.translation: 茜卓纳拉是位性格冲动、技艺高强的烈焰术士。将来她必定能够成为伟大英雄，只是她现在仍在不断进步。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cha.oracleText: Chandra Nalaar still has her planeswalker spark, but she's driven to compete in the Ghirapur Grand Prix to win a spark for her love, Nissa. To maximize her chances, Chandra snubbed her home plane's team and partnered with last year's winners—Team Cloudspire.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cha.translation: 茜卓纳拉依然保有她的鹏洛客火花，但她决心参加吉拉波大奖赛，为她的爱人妮莎赢得一枚火花。为了最大化胜算，茜卓拒绝了家乡时空的队伍，转而与去年的冠军——鼎云侠队合作。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cha.oracleText: There is no virtue in subtlety, at least not as far as Chandra Nalaar is concerned. She's a confident, ardent, defiant Planeswalker whose specialty is pyromancy: spells of fire, fire, and more fire.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cha.translation: 缜密没什么好处～至少茜卓纳拉从不挂心这点。她是一名自信满盈，热情似火，桀骜不驯的鹏洛客，她的专长就是烈焰：火焰咒语，火焰，以及更猛的火焰。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cha.oracleText: An impulsive and immensely powerful pyromancer, Chandra Nalaar is still growing into the hero she is destined to become.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cha.translation: 茜卓纳拉是位性格冲动、技艺高强的烈焰术士。将来她必定能够成为伟大英雄，只是她现在仍在不断进步。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cli.oracleText: Born as the eldest son of Archduke Rosfield, he was expected to awaken as the Dominant of the Phoenix, but that responsibility fell on the shoulders of his younger brother, Joshua. Clive honed his skills with the blade until, after proving his worth in ceremonial combat, he was dubbed a knight. He was appointed as his brother's shield and was blessed with the ability to wield a part of the Phoenix's fire. However, he became ensnared in tragedy and was sent on a quest for vengeance, pursuing the author of this tragedy, the mysterious dark Eikon, Ifrit.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cli.translation: 罗兹菲尔德家族的嫡长子，可觉醒为不死鸟显化者的却是弟弟约书亚。克莱夫日夜精进剑术，在殿前比试中凭借实力获得了「骑士」的称号。从此，他正式成为了约书亚的后盾，获得了「不死鸟的祝福」，能够使用一部分不死鸟的能力。然而不久后他被卷入了巨大的悲剧之中，以复仇者的身份，开始追杀造成这场悲剧的神秘召唤兽「黑死伊弗利特」。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Clo.oracleText: Cloud Strife is a young man who claims to be a former elite member of the Shinra's SOLDIER unit. When he was hired as a mercenary for the anti-Shinra organization Avalanche, he learned that his nemesis Sephiroth was still alive. Now he pursues Sephiroth to settle their score.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Clo.translation: 自称曾是神罗精英「一级神罗战士」的青年。在协助反神罗组织「雪崩」期间，他得知了毁灭其故乡的宿敌萨菲罗斯依然存活，遂为了与其了结恩怨而展开追寻。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cou.oracleText: The court of Ardenvale values loyalty above all else, and only those with truly virtuous hearts survive the trial of the Circle of Loyalty. Ardenvale's knights fight in perfect unison with a single, unbreakable will, each one selflessly defending the next.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cou.translation: 雅登瓦的宫廷重视忠诚高于一切，只有那些正直善良的人才能在忠诚焰圈的考验中幸存下来。雅登瓦的骑士们以一种牢不可破的意志完美地统一作战，每个人都无私地捍卫着下一个人。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cru.oracleText: Few dare to cross Cruelclaw, a weasel mercenary-for-hire who won't question a job or the client behind it. He brags that he's never lost a fight, which is true—but he's also never fought a fair one.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Cru.translation: 很少有人敢与虐爪为敌，他是一只鼬鼠雇佣兵，从不质疑工作或背后的客户。他吹嘘自己从未输过，这是事实——但他也从未公平的打一场。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Dan.oracleText: Danitha, heir of House Capashen, is a brave and brash knight who can always be found at the front of a melee. Trained from a young age in both diplomacy and sword-play, Danitha has taken over command of the knights once loyal to her fallen father—now she fights not just for Benalia, but Dominaria.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Dan.translation: 卡帕轩家族的继承人达妮莎是一位勇敢而无畏的骑士，总是可以在混战的前线找到她。达妮莎从小就接受外交和剑术训练。她接管了曾经忠于她死去的父亲的骑士团的指挥权——现在她不仅为宾纳里亚而战，还为多明纳里亚而战。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Dar.oracleText: After Matthew Murdock was blinded in a childhood accident, his other senses became enhanced. Through training, he found he could use these enhanced senses to defend the streets of Hell's Kitchen as the vigilante Daredevil—all while living a double life as a mild-mannered lawyer.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Dar.translation: 马修·默多克在童年事故中失明后，其他感官变得异常敏锐。通过训练，他发现自己可以利用这些增强的感官，以义警夜魔侠的身份守护地狱厨房的街头——同时过着温文尔雅律师的双重生活。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Dav.oracleText: Davriel Cane is a simple man who enjoys simple pleasures: wealth, luxury, and fine tea. He also happens to be a talented diabolist, skilled at binding demons to his service. He detests playing the hero, yet often finds himself in the role despite his best efforts to avoid it.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Dav.translation: 达夫黎凯恩是一个简单的人，他享受着简单的快乐：财富、奢侈品和上等茶。他还碰巧是一个有天赋的恶魔学家，擅长将恶魔束缚在他的身边。他不喜欢扮演英雄，但却经常发现自己在扮演英雄，尽管他竭力避免这种情况。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Del.oracleText: Dellian was the youngest-ever tenured Witherbloom professor and a pioneer in necromantic studies. After he was discovered dead, he mysteriously rose from the grave thirteen months later with a Planeswalker's spark and a strange hunger lurking in the back of his mind.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Del.translation: 德连曾是靡华学院史上最年轻的终身教授，也是死灵术研究的先驱。然而在被发现身亡之后的第十三个月，他却离奇自墓中复生，觉醒了鹏洛客火花，同时在心底潜伏着一股诡异的饥渴。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Din.oracleText: Dina is a darkly humorous and tea-obsessed dryad who knows hundreds of recipes for potions, charms, and spells that help almost any malady or mood. She's recently found solace in a social life and Witherbloom mentorship, committing herself to deepening roots in her community.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Din.translation: 迪娜是一位带着黑色幽默、沉迷茶饮的树灵，精通数百种配方，能够调制药剂、护符与法术，以应对几乎各种病症与情绪。近来，她在社交生活与靡华学院的师承关系中找到了归属，并致力于在自己的群体中扎下更深的根基。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Din.oracleText: Dina is a weird, darkly humorous, and tea-obsessed student of Witherbloom. She is learning how to concoct all manner of herbal brews from bizarre swamp creatures. If she offers you a cup of tea, you should probably decline.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Din.translation: 是靡华学院的一个古怪、黑暗幽默、痴迷于茶的学生。她正在学习如何从怪异的沼泽生物中炼制各种草药酒。如果她给你一杯茶，你可能应该拒绝。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Dom.oracleText: Domri's affinity for wild creatures grew out of his natural distrust of rules, hierarchies, and authority figures. He can weave magic that summons, commands, and enhances these beasts.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Dom.translation: 多密和野蛮生物的密切关系来自于他天生对规则、阶级和权威人物的不信任。他能使用魔法来召唤、控制并加强这些野兽。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Don.oracleText: Master of machines Donnie leaps into battle with a bo staff and an array of his own useful inventions. His inquisitive nature serves the Turtles well on missions, even if his curiosity can occasionally get the better of him.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Don.translation: 机械大师多尼手持长棍与一系列自制的实用发明跃入战场。他天生的探究心在任务中对忍者神龟们大有助益，尽管有时好奇心会让他过于投入。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Don.oracleText: Master of machines Donnie leaps into battle with a bo staff and an array of his own useful inventions. His inquisitive nature serves the Turtles well on missions, even if his curiosity can occasionally get the better of him.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Don.translation: 机械大师多尼手持长棍与一系列自制的实用发明跃入战场。他天生的探究心在任务中对忍者神龟们大有助益，尽管有时好奇心会让他过于投入。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Dov.oracleText: Dovin can clearly see the flaws in any system or machine and predict with startling accuracy exactly how and when it will fail.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Dov.translation: 多温可以清晰洞见系统或机械当中的任何缺陷，同时还能精确预测故障发生的方式和时间。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_DrD.oracleText: With an ego as great as his genius, Doctor Doom casts a tall and fearsome shadow over the Marvel Universe. Wearing his iron mask and armor, he rules Latveria—but he won't relent until he conquers Earth and finally eliminates his longtime rival, Reed Richards.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_DrD.translation: 毁灭博士的自大与他的天才不相上下，他在漫威宇宙中投下巨大而可怕的阴影。他戴着铁面具、身披铠甲统治拉托维利亚——但他不会停歇，直到征服地球并最终消灭宿敌里德·理查兹。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ele.oracleText: When her infiltration of assassin organization the Hand failed, Elektra Natchios gave herself over to the insidious order, becoming one of their deadliest operatives. She eventually became free of the Hand's solitary grasp, but she'll rarely turn down a contract if the money's good enough.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ele.translation: 当渗透刺客组织手合会失败后，艾丽卡·纳奇丝投身于这个阴险的组织，成为其最致命的特工之一。她最终摆脱了手合会的控制，但如果报酬足够丰厚，她很少会拒绝合约。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ele.oracleText: After dominating the other Phyrexian praetors in a struggle for power, Elesh Norn led the transformation of the plane of Mirrodin into a world of twisted perfection called New Phyrexia. Under her rule, she now envisions an entire Multiverse "blessed" by the same mechanical corruption . . .
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ele.translation: 在权力斗争中统治了其他非瑞克西亚魔判官后，艾蕾侬带领秘罗地位面转变为一个完美且扭曲的世界，称为新非瑞克西亚。 在她的统治下，她现在设想让整个多重宇宙都受到同样的机械腐蚀的“祝福”……

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ell.oracleText: A lucky draw from the Deck of Many Things made Ellywick Tumblestrum the greatest bard in the multiverse. Her enchanting music so moved the Summer Queen and the Queen of Air and Darkness that they gifted the bard with her instrument, Morningmist.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ell.translation: 从万象无常牌中的幸运一抽，使艾利薇鼓琴成为多重宇宙中最伟大的吟游诗人。她迷人的音乐让夏日女王和空气与黑暗女王非常感动，她们把她的乐器--晨雾送给了吟游诗人。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Els.oracleText: Elspeth Tirel has been to hell and back (for starters) but one thing is always true—you can never keep her down for long. Reborn as a planeswalking angel in the final hours of the Phyrexian invasion, Elspeth led the charge to save the Multiverse.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Els.translation: 艾紫培提瑞曾从冥界复还，有一件事永远是对的——你绝对无法让她屈服太久。 在非瑞克西亚入侵的最后时刻，艾紫培重生为天使鹏洛客，带头拯救多元宇宙。
