MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tha.oracleText: Thanos, the Mad Titan, is single-minded in his pursuit of the Infinity Stones, which he believes will bring order—and ruin—to the universe. What drives him to such extremes? His attempted courtship of the goddess Death, who remains cold to his grandest gestures.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tha.translation: 疯狂泰坦灭霸一心追求无限宝石，他相信这将为宇宙带来秩序——以及毁灭。是什么驱使他走向如此极端？是他对死亡女神的追求，而死亡女神对他最宏大的姿态也无动于衷。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_The.oracleText: A mysterious swordswoman of unmatched prowess, the Wanderer appears without warning to defend the innocent before disappearing just as suddenly as she arrived. Few know the truth: she is the lost empress of Kamigawa, wandering the Multiverse in search of a way home.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_The.translation: 飘萍是一位具有无与伦比的能力的神秘女剑客，她毫无征兆地出现在人们面前，保护无辜者，然后就像她到来时一样突然消失。很少有人知道真相：她是神河的失落皇后，在多重宇宙游荡，寻找回家的路。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Thi.oracleText: The definitive muscle of the Fantastic Four. Ben Grimm, aka The Thing, is rock-like in strength, durability, and appearance, but he's a real softie when it comes to his friends and loved ones. If anything poses a threat, you better believe it's clobberin' time!
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Thi.translation: 神奇四侠中当之无愧的力量担当。本·格瑞姆，又名石头人，在力量、耐久和外表上都坚如磐石，但对朋友和亲人却心软得很。如果有任何威胁出现，你最好相信——痛扁时间到！

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tho.oracleText: Thor, the Asgardian god of thunder, was banished to Earth by his father, Odin. Thor's banishment taught him humility, as well as a fondness for the planet and its people. He wields Mjölnir, a divine hammer that can be lifted only by those deemed worthy.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tho.translation: 阿斯加德雷神索尔被父亲奥丁放逐到地球。索尔的放逐让他学会了谦卑，也让他对这颗星球和人类产生了感情。他挥舞着妙尔尼尔，一把只有被认定为有资格之人才能举起的神锤。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tia.oracleText: Appointed guardian of the sacred powerstone at the core of the Weatherlight, Tiana discovered a gift for maintaining the legendary skyship. At home amidst the grease and noise of the engine room, Tiana uses her natural abilities to keep the Weatherlight flying in hostile territory.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tia.translation: 被任命为晴空号核心的神圣能量石的守护者，蒂娅娜发现了维持传奇飞船的天赋。在发动机室的油脂和噪音中，蒂娅娜利用她的自然能力让晴空号能在敌对领土上飞行。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tib.oracleText: A sadistic, interplanar menace who revels in the suffering of others, Tibalt brings misery and conflict wherever he goes. Though born human on Innistrad, his fascination with pain drove him to explore fiendish magic that ultimately transformed him into a half-devil.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tib.translation: 提勃是一个虐待狂，以他人的痛苦为乐的星际威胁，无论他走到哪里都会带来痛苦和冲突。虽然他是出生在依尼翠的人类，但他对痛苦的迷恋促使他探索恶魔般的魔法，最终将自己转变为一个半恶魔。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tid.oracleText: Cheerful and carefree, Tidus was an ace blitzball player in the city of Zanarkand. After stumbling into Spira, a world plagued by the monster known as Sin, Tidus joins the summoner Yuna on her pilgrimage as he searches for a way home.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tid.translation: 一位来自札纳尔坎德的青年，作为水斗球的王牌选手而大放异彩，性格阳光开朗。在遭到散播灾厄的魔物「辛」的袭击后，他被卷入了名为史匹拉的世界，并在对周遭情况一无所知的情况下，加入了尤娜的旅程。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tin.oracleText: For Tinybones, stealing is its own reward—other than the reward, of course. When the skeletal scamp isn't "finding" valuables and infiltrating stealthy spaces for Oko, he's bonding with the demon Rakdos, one of the few beings who can understand him.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tin.translation: 对于细骨来说，偷窃本身就是一种奖励——当然，除了奖赏之外。 当他没有为瓯柯“寻找”贵重物品并渗透到隐秘空间时，他就会与恶魔拉铎司建立联系，拉铎司是少数能理解他的生物之一。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tit.oracleText: Queen Titania, avatar of the goddess Gaea, ruled over the forested island of Argoth. When Urza's and Mishra's forces came to Argoth's shores to plunder the land for resources, Titania unleashed the full fury of nature upon them. But when Urza activated the Sylex to end the war, Argoth was destroyed—and Titania with it.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tit.translation: 泰坦尼亚女王是女神盖亚的化身，统领被树林覆盖、郁郁葱葱的亚格斯岛。克撒和米斯拉的部队登陆此地争抢资源时，泰坦尼亚发动自然之力，将怒火全数倾注在两军之上。然而当克撒起动同兆终结战争时，亚格斯就此毁灭～而泰坦尼亚也未能幸存。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ton.oracleText: This enigmatic creature creeps forward by the light of a lantern held in one hand, before lashing out with the kitchen knife it holds in the other.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ton.translation: 手持菜刀和提灯的神秘魔物。它会缓慢地接近，并使出名为「菜刀」的必杀一击。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Top.oracleText: Toph is a self-reliant, blunt, and confident martial artist who teaches Aang earthbending. Born blind, she learned to "see" by sensing vibrations in the ground. She has trouble opening up to others, but her loyalty, unique perspective, and raw power make her a steadfast companion.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Top.translation: 拓芙是一位独立、自信、直率的武术家，她也是教导安昂运土术的师傅。她生来便双目失明，却学会了凭借感知大地的振动来“看”穿一切。尽管她很难对人敞开心扉，但她的忠诚不渝、独一无二的洞察力以及那份原始纯粹的力量，都让她成为了一位最值得信赖的伙伴。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tro.oracleText: Guildmaster of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica, and speaker for the World Tree, Mat'Selesnya. Trostani is a fusion of three Dryads who each represent a different key Selesnyan value: Life, Order, and Harmony.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Tro.translation: 卓塔妮，拉尼卡瑟雷尼亚盟会公会长，世界之树太瑟雷尼亚之声。她是三位树灵融合一体，分别代表瑟雷尼亚三大核心价值观之一：生命、秩序、和谐。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_UB_.oracleText: Giggly and playful, it's not unusual to find Pinkie Pie prancing, bouncing and skipping through the streets of Ponyville. The silliest pony around, Pinkie Pie has a desire to entertain and put a smile on everypony's face. She moved to Ponyville and lives above the Sugarcube Corner bakery with Gummy, her pet alligator.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_UB_.translation: 经常能发现萍琪派傻笑着、顽皮地在小马谷的街道上蹦蹦跳跳。作为世界上最淘气的小马，萍琪派渴望娱乐并想让她所有的朋友发自内心的笑。 她搬到了小马谷，和她的宠物鳄鱼嘎米一起住在方糖甜点屋楼上。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_UNJ.oracleText: Johnny is the cerebral player who likes to set it up before knocking it all down. They deckbuild and play with unconventional options to show off their style and creativity. Win or lose, they're satisfied if their experiment gets results. Just wait till they get their Krark-Clan Ironworks, Genesis Chamber, Grinding Station...
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_UNJ.translation: 强尼是头脑型玩家，他喜欢在打倒它之前先把它布置好。他们用非传统的选择来构建和玩耍，以展示他们的风格和创造力。无论输赢，只要他们的实验有结果，他们就很满意。等到他们拿到喀勒克族制铁厂、创生秘室、辗碎工段......

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_UNS.oracleText: Spike is here to win, and win a lot. They're a tournament player with ruthless strategies and the best decks to claim victory, no matter how slight. If they can prove themself worthy in a competition, that's a day well spent. Think you've got them beat? Just wait for their response...
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_UNS.translation: 斯派克是来赢的，而且是赢很多。他们是一个拥有无情策略和最佳牌组的比赛选手，无论多么微不足道，都能获得胜利。如果他们能在比赛中证明自己的价值，那就是一天的美好时光。你认为你已经打败了他们？那就等着看他们的反应吧...

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_UNT.oracleText: Timmy likes big plays, big creatures, and big wins. Their gaming style favors powerful smackdowns over sneaky mechanics, and it's the sheer thrill of victory that keeps them coming back for more. When they drop a monstrous beast into play, head for the hills. Just wait till they get their Gigantosaurus...
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_UNT.translation: 蒂米喜欢大场面、大生物和大胜利。他们的游戏风格偏向于强大的打击，而不是鬼鬼祟祟的机械，正是胜利的纯粹快感让他们不断地回来。当他们放出巨兽时，就赶紧去山头吧。等到他们得到巨龙的时候......

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_UNV.oracleText: Vorthos is here for the flavor. That doesn't mean they're not trying to win, they just get their greatest joy from playing cards tied to the lore they adore. Watch out for their clever theming with a killer edge—just wait till you see their Bolas deck complete with an Umezawa subtheme!
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_UNV.translation: 沃尔托斯是为了味道而来。这并不意味着他们不想赢，他们只是从与他们所崇拜的传说相关的牌中获得最大的乐趣。请注意他们巧妙的主题设计与杀手锏--等着看他们的波拉斯套牌与梅泽悟主题的完整版吧!

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ugi.oracleText: Over his unfathomably long life, Ugin has shaped entire planes, vanquished cataclysmic forces, and been reborn at least twice. He's as cunning and powerful as his twin, Nicol Bolas, but luckily much less interested in world domination.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ugi.translation: 在他深不可测的漫长生命中，乌金塑造了整个星球，战胜了灾难性的力量，并至少重生了两次。他和他的孪生兄弟尼可波拉斯一样狡猾和强大，但幸运的是，他对统治世界的兴趣要小得多。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ugi.oracleText: Ugin, twin of Nicol Bolas, aims to balance power rather than accrue it for himself. As a spirit dragon, his energy creates a resonance with Tarkir's dragonstorms. His primary goal is to keep his brother imprisoned in the Meditation Realm, even at Tarkir's expense.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ugi.translation: 乌金是尼可波拉斯的孪生兄弟，他追求力量的平衡，而非为己所用。作为一位灵龙，他的能量与鞑契的龙袭风暴产生共鸣。他的首要目标是确保其兄弟被囚禁在冥想境，即使这会牺牲鞑契。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ugl.oracleText: Uglúk, a fearsome captain of the Uruk-hai, leads the war party that slew Boromir at Amon Hen and attempts to take the Hobbits Pippin and Merry to Isengard. Near Fangorn Forest, the Rohirrim attack the Uruk-hai, killing Uglúk and freeing the Hobbits.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ugl.translation: 乌格鲁克是乌鲁克族的可怕队长，他领导的战争党在阿蒙汉山脉杀死了博罗米尔，并试图将霍比特人皮平和梅里带到艾森加德。 在范贡森林附近，洛希尔人袭击了乌鲁克族，杀死了乌格鲁克并释放了霍比特人。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ula.oracleText: Ulamog is the Eldrazi titan of consumption, bringing destruction, plague, and an endless hunger for everything in his path. Out of the three Eldrazi titans, he is considered to be "on the smaller side."
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ula.translation: 钨拉莫是奥札奇的吞噬泰坦，他带来毁灭、瘟疫，并对他所到之处的一切产生无尽的饥渴。在三位奥札奇先祖中，他被认为是“体型较小的”。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ult.oracleText: As soon as Dr. Hank Pym created the robotic intelligence known as Ultron, he knew he'd made a grave mistake. Ultron defied his creator, escaping and rapidly upgrading himself into a nearly unstoppable global threat. The Age of Ultron had just begun.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ult.translation: 汉克·皮姆博士一创造出名为奥创的机械智能，就意识到自己犯了严重错误。奥创违抗了创造者，逃脱并迅速将自己升级为几乎不可阻挡的全球威胁。奥创纪元就此开启。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ura.oracleText: Blazing with a temper as hot as his furnace, Urabrask is a reclusive praetor solely focused on the perfection of Mirrodin. His devotion was so extreme that he refused to fight the Mirran Resistance, an act which would eventually draw punishment from Elesh Norn. Now he plots a rebellion of his own.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ura.translation: 洼巴司的脾气和他的熔炉一样暴躁，他是一位隐居的魔判官，一心只想让秘罗地变得更加完美。他的献身精神极端到了拒绝与秘罗反抗军作战的地步，这一行为最终招致了艾蕾侬的惩罚。现在，他正在策划一场属于自己的叛乱。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Urz.oracleText: Urza is one of the most influential Planeswalkers to ever live. From his early days exploring Thran ruins, Urza was a brilliant artificer, eventually crafting a mechanized army to fight his brother Mishra. Urza would stop at nothing to win the war, even if it meant shattering Dominaria in the process.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Urz.translation: 克撒是有史以来最具影响力的鹏洛客之一。克撒早年在索蓝废墟探险后，成为了一名出色的工匠，最终，他打造了一支机械化军团来对抗他的兄弟米斯拉。为了赢得战争，克撒将不惜一切代价，甚至包括在战争中毁灭多明纳里亚。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Urz.oracleText: Powered by genius artifice and ancient magical energy, the mechanical soldiers of Urza's army were marvels to behold and terrifying to oppose. Each machine fulfilled a crucial purpose on the battlefield, but their greatest power? They can always build more.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Urz.translation: 克撒的机械士兵军团由天才的手艺打造，又有古老的魔法能量提供动力，是令人叹为观止的奇迹，也是可怕的对手。每台机械都能在战场上发挥重要作用，但它们最大的威能是——它们可以随时制造更多。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Val.oracleText: There is no plane of Duskmourn without Valgavoth—at least in its current form. After being summoned and bound to the House, the moth-like demon waited for centuries until the right moment to expand the walls of his prison until it occupied the entire plane.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Val.translation: 若无瓦伽沃，暮悲邸时空便不会存在——至少不会是如今这般模样。这只蛾形恶魔在被召唤并束缚于宅邸后，蛰伏数百年等待良机，最终将其牢狱之墙扩张至占据整个时空。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Van.oracleText: Guildmaster of the Simic Combine, Vannifar is an elf who has mutated her body into a proto-plasmic ooze. She considers herself a superior life-form.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Van.translation: 析米克联合的公会长凡妮法原本生来是个妖精，但她现在已将自己演化成原质流浆。她以自己是更优越的生命形态为傲。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ven.oracleText: Venom is both a single entity and several, existing as the merged identities of reporter Eddie Brock and the alien symbiote bonded to him. Where one ends and the other begins is difficult to discern, but they both share a deep hatred for Spider-Man.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ven.translation: 毒液既是一个个体也是多个个体的存在，是记者艾迪·布洛克与外星共生体融合后的身份。很难分辨一个在哪里结束、另一个在哪里开始，但他们都对蜘蛛侠怀有深深的仇恨。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Vit.oracleText: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte, vampire cleric of the Church of Dusk, has seen his hardline faith redoubled. To usher Torrezon into a new era of pure devotion, Vito sees a path through Aclazotz, the progenitor god of vampires. And that means seeking Ixalan's hollow core.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Vit.translation: 暮影教会的吸血鬼牧师维托·基哈诺·德帕萨蒙特发现他强硬的信仰更加坚定了。 为了将托雷宗带入一个纯粹奉献的新时代，维托通过吸血鬼的始祖神阿洛佐兹找到了一条道路。 这意味着寻找依夏兰的空洞核心。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Viv.oracleText: Vivien Reid is an expert archer and the wielder of the Arkbow, a magic weapon that summons spirits into battle. As the last survivor of her home plane, she fights for the natural conservation of each new plane she visits, including Ikoria and New Capenna.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Viv.translation: 薇薇安瑞德是一位经验丰富的弓箭手，也是方舟神弓的持有者，方舟神弓是一把能召唤灵魂参加战斗的魔法武器。 作为家乡时空的最后幸存者，她为她到访的每一个新时空的自然保护而奋斗，包括依克黎和新卡佩纳。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Viv.oracleText: Vivien Reid is an expert archer and the wielder of the Arkbow, a magic weapon that summons spirits into battle. As the last survivor of her home plane, she fights for the natural conservation of each new plane she visits, including Ikoria and New Capenna.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Viv.translation: 薇薇安瑞德是一位经验丰富的弓箭手，也是方舟神弓的持有者，方舟神弓是一把能召唤灵魂参加战斗的魔法武器。 作为家乡时空的最后幸存者，她为她到访的每一个新时空的自然保护而奋斗，包括依克黎和新卡佩纳。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Viv.oracleText: Vivien Reid is an expert archer and the wielder of the Arkbow, a magic weapon that summons spirits into battle. As the last survivor of her home plane, she fights for the natural conservation of each new plane she visits, including Ikoria and New Capenna.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Viv.translation: 薇薇安瑞德是一位经验丰富的弓箭手，也是方舟神弓的持有者，方舟神弓是一把能召唤灵魂参加战斗的魔法武器。 作为家乡时空的最后幸存者，她为她到访的每一个新时空的自然保护而奋斗，包括依克黎和新卡佩纳。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Viv.oracleText: Vivien Reid is an expert archer and the wielder of the Arkbow, a magic weapon that summons spirits into battle. As the last survivor of her home plane, she fights for the natural conservation of each new plane she visits, including Ikoria and New Capenna.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Viv.translation: 薇薇安瑞德是位娴熟弓手，所使用的方舟神弓能召现动物精魂加入战斗。她是自己家园时空的最后幸存者，因此每到一处新时空，都会为保护当地自然环境而战，包括依克黎和新卡佩纳。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Viv.oracleText: Magical archer and natural conservationist Vivien Reid seeks to honor the lessons of the past in the wake of her home plane's destruction. Her mythical weapon, the Arkbow, can preserve the life force of dying beasts and summon powerful spirit incarnations to fight alongside her.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Viv.translation: 魔法射手兼自然保护者薇薇安瑞德在故乡时空毁灭后，致力于铭记过往的教训。她持有的神话武器方舟神弓能够封存濒死野兽的生命力，并召唤强大的精怪化身为她并肩作战。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Vor.oracleText: Vorinclex is the praetor of the Hunter Maze and an apex predator of great appetite and power. While intelligent, he rarely prefers speech, delegating matters of rule to the compleated elf Glissa. He was the first to work with Norn and her plan for Multiverse domination, believing it the next step in his theory of Grand Evolution.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Vor.translation: 弗霖凯是猎者迷林的魔判官，也是一位食欲旺盛、力量强大的顶级掠食者。 虽然他很聪明，但他不常讲话，他将管辖的事务委派给完化妖精格莉莎。 他是第一个与艾蕾侬和她的多重宇宙统治计划合作的人，并且相信这是他大进化理论的下一步。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Vra.oracleText: This mysterious Planeswalker wields a suite of deadly spells that suit her gorgon nature. Vraska specializes in magic that involves assassination, stealth, and petrification. And she likes to take souvenirs...
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Vra.translation: 这名神秘的鹏洛客具有蛇发妖本色，而她所使用的致命咒语也恰如其分。瓦丝卡擅长的都是与暗杀、隐形和石化相关的法术。而且她很喜欢带走纪念品...

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Vra.oracleText: The deadly and quick-witted Vraska, a gorgon from Ravnica, has held many titles and allegiances throughout her life. Through compleation, her latest allegiance is to New Phyrexia and the vision of a perfected multiverse. All will be one.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Vra.translation: 致命而机智的瓦丝卡是来自拉尼卡的蛇发妖，一生中拥有许多头衔和效忠对象。 经过完化，她最新的效忠对象是新非瑞克西亚和完化多重宇宙的愿景。 万界归一。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Vra.oracleText: Vraska's been through the wringer after a troubling spot of Phyrexian compleation, but she's starting fresh on Thunder Junction. She's hired muscle for Oko's big vault heist, stopping any pesky do-gooders stone cold in their tracks. But is money her only motivation?
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Vra.translation: 瓦丝卡经历了一段令人心力交困的非瑞克西亚完化时期，但她在光雷驿重新开始。 她为瓯柯的金库大劫案雇佣了人手，阻止了任何讨厌的行善者的脚步。 但金钱是她唯一的动机吗？

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Vre.oracleText: If a dead body sinks into the marshes, Vren and his ratfolk gang will find it. He works closely with his underlings but holds no sentimentality for their wellbeing. In a pinch, he'll leave them high and dry—or at the bottom of the swamp.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Vre.translation: 如果有一具尸体沉入沼泽，维伦和他的鼠民帮就会去找到它。他与下属合作无间，但对他们的安危却毫不关心。紧要关头，他会让他们自生自灭或深陷泥沼。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Wil.oracleText: To reunite the broken Realm of Eldraine after the Phyrexian assault that killed both his parents, Will claimed his father's title of High King of the five courts. Now he tirelessly seeks to calm the chaotic land, quelling rebellions through diplomacy or bloodshed.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Wil.translation: 在非瑞克西亚人的侵袭中不幸失去双亲后，为统一破碎的艾卓王国，威尔继承了父亲五廷至高王的头衔。如今他通过外交或血刃镇压反叛军，不倦地寻求安定这片混乱的土地的计策。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Win.oracleText: Trapped within the house's walls for over a decade, Winter lives a harsh, hardened life where trust is fleeting and altruism spells death. When the team entered Duskmourn, he agreed to help—not out of kindness, but the burning desire to escape at all costs.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Win.translation: 被困在暮悲邸的墙内已逾十年，温特过着艰苦卓绝的生活，在那里信任稍纵即逝，而利他主义意味着死亡。当小队进入暮悲邸时，他同意提供帮助——不是出于善意，而是因为他那不惜一切代价逃离的强烈渴望。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Wol.oracleText: The short-tempered mutant known as Logan may not be a ray of sunshine, but he's nearly unkillable due to his robust healing abilities. His implanted adamantium skeleton grants him razor-sharp claws which he rarely hesitates to use. Watch out, bub!
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Wol.translation: 被称为罗根的暴躁变种人可能不是阳光般温暖的存在，但他凭借强大的自愈能力几乎不可杀死。他植入的艾德曼合金骨架赋予他锋利的爪子，他从不犹豫使用。小心点，伙计！

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Wre.oracleText: Long ago, Wrenn absorbed a raging wildfire to protect an ancient forest. Those flames still burn within her and she must physically merge with especially strong trees to survive. Now, Wrenn and her latest symbiont, Seven, seek a way to quench her inner fire for good.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Wre.translation: 很久以前，芮恩为了保护一个古老的森林，吸收了熊熊的野火。那些火焰仍然在她体内燃烧，她必须与特别强壮的树木身体融合才能生存。现在，芮恩和她最新的共生体，七树妖，寻求一种方法来永久地熄灭她内心的火焰。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Wyl.oracleText: Noble by birth, Wyll made his name as the heroic 'Blade of Frontiers'. He keeps his pact with a devil well-hidden and is desperate to escape the hellish bargain - even if that means rescuing the seductive creature that made the deal.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Wyl.translation: 威迩出身贵族，以英雄的“边境之刃”扬名。他将与恶魔的契约隐藏得很深，并迫切希望逃脱地狱般的交易——即使这意味着要拯救做出交易的诱人生物。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Xan.oracleText: At the top of the food chain for the Maestros is Lord Xander, an eternal vampire with a powerful demonic blessing. He positions himself as a curator and collector of Old Capenna's historical relics. The crown jewel in his collection? Himself, of course.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Xan.translation: 处于绝艺盟食物链顶端的是尚夺尔勋爵，一个拥有强大恶魔祝福的永恒吸血鬼。他把自己定位为老卡佩纳的历史遗物的策展人和收藏家。他的收藏品中的皇冠上的宝石？当然是他自己。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Yar.oracleText: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Yar.translation: 贝赞洛的副手雅库开始展露野心，恶魔领主便把他变成一条蛆虫。有只青蛙吞下了这条蛆虫后不断变大，最终贪食的精怪从其体内破膛而出。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ysh.oracleText: Well versed in arcane and ancient wisdom, Y'shtola's pragmatism is matched only by her thirst for knowledge. Her relentless studies have revealed the edges of a greater truth, and only time will tell where this new perspective will lead her.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Ysh.translation: 隶属于拂晓血盟的猫魅族贤人。精通魔法学，对古代语言和古老传承造诣很深。追寻着「世界的真理」的她在接触到一部分真理时会怀抱着怎样的想法，又会选择通往何方的道路呢。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Yun.oracleText: Yuna is the daughter of High Summoner Braska, the man who defeated Sin ten years ago. She too becomes a summoner and embarks on a pilgrimage to vanquish Sin and bring peace to Spira. To avoid showing pain or sorrow, she maintains an optimistic and cheerful demeanor.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Yun.translation: 十年前打倒了「辛」的大召唤士布拉斯卡的女儿。她和父亲一样选择了召唤士的道路，立志要打倒「辛」，为史匹拉带来和平。为了不辜负周围人的期待，她总是努力表现得开朗乐观，不让人看到自己的痛苦和悲伤。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zia.oracleText: Ziatora not only established the Riveteers, but also much of New Capenna itself from the foundations up. By accepting power from a demonic contract, she left dragonkind in the dust and grew her organization into one of the mightiest the city's ever seen.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zia.translation: 齐朵拉不仅建立了勤工联，而且还从基础上建立了新卡佩纳的大部分地区。通过接受恶魔契约的力量，她将龙族甩在了身后，并将她的组织发展成这个城市有史以来最强大的组织之一。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zim.oracleText: Zimone is a brilliant prodigy from Strixhaven, called in to join the Duskmourn mission based on her expertise with Theoretical Extraplanar Spaces and proven combat skill. The mission is risky, but it's also the perfect opportunity for field research on her academic thesis.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zim.translation: 琦梦是一位来自斯翠海文的天才，她因在理论外时空空间方面的专长和过硬的战斗技巧被召集加入暮悲邸任务。虽然任务充满风险，但这也是她为学术论文进行实地研究的绝佳机会。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zim.oracleText: As one of the brightest mathematical minds in the Multiverse, Zimone Wola is a hero in high demand. When she's not attending Quandrix college for her graduate studies or cracking unsolvable theorems, she's traversing the planes—for school credit, of course.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zim.translation: 作为多重宇宙中最出色的数学奇才之一，琦梦·沃拉可谓是炙手可热。当她不在量析学院专注研究生课业或破解那些无解定理时，便会穿梭于各个时空之间——当然，这也是算学分的。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zim.oracleText: Zimone Wola, mathematical prodigy and survivor of Duskmourn, graduated from Quandrix and wrapped up an internship on Ravnica to begin her Strixhaven graduate studies. Determined to solve future threats like Duskmourn, Zimone put her mind to the test and created multiple copies of herself.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zim.translation: 琦梦沃拉——一位数学天才、亦是暮悲邸的幸存者——自量析学院毕业，并在拉尼卡完成实习后，开始于斯翠海文攻读研究生学业。为了解决如暮悲邸般的未来威胁，琦梦不断挑战自我，甚至创造出了多个自身的复制体。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zim.oracleText: Zimone Wola is a young prodigy who was accepted to Strixhaven early. She is a whiz at many forms of mystical arts, but eventually gravitated to the mathematical magic of Quandrix. Dark forces have noticed her considerable talents...
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zim.translation: 齐莫内·沃拉是一个年轻的神童，很早就被斯翠海文接纳。她在许多形式的神秘艺术方面都很有天赋，但最终倾向于量析的数学魔法。黑暗势力已经注意到她的巨大才能......

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zor.oracleText: As a nocturnal creature, Zoraline would rather be asleep when the rest of her companions are out saving Valley. She's also as much of an astronomer as she is a cleric, attuning herself to the cryptic and auspicious movements of the stars.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zor.translation: 作为夜行动物，佐拉琳在她的同伴们外出拯救苍茂谷时宁愿睡觉。她不仅是一名僧侣，也是一名天文学家，将自己与诡谲而祥瑞的星空融为一体。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zuk.oracleText: Scarred and exiled by his own father, Prince Zuko was tasked with capturing the Avatar. But under Uncle Iroh's guidance, Zuko's proud and impulsive nature takes a more honorable path. He spends time as a fugitive, a restored prince, and finally, as an ally of the Avatar.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zuk.translation: 脸上带着父亲留下的伤疤，身上背负着被放逐的命运，苏科王子的使命只有一个：捉住降世神通。然而，在艾洛皇叔的悉心引导下，他高傲而冲动的灵魂，逐渐被引向了一条充满荣耀的正道。他曾是颠沛流离的逃犯，也曾是重返荣耀的王子，但最终，他选择了成为神通的伙伴，与他并肩作战。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zur.oracleText: The orc warrior known as Zurgo Bellstriker rebelled against his dragonlord. Renamed Zurgo Stormrender, he leads the new Mardu to victory. The spirit dragon Neriv is the clan's vanguard, guiding them across the steppe. He flies into battle with passion, ferocity, and lightning breath.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Avatar_Basic_Zur.translation: 半兽人战士司钟珠高曾反抗他的龙王。如今他改名为镇霆可汗珠高，率领新玛尔都走向胜利。灵龙涅雳伏是部族的先锋，引导他们穿越草原。它以激情、凶猛和闪电吐息飞入战场。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Basri_M21_Bio.oracleText: For most of his life, Basri Ket was utterly devoted to Oketra, god of loyalty and solidarity. When she was slain in the Hour of Devastation, his world was shattered. But rather than let it break him, he took up one of her massive arrows as a spear and vowed to champion her ideals across the Multiverse.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Basri_M21_Bio.translation: 巴席利柯特一生中的大部分时间都完全献给了团结之神。当她在毁灭时刻被杀时，他的世界被打碎了。但他并没有因此而崩溃，而是拿起她的一支巨箭作为长矛，发誓要在整个多重宇宙捍卫她的理想。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/ChandraNalaar_Bi.oracleText: There is no virtue in subtlety, at least not as far as Chandra Nalaar is concerned. She's a confident, ardent, defiant Planeswalker whose specialty is pyromancy: spells of fire, fire, and more fire.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/ChandraNalaar_Bi.translation: 缜密没什么好处～至少茜卓纳拉从不挂心这点。她是一名自信满盈，热情似火，桀骜不驯的鹏洛客，她的专长就是烈焰：火焰咒语，火焰，以及更猛的火焰。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/CourtKnight_Bio.oracleText: The court of Ardenvale values loyalty above all else, and only those with truly virtuous hearts survive the trial of the Circle of Loyalty. Ardenvale's knights fight in perfect unison with a single, unbreakable will, each one selflessly defending the next.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/CourtKnight_Bio.translation: 雅登瓦的宫廷重视忠诚高于一切，只有那些正直善良的人才能在忠诚焰圈的考验中幸存下来。雅登瓦的骑士们以一种牢不可破的意志完美地统一作战，每个人都无私地捍卫着下一个人。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Danitha_DMU_Bio.oracleText: Danitha, heir of House Capashen, is a brave and brash knight who can always be found at the front of a melee. Trained from a young age in both diplomacy and sword-play, Danitha has taken over command of the knights once loyal to her fallen father—now she fights not just for Benalia, but Dominaria.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Danitha_DMU_Bio.translation: 卡帕轩家族的继承人达妮莎是一位勇敢而无畏的骑士，总是可以在混战的前线找到她。达妮莎从小就接受外交和剑术训练。她接管了曾经忠于她死去的父亲的骑士团的指挥权——现在她不仅为宾纳里亚而战，还为多明纳里亚而战。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Davriel_J21_Bio.oracleText: Davriel Cane is a simple man who enjoys simple pleasures: wealth, luxury, and fine tea. He also happens to be a talented diabolist, skilled at binding demons to his service. He detests playing the hero, yet often finds himself in the role despite his best efforts to avoid it.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Davriel_J21_Bio.translation: 达夫黎凯恩是一个简单的人，他享受着简单的快乐：财富、奢侈品和上等茶。他还碰巧是一个有天赋的恶魔学家，擅长将恶魔束缚在他的身边。他不喜欢扮演英雄，但却经常发现自己在扮演英雄，尽管他竭力避免这种情况。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Dina_STX_Bio.oracleText: Dina is a weird, darkly humorous, and tea-obsessed student of Witherbloom. She is learning how to concoct all manner of herbal brews from bizarre swamp creatures. If she offers you a cup of tea, you should probably decline.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Dina_STX_Bio.translation: 是靡华学院的一个古怪、黑暗幽默、痴迷于茶的学生。她正在学习如何从怪异的沼泽生物中炼制各种草药酒。如果她给你一杯茶，你可能应该拒绝。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Domri_Bio.oracleText: Domri's affinity for wild creatures grew out of his natural distrust of rules, hierarchies, and authority figures. He can weave magic that summons, commands, and enhances these beasts.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Domri_Bio.translation: 多密和野蛮生物的密切关系来自于他天生对规则、阶级和权威人物的不信任。他能使用魔法来召唤、控制并加强这些野兽。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/DovinBaan_Bio.oracleText: Dovin can clearly see the flaws in any system or machine and predict with startling accuracy exactly how and when it will fail.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/DovinBaan_Bio.translation: 多温可以清晰洞见系统或机械当中的任何缺陷，同时还能精确预测故障发生的方式和时间。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/ELD_Garruk_Bio.oracleText: Garruk is the ultimate hunter and force of nature. Able to call wild creatures to his side and magically enhance their strength, he is a formidable foe to face anywhere. Currently under the spell of Oko, Garruk serves as a bodyguard; but for how long?
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/ELD_Garruk_Bio.translation: 贾路是终极猎手和自然力量。他能够召唤野生动物到他身边，并通过魔法增强它们的力量，在任何地方，他都是一个可怕的敌人。目前，在瓯柯的咒语下，贾路充当他的保镖；但能维持多久？

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/EleshNorn_ONE_Bi.oracleText: After dominating the other Phyrexian praetors in a struggle for power, Elesh Norn led the transformation of the plane of Mirrodin into a world of twisted perfection called New Phyrexia. Under her rule, she now envisions an entire Multiverse "blessed" by the same mechanical corruption . . .
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/EleshNorn_ONE_Bi.translation: 通过权力斗争击败了其他非瑞克西亚魔判官后，艾蕾侬主导将秘罗地时空转化为一个被称为新非瑞克西亚的扭曲完美世界。在其统治下，她愿景整个多元宇宙都沐浴在机械腐败的"祝福"中...

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Ellywick_AFR_Bio.oracleText: A lucky draw from the Deck of Many Things made Ellywick Tumblestrum the greatest bard in the multiverse. Her enchanting music so moved the Summer Queen and the Queen of Air and Darkness that they gifted the bard with her instrument, Morningmist.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Ellywick_AFR_Bio.translation: 从万象无常牌中的幸运一抽，使艾利薇鼓琴成为多重宇宙中最伟大的吟游诗人。她迷人的音乐让夏日女王和空气与黑暗女王非常感动，她们把她的乐器--晨雾送给了吟游诗人。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Elspeth_MOM_Bio.oracleText: If anyone else had been dealt the full force of a sylex blast in the Blind Eternities, they'd be gone for good—but not Elspeth Tirel. Split from her physical body, Elspeth's true form awakened, transforming her into a planeswalking angel. Her only goal is to find Elesh Norn and deliver a bit of divine butt kicking. Compleat this!
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Elspeth_MOM_Bio.translation: 如果其他人在黑暗虚空中承受了同兆爆炸的震撼全力，他们便会从此消失不见～但艾紫培提瑞并非如此。从肉体分离之后，艾紫培的真实形态就此觉醒，成为穿行时空的鹏洛客天使。她的唯一目标便是找到艾蕾侬，给她一点神圣的颜色瞧瞧。再完化试试！

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Elspeth_SNC_Bio.oracleText: The valiant planeswalker Elspeth Tirel has lived—and died—in her pursuit of justice. Now free from the underworld, she has arrived in New Capenna to find evidence of Phyrexian threats and demonic control. Time to get to work.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Elspeth_SNC_Bio.translation: 英勇的鹏洛客艾紫培提瑞在追求正义的过程中出生入死。现在，她从地下世界中解脱出来，来到了新卡佩纳，找到了非瑞克西亚威胁和恶魔控制的证据。是时候开始工作了。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Eternal_Army_Bio.oracleText: After death, the warriors of Amonkhet that passed the trials of Gods become part of Bolas's lethal undead fighting force, the Dreadhorde. Embalmed in layers of lazotep to preserve their lifeforce, they lack emotions, hesitation, and disloyalty.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Eternal_Army_Bio.translation: 阿芒凯的勇士生前历经万苦力争通过五神祀炼，然最终成得豪英者死后却变作波拉斯不死亡灵大军震惧军中一员杀戮四方。永生者经数层拉佐特石遗存，虽然能保留生命活力，但毫无情感，从不犹豫，绝对忠诚。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Fblthp_Bio_Alt2.oracleText: Fblthp is a humble homunculus from Ravnica with a penchant for stumbling (or being shoved) into dangerous, important events he'd rather have nothing to do with. With his habit of getting lost, there's no telling where he'll turn up next!
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Fblthp_Bio_Alt2.translation: 夫毕佐是一个来自拉尼卡的不起眼的造妖，喜欢在危险的、重要的事件中跌跌撞撞（或被推搡），他宁愿与之无关。以他迷路的习惯，不知道他接下来会出现在哪里！

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Freyalise_J21_Bi.oracleText: A half-elven Planeswalker from a bygone era, Freyalise was a leader of elven clans who used her incredible power to protect their forest home. She heroically sacrificed her life to save her people and prevented a catastrophe that threatened to destroy Dominaria.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Freyalise_J21_Bi.translation: 妃雅丽兹是一位来自过去时代的半精灵鹏洛客，她是精灵部族的领袖，用她难以置信的力量来保护他们的森林家园。她英勇地牺牲了自己的生命来拯救她的人民，并阻止了一场有可能摧毁多明纳里亚的灾难。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Gale_HBG_Bio.oracleText: In his youth, Gale was a prodigy practitioner of the Art. He likened his skill as a wizard to that of an actual artist, who manipulated the Weave in the same manner a virtuoso did music. After he was spurned by the goddess Mystra, Gale sought to win back her affection by reuniting her with a lost piece of her old magics.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Gale_HBG_Bio.translation: 在年轻时，盖尔是一个天才般的艺术实践者。他把自己作为一个巫师的技能比作一个真正的艺术家，他以演奏家演奏音乐的方式操纵着魔网。在他被魔法女神蜜斯拉抛弃后，盖尔试图通过让她重新获得她的旧魔法中的一个失落部分来赢回她的感情。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/GideonJura_Bio.oracleText: A powerful warrior-mage with the ability to make himself invulnerable, Gideon is fiercely loyal, unyielding, just, charismatic and never hesitates to enter combat to defend the innocent.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/GideonJura_Bio.translation: 基定是擅使法术的强大战士，身怀战而无伤之力。他尽节竭诚、坚定不屈、刚正坚贞而又富有魅力，总会毫不犹豫地冲入战团以保卫无辜者。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Huatli_Bio.oracleText: Under instruction from her Emperor, Huatli adventures in search of the Golden City, the Immortal Sun, and to secure her title as Warrior-Poet of the Sun Empire.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Huatli_Bio.translation: 受帝国皇帝之令，华特莉率部进发寻找黄金城与永生圣阳，守护自己「烈阳帝国战士诗人」头衔。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/IKO_Lukka_Bio.oracleText: Lukka was once a loyal soldier who dedicated his life to protecting the humans of Ikoria from monsters. Then he magically bonded with one of the creatures he'd been trained to hate and fear, leaving him caught between two warring worlds.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/IKO_Lukka_Bio.translation: 卢卡曾经是一名忠诚的士兵，他毕生致力于保护依克黎的人类免受怪物的侵害。然后他神奇地与一只被他训练的让人憎恨和恐惧的生物结合在一起，让他被夹在两个交战的世界之间。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/JaceBeleren_Bio.oracleText: Jace Beleren is a master of mental magic: spells of illusion, deception, and mind reading. His powers allow him to manipulate enemies by countering their magic or turning their spells against them.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/JaceBeleren_Bio.translation: 杰斯擅长心灵魔法：幻影、欺瞒，以及读取心灵的咒语。他的力量让他能反击敌对法师的魔法，或以其道反治其身。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/JaceTMS_Bio.oracleText: Few can compete with Jace Beleren as a strategist. Fewer still can overcome the influence of his mind-altering magic. While clever illusions help tip the balance of power in Jace's favor, his true strength lies in knowing his opponent's mind better than they know themselves.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/JaceTMS_Bio.translation: 作为战略家，很少有人能与杰斯贝连抗衡，更少有人能够克服他的心灵魔法的影响。虽然聪明的幻象有助于使力量平衡向有利于杰斯的方向倾斜，但他真正的力量在于比对手更了解自己的思想。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Jace_ONE_Bio.oracleText: Jace Beleren's power to manipulate minds finally met its match when he found his own consciousness dominated by the shadowy thrall of New Phyrexia. With Jace compleated, is any mind safe? All will be one.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Jace_ONE_Bio.translation: 当杰斯贝连发现自己的意识被新非瑞克西亚的阴暗所奴役时，才意识到他操纵心灵的能力终于棋逢对手。就连杰斯这等心灵专家亦被完化，这世界上还有谁能逃得掉吗？万界归一。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/JayaBallard_Bio.oracleText: Jaya is a native of Dominaria and a prominent part of both its past and its present. In her reckless youth, she sold her considerable pyromantic talents to the highest bidder.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/JayaBallard_Bio.translation: 雅亚巴拉德是土生土长的多明纳里亚人，在它的过去与现今都扮演着重要角色。在当她还年轻气盛时，这位特务法术师强大的烈焰术天赋只为出价最高者效力。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Jaya_DMU_Bio.oracleText: Born on Dominaria more than 1,500 years ago, Jaya Ballard is a hot-headed Planeswalker who played an important part in the plane's early history before disappearing for centuries. In recent years, she resurfaced as an older, wiser, but no less sarcastic hero, helping unite Dominaria to fight back against the threat of New Phyrexia.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Jaya_DMU_Bio.translation: 雅亚巴拉德于1，500 多年前出生于多明纳里亚，是一位急性子的鹏洛客。她在销声匿迹几个世纪之前，在该位面的早期历史中扮演了重要角色。近年来，她以年长、睿智但毒舌的英雄身份重新出现，帮助联合多明纳里亚对抗新非瑞克西亚的威胁。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/JinGitaxias_ONE_.oracleText: Cold, calculating, and brutal, Jin-Gitaxias thinks himself the smartest of all the Phyrexian praetors. He chooses his words carefully, but will gladly deliver long speeches on complex topics. His terrifying research is unburdened by ethics, and he cannot resist an intellectual challenge.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/JinGitaxias_ONE_.translation: 金吉塔厦冷酷、精于算计且残忍，自认为是所有非瑞克西亚魔判官中最聪明的。他措辞谨慎，但很乐意就复杂的话题发表长篇演讲。他的可怕的研究不受伦理限制，并对对智力挑战有极大兴趣。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Kaito_NEO_Bio.oracleText: Kaito Shizuki is a master ninja whose telekinetic powers augment his skills as an infiltrator. A risk-taker at heart with few qualms about breaking the rules, Kaito pursues technological progress to make his home plane of Kamigawa a better place for himself and his sister.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Kaito_NEO_Bio.translation: 漆月魁渡是一位忍者大师，他的心灵感应能力增强了他作为潜入者的技能。漆月魁渡是一个敢于冒险的人，对打破规则没有什么顾虑。他追求技术进步，致力于使他的家乡神河成为一个对他自己和他妹妹来说更好的地方。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Karn_Bio.oracleText: Originally created as a war weapon, Karn is able to control all five colors of mana. This silver golem is a time-travelling Planeswalker, powerful artifact, world builder, and unstoppable ally.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Karn_Bio.translation: 原本生为战争机器的卡恩，这尊银魔像能够控制全部五种颜色的法术力，它是一个能够进行时间旅行的鹏洛客，一件强大的神器，一位世界建造者和坚不可摧的盟友。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Kaya_Bio.oracleText: Kaya is a firm believer that life is for the living. If you die with unfinished business, well, that's probably your fault.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Kaya_Bio.translation: 卡娅坚信，只有生者才有资格生活。如果在逝去时仍有未竟的心愿，那么这大概是你自己的错。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Kaya_Bio_Alt.oracleText: A confident, roguish duelist with a mysterious past, Kaya has the ability to become partially incorporeal—allowing her to slip through solid items and physically interact with ghosts and the spirit world.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Kaya_Bio_Alt.translation: 卡娅是一名自信不羁的斗客，而她的过去是一个谜。她有能力使身体的部分成为虚体形态使她能穿越实物并与鬼魂和灵魂世界进行实体接触。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Killian_STX_Bio.oracleText: Killian Lu is a competitive and driven student of Silverquill who puts a lot of pressure on himself. His father being one of the deans doesn't make it any easier. While Killian's talents may seem effortless, he secretly trains for long hours every day.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Killian_STX_Bio.translation: 齐力安是一个好胜心强的银毫学生，他给自己施加了很大的压力。他的父亲是院长之一，这并没有让他轻松。或许齐力安看似毫不费力就拥有那些天赋，不过他每天都会进行长时间的秘密训练。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Kiora_J21_Bio.oracleText: Cocky, brash, and occasionally selfish, Kiora is a merfolk Planeswalker who wields a magical bident she once stole from a god. She shares a close bond with creatures of the ocean, especially the titanic leviathans that lurk deep beneath the waves.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Kiora_J21_Bio.translation: 傲慢、粗鲁，偶尔还很自私，奇奥拉是一个人鱼族的鹏洛客，她挥舞着曾经从一个神那里偷来的双叉戟。她与海洋生物有着密切的联系，尤其是潜伏在海面下的泰坦巨兽。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Koth_ONE_Bio.oracleText: Koth, a vulshok Planeswalker from Mirrodin, uses geomancy to split stone and shape metal in his fight for Mirran peace. With his home plane twisted into New Phyrexia, Koth prepares one final strike to defend it—along with the entire Multiverse.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Koth_ONE_Bio.translation: 来自秘罗地瓦许克的鹏洛客寇斯，通过塑地术法来裂石塑金以为秘罗地的和平而战。随着他的家乡时空畸变为新非瑞克西亚，寇斯准备发起保卫战的最终一击～这次要联合整个多元宇宙一道。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Laezel_HBG_Bio.oracleText: Lae'zel is a consummate warrior, ferocious even by the standards of the githyanki. Faced with transforming into the very monster she has sworn to destroy, Lae'zel must prove herself worthy of rejoining her people - if they do not execute her first.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Laezel_HBG_Bio.translation: 莱埃泽尔是技艺高超的斗士，即使以一个吉斯洋基养育所的标准来看也非寻常。面临即将转变为自己发誓要消灭的怪物，她必须向自己的同胞证明自己还有作用——如果他们饶她一命的话。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Lazav_Bio.oracleText: Little is known about the mysterious shapeshifter Lazav. House Dimir's Guildmaster is able to warp reality and seems to attract all of the magic in his surroundings toward him.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Lazav_Bio.translation: 底密尔会堂公会长拉札夫是位神秘的变形法师。他行踪成谜，无人知晓他的底细。人们只知道他能够扭曲现实，同时吸引身旁周遭的一切魔法。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/LilianaVess_Bio.oracleText: Beautiful, cunning, and ambitious to a fault, Liliana has mastered the dark art of necromancy. Her spells reanimate the dead and corrupt the living.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/LilianaVess_Bio.translation: 美丽，狡猾，而充满野心的莉莲娜，擅长运用暗黑魔法死灵术。她的咒语能够操弄亡者，腐化生灵。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/M20_Chandra_Bio.oracleText: An impulsive and immensely powerful pyromancer, Chandra Nalaar is still growing into the hero she is destined to become.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/M20_Chandra_Bio.translation: 茜卓纳拉是位性格冲动、技艺高强的烈焰术士。将来她必定能够成为伟大英雄，只是她现在仍在不断进步。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/M20_MuYanling_Bi.oracleText: Mu Yanling has adept command over wind and water, shaping them to meet her needs, whether it be gales to carry her through the air or weaving wind and water together to aid in her martial prowess.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/M20_MuYanling_Bi.translation: 沐燕灵善控清风流水，可将其随意塑形为己所用：既可驾风疾行，又能乘浪助力。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/M21_Ugin_Bio.oracleText: Over his unfathomably long life, Ugin has shaped entire planes, vanquished cataclysmic forces, and been reborn at least twice. He's as cunning and powerful as his twin, Nicol Bolas, but luckily much less interested in world domination.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/M21_Ugin_Bio.translation: 在他深不可测的漫长生命中，乌金塑造了整个星球，战胜了灾难性的力量，并至少重生了两次。他和他的孪生兄弟尼可波拉斯一样狡猾和强大，但幸运的是，他对统治世界的兴趣要小得多。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/MH1_Serra_Bio.oracleText: A human Planeswalker from the distant past, Serra was a powerful and benevolent healer. She created an artificial plane known as Serra's Realm, where she and her followers lived in peace defended by flights of angels. Though Serra and her realm are long gone, her legacy and teachings have lived on as a beacon of hope throughout the Multiverse.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/MH1_Serra_Bio.translation: 来自遥远过去的人类鹏洛客，撒拉是一位强大而仁慈的治疗师。她创造了一个被称为撒拉国度的人造位面，在那里她和她的追随者在飞行天使的保护下过着和平的生活。尽管撒拉和她的国度早已不复存在，但她的遗产和教义作为整个多重宇宙的希望灯塔一直存在。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Minsc_HBG_Bio.oracleText: Minsc is a bald, purple-tattooed ranger and a source of comic relief. His loyal companion is a miniature giant space hamster (a.k.a., a regular hamster) known as Boo, who doesn't talk. Minsc hails from Rashemen, Boo from Wildspace. Minsc is kind-hearted, has good intentions, and absolutely loves to be the hero even if it means throwing himself into danger to do what he believes is right.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Minsc_HBG_Bio.translation: 明斯克是一位秃头、紫色纹身的游侠，不去演相声真是一大损失。他的忠实伙伴是一只名叫布布的微型巨型太空仓鼠（又名普通仓鼠），它不会说话。明斯克来自莱瑟曼，布布来自野性空间。明斯克心地善良，心怀善意，绝对喜欢成为英雄，即使这意味着将自己置于危险之中去做他认为正确的事情。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Mishra_BRO_Bio.oracleText: Mishra's story began after discovering a powerful stone with his brother Urza. When the stone split, so did the brothers' bond, leaving Mishra an outcast. He waged a war against Urza with the help of formidable dragon engines and—unbeknownst to him—the corrupting influence of Phyrexia.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Mishra_BRO_Bio.translation: 米斯拉的故事，要从跟哥哥克撒一起发现那块强大的魔力石开始说起。当石头分裂时，他们之间的手足之情也就此断裂，将米斯拉抛离在他界。得到强大无匹的龙形引擎和（他还不知情）的非瑞克西亚腐败势力相助之后，他悍然向克撒兴战。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Nahiri_ONE_Bio.oracleText: Nahiri is a kor Planeswalker from Zendikar with the power of lithomancy—the control of stone. Setting aside old rivalries to fight New Phyrexia, she moved mountains protecting her allies...before crumbling under Elesh Norn's subjugation. All will be one.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Nahiri_ONE_Bio.translation: 来自赞迪卡的寇族鹏洛客娜希丽深谙操控顽石的砾岩术。为了对抗新非瑞克西亚，她抛下旧恨，开山移石保护盟友......然而却最终崩溃于艾蕾侬的统治。万界归一。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Niambi_DMU_Bio.oracleText: Niambi is daughter to the Planeswalker Teferi and a legend in her own right, having served as an advisor and healer throughout Jamuraa. It is her sincere hope that, through diplomacy and compassion, she can mend the wounds that divide her fellow Dominarians in time to unite them.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Niambi_DMU_Bio.translation: 妮安碧是鹏洛客泰菲力之女，自身也已名声在外～她的咨政佳绩与回春妙手早已享誉整片杰姆拉大陆。她真诚希望，通过外交与感化能够及时弥合多明纳里亚人之间的创伤，最终促使人们重欣团结如一。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/NicolBolas_Bio.oracleText: Elder dragon and tyrant of worlds, Nicol Bolas is one of the oldest known beings in the Multiverse. He's a force of villainous destruction, crushing all magic—and minds—that stand in his way.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/NicolBolas_Bio.translation: 龙族的长老，世界的暴君；尼可波拉斯是多重宇宙中已知的最古老人物之一。他掌握着邪恶的毁灭力量，能够粉碎一切敢阻止他的魔法和生灵。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/NicolBolas_Drago.oracleText: A force of villainous destruction, crushing all that stand in his way.  Elder dragon and tyrant of worlds, Nicol Bolas is one of the oldest known beings in the Multiverse.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/NicolBolas_Drago.translation: 尼可波拉斯掌握着邪恶的毁灭力量，能够粉碎一切敢阻止他的事物。他是龙族的长老，世界的暴君，多重宇宙中已知的最古老人物之一。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/NikoAris_Bio.oracleText: Niko Aris, a star athlete from Theros, fights with cleverness and dexterity rather than brute force. They prefer to avoid outright violence when they can, but those who cross them learn a hard lesson: Once they set their sights on a target, they never miss.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/NikoAris_Bio.translation: 来自塞洛斯的明星运动员尼科阿理斯，以聪明和灵巧而非蛮力进行战斗。TA宁愿在可能的情况下避免彻底的暴力，但那些越过TA的人学到了一个惨痛的教训：一旦TA瞄准目标，TA就不会错过。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/NissaRevane_Bio.oracleText: Driven, devoted, and deeply connected to the land, Nissa Revane wields elemental magic. She's able to channel the mana leylines of a plane and to bring the land to life.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/NissaRevane_Bio.translation: 妮莎努力奋进，做事倾尽全力，与大地有密切的联系，还擅使元素魔法。她能够引导时空的魔法生机地脉，为土地赋予生命。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Nissa_ONE_Bio.oracleText: Nissa is an elven Planeswalker from Zendikar and a steward of nature. However, her devotion to organic life withers under the corruption of Phyrexian compleation. All will be one.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Nissa_ONE_Bio.translation: 来自赞迪卡的妖精鹏洛客妮莎是大自然的管家。然而，她对有机体生命的奉献在非瑞克西亚完化的侵蚀下逐渐枯萎。万界归一。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Oko_ELD_Bio.oracleText: A trickster and master of deception, the shapeshifting Planeswalker Oko embraces any excuse to sow chaos and undermine authority. He has kept a low profile since wreaking havoc on Eldraine, but the odds are good that his next mischievous scheme is already in motion.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Oko_ELD_Bio.translation: 妮莎与三个鹏洛客相约见面，妮莎迟到了，她愧疚地说：“不好意思，我刚刚遇到一位小蓝牌手，他一边闪现生物，一边用生物的异能抓牌。”第一位鹏洛客问道：“什么叫闪现？”第二位鹏洛客问道：“什么叫抓牌？”第三位鹏洛客则问道：“什么叫生物的异能？”

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Olivia_VOW_Bio.oracleText: Olivia, head of the Voldaren bloodline, plans to seize power and exact revenge on her adversary, Sorin Markov, in a single stroke. By marrying Sorin's grandfather Edgar in an opulent vampiric wedding, she hopes to unite the bloodlines under her rule once and for all.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Olivia_VOW_Bio.translation: 沃达连血脉的首领，奥莉薇亚计划夺取权力，并一举向她的对手索霖马可夫复仇。通过与索林的祖父艾德嘉在一场奢华的吸血鬼婚礼上结婚，她希望在她的统治下一劳永逸地统一各血脉。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Quintorius_STX_B.oracleText: Quintorius Kand is a gentle, earnest-hearted archaeomancer. Expelled from a military academy, he discovered his true passion as a student of Lorehold. Quintorius is an extensive reader with a head full of facts and a big heart, even for a loxodon.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Quintorius_STX_B.translation: 昆托力康德是一位温和、真诚的古语术士。被一所军事学院开除，他发现自己对于衡鉴修习法师的身分怀有真正的热诚。昆托力博览群书，学富五车。在经历于不同道路上摸索的漫长青春期之后，他一心只想「寻找自我」，而且他相信自己能够藉由探索世界上奇妙的历史名胜而达成该目标。他当然能够利用一点指引来协助他找到方向。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Rakdos_Bio.oracleText: Rakdos is a consummate entertainer. A monstrous figure standing thirty feet tall, Rakdos demands the spotlight. His every entrance is a showstopper.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Rakdos_Bio.translation: 拉铎司演艺精湛。作为身长三十英尺的庞然巨物，他必然占据主角之位，堪称镇场明星。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/RalZarek_Bio.oracleText: Brilliant, unpredictable, and daring, Ral Zarek was always testing boundaries (and nerves) as a young mage. His bright, fearless skill made him a natural at harnessing the chaotic power of lightning and storms.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/RalZarek_Bio.translation: 年轻法师拉尔查雷克才华横溢、难以预测又大胆勇敢，他总是在挑战极限（和勇气）。他聪明无畏的技艺让其能够自如驾驭闪电和风暴的混乱能量。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Rootha_STX_Bio.oracleText: Rootha Squallheart is a student of Prismari. She is intense, passionate, and obsessed with perfecting her art. She often becomes enamored of a visionary idea, spends weeks working to make it incredible, then suddenly hates her creation and destroys it.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Rootha_STX_Bio.translation: 如莎斯奎哈特是一位粹丽修习法师。她积极、热情，醉心于使她的艺术趋于完美。她经常沉浸于预想的点子中，花了好几个礼拜让它看起来十分惊人，然后突然厌恶她的作品并在隔天摧毁它。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/STX_ProfessorOny.oracleText: An alumna of Witherbloom, Professor Onyx has returned to her alma mater as a teacher. She is researching a way to return the dead to life. The good professor is definitely not the planeswalker Liliana Vess. Look, no headdress. Totally a different person.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/STX_ProfessorOny.translation: 黑玉教授原本即就读于靡华学院，并在随后回到母校任教。她的研究方向是如何让死者复生。这位和善的教授绝对不是鹏洛客莉莲娜维斯。瞧，她没戴头饰。一定不是她。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/SaheeliRai_Bio.oracleText: Saheeli is a master inventor. Her brilliant mind is a never-ending font of innovative ideas, and her magical command over metal allows her to bring them into reality. She's a fierce competitor who loves a good challenge, but nothing can dampen her bright, optimistic spirit.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/SaheeliRai_Bio.translation: 莎希莉是一位伟大的发明家。她聪明的头脑是一个永无止境的创新想法的源泉，而她对金属的神奇控制使她能够将它们变成现实。她是一个激烈的竞争者，喜欢挑战，但没有什么能阻挡她明亮、乐观的精神。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/SarkhanVol_Bio.oracleText: The dragon-worshipping Sarkhan Vol is a native of Tarkir. Obsessed with their fury and predatory majesty, he joined a group of infamous shamans who venerated the apex predators.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/SarkhanVol_Bio.translation: 崇拜巨龙的萨坎沃出身鞑契，他迷恋巨龙的盛怒，醉心其身居掠食者高位的威严，于是加入了恶名昭彰的崇龙祭师会，共同顶礼心目中的世间霸主。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Sarkhan_J21_Bio.oracleText: Sarkhan Vol is a wandering shaman whose obsessive reverence for dragons drove him into the service of an ancient evil. After years of madness, he recovered his senses and turned his draconic powers toward vengeance against his former master.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Sarkhan_J21_Bio.translation: 萨坎沃是一个流浪的萨满，他对龙的痴迷驱使他为一个古老的邪恶服务。经过多年的疯狂，他恢复了理智，将他的龙之力量转向了对他以前的主人的复仇。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Shadowheart_HBG_.oracleText: Shadowheart is a devout follower of the dark goddess Shar with a keen sense of duty that holds Shar's will above her personal interests. The dark cleric is tenacious when focused on goal and holds tremendous power through her faith in the Mistress of the Night.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Shadowheart_HBG_.translation: 影心是黑暗女神夏尔的虔诚追随者，有着敏锐的责任感，将夏尔的意志置于她的个人利益之上。这位黑暗牧师在专注于目标时非常顽强，并通过她对夜之女莎尔的信仰拥有巨大的力量。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Sheoldred_ONE_Bi.oracleText: Sheoldred is a graceful, cruel, and clever praetor and the mightiest of the Seven Steel Thanes. She is known for underhanded manipulation and effective use of sleeper agents to infiltrate her opposition. Returned now to New Phyrexia, Sheoldred prepares to betray Norn before her moment of triumph.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Sheoldred_ONE_Bi.translation: 希欧蕊这位魔判官优雅、残忍、聪慧，也是七大钢铁伯爵中的最强者。她长于卑鄙操弄，并善于利用潜藏密探渗透对手。如今的她已回到新非瑞克西亚，准备在艾蕾侬享受凯旋时刻前反手出击。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Sorin_VOW_Bio.oracleText: A powerful vampire Planeswalker, Sorin Markov was born over 7,000 years ago on Innistrad. For millennia, he lorded over his home plane, preserving the balance between humans and the monsters that hunt them. Now, his power has been challenged by his longtime rival, Olivia Voldaren.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Sorin_VOW_Bio.translation: 一个强大的吸血鬼鹏洛客，索霖马可夫在7000 多年前出生在依尼翠。几千年来，他一直统治着他的家乡时空，保持着人类与猎杀他们的怪物之间的平衡。现在，他的权力受到了他长期以来的对手奥莉薇亚沃达连的挑战。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/THB_Ashiok_Bio.oracleText: Cloaked in darkness and mystery, Ashiok has the power to turn nightmares into reality. Ashiok claims to act in the name of equality—and believes there is no greater equalizer than fear.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/THB_Ashiok_Bio.translation: 隐藏在黑暗和神秘之中，安梭苛拥有将噩梦变为现实的力量。 安梭苛声称以平等的名义行事——并相信没有比恐惧更能平衡的东西了。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/THB_Elspeth_Bio.oracleText: Elspeth fights for a single core principle: freedom for all. Struck down into the Underworld by a jealous god, she must find a way back to the land of the living—or stay dead trying.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/THB_Elspeth_Bio.translation: 艾紫培为一个核心原则而战：所有人的自由。她被嫉妒的神明击落到冥界，她必须找到返回活人之地的方法——否则就死定了。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Tamiyo_NEO_Bio.oracleText: For years, Tamiyo traveled the Multiverse, an impartial historian documenting stories from across dozens of different planes. Now, she has been compleated by the Phyrexians, her purpose twisted to serve their one "true" story: the inexorable rise of Phyrexia.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Tamiyo_NEO_Bio.translation: 多年来，多美代游历了多重宇宙，一位公正的历史学家记录了来自数十个不同位面的故事。现在，她已经被非瑞克西亚完化，她的目的被扭曲为服务于他们的一个“真实”故事：非瑞克西亚崛起不可阻挡。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Tasha_HBG_Bio.oracleText: Tasha hails from Oerth (the World of Greyhawk) and is the adopted daughter of Baba Yaga, an archfey known as the Mother of Witches. An archmage with unsurpassed knowledge of the planes, she is also an archfey with control over her own Domain of Delight.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Tasha_HBG_Bio.translation: 塔莎来自Oerth（灰鹰世界），是被称为女巫之母的大法师Baba Yaga的养女。她是一位大法师，拥有无与伦比的平面知识，同时也是一位大法师，控制着她自己的快乐领域。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Teferi_Bio.oracleText: Teferi was recognized as a magical prodigy at a young age. With a talent for temporal magic and a fondness for practical jokes, he was one of the academy's most renowned, and confounding, students.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Teferi_Bio.translation: 泰菲力在很年轻时就被认为是个魔法奇才。他拥有时间魔法的天赋和恶作剧的爱好，也成为了学院里最有名，也是最会捣乱的学生。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Teyo_J21_Bio.oracleText: Teyo Verada is a young, inexperienced shield mage who was unexpectedly thrust into the chaos of war, surviving deadly trials against all odds. He's still learning what it means to be a Planeswalker and has only scratched the surface of his true potential.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Teyo_J21_Bio.translation: 泰佑维拉达是一个年轻的、没有经验的盾法师，他意外地被推入了混乱的战争中，在致命的考验中逆境生存。他仍在学习成为一名鹏洛客的意义，对他真正的潜力也只是触及表面。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Tezzeret_Bio.oracleText: Tezzeret specializes in blue artifice magic: spells that forge and manipulate artifacts, sometimes even bringing them to life. His body is enhanced with the magical alloy etherium.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Tezzeret_Bio.translation: 泰兹瑞擅长于蓝色神器法术：铸造神器，操弄神器，甚至替神器赋与生命的咒语。他的身体都有一部分以法术合金乙金增强过。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/TheWanderer_NEO_.oracleText: A mysterious swordswoman of unmatched prowess, the Wanderer appears without warning to defend the innocent before disappearing just as suddenly as she arrived. Few know the truth: she is the lost empress of Kamigawa, wandering the Multiverse in search of a way home.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/TheWanderer_NEO_.translation: 飘萍是一位具有无与伦比的能力的神秘女剑客，她毫无征兆地出现在人们面前，保护无辜者，然后就像她到来时一样突然消失。很少有人知道真相：她是神河的失落皇后，在多重宇宙游荡，寻找回家的路。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Tibalt_KHM_Bio.oracleText: A sadistic, interplanar menace who revels in the suffering of others, Tibalt brings misery and conflict wherever he goes. Though born human on Innistrad, his fascination with pain drove him to explore fiendish magic that ultimately transformed him into a half-devil.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Tibalt_KHM_Bio.translation: 提勃是一个虐待狂，以他人的痛苦为乐的星际威胁，无论他走到哪里都会带来痛苦和冲突。虽然他是出生在依尼翠的人类，但他对痛苦的迷恋促使他探索恶魔般的魔法，最终将自己转变为一个半恶魔。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Titania_BRO_Bio.oracleText: Queen Titania, avatar of the goddess Gaea, ruled over the forested island of Argoth. When Urza's and Mishra's forces came to Argoth's shores to plunder the land for resources, Titania unleashed the full fury of nature upon them. But when Urza activated the Sylex to end the war, Argoth was destroyed—and Titania with it.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Titania_BRO_Bio.translation: 作为女神盖亚的化身，泰坦尼亚女王统治整个亚格斯的林覆海岛。当克撒和米斯拉的势力抵达亚格斯的海岸来掠夺资源时，泰坦尼亚对他们释放了自然的全部怒火。但当克撒启动同兆来结束战争时，泰坦尼亚与亚格斯被其一同摧毁殆尽。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Trostani_Bio.oracleText: Guildmaster of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica, and speaker for the World Tree, Mat'Selesnya. Trostani is a fusion of three Dryads who each represent a different key Selesnyan value: Life, Order, and Harmony.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Trostani_Bio.translation: 卓塔妮，拉尼卡瑟雷尼亚盟会公会长，世界之树太瑟雷尼亚之声。她是三位树灵融合一体，分别代表瑟雷尼亚三大核心价值观之一：生命、秩序、和谐。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Urabrask_ONE_Bio.oracleText: Blazing with a temper as hot as his furnace, Urabrask is a reclusive praetor solely focused on the perfection of Mirrodin. His devotion was so extreme that he refused to fight the Mirran Resistance, an act which would eventually draw punishment from Elesh Norn. Now he plots a rebellion of his own.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Urabrask_ONE_Bio.translation: 洼巴司的脾气跟他的熔炉一样火爆。这位魔判官通常深居简出，全身心都投入在令秘罗地更完美的志业上。为求专注，他甚至不愿一举肃清秘罗志士的反抗势力，此举最终定会招致艾蕾侬的严惩。如今，他开始谋划一场属于自己的反抗志业。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Urza_BRO_Bio.oracleText: Urza is one of the most influential Planeswalkers to ever live. From his early days exploring Thran ruins, Urza was a brilliant artificer, eventually crafting a mechanized army to fight his brother Mishra. Urza would stop at nothing to win the war, even if it meant shattering Dominaria in the process.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Urza_BRO_Bio.translation: 克撒堪称有史以来最具影响力的鹏洛客之首。在他早期勘测索蓝遗迹开始，他的出众神器师天才就已崭露头角，最终更是凭一己之力建造出机械化大军与弟弟米斯拉战斗。为了赢得战争，克撒愿意付出一切代价，就算毁灭多明纳里亚也在所不惜。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Urzabot_BRO_Bio.oracleText: Powered by genius artifice and ancient magical energy, the mechanical soldiers of Urza's army were marvels to behold and terrifying to oppose. Each machine fulfilled a crucial purpose on the battlefield, but their greatest power? They can always build more.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Urzabot_BRO_Bio.translation: 克撒军的机械兽制造技艺巧夺天工，魔力驱动力大无穷。它们不止外观赏心悦目，威力更是令对手胆寒。每台机器都能在战场上独当一面。要问它们最大的优点是什么？那恐怕得是：总能造出更多。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Vannifar_Bio.oracleText: Guildmaster of the Simic Combine, Vannifar is an elf who has mutated her body into a proto-plasmic ooze. She considers herself a superior life-form.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Vannifar_Bio.translation: 析米克联合的公会长凡妮法原本生来是个妖精，但她现在已将自己演化成原质流浆。她以自己是更优越的生命形态为傲。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/VivienReid_Bio.oracleText: Vivien's homeworld was deeply divided between the forest dwellers and an advanced civilization that encircled the dwindling woodlands; she belonged to the Smaragdi, sworn to protect the forest.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/VivienReid_Bio.translation: 薇薇安的家园时空有着鲜明的族群对立～栖居深林的原始住民与侵蚀自然土地之先进文明一直冲突不断；碧玉族誓死保卫林地家园，而薇薇安正是其中一员。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Vivien_ANB_Bio.oracleText: Vivien Reid is a magical archer and the last survivor of Skalla, a plane where advocates of progress and guardians of nature failed to find balance. Her weapon, the Arkbow, can preserve the life force of dying beasts and summon their powerful spirits into battle.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Vivien_ANB_Bio.translation: 薇薇安瑞德这位善使魔法的弓箭手是斯凯拉时空最后的幸存者。斯凯拉深陷推崇进步与守卫自然两派势力的长期纷争，到最终也未能形成平衡局面。她的武器名唤方舟神弓，能够留存消亡野兽的生命力，并在之后的战斗中召现灵魂为己而战。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Vorinclex_ONE_Bi.oracleText: Vorinclex is the praetor of the Hunter Maze and an apex predator of great appetite and power. While intelligent, he rarely prefers speech, delegating matters of rule to the compleated elf Glissa. He was the first to work with Norn and her plan for Multiverse domination, believing it the next step in his theory of Grand Evolution.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Vorinclex_ONE_Bi.translation: 弗霖凯是猎者迷林的魔判官，也是食欲和力量都极强的顶级掠食者。虽然他很聪明，但极少言语，并将统治事宜交由已完化的妖精格莉莎全权打理。他是第一个与艾蕾侬合作共同推进统治多重宇宙计划的魔判官，相信这就是他「大进化」理论的下一步。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Vraska_Bio.oracleText: This mysterious Planeswalker wields a suite of deadly spells that suit her gorgon nature. Vraska specializes in magic that involves assassination, stealth, and petrification. And she likes to take souvenirs...
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Vraska_Bio.translation: 这名神秘的鹏洛客具有蛇发妖本色，而她所使用的致命咒语也恰如其分。瓦丝卡擅长的都是与暗杀、隐形和石化相关的法术。而且她很喜欢带走纪念品...

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Vraska_ONE_Bio.oracleText: The deadly and quick-witted Vraska, a gorgon from Ravnica, has held many titles and allegiances throughout her life. Through compleation, her latest allegiance is to New Phyrexia and the vision of a perfected multiverse. All will be one.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Vraska_ONE_Bio.translation: 瓦丝卡是位来自拉尼卡的蛇发女妖，她致命而睿智，一生头衔无数，亦曾效忠数主。经完化后的她，如今忠心属于新非瑞克西亚及其完美多重宇宙的美好愿景。万界归一。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/WAR_Ashiok_Bio.oracleText: Ashiok is an elegant being of nightmare who draws on fear, creating twisted physical manifestations of each victim's darkest dreams. Ashiok's motives and origin are unknown, but most who encounter this sinister entity quickly conclude that some mysteries are better left unraveled.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/WAR_Ashiok_Bio.translation: 安梭苛是一个优雅的噩梦生物，利用恐惧，为每个受害者最黑暗的梦想创造扭曲的物理表现。安梭苛的动机和来源不明，但大多数遇到这个邪恶的实体的人很快就会得出结论，有些谜团最好不要被揭开。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/WAR_Tamiyo_Bio.oracleText: Tamiyo is a brilliant moonfolk scholar who travels the Multiverse seeking stories and secrets from every plane. She usually tries to stay an impartial observer, but will intervene when she deems it necessary. Who else would have thought to imprison Emrakul in Innistrad's moon?
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/WAR_Tamiyo_Bio.translation: 多美代是一位才华横溢的月人学者，她周游多重宇宙，从各个位面寻找故事和秘密。她通常试图保持一个公正的观察者，但会在她认为有必要时进行干预。还有谁会想到将伊莫库囚禁在依尼翠的月球上？

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Wrenn_MID_Bio.oracleText: Long ago, Wrenn absorbed a raging wildfire to protect an ancient forest. Those flames still burn within her and she must physically merge with especially strong trees to survive. Now, Wrenn and her latest symbiont, Seven, seek a way to quench her inner fire for good.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Wrenn_MID_Bio.translation: 很久以前，芮恩为了保护一个古老的森林，吸收了熊熊的野火。那些火焰仍然在她体内燃烧，她必须与特别强壮的树木身体融合才能生存。现在，芮恩和她最新的共生体，七树妖，寻求一种方法来永久地熄灭她内心的火焰。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Wyll_HBG_Bio.oracleText: Noble by birth, Wyll made his name as the heroic 'Blade of Frontiers'. He keeps his pact with a devil well-hidden and is desperate to escape the hellish bargain - even if that means rescuing the seductive creature that made the deal.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Wyll_HBG_Bio.translation: 威迩出身贵族，以英雄的“边境之刃”扬名。他将与恶魔的契约隐藏得很深，并迫切希望逃脱地狱般的交易——即使这意味着要拯救做出交易的诱人生物。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Yargle_DAR_Bio.oracleText: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Yargle_DAR_Bio.translation: 贝赞洛的副手雅库开始展露野心，恶魔领主便把他变成一条蛆虫。有只青蛙吞下了这条蛆虫后不断变大，最终贪食的精怪从其体内破膛而出。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/ZNR_Nahiri_Bio.oracleText: Nahiri is a lithomancer: a mage who wields great power over stone. She can create arcane, complex formations that redirect the leylines of an entire world, or simply drag red-hot blades from the earth and leap into battle. Some call her a hero, some a villain, but nobody not even her most vicious enemies can deny her courage.
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/ZNR_Nahiri_Bio.translation: 娜希丽是一位砾岩术士：一位对石头拥有强大力量的法师。她可以创造出神秘而复杂的阵型来改变整个世界的地脉，或者干脆从大地中拖出炽热的刀刃并跃入战斗。有人称她为英雄，有人称她为恶棍，但即使是她最恶毒的敌人，也没有人能否认她的勇气。

MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Zimone_STX_Bio.oracleText: Zimone Wola is a young prodigy who was accepted to Strixhaven early. She is a whiz at many forms of mystical arts, but eventually gravitated to the mathematical magic of Quandrix. Dark forces have noticed her considerable talents...
MainNav/Profile/Avatars/Zimone_STX_Bio.translation: 齐莫内·沃拉是一个年轻的神童，很早就被斯翠海文接纳。她在许多形式的神秘艺术方面都很有天赋，但最终倾向于量析的数学魔法。黑暗势力已经注意到她的巨大才能......

MainNav/Profile/Emotes/MaxEquippedEmoteC.oracleText: One of your emote types has gone over the equip cap. Would you like to discard changes?
MainNav/Profile/Emotes/MaxEquippedEmoteC.translation: 你装备的一种表情已经超过上限，是否要放弃更改？

MainNav/Profile/Emotes/UnlockNewEmotes.oracleText: Unlock new Emotes through the Mastery Pass, Store, or Rewards.
MainNav/Profile/Emotes/UnlockNewEmotes.translation: 通过精研通行证、商店、奖励解锁新的表情。

MainNav/Profile/Emotes/UnsavedChanges_Bo.oracleText: You have unsaved changes. Would you like to discard changes or save and exit?

MainNav/Vault/DraftProgressDescription.oracleText: After drafting your final card, common and uncommon cards that exceeded the 4x collection limit increase your vault progress.
