MainNav/Widgets/TOHO_Body.oracleText: Until May 21, 2020 get bonus Godzilla Series Monster card styles with IKO pack bundles!
MainNav/Widgets/TOHO_Body.translation: 直到 2020年5月21日，通过IKO套装包获得额外的哥斯拉系列怪物卡牌样式！

MainNav/homepage/billboards/LockedDescri.oracleText: Complete more Color Challenges to unlock additional play modes.
MainNav/homepage/billboards/LockedDescri.translation: 完成当前所有任务，即可启用更多游戏模式。

Match/LeaveQueue.oracleText: This will attempt to leave the matchmaking queue without joining a match.
Match/LeaveQueue.translation: 这会尝试离开配对队列，不加入对局。

Match/Match_Join_Cancel.oracleText: This will cancel joining the match. This may count as a loss if your opponent has already joined the match.
Match/Match_Join_Cancel.translation: 这会取消加入对局。如果对手已加入对局，则会算作你认输。

Match/QueueTip001.oracleText: If you click End Turn but change your mind before the turn ends, you can cancel that by quickly pressing Enter or clicking End Turn again.
Match/QueueTip001.translation: 如果你已点击「结束回合」按钮，但在回合实际结束前改变心意，可以通过快速按下Enter键或再次点击「结束回合」按钮来取消。

Match/QueueTip002.oracleText: To tap specific lands to cast a spell, tap them before starting to cast your spell.
Match/QueueTip002.translation: 若要横置特定的地来施放咒语，请在开始施放咒语前先行横置之。

Match/QueueTip003.oracleText: Drag cards from your hand to the battlefield to play them.
Match/QueueTip003.translation: 将你手上的牌拖至战场以使用之。

Match/QueueTip004.oracleText: As you drag a spell over the battlefield, the lands that will be tapped to cast it become highlighted.
Match/QueueTip004.translation: 当你将咒语拖到战场上方时，游戏会高亮显示将横置用于施放该咒语的地。

Match/QueueTip005.oracleText: You can click a graveyard or exile zone to browse its contents.
Match/QueueTip005.translation: 你可以点击坟墓场或放逐区来查看位于该区域的牌张。

Match/QueueTip006.oracleText: If you don't want to cast a spell or activate an ability, you can pass priority with the spacebar.
Match/QueueTip006.translation: 如果你不希望施放咒语或起动异能，你可以按下空格键来让过优先权。

Match/QueueTip007.oracleText: If you play through three of your turns without seeing the timer fuse, you'll get a 30-second extension for a future turn.
Match/QueueTip007.translation: 如果你在没有激活计时引信的情况下完成自己的三个回合，便会获得一次30秒延长时间供后续回合使用。

Match/QueueTip008.oracleText: If your timer fuse runs down, you'll automatically use one of your 30-second extensions, if available.
Match/QueueTip008.translation: 如果你计时引信已烧尽，则你会自动用掉一次30秒延长时间（如有）。

Match/QueueTip009.oracleText: If your timer fuse runs down and you don't have any time extensions, you'll automatically pass through the current turn.
Match/QueueTip009.translation: 如果你计时引信已烧尽，也没有可用的延长时间，则你会自动让过本回合剩余所有阶段。

Match/QueueTip010.oracleText: Known cards in your opponent's hand are shown face-up, fully visible - no need to take notes!
Match/QueueTip010.translation: 如果对手手牌中有你已经知晓的牌张，则它们便会以牌面朝上的状态显示，让你看得清清楚楚，无需另外记录！

Match/QueueTip011.oracleText: When cards in a library are known to a player, they'll see them face-up when browsing that library.
Match/QueueTip011.translation: 如果牌手因故已知晓某张牌在牌库中的位置，则他在浏览该牌库时，该牌会以牌面朝上的状态显示。

Match/QueueTip012.oracleText: If you can cast a card that isn't actually in your hand, you'll see a version of it there that you can drag out to cast, just the same as if it were really there!
Match/QueueTip012.translation: 如果你能够施放一张不在你手上的牌，则该牌也会显示在你的手牌区域中，让你能够如同其他手牌一般将它拖出来施放！

Match/QueueTip013.oracleText: Express yourself to your opponent with emotes by clicking your avatar.
Match/QueueTip013.translation: 点击自己的头像可向对手发送表情。

Match/QueueTip014.oracleText: You can mute your opponent's emotes by clicking their avatar and choosing Mute.
Match/QueueTip014.translation: 你可以点击对手头像并选择「静音」以忽略对手的表情。

Match/QueueTip015.oracleText: Wildcards can be redeemed in your collection for cards of the same rarity.
Match/QueueTip015.translation: 你牌张收藏中的万用牌可用来兑换同等稀有度的牌张。

Match/QueueTip016.oracleText: Right-click or hover over a card during a game to zoom in, giving you more information.
Match/QueueTip016.translation: 在游戏过程中，你可以右击某牌，或将指针悬停在该牌上以放大显示，好了解更多信息。

Match/QueueTip017.oracleText: Click a phase in either player's phase bar to set a "stop" there, letting you take an action the next time the game reaches that phase.
Match/QueueTip017.translation: 点击双方牌手阶段栏上任一阶段便可在该处设置「暂停点」，方便你在下次游戏推进到该阶段时采取行动。

Match/QueueTip018.oracleText: Press Ctrl to use Full Control for the next action, and Shift+Ctrl to use Full Control until you turn it off.
Match/QueueTip018.translation: 按下Ctrl键便可为下次行动时启用「完全掌控」，而按下Shift+Ctrl便会一直启用「完全掌控」，直到你关闭为止。

Match/QueueTip019.oracleText: You can bluff having a spell to cast by entering Full Control (Ctrl), or clicking a phase on a Phase Bar to set a stop.
Match/QueueTip019.translation: 你可以利用「完全掌控」（按下Ctrl键）或暂停点（通过点击阶段栏上的阶段来设置）来假装自己有能够施放的咒语。

Match/QueueTip020.oracleText: You can bluff not having a spell to cast by passing quickly with the space bar, or automatically by clicking End Turn.
Match/QueueTip020.translation: 你可以快速让过（按下空格键）或自动让过回合（点击「结束回合」）来假装自己没有能够施放的咒语。

Match/QueueTip021.oracleText: You can change the art used to represent your deck by dragging a card onto the deck image during deckbuilding.
Match/QueueTip021.translation: 在构筑套牌时，你可以将牌张拖到套牌图像上，以更改用来代表你套牌的图案。

Match/QueueTip023.oracleText: Players with "Mythic Orange" names are MTG Arena team members.
Match/QueueTip023.translation: 名称以秘稀橙颜色显示的牌手是MTGA团队成员。

Match/QueueTip024.oracleText: Acquiring copies of a card beyond your fourth brings you closer to opening the Vault, which contains a Mythic Wildcard, two Rare Wildcards, and three Uncommon Wildcards
Match/QueueTip024.translation: 在某牌已有四张后，再度获得该牌便能增加打开宝库的进度。宝库内容丰富：内有一张秘稀万用牌，两张稀有万用牌，以及三种非凡万用牌。

Match/QueueTip025.oracleText: If you don't like your opening hand, you can "mulligan": drawing a new opening hand with one fewer card.
Match/QueueTip025.translation: 如果你不喜欢你的起手牌，你可以选择「再调度」：重抓一副新的起手牌，但张数会比之前少一张。

Match/QueueTip026.oracleText: If you're able to cast a spell without paying its mana cost, and there's an X in that cost, X must be zero.
Match/QueueTip026.translation: 如果你能以不需支付法术力费用的方式来施放某咒语，且该咒语费用中有X，则X只能是0。

Match/QueueTip027.oracleText: Your creatures can attack your opponent or their planeswalkers. When you click a creature to attack with it, click the planeswalker or the opponent to decide what they're attacking.
Match/QueueTip027.translation: 你的生物可以攻击对手或对手的鹏洛客。在利用生物攻击时，先点击生物，然后再点击要让其攻击的鹏洛客或对手。

Match/QueueTip028.oracleText: Spells that deal damage to "any target" can target planeswalkers and reduce their loyalty just as easily as they damage a creature or player.
Match/QueueTip028.translation: 能对「任意一个目标」造成伤害的咒语可以指定鹏洛客为目标。这样会降低鹏洛客的忠诚，跟对生物和牌手造成伤害类似。

Match/QueueTip029.oracleText: Aggressive ("aggro") decks look to win quickly with cheap creatures before the opponent can set up effective defenses.
Match/QueueTip029.translation: 强攻（「快攻」）套牌偏好使用费用较低的生物，力争在对手建立起有效防御之前赢得胜利。

Match/QueueTip030.oracleText: Midrange decks use efficient creatures and value-generating spells to outclass aggro decks and pressure control and combo decks.
Match/QueueTip030.translation: 中速套牌则会放入各类优质生物和高效咒语，以此拖垮快攻套牌，并与控制及组合技等套牌周旋、抗衡。

Match/QueueTip031.oracleText: Control decks look to answer early threats and survive until the late game, when they take over with powerful spells and card advantage.
Match/QueueTip031.translation: 控制套期偏重化解前期威胁，以存活到游戏后期，而后再以强力咒语和卡牌优势掌控游戏。

Match/QueueTip032.oracleText: Combo decks focus on finding and casting spells that work together to produce powerful effects, often winning the game outright!
Match/QueueTip032.translation: 组合技套牌注重于搜寻并施放配合良好的咒语来产生强大的效应，通常能够一举赢下游戏！

Match/QueueTip033.oracleText: Ideal draws allow you to "curve out" by both playing a land and spending all available mana every turn for the first few turns.
Match/QueueTip033.translation: 理想的起手能让你在游戏最初的数回合中都连续使用地牌并用尽法术力。这便叫做「曲线平滑」。

Match/QueueTip034.oracleText: When you can't decide which spell to cast, the play that lets you spend as much of your available mana as possible is generally better.
Match/QueueTip034.translation: 当你举棋不定，不知道要施放哪个咒语时，不妨先考虑能够用尽你所有法术力的方案，通常收效较佳。

Match/QueueTip035.oracleText: Your life total is a resource, so don't be afraid to spend it! Winning at one life counts the same as winning at 20 life.
Match/QueueTip035.translation: 你的总生命也是一种资源，能派上用场时请不要吝惜！获胜时还剩1点生命和还剩20点生命并没有区别。

Match/QueueTip036.oracleText: When you spend less mana to answer a threat than it cost, you have gained an important mana advantage.
Match/QueueTip036.translation: 当你利用较少的法术力来化解费用较高的威胁时，你已获得显著的法术力优势。

Match/QueueTip037.oracleText: If your opening hand doesn't contain any early plays, consider taking a mulligan.
Match/QueueTip037.translation: 如果你的起手牌中没有可在游戏早期打出的牌，则应考虑再调度。

Match/QueueTip038.oracleText: An ideal opening hand typically has three or four lands in it. If you have more than five or fewer than two, consider taking a mulligan.
Match/QueueTip038.translation: 起手牌通常以其中有三到四张地牌为佳。如果你起手抓到的地牌数量过多（多于五张）或过少（少于两张），则应考虑再调度。

Match/QueueTip039.oracleText: 60-card decks typically have 23-27 lands, depending on average spell cost and deck plan. The auto-land tool adds 24.
Match/QueueTip039.translation: 一副60张的套牌通常会有23-27张地牌，具体数量取决于套牌的平均咒语费用和游戏计划。「自动配地」工具会将地牌数量加至24。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_1.oracleText: If you click End Turn but change your mind before the turn ends, you can cancel that by quickly pressing 'ENTER' ('RETURN' on Mac) or clicking End Turn again.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_1.translation: 如果你已点击「结束回合」按钮，但在回合实际结束前改变心意，可以通过快速按下Enter键（MAC为RETURN键）或再次点击「结束回合」按钮来取消。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_10.oracleText: Known cards in your opponent's hand are shown face-up, fully visible—no need to take notes!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_10.translation: 如果对手手牌中有你已经知晓的牌张，则它们便会以牌面朝上的状态显示，让你看得清清楚楚，无需另外记录！

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_100.oracleText: Your opponent can be any kind of person from any kind of background. Magic is for everyone!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_100.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_101.oracleText: Digital-only cards have a small Arena logo in the space where the holofoil stamp normally is on a printed card.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_101.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_102.oracleText: You can mute your opponent's emotes by tapping their avatar and choosing Mute.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_102.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_103.oracleText: Your creatures can attack your opponent or their planeswalkers. When you tap a creature to attack with it, tap the planeswalker or the opponent to decide what they're attacking.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_103.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_104.oracleText: When cards are stacked together on the battlefield, you can tap on the quantity number to select all of them while attacking and blocking.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_104.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_105.oracleText: You can replay the Color Challenges or the Tutorial by tapping on the ‘Learn More' button. It's located in the top right and looks like a question mark.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_105.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_106.oracleText: You can assign specific companions, sleeves, emotes, and avatars on a per-deck basis!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_106.translation: 你可以为每副套牌指定特定的宠物、牌套、表情和头像！

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_107.oracleText: You can mute your opponent's emotes and companion by selecting their avatar and choosing Mute.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_107.translation: 你可以选择对手头像并选择「静音」来忽略对手的表情和宠物。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_108.oracleText: Want to know even more about Magic: The Gathering and MTG Arena? Then it's time to explore the Codex of the Multiverse! You can find it in the top right of your screen next to your Mail.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_108.translation: 想了解更多关于万智牌和万智牌竞技场的事吗？是时候去多重宇宙法典看看了！你可以在你屏幕顶端右侧的邮箱旁边找到它。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_109.oracleText: To show only cards from Streets of New Capenna in the deckbuilder, type "set:SNC" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_109.translation: 想让组牌器只显示新卡佩纳：喧嚣黑街的卡，在搜索栏输入“set:SNC” 或者“e:SNC”。每个系列有一个独有的3字缩写。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_11.oracleText: When cards in a library are known to a player, they'll see them face-up when browsing that library.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_11.translation: 如果牌手因故已知晓某张牌在牌库中的位置，则他在浏览该牌库时，该牌会以牌面朝上的状态显示。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_110.oracleText: Falco Spara studied law long ago, but was ousted from his university due to always correcting his teachers. His studies have culminated in the magically binding pact his Brokers use to protect New Capenna.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_110.translation: 冯柯斯帕拉很久以前就开始学习法律，但由于总是忍不住纠正老师的错误而被赶出了大学。他的研究最终促成了他的扶济社用来保护新卡佩纳的神奇契约。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_111.oracleText: Raffine poses as a simple fortune teller, but in truth leads the Obscura from her perch in the Cloud Spire, a glass enclosure that marks the highest point in the city.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_111.translation: 拉斐茵假扮成一个普通的的占卜师，但实际上她栖身在尖云顶的栖息地引导着秘闻帮行动。尖云顶，一座位于高地园且看似无法进入的摩天楼。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_112.oracleText: Lord Xander used to be an assassin and artist in Old Capenna, but nowadays the retired vampiric demon curates the archives and museums of New Capenna.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_112.translation: 尚夺尔勋爵曾经是旧卡佩纳的刺客和艺术家，但如今这位退休的恶魔吸血鬼管理着新卡佩纳的档案和博物馆。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_113.oracleText: Ziatora is a thrill-seeker whose need for adventure has now turned into a lust for violence and crime. She now has one goal: increase her hoard beneath the Caldaia district as the last dragon in New Capenna.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_113.translation: 齐朵拉是一个寻求刺激的人，她对冒险的渴望现在已经变成了对暴力和犯罪的渴望。她现在只有一个目标：增加她在柯达亚区下方的巨龙宝库，成为新卡佩纳的最后一条巨龙。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_114.oracleText: Jetmir was born to a sect of leonin paladins, but now he charismatically and hedonistically leads the Cabaretti throwing a never-ending party in the Vantoleone, his prized dance hall.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_114.translation: 杰米尔出生于一个狮族德鲁伊宗派，但现在他以超凡魅力和享乐主义的方式带领他珍视的乐舞会在万通汇举办一场永无止境的派对。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_115.oracleText: Halo is the most valuable resource in New Capenna, and while nobody truly knows what it is, everybody knows they want it. Halo can be used as a currency, to power up spells, or can be transformed into a tasty beverage.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_115.translation: 金圆是新卡佩纳最有价值的资源，虽然没有人真正知道它是什么，但所有人都知道他们想要它。金圆可以作为一种货币，为咒语提供能量，也可以转化为美味的饮品。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_116.oracleText: The opulent Park Heights is the uppermost tier of New Capenna where the streets are paved with literal gold. While crime is rampant even here, it is the only place where you can see something truly rare: the open sky.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_116.translation: 富丽堂皇的高地园是新卡佩纳的最上层，这里的街道是由字面上的黄金铺成的。虽然即使在这里犯罪也很猖獗，但这是唯一可以看到真正罕见的东西的地方：开放的天空。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_117.oracleText: The bustling Mezzio is the city center of New Capenna, full of glitzy cabarets, busy shops both magical and mundane, and secret backrooms you shouldn't know about.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_117.translation: 繁华的梅齐奥区是新卡佩纳的市中心，到处都是炫目的歌舞表演、神奇而平凡的繁忙商店，以及你不应该知道的秘密密室。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_118.oracleText: The industrial Caldaia is the lowest level of New Capenna and resembles a dragon's lair combined with industrial elements. Many residents live in The Verts, an infamous district of row houses with a sudden vertical drop.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_118.translation: 工业区柯达亚是新卡佩纳最底层的行政区，就像是结合了工业元素的龙的巢穴。许多居民住在维兹区，这是一个臭名昭著的排屋区。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_119.oracleText: New Capenna was built by angels, but most have now disappeared. The average denizen believes the now-absent angels are still enforcing order, but the city's demonic masters and their five Families are its current rulers.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_119.translation: 新卡佩纳是天使建造的，但现在大部分都消失了。普通居民认为，现在缺席的天使仍在执行秩序，但这座城市的恶魔主人和他们的五个家族却是目前的统治者。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_12.oracleText: If you can cast a card that isn't actually in your hand, you'll see a version of it there that you can drag out to cast, just the same as if it were really there!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_12.translation: 如果你能够施放一张不在你手上的牌，则该牌也会显示在你的手牌区域中，让你能够如同其它手牌一般将它拖出来施放！

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_120.oracleText: To show only cards from Alchemy Horizons: Baldur's Gate in the deckbuilder, type "set:HBG" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_120.translation: 想让组牌器只显示炼金新篇：博德之门的卡，在搜索栏输入“set:HBG”或者“e:HBG”。每个系列有一个独有的3字缩写。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_121.oracleText: The world of the Forgotten Realms takes place on a planet called Toril and its moon Selûne, which is always trailed by an asteroid cluster known as The Tears of Selûne.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_121.translation: 被遗忘国度的故事发生在一个名为托瑞尔的行星及其卫星阿贝尔内，它总是被一个名为塞伦涅之泪的小行星团尾随。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_122.oracleText: Baldur's Gate is a welcoming and inclusive port city on the Sword Coast. It's a haven for opportunity, commerce...and corruption.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_122.translation: 博德之门是位于剑湾的一座热情、包容的港口城市。它是机会、商业……和腐败的天堂。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_123.oracleText: The Yawning Portal is a tavern in Waterdeep named after the great hole in the taproom that leads to the dungeons of Undermountain.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_123.translation: 呵欠大门是深水城的一家酒馆，以酒窖里的大洞命名，这个大洞通向地脉迷城的地下城。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_124.oracleText: Chromatic dragons are driven by greed and united by their sense of superiority. Meanwhile, metallic dragons are curious, protective, and can shapeshift into humanoids and beasts.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_124.translation: 彩色龙被贪婪驱使，因他们的优越感而团结。同时，金属龙好奇，善良，并且可以变形为类人生物和野兽。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_125.oracleText: Baldur's Gate is protected by the Watch, who guard the citizens of the Upper City; and the Flaming Fists, a mercenary company who control Wyrm's Rock, an imposing island-fortress.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_125.translation: 博德之门受到守卫上城区市民的守望者的保护；还有焰拳兵团，一个控制着巨龙之石的雇佣兵公司，一个雄伟的岛屿堡垒。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_126.oracleText: Lulu is a gentle and caring hollyphant who served for centuries as the war mount for a certain fallen angel, and believes in the power of friendship above all else.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_126.translation: 露露是一只温柔体贴的圣飞象，几个世纪以来一直作为某个堕落天使的战争坐骑，她相信友谊的力量高于一切。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_127.oracleText: Miirym was one of the guardians of Candlekeep, Faerûn's famous library-fortress of enlightenment and knowledge. The ghostly and lonely dragon only desires to protect Candlekeep, and to fly again in the blue sky.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_127.translation: 米瑞穆是烛堡的守护者之一，烛堡是费伦著名图书馆——启蒙与知识的堡垒。幽冥孤龙，只愿守护烛堡，再次翱翔于蓝天。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_128.oracleText: Iggwilv is famous for creating her namesake Demonomicon, which contained many spells such as Tasha's hideous laughter, Tasha's mind whip, Tasha's otherworldly guise, and torment.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_128.translation: 伊格维尔伏以创造她的同名恶魔之书而闻名，其中包含许多法术，如塔莎狂笑术、塔莎心灵之鞭、塔莎的超凡脱俗的伪装和折磨。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_129.oracleText: Minsc is a beloved berserker and a virtuous member of the Heroes of Baldur's Gate. He can always be found accompanied by his most trusted companion Boo, a hamster that is definitely a miniature giant space hamster.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_129.translation: 明斯克是一位受人喜爱的狂战士游侠，也是博德之门英雄中的一名正直成员。总能找到他最信任的伙伴布布陪伴，这只仓鼠绝对是一只微型的巨型太空仓鼠。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_13.oracleText: Express yourself to your opponent with emotes by clicking your avatar.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_13.translation: 点击自己的头像可向对手发送表情。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_130.oracleText: Catti-brie is a kind and insightful member of the Companions of the Hall, a group of adventurers that also count Drizzt Do'Urden and King Bruenor Battlehammer among its members.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_130.translation: 凯蒂布莉儿是秘银厅同伴中一位善良而富有洞察力的成员。秘银厅同伴是一群冒险家，其中也包括崔斯特杜垩登和布鲁诺·战锤国王。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_131.oracleText: To show only cards from Dominaria United in the deckbuilder, type "set:DMU" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_131.translation: 想让组牌器只显示多明纳里亚：众志成城的卡，在搜索栏输入 "set:DMU" 或者 "e:DMU" 。每个系列有一个独有的3字缩写。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_132.oracleText: The Seven Great Houses rule New Benalia and attempt to live up to a thousand years of heroic ancestors. The current Highest House is House Capashen, the first house to accept the Serran faith.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_132.translation: 七大家族统治新宾纳里亚，并试图不辜负祖先的千年英名。目前的最高家族是卡帕轩家族，第一个接受塞伦信仰的家族。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_133.oracleText: The great island of New Argive is part of the archipelago of Terisiare, which was shattered at the end of the Brothers' War. It's currently ruled by King Darien XLVIII, but the dragon Prossh reigns over its Kher ridges.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_133.translation: 新阿基夫是特里西安群岛的一部分，该群岛在兄弟战争结束时由特里夏瑞板块部分沉入海平面形成。新阿基夫目前由国王达利安四十八世统治，但喀尔天君普罗许统治着它的喀尔山脊。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_134.oracleText: While the original Tolaria was utterly destroyed by the Phyrexian Invasion, the idea of unfettered magical learning lives on among the various campuses of the Tolarian Academies. Each wizard school is protected by a magical barrier called the Perimeter.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_134.translation: 虽然最初的陶拉里亚被非瑞克西亚入侵彻底摧毁，但无拘无束的魔法学习理念在陶拉里亚学院的各个校区中流传。每所魔法学校都受到称为“周界”的魔法屏障的保护。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_135.oracleText: Most of Dominaria is covered in water, and therein lies the global empire of Vodalia. The center of this society dwells in the Voda Sea and modern Vodalia still keeps a wary eye on the activities of the homarids.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_135.translation: 多明纳里亚的大部分地区都被水覆盖，其中坐落着全球帝国伏特里亚。这个社会的中心坐落于伏特海，现代伏特里亚仍然对荷马利人的活动保持警惕。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_136.oracleText: With Belzenlok and the rest of the Cabal's leadership slain, a conclave of dementia sorcerers have brought Braids, the Cabal's former second-in-command, back from dementia space— a place of created nightmares and horrors.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_136.translation: 随着贝赞洛以及柯帮的其他领导悉数被杀，一个惧像召唤师秘密组织举行仪式将柯帮的前副手布蕾德从惧像空间带了回来——这是一个制造噩梦和恐怖的地方。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_137.oracleText: Urborg is now dominated by the Cabal's enormous Stronghold, but used to be home to Crosis, the Primeval Dragon of death, the infamous necromancer Nevinyrral, and the noble panther planeswalker Lord Windgrace.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_137.translation: 乌尔博格现在被柯帮的天罗城塞所统治，但它曾经是死亡的太古龙克罗希司、臭名昭著的死灵法师妮维亚洛和高贵的黑豹鹏洛客风华领主的家园。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_138.oracleText: Hailing from the barren land of Keld on the far northern continent of Icehaven live the courageous and resilient Keldons. The task of restoring Keld has fallen to Radha, granddaughter of the great warlord Astor and an elf of Skyshroud.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_138.translation: 来自遥远的冰河大陆北部的荒芜之地凯尔德，生活着勇敢而坚韧的凯尔德人。复兴凯尔德的任务落在了大军阀阿斯托的孙女、天帷妖精拉妲身上。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_139.oracleText: The isolated continent of Shiv is home to dragons, Ghitu pyromancers, goblins, and viashino, and is nominally lead by the Shivan Nation. Teferi once phased out most of Shiv to save it from the Phyrexians and it is home to the imperative Mana Rig.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_139.translation: 与世隔绝的西瓦大陆是龙族、基图烈焰术士、鬼怪和凡尔西诺的家园，名义上由西瓦国掌控。泰菲力曾经为了从非瑞克西亚的入侵中拯救西瓦，将西瓦的大部分跃离出此时空。西瓦是势在必得的魔力钻探机的所在地。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_14.oracleText: You can mute your opponent's emotes by clicking their avatar and choosing Mute.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_14.translation: 你可以点击对手头像并选择「静音」以忽略对手的表情。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_140.oracleText: Some of the reclusive Llanowar Elves are still wholly devoted to Gaea, the Dominaria nature goddess, while many others are more pragmatic. But despite differences in their beliefs they all still punish transgressions of their unwritten laws, often by breaking bones.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_140.translation: 一些隐居的罗堰妖精仍然完全献身于多明纳里亚自然女神盖亚，而其他许多人则更加务实。但是，尽管他们的信仰不同，他们都会惩罚违反他们不成文法律的行为，通常是打断骨头。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_141.oracleText: The tremendous coastal forest of Yavimaya has a collective consciousness and remembers the harm it has suffered at the hands of artificers. In the heart of Yavimaya, the largest and oldest magnigoth trees grow nearly a mile high.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_141.translation: 亚维马雅巨大的沿海森林有一个集体意识，它还记得工匠们对它的伤害。在亚维马雅的中心地带，最大和最古老的马尼古斯树有近一英里高。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_142.oracleText: Holding 'SHIFT' and pressing 'ENTER' ('RETURN' on Mac) allows you to pass priority for the rest of the turn, unless you're prompted to block.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_142.translation: 按住'SHIFT'键时再按住'ENTER' 键(Mac为'RETURN' 键) ，你可以快速让过此回合剩余步骤，除非你被要求阻挡。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_143.oracleText: To show only cards from The Brothers' War in the deckbuilder, type "set:BRO" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_143.translation: 想让组牌器只显示兄弟之战的卡，在搜索栏输入 "set:BRO" 或者 "e:BRO" 。每个系列有一个独有的3字缩写。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_144.oracleText: Urza was obsessed with perfection, emphasizing efficiency, elegance, and power. In his machines, he finds the perfection he cannot see in people - or himself.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_144.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_145.oracleText: Mishra was obsessed with ancient Thran artifacts, which made him an easy target for Phyrexia's influence following his fall into hardship after parting ways with his brother.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_145.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_146.oracleText: The Brothers' War is a 40 year conflict set on the continent of Terisiare, on the world of Dominaria, roughly 4,500 years prior to present day. The birth of Urza marks 0 "AR," or "Argivian Reckoning" time.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_146.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_147.oracleText: In the beginning, Urza was interested primarily in machines, and Mishra was more interested in people. But Urza eventually marries the princess of Kroog: Kayla bin-Kroog, while Mishra discovers an ancient Phyrexian artifact: a dragon engine.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_147.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_148.oracleText: Each brother has an assistant: Urza has Tawnos, who works on automatons, while Mishra has Ashnod, who develops machine-human zombies called "Transmogrants." They share in their mutual difficulties with their employers.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_148.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_149.oracleText: The beginning of the War is marked by Urza and Mishra discovering the Caves of Koilos, which hold the Mightstone and the Weakstone. The former empowers machines, while the latter does the opposite.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_149.translation: 本Mod并不收费，找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_15.oracleText: Wildcards can be redeemed in your collection for cards of the same rarity.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_15.translation: 你牌张收藏中的万用牌可用来兑换同等稀有度的牌张。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_150.oracleText: The end of the War is marked by Urza using his latent magical abilities to activate The Golgothian Sylex, which shatters the world, causes cracks in the Multiverse, and ignites Urza's planeswalker spark.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_150.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_151.oracleText: The Thran Empire fell to Phyrexia 5,000 years before Urza, but was known for their highly advanced artifacts. Powerstones have nearly inexhaustible sources of power, and Urza reverse engineers the mighty ornithopter.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_151.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_152.oracleText: The Union of scholars in Terisia City comprise of the archimandrite, Feldon, Loran, Drafna, and Hurkyl. They agree to form a coalition to protect and foster knowledge, in an attempt to find a path to a future that doesn't involve Mishra or Urza.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_152.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_154.oracleText: To show only cards from Phyrexia: All Will Be One in the deckbuilder, type "set:ONE" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_154.translation: 想让组牌器只显示非瑞克西亚：万界归一的卡，在搜索栏输入 "set:ONE" 或者 "e:ONE" 。每个系列有一个独有的3字缩写。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_155.oracleText: Elesh Norn leads the Machine Orthodoxy as The Mother of Machines. She aims to unify all living creatures and end needless conflict through phyresis.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_155.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_156.oracleText: Jin-Gitaxias runs the Progress Engine and believes he is smartest of the praetors. His goal is to achieve total compleation by the most efficient means possible.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_156.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_157.oracleText: Sheoldred is the tenuous leader of the Seven Steel Thanes. The Thanes rose from the swamp of Mirrodin's black sun and see themselves as direct heirs of Yawgmoth's Old Phyrexia.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_157.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_158.oracleText: Urabrask oversees the Quiet Furnace with a blazing hot temper. He has closed off the Furnace Layer to the other factions, and even leaves the Mirran Resistance alone.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_158.translation: 洼巴司以炽热的脾气监管着安静的熔炉。他对其他派系关闭了熔炉层，甚至对秘罗抵抗组织也不闻不问。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_159.oracleText: Vorinclex rules the Vicious Swarm as its apex predator, but delegates most of his responsibilities to the compleated elf Glissa.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_159.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_16.oracleText: Right-click or hover over a card during a game to zoom in, giving you more information.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_16.translation: 在游戏过程中，你可以右击某牌，或将指针悬停在该牌上以放大显示，好了解更多信息。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_160.oracleText: The Nine Spheres of New Phyrexia are: The Monumental Facade, Mirrex, the Autonomous Furnace, the Hunter Maze, the Surgical Bay, the Dross Pits, the Fair Basilica, the Mycosynth Gardens, and the Seedcore.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_160.translation: 新非瑞克西亚的九层狱界由外而内依次是：丰碑外壳、秘罗荒境、自治熔炉、猎者迷林、外展海湾、蔓非深沼、苍皓宗堂、构生花园、树种核心。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_161.oracleText: The Domini are mysterious, cosmic beings that became sentient as the Phyrexians compleated the terrain of Mirrodin itself.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_161.translation: 圣主乃是神秘的寰宇生物，随着非瑞克西亚人将秘罗地全数完化，这些生灵也开始觉醒。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_162.oracleText: The Mirrans inhabited Mirrodin prior to the Phyrexians' arrival. Most have been wiped out, but the rest fight for their future under the strong leadership of the Vulshok Planeswalker Koth.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_162.translation: 秘罗人在非瑞克西亚人到来之前居住在秘罗地。大多数秘罗人已经被消灭了，但剩下的人在瓦许克族鹏洛客寇斯的强大领导下为他们的未来而战。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_165.oracleText: To show only cards from March of the Machine in the deckbuilder, type "set:MOM" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_165.translation: 要在套牌构组界面中只显示出自 邪军压境 系列的牌张，可在搜索栏中输入「set:MOM」。每个系列都有一个专属的三码代号。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_166.oracleText: The Invasion Tree, or Realmbreaker, was grown from the stolen essence of Kaldheim's World Tree and is the linchpin to Phyrexia's conquest of the Multiverse.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_166.translation: 移行树又称洞境树，由窃取自凯德海姆世界树的精华生长而成，在非瑞克西亚征服多元重宙中起到关键作用。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_167.oracleText: Despite being warned ahead of time, Strixhaven University's faculty were no match for the Phyrexian invaders. Meanwhile, students have been searching the Biblioplex for a fabled ancient spell...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_167.translation: 尽管事先收到警告，但斯翠海文大学的教员依然无力抵抗非瑞克西亚侵攻。同时，学生们一直在茂典阁中寻找一种传说中的古代咒语...

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_168.oracleText: Once upon a time, a host of terrible monsters came to Eldraine. While the knights of the Realm fell, the fae are cunning and wily, and the newly Phyrexianized knights need reminding...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_168.translation: 从前，一群可怕的怪物来到了艾卓。领地的骑士们被屠戮，而仙灵们却狡猾机智。那些刚刚被非瑞化的骑士们需要被提醒一番...

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_169.oracleText: Glistening oil has corrupted Ikoria's crystals, and now even more monstrously mutated monsters clash with bonders and their crystal clad companions...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_169.translation: 烁油污染了依克黎的晶石，导致更多蛮化的怪物与系绊师及其晶石外壳的旅伴们激烈对抗...

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_17.oracleText: Click a phase in either player's phase bar to set a "stop" there, letting you take an action the next time the game reaches that phase.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_17.translation: 点击双方牌手阶段栏上任一阶段便可在该处设置「暂停点」，方便你在下次游戏推进到该阶段时采取行动。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_170.oracleText: Thanks to Saheeli Rai's warnings, the people of Kaladesh have time to prepare. Now both sides race to the Aetherflux Reservoir hoping to control the flow of aether in the world...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_170.translation: 多亏了莎希莉·莱伊的警告，卡拉德许的居民才有时间来做好准备。现在，双方都争先恐后地前往以乙太流贮库，希望掌控世界中的乙太流动...

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_171.oracleText: The Invasion Tree has broken into Kaldheim and snarled around the World Tree, causing devastating doomskars. So the denizens of Kaldheim do what they do best and ride out gloriously into battle...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_171.translation: 移行树闯入了凯德海姆并缠绕在世界树周围，导致毁灭性的末日劫。因此，凯德海姆的居民做了他们最擅长的事情，壮烈地骑乘出征...

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_172.oracleText: The samurai of Kamigawa rushed to defend Towashi against Phyrexia, but were tragically converted. It's now Kamigawa's ninjas and their use of high-tech weaponry versus the Phyrexianized samurai...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_172.translation: 神河的武士们匆忙地前往都和市保卫其免受非瑞克西亚的侵袭，却遭不幸异化。现在，神河的忍者们运用高科技武器与被非瑞化的武士们展开战斗...

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_173.oracleText: Elesh Norn has dispatched Atraxa to New Capenna to cut off Halo at its source. While the Maestro vampires were quickly converted, the rest of the families have set aside their differences to fight this dark angel...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_173.translation: 艾蕾侬派遣亚崔夏前往新卡佩纳，以切断金圆源头。虽然绝艺盟的吸血鬼很快便被异化，但其他家族均已经放下成见，共同抵抗这位黑暗天使......

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_174.oracleText: Due to the nature of faith on Theros, compleation of the gods' devotees means compleation of the gods as well. Now Ephara leads the citizens of a besieged Meletis against a fully Phyrexianized plane...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_174.translation: 由于塞洛斯信仰本性，神明信徒遭到完化，即意味着神明自身也会完化。如今厄芳拉引领遭重重围攻的迈勒提斯市民们抵抗整个被非瑞化的时空...

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_175.oracleText: A Phyrexianized Nahiri has returned to Zendikar to use the Skyclaves to convert the entire plane. It's now up to Zendikar's residents, and Zendikar's Roil to stop her...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_175.translation: 遭非瑞化的纳希莉重回赞迪卡，打算利用空境转化整个时空。现在得依靠赞迪卡居民与赞迪卡狂搅来阻止她的计划...

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_178.oracleText: To show only cards from The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth in the deckbuilder, type "set:LTR" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_178.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_179.oracleText: "All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us." —Gandalf
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_179.translation: “我们需要决定的是，如何利用好上天赋予我们的时间。” —甘道夫

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_18.oracleText: Press 'CTRL' key ('CMD'key on Mac) to use Full Control for the next action, and 'SHIFT+CTRL' keys ('SHIFT+CMD' keys on Mac) to use Full Control until you turn it off.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_18.translation: 按下Ctrl键(Mac为'CMD'键)便可为下次行动时启用「完全掌控」，而按下Shift+Ctrl键(Mac为'SHIFT'+'CMD'键)便会一直启用「完全掌控」，直到你关闭为止。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_180.oracleText: "I am a servant of the Secret Fire, wielder of the flame of Anor. You cannot pass. The dark fire will not avail you, flame of Udûn. Go back to the Shadow! You cannot pass." -Gandalf
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_180.translation: “我是圣火的仆人，高举着亚尔诺炽焰，你绝不能通过。黑暗之火不会帮你的，乌顿之火。滚回黑暗中吧！你绝不能通过！” ——甘道夫

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_181.oracleText: "'He stands not alone,' said Legolas, bending his bow and fitting an arrow with hands that moved quicker than sight. 'You would die before your stroke fell.'" —Legolas, to Éomer
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_181.translation: “他并不孤单，”莱戈拉斯一边说，一边用比视线更快的手弯弓搭箭。“在你中箭倒下之前，你就会死去。” ——莱格拉斯对伊欧墨说

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_182.oracleText: ‘Faithless is he that says farewell when the road darkens,' -Gimli
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_182.translation: “信念不足的人在路变黑时道别。” ——吉姆利

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_183.oracleText: "It is useless to meet revenge with revenge: it will heal nothing." —Frodo
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_183.translation: "以牙还牙没有用，无济于事。" ——弗罗多

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_184.oracleText: "For the Quest is achieved, and now all is over. I am glad you are here with me. Here at the end of all things, Sam." —Frodo, to Sam
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_184.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_185.oracleText: "Arise now, arise, Riders of Théoden! Dire deeds awake, dark is it eastward. Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded! Forth Eorlingas!" —Théoden
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_185.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_186.oracleText: "I do not love the bright sword for its sharpness, nor the arrow for its swiftness, nor the warrior for his glory. I love only that which they defend..." —Faramir
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_186.translation: “我不喜欢亮剑的锋利，不喜欢箭的迅捷，也不喜欢勇士的荣耀，我只喜欢他们捍卫的东西……” ——法拉米尔

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_187.oracleText: "In sorrow we must go, but not in despair. Behold! we are not bound for ever to the circles of the world, and beyond them is more than memory." —Aragorn
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_187.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_188.oracleText: "For thus is it spoken: Oft hope is born, when all is forlorn." —Legolas, to Aragorn
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_188.translation: “正如俗话所说：当一切都绝望时，希望往往诞生。” ——莱戈拉斯对阿拉贡说

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_189.oracleText: Right click a card during a game to zoom in, giving you more information!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_189.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_19.oracleText: You can bluff having a spell to cast by entering Full Control ('CTRL' key, or 'CMD' key on Mac), or clicking a phase on a Phase Bar to set a stop.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_19.translation: 你可以利用「完全掌控」（按下Ctrl键，Mac为'CMD'键）或暂停点（通过点击阶段栏上的阶段来设置）来假装自己有能够施放的咒语。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_190.oracleText: Is the text on some cards too small to read? You can enable  "Fixed Rules Text Size" in the Gameplay Menu under Options to keep all card text the maximum size.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_190.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_191.oracleText: Can't place a card's alternate art? You can enable "Hide Alternate Art Styles" in the Gameplay Menu under Options to show all cards with their base art from the set.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_191.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_192.oracleText: Pressing 'QQ' will tap all your noncreatures that add mana and "float" it until you use it, or proceed to the next step or phase.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_192.translation:
本MOD并不收费，也没有提供给任何加速器进行分发。
找某宝或其他平台店家进行代氪存在"黑卡氪金/氪后数天请求退款"导致封号的风险。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_193.oracleText: You can play one land each turn, and it's generally best to do so!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_193.translation: 你每回合可以下一块地，通常最好也这样做！

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_194.oracleText: You can usually only play cards on your own turn, but instants can be played during another player's turn!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_194.translation: 您通常只能在自己的回合使用牌，但瞬间可以在其他玩家的回合中使用！

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_195.oracleText: It's a good idea to spend as much mana as you can each turn. Bigger spells are usually better!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_195.translation: 每回合消耗尽可能多的法术力是个好主意。 越大的咒语越好！

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_196.oracleText: About half of the spells in the game are creatures, and most decks center around attacking with them!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_196.translation: 游戏中大约一半的咒语是生物，大多数套牌都以用它们攻击为核心！

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_197.oracleText: Tapping means "using up" that card for the turn. You cast spells by tapping lands, and creatures tap to attack. Don't worry, you'll get to untap everything at the start of your turn!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_197.translation: 横置意味着“用完”该回合的那张牌。 你可以通过横置地来施放咒语，生物也可以横置来进行攻击。 别担心，你将在你的回合开始时重置这一切！

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_198.oracleText: Creatures can't attack the turn you cast them, but they can still block your opponent's creatures!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_198.translation: 生物在你施放它们的回合无法攻击，但它们仍然可以阻挡你对手的生物！

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_199.oracleText: There are five basic lands that each tap to add one mana of the five colors of Magic: White, Blue, Black, Red, and Green.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_199.translation: 一共有五种基本地，横置它们可以分别添加对应万智牌五种颜色中的一种法术力：白色、蓝色、黑色、红色和绿色。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_2.oracleText: To tap specific lands to cast a spell, tap them before starting to cast your spell.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_2.translation: 若要横置特定的地来施放咒语，请在开始施放咒语前先行横置之。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_20.oracleText: You can bluff not having a spell to cast by quickly passing or clicking End Turn.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_20.translation: 你可以快速让过（按下空格键）或自动让过回合（点击「结束回合」）来假装自己没有能够施放的咒语。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_200.oracleText: MTG Arena lets you play Magic: The Gathering wherever you are, but you can also play at your local game store with paper cards!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_200.translation: 万智牌：竞技场让你随时随地畅玩万智牌，同时你也可以在本地牌店使用实体卡牌进行对战！

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_201.oracleText: Lands are cards you simply play. Spells are cards you cast using mana from tapping those lands, and can be responded to!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_201.translation: 地是你只需打出的牌。 咒语是你使用横置这些地产生的法术力施放的牌，并且可以得到回应！

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_202.oracleText: To show only cards from Wilds of Eldraine in the deckbuilder, type "set:WOE" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_202.translation: 想让组牌器只显示艾卓仙踪的卡，在搜索栏输入 "set:WOE" 。每个系列有一个独有的3字缩写。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_203.oracleText: Hylda is an exacting and dispassionate woman who could bury Eldraine in snow and ice with her crown of weather manipulation. But she mostly just wants to be left alone in her self-imposed isolation.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_203.translation: 希尔妲是一位严谨而冷静的女人，她可以用她能操纵天气的王冠将艾卓埋葬在冰雪之中。 但她大多时候只想一个人与世隔绝。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_204.oracleText: The Kindly Lord Talion, ruler and progenitor of the race of fae, unleashed a terrible sleeping curse upon Eldraine to defeat the Phyrexians. Even their daughter Obyra is fast asleep, but just as deadly, and just as kind.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_204.translation: 仁慈的塔莱恩领主，仙灵种族的统治者和祖先，向艾卓释放了可怕的沉睡诅咒以击败非瑞克西亚人。 就连他们的女儿欧拜拉也在熟睡，同样致命，也同样善良。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_205.oracleText: Totentanz never made much coin playing songs on his carved pipe. But after making a dark deal with the demonic rat Lord Skitter, he's been granted eerie and wonderous powers for his second verse.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_205.translation: 托腾坦用他的雕花乐笛演奏歌曲从来没有赚到多少钱。 但在与恶魔老鼠捷敏王达成黑暗交易后，他的第二段歌被授予了怪异而奇妙的力量。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_206.oracleText: Ruby is a tough, street-smart girl who lives on the outskirts of the dangerous Wilds. But when her brother is kidnapped and ensorcelled, she has no choice but to take on the red mantle of his rescuer.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_206.translation: 小红玉是一个坚强、聪明的女孩，住在危险的荒野郊区。 但当她的哥哥被绑架并被迷惑时，她别无选择，只能披上拯救他的红色斗篷。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_207.oracleText: Syr Armont is known throughout the Realm for her beauty and devotion to Ardenvale. When she stumbles upon Redtooth Keep and the cursed elves within, she vows to outfox the terrible enchantment that transforms them into beasts.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_207.translation: 希尔·娅蒙因其美丽和对雅登瓦的奉献而闻名于整个王国。 当她偶然发现红牙要塞和里面被诅咒的精灵时，她发誓要智胜将他们变成野兽的可怕结界。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_208.oracleText: Once just a nervous village boy with a knack for elementary cantrips, Johann was chosen to be an apprentice to the sorcerer of Caervelin. But now with his master asleep, he is desperate to find a way to undo the elemental chaos he has inadvertently caused.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_208.translation: 约翰曾经只是一个胆怯的乡村男孩，擅长初级法术，后来被选为卡尔维林魔法师的学徒。 但现在他的老师睡着了，他迫切希望找到一种方法来消除他无意中造成的元素混乱。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_209.oracleText: Eriette was gifted an apple that caused anybody who tasted it to fall in love with her, but she always dreamed a bit bigger. Now sleepwalkers and dreamers do her bidding, all while the mind of Neva, a girl interred in a glass coffin, wanders the realm of dreams.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_209.translation: 艾纶缇收到了一个苹果，任何尝过它的人都会爱上她，但她的梦想总是更大。 现在，梦游者和做梦者都听从她的命令，而埋葬在玻璃棺里的女孩涅娃的心灵却在梦境中徘徊。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_21.oracleText: You can change the art used to represent your deck by dragging a card onto the deck image during deckbuilding.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_21.translation: 在构筑套牌时，你可以将牌张拖到套牌图像上，以更改用来代表你套牌的图案。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_210.oracleText: Years ago, siblings Hanlon and Greta wandered into Sweettooth Village and were attacked by sinister living candy. Unlike Hanlon, Greta was able to escape with her life. Now she returns as a witch hunter to exact sweet justice upon those who robbed her of her brother.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_210.translation: 几年前，汉隆和格蕾特兄妹误入甘饴村，遭到邪恶的活体糖果的袭击。 与汉隆不同的是，格蕾特活着逃了出去。 现在，她以猎巫人的身份回归，对那些夺走她哥哥的人施以正义。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_211.oracleText: Ash always wanted to attend the Grand Ball in the dwarven halls of Delverhaugh, but her parents forbade it. Unbeknownst to them, she dons a disguise and sneaks into the ball. Unbeknownst to her, she falls in love with a mysterious stranger and is forced to flee leaving her helmet behind...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_211.translation: 灰钴娘一直想参加在德尔弗豪矮人大厅举行的盛大舞会，但她的父母不允许。 他们不知道的是，她乔装打扮，溜进了舞会。 她不知道的是，她爱上了一个神秘的陌生人，并被迫留下头盔逃离……

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_212.oracleText: Troyan is a vedalken from Ravnica who once paid allegiance to the Izzet League. After discovering an Omenpath leading to Eldraine, he's managed to climb the Everstalks to hijack as much treasure from Stormkeld as he can before the cloud giants find him.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_212.translation: 特洛扬是来自拉尼卡的维多肯人，曾效忠伊捷联盟。 在发现一条通往艾卓的预兆之路后，他成功地攀登了永恒之茎，在云巨人找到他之前从风暴凯尔德那里劫持了尽可能多的宝藏。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_213.oracleText: To show only cards from The Lost Caverns of Ixalan in the deckbuilder, type "set:LCI" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_213.translation: 想让组牌器只显示依夏兰迷窟中的卡，请在搜索栏中输入"set:LCI"。 每个系列有一个独有的3字缩写。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_214.oracleText: The Sun Empire is a proud and ancient imperial power that dominates the coastal territories of Ixalan. Orazca, the Golden City, was claimed but later became a city of death, due to Phyrexian sleeper agents awakening behind sealed doors. During the slaughter, a team of soldiers fighting to clear out a nest of Phyrexians discover a grand, ancient door beneath the earth...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_214.translation: 烈阳帝国是一个骄傲而古老的帝国势力，统治着依夏兰沿海地区。 黄金之城欧拉兹卡曾被占领，但后来由于非瑞克西亚潜探在密封的门后苏醒而成为一座死亡之城。 在屠杀过程中，一队士兵在奋力清除非瑞克西亚人的巢穴时，发现了地底下有一扇宏伟而古老的大门……

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_215.oracleText: The Legion of Dusk is the military arm of Alta Torrezon, the ecclesiastic kingdom of vampires on the continent of Torrezon. The Queen's Bay Company was created to liberate Ixalan of its resources, but these vampires also feel the tugging of their progenitor god, calling to them beneath the earth...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_215.translation: 暮影军团是托雷宗大陆上的吸血鬼教会王国阿尔塔托雷宗的军队。女王湾连队的成立是为了解放依夏兰的资源，但这些吸血鬼也感受到了他们的始祖神的牵引，神在地下召唤着他们……

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_216.oracleText: The Brazen Coalition is a confederacy of ships, with each captain a sovereign of the state contained within their vessel's decks. From the floating city of High and Dry, Governor Beckett Brass may have declared the age of piracy to be "over" but new riches are being discovered beneath the earth...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_216.translation: 莽霸联盟是一个由船组成的联盟，每位船长都是其船只甲板上的领导人。 贝克蒂霸司总督可能已经在漂浮的高地之城宣布海盗的时代“结束”了，但新的财富正在地下被发现……

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_217.oracleText: The River Heralds are nomadic bands of merfolk that live in harmony with the natural world. They once unified to defend Orazca, but ultimately failed, and were hit hard by the Phyrexian Invasion. They have now migrated underground only to discover a freshwater ocean, untouched and unspoiled beneath the earth...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_217.translation: 川流使是与自然世界和谐相处的游牧人鱼群体。 他们曾经联合起来保卫欧拉兹卡，但最终失败，并遭到非瑞克西亚入侵的重创。他们现在迁徙到地下，只是为了发现地底下一片未被接触、未受污染的内陆海洋……

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_218.oracleText: Quintorius Kand, or Quint, is a Planeswalker from the world of Arcavios and has been ranging throughout the Multiverse for Lorehold. He teams up with Huatli on the Sun Empire's expedition to the Core and harnesses his ability to bring history to life by summoning the spirits of legends to aid them.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_218.translation: 昆托力康德，或者昆特，是一位来自阿凯维沃世界的鹏洛客，一直在为衡鉴而游历多元宇宙。 他与华特莉联手进行烈阳帝国对核心的远征，并利用自己的能力召唤传说中的灵魂来帮助他们，让历史栩栩如生。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_219.oracleText: Huatli is the Warrior-Poet of the Sun Empire. While she was victorious in leading the defense against the Phyrexian Invasion thanks to Saheeli's warnings, it came at great cost. With her companion dinosaurs corrupted and her spark quieted, she now looks for the future of the Empire buried somewhere in its ancient past.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_219.translation: 华特莉是烈阳帝国的战士诗人。 虽然由于莎希莉的警告，她在领导防御非瑞克西亚入侵方面取得了胜利，但她也付出了巨大的代价。 随着她的恐龙同伴被腐化，她的火花也熄灭了，她现在寻找埋藏在其古老过去某个地方的帝国的未来。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_22.oracleText: In best-of-one matches, your starting hand is selected from two random hands, leaning towards the one with the more average land-spell mix.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_22.translation: 在一盘定胜负的对局中，游戏会从两份随机手牌中挑选地牌与咒语牌分布更为平均的一份作为你的起手牌。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_220.oracleText: The Deep Gods are Chimil's children who walk among the Oltec, and once helped shatter the shell that once contained their mother. The chief deity of the Oltec is Ojer Taq, and all the Deep Gods have temples dedicated to them in the Core, though Aclazotz's places of worship are rather hidden.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_220.translation: 深邃尊神是奇密理的孩子，他们行走在欧尔特人之中，曾经帮助粉碎了过去容纳他们母亲的外壳。 欧尔特人的主神是塔克尊神，所有深邃尊神在核心都有供奉他们的神庙，尽管阿洛佐兹的礼拜场所相当隐蔽。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_221.oracleText: Chimil is the star at the center of Ixalan's Core, revered by the Oltec. From her comes Cosmium, which is highly sought after for its practical and fantastic applications. Cosmium magic resembles solar flares and magnetic field patterns.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_221.translation: 奇密理是依夏兰核心中心的恒星，受到欧尔特人的崇敬。 她带来了宇金，因其实用和奇妙的应用而备受追捧。 宇金魔法类似于太阳耀斑和模仿磁场。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_222.oracleText: Echoes are ancestor spirits strongly associated with a focus, an item that was important to them in life. Abuelo is an Oltec Echo of a warrior from centuries past. His memory is patchy due to his lonely death long ago, far from home.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_222.translation: 念世灵是与中心密切相关的祖先灵魂，中心对他们的生活很重要。 阿布罗是几个世纪前的欧尔特念世战士。 由于他很久以前在远离家乡的地方孤独死去，他的记忆变得支离破碎。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_223.oracleText: The Mycotyrant is the gestalt leader of the mycoids, a race of virulent fungus. The primary way this single entity learns is via consumption, digestion, and replication. It only has two overriding motivations: to consume and expand.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_223.translation: 智蕈暴君是一种剧毒真菌的完形领袖。 该单一实体学习的主要方式是通过进食、消化和复制。 它只有两个最重要的动机：吞噬和扩张。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_224.oracleText: To show only cards from Murder at Karlov Manor in the deckbuilder, type "set:MKM" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_224.translation: 想让组牌器只显示卡洛夫庄园谋杀案的卡，在搜索栏输入 "set:MKM" 或者 "e:MKM" 。每个系列有一个独有的3字缩写。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_225.oracleText: The Azorius Senate is responsible for establishing, refining, and enforcing the extensive legal code by which all of Ravnica abides.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_225.translation: 俄佐立元老院负责制定、完善和执行全拉尼卡都要遵守的全面法律规范。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_226.oracleText: Behind the facade of religious hierarchy, the Orzhov Syndicate is at heart an organized crime ring with connections to every business across the plane.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_226.translation: 在宗教等级制度的表象背后，欧佐夫集团本质上是一个有组织的犯罪团伙，与整个位面的每一个企业都有联系。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_227.oracleText: The spies and secretkeepers of the Dimir once ran the information trade in Ravnica. Since the Phyrexian invasion, they have retreated into the shadows--some even claim they don't exist any more.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_227.translation: 底密尔的间谍和保密人曾经在拉尼卡经营信息贸易。 自从非瑞克西亚入侵后，他们就隐退到了阴影之中——有些人甚至声称他们已经不存在了。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_228.oracleText: Many of the best decks don't go over the recommended card limit. Very rarely do you need over 40 cards in your deck for Limited formats or over 60 cards in Constructed formats.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_228.translation: 大多数优秀的套牌都不会超过推荐的牌张数量上限。在限制赛制中很少需要超过40张牌，在构筑赛制中也很少需要超过60张牌。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_229.oracleText: The Cult of Rakdos are entertainers, satirists, and circus acrobats who revel in unrestrained hedonism; often to the point of risking their lives. They regularly mock and undermine the other guilds, whom they believe take themselves too seriously.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_229.translation: 拉铎司教派是一群陶醉于无拘无束的享乐主义的艺人、讽刺作家和马戏杂技演员；往往到了冒着生命危险的程度。 他们经常嘲笑和损害其他公会，因为他们认为其他公会把自己看得太重了。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_23.oracleText: Players with "Mythic Orange" names are MTG Arena team members.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_23.translation: 名称以秘稀橙颜色显示的牌手是MTGA团队成员。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_230.oracleText: Originally functioning as the agricultural and waste reclamation sector, the Golgari are a pragmatic guild who are unafraid of the concept that death is a reality of life. They served as the Phyrexia Invasions' first converts, and have been treated poorly by the other guilds ever since rebuilding has begun.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_230.translation: 葛加理最初的职能是农业和废物回收部门，他们是一个务实的行会，不惧怕死亡是生命的现实这一概念。 同时也是非瑞克西亚入侵时的第一批皈依者，自从重建开始以来他们一直受到其他公会的恶劣对待。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_231.oracleText: The Gruul Clans are a loose affiliation of clans that make their homes in Ravnica's alleyways and ruins. They hold the most anti-civilization views of all of Ravnica's guild, viewing civilization as something for the weak.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_231.translation: 古鲁部族是一个松散的氏族联盟，他们在拉尼卡的小巷和废墟中安家。 他们是拉尼卡公会中最反文明的人，认为文明是弱者的东西。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_232.oracleText: The Boros Legion is a military that combines the force of law with strength of arms to forge Ravnica into a just society, a safe and healthy community for all.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_232.translation: 波洛斯教团是一支将法律与武力相结合的军队，旨在将拉尼卡打造成一个公正的社会，一个所有人都安全健康的社区。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_233.oracleText: The Selesnya Conclave is part commune, part naturalistic church, and are united by the will of the Worldsoul. They dream of embracing all of Ravnica in a harmonious union of nature and civilization.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_233.translation: 瑟雷尼亚盟会一半是公社，一半是自然主义教会，并通过言灵的意志联合起来。 他们梦想着将整个拉尼卡融入自然与文明的和谐统一之中。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_234.oracleText: The Simic Combine is Ravnica's steward of nature and the wild; the guild uses magic to coax new morphologies from existing creatures, as well as to combine traits from multiple organisms in one.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_234.translation: 析米克联合体是拉尼卡自然与荒野的管理者； 该公会使用魔法从现有生物中诱导出新的形态，并将多种生物的特征结合到一个生物上。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_235_OTJ_SetCod.oracleText: To show only cards from Outlaws of Thunder Junction in the deckbuilder, type "set:OTJ" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_235_OTJ_SetCod.translation: 想让组牌器只显示光雷驿镖客的卡，在搜索栏输入 "set:OTJ"  。每个系列有一个独有的3字缩写。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_236_OTJ_Freest.oracleText: The Freestriders are vigilantes who do what they believe is right, regardless of what the law says. They live a nomadic lifestyle, riding wherever the wind takes them and helping the disenfranchised along the way.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_236_OTJ_Freest.translation: 畅行帮是义务警员，他们做自己认为正确的事情，无论法律如何规定。 他们过着游牧的生活方式，随风而行，并帮助沿途的弱势群体。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_237_OTJ_Outcas.oracleText: The Outcasters are survivalists, adhering only to the laws of nature. Whether exploring unmapped territory or conducting natural experiments, so long as you don't bother them, they won't bother you.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_237_OTJ_Outcas.translation: 莽野帮是生存主义者，只遵守自然法则。 无论是探索未知领域还是进行自然实验，只要你不打扰他们，他们就不会打扰你。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_238_OTJ_Slicks.oracleText: What good is skill without style? No good at all, according to the Slickshots. Every duel is an opportunity for pageantry, and every con is a shot at fame. Wherever they go, they'll be sure to make it the ride of a lifetime.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_238_OTJ_Slicks.translation: 没有风格，技巧有什么用呢？ 根据花枪帮的说法，一点也不好。 每一次决斗都是一次炫耀的机会，每一次骗局都是一次成名的机会。 无论他们去哪里，都一定会成为其一生难忘的经历。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_239_OTJ_Sterli.oracleText: The Sterling Company believes that money and political hierarchy is the best way to bring order to the chaos of Thunder Junction. Anyone who doesn't conform to this belief is met with banishment.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_239_OTJ_Sterli.translation: 银光社相信金钱和政治等级制度是给混乱的光雷驿带来秩序的最佳方式。 任何不遵守这一信念的人都会遭到放逐。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_240_OTJ_Hellsp.oracleText: The Hellspurs are the most hard-boiled and violent bandits of them all. They integrate the natural magic of the land directly into their bodies, turning themselves into villains that can perform cruel feats of legend.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_240_OTJ_Hellsp.translation: 炼刺帮是所有强盗中最冷酷、最暴力的。 他们将大地的自然魔法直接融入到自己的身体中，将自己变成了能够做出传说中残酷壮举的恶棍。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_241_OTJ_Oko.oracleText: Oko is "The Face" of his crew, using his charisma and charm to recruit others to his side and advance his dastardly plans. But who could his mysterious benefactor be? Only time will tell...
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_241_OTJ_Oko.translation: 瓯柯是他的团伙的“脸面”，利用他的个人魅力招募其他人加入他的阵营并推进他的卑鄙计划。 但他的神秘赞助人会是谁呢？ 只有时间会给出答案...

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_242_OTJ_Vraska.oracleText: Vraska is "The Blade" of Oko's crew, using her powers of assassination to further their cause and remove any obstacles in their path. But she may be hiding ulterior motives in reaching the storied vault, Maag-Taranau.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_242_OTJ_Vraska.translation: 瓦丝卡是瓯柯团伙的“刀锋”，她利用她的暗杀技能来推进他们的事业并清除他们前进道路上的任何障碍。 但她想去传奇金库Maag-Taranau的背后可能隐藏着不可告人的动机。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_243_OTJ_Annie.oracleText: Annie Flash was recruited by Oko due to her knowledge of the Hellspurs. She just needs to finish this one last job before retirement.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_243_OTJ_Annie.translation: 电闪安妮因其对炼刺帮的了解而被瓯柯招募。 她在退休前只需要完成这最后一份工作。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_244_OTJ_TinyBo.oracleText: Originally from Urborg on Dominaria, Tinybones is "The Thief" of Oko's crew. He's able to take his skeleton apart and piece himself back together, allowing him to break into anywhere and take anything he desires.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_244_OTJ_TinyBo.translation: 细骨来自多明纳里亚的乌尔博格，是瓯柯团伙中的“盗贼”。 他能够把自己的骨架拆开，然后将自己重新组装起来，这让他能够闯入任何地方并拿走任何他想要的东西。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_245_OTJ_Rakdo.oracleText: Normally a guildmaster on Ravnica, the demon Rakdos has taken a holiday to the plane of Thunder Junction to wreak as much havoc as possible. His joy at pure chaos and destruction makes him the perfect "Muscle" of the group.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_245_OTJ_Rakdo.translation: 恶魔拉铎司通常是拉尼卡的公会会长，但他却在光雷驿时空休假，以尽可能地造成破坏。 他对纯粹的混乱和破坏的喜悦使他成为团伙中完美的“帮凶”。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_246_BLB_SetCod.oracleText: To show only cards from Bloomburrow in the deckbuilder, type "set:BLB" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_246_BLB_SetCod.translation: 想让组牌器只显示班隆洛的卡，在搜索栏输入 "set:BLB" 。每个系列有一个独有的3字缩写。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_247_BLB_Birdfo.oracleText: Birdfolk of Valley make their homes in the skies, helping to connect all the other animalfolk by transporting mail, aid, and sometimes even the other animals!
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_247_BLB_Birdfo.translation: 苍茂谷的鸟民在空中筑巢，他们通过运送邮件和援助物资，有时甚至运送其他动物，来帮助其他动物民相互沟通。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_248_BLB_Ratfol.oracleText: Ratfolk are self-reliant loners who value building their own skills over interpersonal relationships. Many others in Valley view them as standoffish, but they see themselves as keeping all the animalfolks secrets' from falling into the wrong hands.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_248_BLB_Ratfol.translation: 老鼠民是自力更生的独行侠，相对于人际关系，他们更重视培养一技之长。苍茂谷的许多其他动物认为他们太过冷漠，但他们却认为自己是在保护动物民的秘密不落恶人之手。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_249_BLB_Lizard.oracleText: Lizardfolk of Valley are passionate artists who know that art is meant to inspire awe and wonder. As soon as they feel bored by their art, they will destroy it and use the pieces to create something new.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_249_BLB_Lizard.translation: 苍茂谷的蜥蜴民都是充满激情的艺术家，他们深知艺术就是让人敬畏和惊叹。一旦他们对自己的艺术感到厌倦，就会将其摧毁，再将碎片创作成新的作品。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_25.oracleText: If you don't like your opening hand, you can "mulligan": drawing a new opening hand with one fewer card.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_25.translation: 如果你不喜欢你的起手牌，你可以选择「再调度」：重抓一副新的起手牌，但张数会比之前少一张。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_250_BLB_Raccon.oracleText: Racoonfolk are wanderers, allowing their whims and desire for self-discovery to take them on adventures all over Valley. Though they don't tend to make stable homes, they keep mementos from all their travels with them so they can reminisce.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_250_BLB_Raccon.translation: 浣熊民是流浪者，他们随心所欲，渴望自我发现，因此他们会在苍茂谷四处冒险。虽然他们不倾向于安家，但他们会保留所有旅行的纪念品，以便日后回忆。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_251_BLB_Rabbit.oracleText: Rabbitfolk are industrious farmers and talented chefs, providing Valley with the bulk of its food. Even if other animalfolk view them as ‘boring' for their stable lives, the Rabbitfolk are treated with respect for all the hard work they do.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_251_BLB_Rabbit.translation: 兔民是勤劳的农民和天生的厨师，为苍茂谷提供了大部分食物。尽管其他动物民认为他们过着“无聊”的稳定生活，但兔民用辛勤的劳动赢得了大家的尊重。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_252_BLB_Batfol.oracleText: Batfolk of Valley live their lives within rigid hierarchies, concerning themselves with balance on a cosmic scale. Being nocturnal, they also view themselves as the protectors of Valley during nighttime when other animalfolk rest.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_252_BLB_Batfol.translation: 苍茂谷的蝙蝠民生活在严格的阶级制度中，关注其在宇宙范围内的平衡。作为夜行动物，他们觉得自己是夜间其他动物民休息时的苍茂谷守护神。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_253_BLB_Otterf.oracleText: Otterfolk are playful, curious, and excitable storm-chasers. When not out adventuring and chasing down calamity beasts, their most popular game is Otterball, a sport that's played largely on the water and whose exact rules are always changing.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_253_BLB_Otterf.translation: 水獭民是爱玩、好奇且充满激情的风暴追逐者。当他们不用外出冒险和追逐灾兽时，最喜欢玩的游戏是獭球，这项运动主要在水上进行，但确切规则却一直在变化。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_254_BLB_Squirr.oracleText: Squirrelfolk are the pragmatic stewards of Valley's cycles of life and death. They take on the role of burying calamity beast remains, rejuvenating farmed soil, and preserving food for when harsh seasonal changes strike.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_254_BLB_Squirr.translation: 松鼠民是苍茂谷生死循环的务实管家。他们负责掩埋灾兽的遗骸，恢复耕地的肥力，并在严酷的季节变化来袭时储备食物。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_255_BLB_Mousef.oracleText: Mousefolk are known for their heroic actions and glorious adventuring parties. They carry a deep sense of familial pride, and do not shy away from danger, even if others may view their actions as unnecessarily risky or impulsive.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_255_BLB_Mousef.translation: 家鼠民以其勇行和辉煌的冒险团队而闻名。他们有着强烈的家族自豪感，即使其他人认为他们的行为过于冒险或冲动，他们也绝不会临危退缩。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_256_BLB_Frogfo.oracleText: Frogfolk of Valley are augurs, using their alignment with nature to divine the shifts in seasons and predict the movements of Calamity Beasts. This can lead them towards dramatic proclamations of doom, but it never prevents them from using their skills to help keep Valley and other animals safe.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_256_BLB_Frogfo.translation: 苍茂谷的蛙民是卜算师，他们利用与自然的联系来预测季节变化和灾兽的动向。虽然这为他们显现出了悲观的末日预言，但也绝不会动摇他们运用自身能力来保护苍茂谷和其他动物的决心。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_257_DSK_SetCod.oracleText: To show only cards from Duskmourn in the deckbuilder, type "set:DSK" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_257_DSK_SetCod.translation: 要在组牌器中只显示出自暮悲邸系列的牌张，可在搜索栏中输入「set:DSK」。每个系列都有一个专属的三码代号。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_258_DSK_Mutemo.oracleText: Rooms in the Mutemoors are vast and echoing, lined with marble statues and white drapes that billow without wind. They typically make up the Attics, Foyers, Patios, or Chapels of the House.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_258_DSK_Mutemo.translation: 雾原中的房间宽广而回声萦绕，四周装饰着大理石雕像和无风也会飘动的白色帷幔。它们通常构成了宅邸的阁楼、大厅、露台或礼拜堂。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_259_DSK_Floodp.oracleText: Rooms in the Floodpits are filled with physics-defying juxtapositions. Water will hang from the ceiling or soak into the floors in libraries and meat lockers, making inconspicuous portals for glitch ghosts.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_259_DSK_Floodp.translation: 洪坑中的房间充满了违背物理法则的反差现象。水会悬挂在天花板上，或渗入图书馆和肉类储藏室的地板中，形成不起眼的入口，供花斑鬼魂穿行。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_26.oracleText: If you're able to cast a spell without paying its mana cost, and there's an X in that cost, X must be zero.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_26.translation: 如果你能以不需支付法术力费用的方式来施放某咒语，且该咒语费用中有X，则X只能是0。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_260_DSK_Balemu.oracleText: It's said that the path to Valgavoth's lair is somewhere in the Balemurk, but it's nearly impossible to find through all the rotting floorboards and shifting shadows. Basements, bedrooms, crypts, and catacombs are all places within the Balemurk's septic domain.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_260_DSK_Balemu.translation: 据说通往瓦伽沃巢穴的道路位于灾沼的某处，但由于腐烂的地板和变幻的阴影，几乎难以找到。地下室、卧室、墓穴和陵墓都是灾沼这一腐败领域中的场所。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_261_DSK_Boiler.oracleText: The Boilerbilges have some of the most treacherous terrain the House, full of suffocating heat, jagged drops, and vents of fire. Kitchens, furnace rooms, and dining rooms are all prone to destructive earthquakes and eruptions of fire in the Boilerbilges.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_261_DSK_Boiler.translation: 沸角拥有宅邸中最危险的地形，充满令人窒息的高温、陡峭的落差和喷射的火焰。厨房、熔炉室和餐厅在沸角中都容易遭受破坏性的地震和火焰喷发。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_262_DSK_Hauntw.oracleText: The line between interior and exterior blends most in the Hauntwoods. Vegetation invades gyms, greenhouses, and conservatories, choking the structure of the house with twisting hedges, fog, and overgrown plants.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_262_DSK_Hauntw.translation: 在凶林中，内外的界限最为模糊。植物侵入了健身房、温室和音乐厅，扭曲的树篱、浓雾和疯长的植物侵蚀了宅邸的结构。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_263_DSK_Valgav.oracleText: Deep within the House is an underground chamber where the demon Valgavoth resides. From there he weaves his way throughout the rest of the House, tormenting survivors and plotting how to extend his reaches into the rest of the Multiverse.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_263_DSK_Valgav.translation: 在宅邸的深处，有一个地下密室，恶魔瓦伽沃就栖息在那里。他从那里暗中游走于宅邸的各个角落，折磨求生者，并设谋将他的触手延伸至整个多重宇宙。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_264_DSK_Harrow.oracleText: A Harrowing in the House occurs when the demon Valgavoth molts into a new body. This molting causes a surge of malevolence that creates a heightened bloodlust and paranoia in the various entities in the House.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_264_DSK_Harrow.translation: 当恶魔瓦伽沃蜕变为新的躯体时，宅邸内便会进入搅魂期。这次蜕变会引发一股强烈的恶意，使宅邸中的各种存在变得更加嗜血和偏执。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_265_DSK_HowToS.oracleText: In order to stay alive, survivors on Duskmourn will rig together tools to protect them. These can be anything from improvised weaponry to devices that help monitor activity in the house. Despite these tools, survivors are often left with nothing but their wits to protect them.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_265_DSK_HowToS.translation: 为了活下去，暮悲邸中的求生者会拼凑出各种工具来保护自己。这些工具可以是简易武器，也可以是帮助监测宅邸内活动的装置。尽管有这些工具，求生者通常还是只能依靠智慧来保护自己。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_266_DSK_CultOf.oracleText: The Cult of Valgavoth is a group of fanatics that promote Valgavoth's glory and tend to the House. Enough time in the cult hollows them out of all emotion, leaving them empty husks that desire only to feed the House.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_266_DSK_CultOf.translation: 瓦伽沃教团是一群狂热的信徒，他们宣扬瓦伽沃的荣耀并照料宅邸。长时间待在教团中会使他们情感尽失，最终变成只渴望供宅邸进食的空壳。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_267_DSK_Glimme.oracleText: Glimmers are physical manifestations of the survivor's hope and will to live. They protect survivors from succumbing to the House, even if the Glimmer and their survivor get separated.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_267_DSK_Glimme.translation: 烁光体是求生者希望与生存意志的实体具现。即使烁光体与它们的求生者分离，它们仍能保护求生者不屈服于宅邸。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_268.oracleText: If something seems weird or wrong with your game, try going to Options -> Report Bug and run Repair Game Files
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_268.translation: 如果你的游戏出现了奇怪的错误，请尝试点击选项 - 联系客服 - 运行修复游戏文件

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_269_DFT_SetCod.oracleText: To show only cards from Aetherdrift in the deckbuilder, type "set:DFT" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_269_DFT_SetCod.translation: 要在组牌器中只显示出自乙太飘移系列的牌张，可在搜索栏中输入「set:DFT」。每个系列都有一个专属的三码代号。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_27.oracleText: Your creatures can attack your opponent or their planeswalkers. When you click a creature to attack with it, click the planeswalker or the opponent to decide what they're attacking.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_27.translation: 你的生物可以攻击对手或对手的鹏洛客。在利用生物攻击时，先点击生物，然后再点击要让其攻击的鹏洛客或对手。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_270_DFT_Tirele.oracleText: The Tireless Wanderers are a group of automatons animated by a central brain. Once they slot into their machines, they exhibit perfect control over their entire racing system, from the wheels to the attached weapons.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_270_DFT_Tirele.translation: 不休漫游怪是一群由中央大脑驱动的机械兽。一旦它们进入自己的机器，就能完美操控整个赛车系统，从车轮到贴附的武器。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_271_DFT_SpeedD.oracleText: Hailing from the haunted plane of Duskmourn, the Speed Demons use ghosts, revenants, and nightmares as fuel. They also use other racers—possessing and dragging enemy vehicles into their engines to be consumed.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_271_DFT_SpeedD.translation: 来自于闹鬼时空暮悲邸的迅疾魔队，以幽灵、亡魂和梦魇为燃料。他们还利用其他赛手——附身并将敌方车辆拖入他们的引擎中消耗。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_272_DFT_Endrid.oracleText: Hailing from an unknown plane, the Endriders are hardened raiders, ready to do whatever it takes to win. Their vehicles are equipped with tools to catch other cars, crude explosives, or channels for their unique wasteland magic.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_272_DFT_Endrid.translation: 来自未知时空的送终士队是坚韧的掠夺者，准备不惜一切代价赢得胜利。他们的车辆配备了捕捉其他车辆的工具、简陋的爆炸物，或是用于施展其独特荒原魔法的通道。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_273_DFT_Rocket.oracleText: Most would be scared of Goblin rocketeering, but not the Rocketeers! These Goblins believe in using their elegant and explosive science to get their vehicles to go as high, fast, and far as possible.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_273_DFT_Rocket.translation: 大多数人会害怕鬼怪的火箭技术，但窜天鬼队可不怕！这些鬼怪相信通过使用他们优雅而爆炸性的科学技术，可以让他们的车辆飞得更高、更快、更远。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_274_DFT_Alacri.oracleText: Fueled by a diet of aether, Quickbeasts are capable of shockingly quick movement, and are able to carry their riders across treacherous terrain for days at a time without rest. Their speed is how they protect themselves—that, and magically enhanced armor and weapons.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_274_DFT_Alacri.translation: 以乙太为食的捷兽能够进行惊人的快速移动，在险恶的地形上连续数天不休息地载着骑手前行。它们的速度是自我保护的方式——此外，还有魔法强化的护甲和武器。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_275_DFT_Champi.oracleText: The people of Amonkhet are still in the process of rebuilding their plane, but that doesn't mean they can't leave time for an interplanar death race! They've re-animated the legendary charioteer Ramose to be their champion, and he rides to win glory for New Amonkhet.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_275_DFT_Champi.translation: 阿芒凯的人民仍在重建他们的时空，但这并不意味着他们不能抽出时间来进行一场跨时空的死亡竞赛！他们复活了传奇的战车手拉摩斯作为他们的豪杰，他骑乘战车为新阿芒凯赢得荣耀。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_276_DFT_Speedb.oracleText: The Speedbrood have formed symbiotic relationships with their vehicles, allowing them greater control when racing. The most honored members shed their exoskeletons in a metamorphic process to become the vehicles used by other members of the team.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_276_DFT_Speedb.translation: 极速虫队与他们的车辆形成了共生关系，使他们在比赛时具有更强的操控能力。最受尊敬的成员通过变形过程脱去外骨骼，成为队伍中其他成员使用的车辆。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_277_DFT_Aether.oracleText: The Aether Rangers are light and strong, building their vehicles to fly above the fray. As Avishkar's unofficial flagship team, their loss at the Grand Prix last year has only inspired them to try even harder.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_277_DFT_Aether.translation: 乙太流浪者队轻盈而强壮，他们打造的飞行器能够在战场之上翱翔。作为阿维什卡的非官方旗舰队，他们在去年大奖赛的失利只会激励他们更加努力。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_278_DFT_Chorda.oracleText: The Keelhaulers are rowdy, hardy, and prefer stripped-down vehicles to overly complicated mechanics. They've brought their most cutthroat corsairs to the Grand Prix, and are eager to carve out a name for themselves and win some sweet aether.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_278_DFT_Chorda.translation: 沧海盗队粗犷坚韧，偏爱简约的车辆而非过于复杂的机械。他们带来了最凶狠的海盗参加大奖赛，渴望为自己赢得名声并获取丰厚的乙太。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_279_DFT_Clouds.oracleText: The Cloudspire Racing Team are the high-speed, low-drag winners of last year's Ghirapur Grand Prix. With their professionalism and star personalities, they're favored to win again this year. They also have a new leader—Chandra Nalaar.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_279_DFT_Clouds.translation: 鼎云侠队是去年吉拉波大奖赛的高速低阻冠军。凭借他们的专业精神和明星风采，今年再次成为夺冠热门。他们还有一位新领袖——茜卓纳拉。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_28.oracleText: Spells that deal damage to "any target" can target planeswalkers and reduce their loyalty just as easily as they damage a creature or player.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_28.translation: 能对「任意一个目标」造成伤害的咒语可以指定鹏洛客为目标。这样会降低鹏洛客的忠诚度，跟对生物和牌手造成伤害类似。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_280_TDM_SetCod.oracleText: To show only cards from Tarkir: Dragonstorm in the deckbuilder, type "set:TDM" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_280_TDM_SetCod.translation: 要在组牌器中只显示出自鞑契龙岚录系列的牌张，可在搜索栏中输入「set:TDM」。每个系列都有一个专属的三码代号。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_281_TDM_Abzan.oracleText: The Abzan are stalwart warriors who have strong familial bonds that allow them to summon their ancestors' spirits to defend, empower, and guide them.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_281_TDM_Abzan.translation: 阿布赞人是坚毅的战士，他们拥有强大的家族纽带，能够召唤祖灵为他们提供庇护、力量和指引。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_282_TDM_Jeskai.oracleText: The Jeskai are led by monk practitioners who study the Way. They seek unity of thought and consider it their duty to guide Tarkir into a better future.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_282_TDM_Jeskai.translation: 洁斯凯由研习道法的修行僧领导。他们追求思想的统一，并视引导鞑契迈向更美好的未来为己任。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_283_TDM_Sultai.oracleText: The Sultai are necromancers and agriculturalists. They are expert cultivators, using their talents to renew the earth and raise the dead to help lead and serve their clan.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_283_TDM_Sultai.translation: 苏勒台人既是死灵法师，也是农耕者。他们是专业的培育家，运用自身才能复新大地，并唤醒亡者来帮助领导和服务他们的部族。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_284_TDM_Mardu.oracleText: The Mardu are nomadic warriors who defend and expand their territory through their superior agility, expert tactics, and advanced technology.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_284_TDM_Mardu.translation: 玛尔都人是游牧战士，他们通过卓越的敏捷、精湛的战术和先进的技术来保卫和扩张自己的领地。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_285_TDM_Temur.oracleText: The Temur are a semi-nomadic clan who are expert hunters, gatherers, and herders. They work alongside animal companions, with whom they form tight-knit bonds.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_285_TDM_Temur.translation: 铁木尔是一个半游牧部族，他们是专业的猎人、采集者和牧民。他们与动物伙伴并肩工作，彼此之间形成了紧密的联系。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_286_TDM_Betor.oracleText: The dragon Betor is a manifestation of all the lost and drifting Abzan spirits. They view themselves as a collective consciousness, serving as a link between the living and the dead.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_286_TDM_Betor.translation: 巨龙贝托是所有迷失飘零的阿布赞灵魂的化身。它视自己为集体意识，是连接生者与死者的纽带。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_287_TDM_Shiko.oracleText: The dragon Shiko is constantly watching over the Jeskai and helping them work towards a unified Tarkir. In her efforts to remain impartial, she observes from all sides before offering guidance.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_287_TDM_Shiko.translation: 巨龙席科始终守望着洁斯凯，帮助他们为统一鞑契而努力。为了保持公正，她会在给予指引前从各个角度进行观察。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_288_TDM_Teval.oracleText: The dragon Teval is viewed by the Sultai not as a leader, but an arbiter. She is pragmatic and bluntly honest, acting as a balancing force between the khan and other leaders.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_288_TDM_Teval.translation: 巨龙特瓦尔在苏勒台人眼中并非领袖，而是仲裁者。她务实且直言不讳，在可汗与其他领导者之间充当平衡力量。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_289_TDM_Neriv.oracleText: The dragon Neriv was summoned by the Mardu in the hopes of finding unity through their strength of will. He is their marshal, leading them into new lands for battle, and helping guide them towards retreat when it ensures their survival.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_289_TDM_Neriv.translation: 巨龙涅雳伏被玛尔都人召唤而来，他们希望通过意志的力量找到团结。他是他们的元帅，带领他们进入新的地域作战，并在确保生存的情况下指引他们撤退。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_29.oracleText: Aggressive ("aggro") decks look to win quickly with cheap creatures before the opponent can set up effective defenses.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_29.translation: 强攻（「快攻」）套牌偏好使用费用较低的生物，力争在对手建立起有效防御之前赢得胜利。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_290_FIN_SetCod.oracleText: To show only cards from Magic: The Gathering—FINAL FANTASY in the deckbuilder, type "set:FIN" into the search bar. Each set has a unique 3-letter-code.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_290_FIN_SetCod.translation: 要在组牌器中只显示出自万智牌～最终幻想系列的牌张，可在搜索栏中输入「set:FIN」。每个系列都有一个专属的三码代号。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_290_TDM_Ureni.oracleText: The dragon Ureni was summoned by the Temur to help heal and reforge their connection to the land. They are fiercely protective, and will not hesitate to drive out intruders that they believe mean harm to their clan.
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_290_TDM_Ureni.translation: 巨龙乌列尼被铁木尔人召唤而来，帮助他们治愈并重铸与大地的联系。他们极具保护欲，若认为有入侵者意图伤害其部族，绝不会犹豫驱逐之。

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_291_FIN_FF1.oracleText:
The elements of wind, water, earth, and fire, embodied by the four Crystals, once brought balance to the world. Now, a preternatural paradox throws the forces of nature into disarray, threatening to engulf the land in darkness. Although fear grips the populace, hope remains in a prophecy:
"When darkness veils the world, four Warriors of Light shall come."
~ FINAL FANTASY ~
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_291_FIN_FF1.translation:
风、水、土、火，世界原本由象征这四种力量的水晶支撑。如今，黑暗降临，毁灭将至，这是“两千年的时间轮回”昭示的既定命运。然而，即使身处恐惧和不安中，人们还是坚信着一条预言：“当世界被黑暗侵染之时，四名光之战士将现身于世。”人们心怀希望，等待这一天的到来。
~ 最终幻想 ~

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_292_FIN_FF2.oracleText:
The ruthless emperor of Palamecia leads his demonic armies across the land, laying waste to all in his path. When the conflict reaches the borders of Fynn, its people choose to fight and are all but annihilated. The survivors flee to Altair, where they gain the rebellion's trust and join the battle to reclaim their homeland.
~ FINAL FANTASY II ~
Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_292_FIN_FF2.translation:
这是一个发生在遥远世界的故事。
长久的和平被突然打破。帕拉美奇亚帝国的皇帝为满足一己私欲，从魔界召来无数魔物，企图征服世界。
迪斯特、卡修安、巴弗斯科、萨拉曼德……世界各地的城镇一个个毁灭沦陷……
~ 最终幻想 II ~

Match/QueueTips/Queue_Tip_293_FIN_FF3.oracleText:
The Gulgan prophesied: "The earthquake was only the beginning. The tremors that swallowed the crystals, only to spawn monsters from the scarred land, are nothing but harbingers of what is to come. Something fathomless, ominous, and full of sorrow... But hope is not yet lost. Four souls will be blessed with light, and so it begins..."
~ FINAL FANTASY III ~
